a2DPrId.description:
This parameter uniquely identifies an A2DPR object.

The instance defines the default profile for A2 configuration for measurement based CoMP funtionalities.

a2TimeToTriggerCoMp.description: Duration for which the event A2 entry condition or leave condition must be valid at the UE, such that A2 event can be triggered for CoMP/CS purposes
a2TimeToTriggerCoMp.fullName: A2 time to trigger for CoMP/CS

hysThreshold2CoMp.description:
Hysteresis related to RSRP threshold of A2 RSRP event for CoMP/CS.
Parameter is used in the entry and leave condition of the A2 reporting condition by UE. The IE value is multiplied by 2.
hysThreshold2CoMp.fullName: Hysteresis for A2 RSRP CoMP/CS event

threshold2CoMp.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell used in A2 measurement for CoMP/CS 
If value is below threshold2Comp (event A2) then A3 CoMP/CS measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

a2PrId.description:
This parameter uniquely identifies an A2PR object.

The instance defines the profile for A2 configuration for measurement based CoMP funtionalities that allows to configure specific setting in addition to the default profile A2DPR.
If an A2PR configuration is assigned to a cell, all the values defined are used. For parameter that are nor defined, the value of the default profile ADPR is being used for the cell.

acBarSkipForMMTELVideo.description:
Indicates if access barring for  mobile originating MMTEL video  calls within RRC layer is skipped in this cell.
If this parameter is TRUE, eNB indicates UE to skip ACB in RRC layer when UE establishes the RRC connection for mobile originating MMTEL video call; otherwise (i.e. this parameter is FALSE), UE performs ACB in RRC layer. 

Note: SIB2:ssac-barringForMMTEL-Video, if presented, shall always be applicable in UE,  no matter this parameter is configured to TRUE or FALSE.
acBarSkipForMMTELVideo.fullName: Skip Indicator for mobile originating MMTEL video

acBarSkipForMMTELVoice.description:
Indicates if access barring for mobile originating MMTEL voice calls within RRC layer is skipped in this cell.
If this parameter is TRUE, eNB indicates UE to skip ACB in RRC layer when UE establishes the RRC connection for mobile originating MMTEL voice call; otherwise (i.e. this parameter is FALSE), UE performs ACB in RRC layer. 

Note: SIB2:ssac-barringForMMTEL-Voice, if presented, shall always be applicable in UE,  no matter this parameter is configured to TRUE or FALSE.
acBarSkipForMMTELVoice.fullName: Skip Indicator for mobile originating MMTEL voice

acBarSkipForSMS.description:
Indicates if access barring for mobile originating SMSoIP or mobile originating SMS within RRC layer is skipped in this cell.
If this parameter is TRUE, eNB indicates UE to skip ACB in RRC layer when UE establishes the RRC connection for mobile originating SMSoIP or mobile originating SMS over SG/S102. Otherwise (i.e. this parameter is FALSE), UE performs ACB in RRC layer.

Note: SIB8:ac-BarringConfig1XRTT, if presented, shall always be applicable in UE,  no matter this parameter is configured to TRUE or FALSE.
acBarSkipForSMS.fullName: Skip Indicator for mobile originating SMSoIP or SMS

This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC ACBPR.
It uniquely identifies an ACBPR instance.

acbScEcBitmask.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "acb Sc Ec (chip energy; part of the WCDMA Ec/No signal-quality ratio) Bitmask" on the ACBPR object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

barAC.description:
Access class barring list (5 bit) for originating CS fallback.
Access class barring list (5 bit) for originating CS fallback for AC 11-15 (leftmost bit is for AC 11, the second bit in the list is for AC 12, and so on...).
barAC.fullName: Max auto access class barring list for CS fallback
barAC.officialRange:
Bit 0:AC 11:0:N; Bit 1:AC 12:0:N; Bit 2:AC 13:0:N; Bit 3:AC 14:0:N; 
Bit 4:AC 15:0:N; Bit 5:::; Bit 6:::; Bit 7:::

barTime.description:
Defines the access class barring time.
The access class barring time defines the time that the access barring check remains unsuccessful while the UE is not performing an emergency call. In this case, the UE starts timer T305 using Tbarring value.

Note:Tbarring = (0.7+0.6* rand) * ac-BarringTime
barTime.fullName: Max auto access class barring time for CS fallback

cellResHoBlockPlmnAcbMax.description: Indicates if the cell/PLMN combination is reserved for operator use and incoming handovers for the combination are blocked when ACB max step is reached as a result of step-wise PLMN ACB. Note that this functionality only applies for the PLMN associated with the ACBPR.
cellResHoBlockPlmnAcbMax.fullName: Automatic handover blocking and cell reserved for PLMN

eCallAcBarredAuto.description:
Indicates that access is barred for emergency calls in this cell when automatic AC barring broadcast condition is met due to BTS C-plane overload or number of RRC connections.
Access Class barring for AC 10.
The access barred for emergency calls flag indicates that access is barred for emergency calls in this cell.

In case of RRC connection triggered ACB emergency calls becomes barred after acbEcTimer expiration.
eCallAcBarredAuto.fullName: Auto access barred for emergency calls

eCallAcBarredStatic.description:
Indicates that access is barred for emergency calls in this cell.
Access Class barring for AC 10.
The access barred for emergency calls flag indicates that access is barred for emergency calls in this cell.
eCallAcBarredStatic.fullName: Static access barred for emergency calls

emerHoBlockPlmnAcbMax.description: Indicates if incoming emergency handovers are also blocked for the cell/PLMN combination when ACB max step is reached as a result of step-wise PLMN ACB. Note that this functionality only applies for the PLMN associated with the ACBPR and only when cellResHoBlockPlmnAcbMax is set to 'reserved'.
emerHoBlockPlmnAcbMax.fullName: Emergency handover blocking in max PLMN barring step

hoBlockPlmnAcbMaxOnly.description: When enabled, restricts handover blocking based on target-PLMN access barring so it only applies when Access Class Barring for that PLMN is at its maximum (most restrictive) setting.

probFac.description:
Defines the maximum barring threshold and  probability for a UE to establish an RRC connection.
The access probability factor defines the probability for a UE to establish an RRC connection.
The UE draws a random number (0 <= rand < 1). If rand is higher than the value indicated by the access probability factor, the UE considers the access barring check to be unsuccessful.
probFac.fullName: Max auto access probability factor for CS fallback

actCnumLdapClientAcctSup.description: Activates support for LDAP-based centralized user-account management (CNUM) as an LDAP client, integrating local login authentication with a central directory.

actParallelUserSessions.description:
This flag activates multiple parallel BTS user sessions from the BTSSM.

If the flag is false(default), then just 1 session is allowed. If the flag is true, maximum of 5 parallel user sessions are allowed.

amgrId.description: This parameter identifies the account manager.

btsEMRestrictedAccess.description: When enabled, restricts local craft/Element Manager access to the BTS, limiting who can log in via the local management interface.

checkCnumPasswdExpiry.description: This parameter determines whether BTS checks the password aging related information for CNUM accounts returned by LDAP server.

enableCnumLdapCtrlAlarm.description: Enables an alarm raised when the LDAP-based centralized user-account-management connection/control fails.

enableDefaultPasswdAlarm.description: Enables raising a fault-management alarm when a default (factory-set) password is still in use, prompting the operator to change it for security.

ldapConnectionType.description: This parameter holds the TLS access mode for the LDAP server(s) of the BTS. The values are "TLS" (allows only secured connections) and "TLS_OR_PLAIN_TEXT" (allow both unsecured and secured connections).

ldapPortPrimary.description: This parameter holds the port number of the primary LDAP server.
ldapPortPrimary.fullName: Port number of the primary LDAP server

ldapServerPrimary.description: This parameter holds the IP address of the primary LDAP server. The IPv4 is in dotted decimal format  or IPv6 in format defined in RFC4291.
ldapServerPrimary.fullName: IP address of the primary LDAP server

amlePrId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC AMLEPR and it uniquely identifies an instance of the Active Mode Load Equalization Profile (AMLEPR).

If the feature "Inter-frequency load equalization" is activated, a default AMLEPR profile with AMLEPR-amlePrId = 0 must exist.
amlePrId.fullName: Active mode load equalization profile identifier

cacHeadroom.description: The active mode load equalization feature in direction to a certain target cell shall leave the 'active state', if the reported CAC value from this target cell is smaller than the CAC headroom for the target cells frequency layer.

deltaCac.description: Active mode load equalization shall be applied only if the difference in composite available capacity (CAC) in source and target cells is above this target frequency-specific value.
deltaCac.fullName: Difference in CAC of source and target cells

maxCacThreshold.description: Active mode load equalization shall be applied only if the composite available capacity (CAC) in the source cell falls below this target frequency-specific threshold.

targetCarrierFreq.description: This parameter describes the FDD/TDD EUTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the (downlink) frequency layer this inter-frequency load equalization profile (AMLEPR) is valid for.

amlePrSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC AMLEPRSPARE.
It uniquely identifies an AMLEPRSPARE instance.
amlePrSpareId.fullName: Active Mode Load Equalization Profile spare

name.description:
This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.
name.fullName: Active Mode Load Equalization Profile spare

value.description:
This is the value of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The allowed parameter values are defined in the feature specification.

The value of this spare parameter must be according to the provided information. It need to be case sensitive. In case the specified value doesn't match the supported values for this spare parameter, the BTS will reject the configuration.
value.fullName: Active Mode Load Equalization Profile spare

actAutoLteNeighRemoval.description: Activates autonomous removal of unused LTE neighbour relation and neighbour information
actAutoLteNeighRemoval.fullName: Activate autonomous removal of LTE neighbours

actAutoNrNeighRemoval.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Auto NR (5G New Radio) Neigh Removal" on the ANR object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actAutoRttNeighRemoval.description:
Activates autonomous removal of unused CDMA2000 1xRTT neighbour relation and neighbour cell configuration information



NOTE:  activation of 1xRTT autonomous removal function is independent of actAnrRtt enabled for 1xANR or not.

actAutoUtranNeighRemoval.description: Activates autonomous removal of unused UTRAN neighbour relation and neighbour cell configuration information
actAutoUtranNeighRemoval.fullName: Activate autonomous removal of UTRAN neighbours

actX2IpV4Prioritization.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable X 2 IP V 4 Prioritization" on the ANR object. anrId.description:
This parameter uniquely identifies an ANR object.

The instance defines basic ANR configuration parameters  which are not related to a dedicated carrier frequency.

anrIfTRSC.description: It defines the maximum time at the eNB to wait for an LTE inter-frequency ReportStrongestCells measurement report from a UE configured to perform such measurement

anrNrCoverageConfirmTimer.description: Time the eNodeB waits, via repeated measurements, to confirm stable NR coverage before finalising an automatically discovered NR neighbor relation.

anrNrHoNbrRelRemGuardTime.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "Automatic Neighbor Relation NR (5G New Radio) handover neighbor relation Rem Guard Time" on the ANR object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

anrNrInactivityTimer.description: Inactivity timer for the NR-related ANR function: an unused NR neighbor candidate relation is aged out or reconsidered after this period of inactivity.

anrNrNbrHoRelVerifyPeriod.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "Automatic Neighbor Relation NR (5G New Radio) neighbor handover relation Verify Period" on the ANR object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

anrNrNbrRelRemGuardTime.description: Guard time before an NR neighbor relation flagged for removal is actually deleted by ANR, allowing time to reverse the decision if the relation becomes used again.

anrRobLevel.description:
Specifies the level of robustness of UE-based ANR functions. 
- For high level of robustness, eNB attempts for a longer time period to resolve a detected unknown neighbour cell via UE-based ANR before stopping these attempts.
- For high level of robustness, the minimum wait time between re-validations of the same Neighbour Relation becomes shorter.
anrRobLevel.officialRange:
0: none 
1: very low 
2: low 
3: middle 
4: high 
5: very high

anrRobLevelUtran.description:
Specifies the level of robustness of UTRAN UE-based ANR functions. 
* For high level of robustness, eNB attempts for a longer time period to resolve a detected unknown neighbour cell via UE-based ANR before stopping these attempts.
* For high level of robustness, the minimum wait time between re-validations of the same Neighbour Relation becomes shorter
anrRobLevelUtran.officialRange:
0: none 
1: very low 
2: low 
3: middle 
4: high 
5: very high

anrRttTRSCFS.description: It defines the maximum time eNB waits for an activated ReportStrongestCellForSon measurement report on an 1xRTT carrier frequency of the LTE cell.

anrUtraTRSCFS.description: It defines the maximum time eNB waits for an activated ReportStrongestCellForSon measurement report on an UTRAN carrier frequency.

autoUtraNeighRemovalThres.description: Autonomous removal of UTRAN neighbors is applied by eNB only if the number of UTRAN neighbors for the respective eNB cell and UTRAN carrier exceeds this threshold.

consec5gHoFailThres.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "consec 5 g handover Fail Thres" on the ANR object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

consecHoFailThres.description:
If for a LTE Neighbour Relation (NR) 'consecHoFailThres' consecutive handover execution failures are observed, then the eNB triggers a re-validation for this NR via CGI measurement (if CGI measurements are allowed).

If 'consecHoFailThres=0', then no re-validation is triggered.
Note: To limit the load due to re-validations, eNB triggers  re-validation only if at least some minimum wait time since last validation of the same NR has expired.
consecHoFailThres.fullName: Consecutive handover execution failure re-validation TH

consecUtranHoFailThres.description:
If for an UTRAN Neighbour Relation (UtranNR) 'consecUtranHoFailThres' consecutive UTRAN handover execution failures are observed, then the eNB triggers a re-validation for this UtranNR via CGI measurement (if CGI measurements are allowed).

If 'consecUtranHoFailThres=0', then no re-validation is triggered.

Note: To limit the load due to re-validations, eNB triggers  re-validation only if at least some minimum wait time since last validation of the same UtranNR has expired.
consecUtranHoFailThres.fullName: Consecutive UTRAN HO execution failure re-validation TH

dlEarfcn.description: Downlink EARFCN of the neighbour cell included in the 'pciIpAdrMap'

enbId.description:
Macro eNB Id of the Global eNB Id of a neighbour eNB towards which no establishment of an eNB Controlled X2-link is allowed.
If ‘enbId’ is not provided then the associated ‘Global eNB Id’ is a ‘partially specified Global eNB Id’, i.e.:
All ‘Global eNB Ids’ with a PLMN ID which is identical to the associated 'X2 Blacklisted PLMN ID' are considered as members of the 'Global eNB Id X2-link Blacklist'.

idleTimeThresLteNR.description:
The eNB may autonomously remove a LTE NR, if the LTE NR is not used for handover for at least the time 'idleTimeThresLteNR'.


Notes: 
* LTE NRs which are 'reserved by operator' are not autonomously removed by eNB
* The eNB checks once per hour if a LTE NR has to be removed
Note:  It is recommended to chose 'idleTimeThresLteNR' to be smaller than 'idleTimeThresX2' to avoid that one eNB may autonomously close an X2 link and the peer eNB re-esatblishes the X2 link again, because autonomous removal of associated unused Neighbour Relations did not yet occur.
Note: It is recommended to chose 'idleTimeThresLteNR' to be greater than 24 hours if a Load-based power saving feature is activated at the eNB ('actLBPowerSaving' = 'true' or 'actLBRTXPowerSaving' = 'true') to avoid the autonomous removal of Neighbor Relations due to either the serving cell or the neighbor cell being switched off into the 'energySavingState' = 'energySaving' state or having transmit power reduced due to switched off TX paths when the 'energySavingState' = 'reducedEnergySaving.
idleTimeThresLteNR.fullName: Idle Time Threshold for LTE Neighbour Relations

idleTimeThresNbEnbExch.description:
If the maximum number of LTE neighbour eNBs is already stored, then a stored neighbour eNB may be exchanged against a neighbour eNB newly detected via CGI measurement only, if the idle time for the stored neighbour eNB is at least equal to 'idleTimeThresNbeNBExch'.

If 'idleTimeThresNbeNBExch' is set to '0', then no exchange of LTE neighbour eNBs is triggered.
idleTimeThresNbEnbExch.fullName: Idle Time Threshold for Neighbour eNB Exchange

idleTimeThresNbeNB.description:
If for at least the time “idleTimeThresNbeNB” an enbControlled NbeNB no NR and no X2 link is available, then the eNB removes the LNADJ/ LNADJL objects associated with the NbeNB

Notes: 
* Neighbour eNBs and Neighbour Cells which are associated with an oamControlled LNADJ object are not autonomouosly removed by eNB
* The eNB checks once per hour if a LTE NR has to be removed
idleTimeThresNbeNB.fullName: Idle Time Threshold for Neighbour eNBs

idleTimeThresRttNR.description:
The eNB may autonomously remove a 1xRTT NR corresponding to a 1xRTT neighbour cell, only if the 1xRTT NR is not detected in 1xRTT mobility measurement reports for at least the time 'idleTimeThresRttNR' on the 1xRTT carrier of the LTE cell.


Notes: 
* 1xRTT NRs corresponding to 1xRTT neighbour cells which are  indicated with 'removeAllowed=false' are not autonomously removed by eNB
* The eNB checks once per hour if a 1xRTT NR has to be removed
idleTimeThresRttNR.fullName: Idle time threshold for 1xRTT neighbour relations

idleTimeThresUtranNR.description:
The eNB may autonomously remove a UTRAN NR corresponding to a WCDMA neighbour cell, if the UTRAN NR is not used by UTRAN mobility management for at least the time 'idleTimeThresUtranNR'.


Notes: 
* UTRAN NRs corresponding to WCDMA neighbour cells which are  indicated with 'removeAllowed=false' are not autonomously removed by eNB
* The eNB checks once per hour if a UTRAN NR has to be removed
idleTimeThresUtranNR.fullName: Idle time threshold for UTRAN neighbour relations

idleTimeThresX2.description:
If for an enbControlled X2 link no LTE Neighbour Relation exists and if for at least the time “idleTimeThresX2” no X2 handover is received, then the eNB autonomously closes the X2 link.

Notes: 
* oamControlled X2 links are not autonomouosly closed by eNB
* The eNB checks once per hour if a X2 link has to be closed.
Note: It is recommended to chose 'idleTimeThresX2' to be larger than 'idleTimeThresLteNR' to avoid that one eNB may autonomously close an X2 link and the peer eNB re-esatblishes the X2 link again, because autonomous removal of associated unused Neighbour Relations did not yet occur.
idleTimeThresX2.fullName: Idle Time Threshold for X2 links

ipAdr.description: X2 C-plane V4/V6 IP address of the eNB serving the cell included in the 'pciIpAdrMap'

maxNumX2LinksIn.description: If the number of eNB-controlled X2-links reaches 'maxNumX2LinksIn', then the eNB shall stop accepting establishment requests for new eNB-controlled X2-links from neighbour eNBs
maxNumX2LinksIn.fullName: Maximum number of eNB-controlled incoming X2-links

maxNumX2LinksOut.description: If the number of eNB-controlled X2-links reaches 'maxNumX2LinksOut', then the eNB shall stop the automatic establishment of new eNB-controlled X2-links
maxNumX2LinksOut.fullName: Maximum number of eNB-controlled outgoing X2-links

mcc.description: Mobile Country Code of  the Global eNB Id of a neighbour eNB towards which no establishment of an eNB Controlled X2-link is allowed.
mcc.fullName: X2 blacklisted global eNB id MCC

minNotActivatedRttRSCFS.description:
This parameter defines the minimum time interval that should elapse since the last search of possible unknown PCIs on a 1xRTT carrier frequency of the LTE cell, before re-initiating a new search on that carrier. 

Via this parameter, it is possible to control the minimum frequency according which a 1xRTT carrier frequency in slow search mode is scanned for potential new neighbor cell detection. 

If value "0" is selected, all 1xRTT carrier frequencies for 1xRTT ANR will always be in fast Active search.

minNotActivatedUtraRSCFS.description: This parameter defines the minimum time interval that should elapse since the last search of possible unknown PCIs, respectively PSCs, on an UTRAN carrier frequency, before re-initiating a new search on that carrier. Via this parameter, it is possible to control the maximum frequency according which an UTRAN carrier frequency in slow search mode is scanned for potential new neighbor cell detection. If value "0" is selected, the respective UTRAN carrier frequency will always be in fast Active search.

minNumThresRttNR.description: The eNB may autonomously remove a 1xRTT NR corresponding to a 1xRTT neighbour cell, only if the number of 1xRTT neighbor relations (LNRELX instances) on the related CDMA2000 1xRTT carrier frequency of a LTE cell  is larger than 'minNumThresRttNR'.
minNumThresRttNR.fullName: Minimum number threshold of 1xRTT neighbor relations

mnc.description: Mobile Network Code of  the Global eNB Id of a neighbour eNB towards which no establishment of an eNB Controlled X2-link is allowed.
mnc.fullName: X2 blacklisted global eNB id MNC

mncLength.description: Length of Mobile Network Code of  the Global eNB Id of a neighbour eNB towards which no establishment of an eNB Controlled X2-link is allowed.
mncLength.fullName: X2 blacklisted global eNB id MNC length

nbEnbExchWaitTmr.description: If the eNB performs a Neighbour eNB exchange, then the eNB will afterwards wait for at least the time given by ‘nbEnbExchWaitTmr’, before the next Neighbour eNB exchange may be triggered.

pci.description: Physical Cell Identity of the neighbour cell included in the 'pciIpAdrMap'

s1PrdRevalWaitTmr.description:
If for an inter-eNB LTE Neighbour Relation (NR) without available X2 link a handover preparation is started and since the last validation of the NR at least  the time 's1PrdRevalWaitTmr' has elapsed, then eNB triggers a re-validation for this NR via CGI measurement (if CGI measurements are allowed).

If 's1PrdRevalWaitTmr' is set to '0', then no re-validation is triggered.
Note 1: To limit the load due to re-validations, eNB triggers  re-validation only if at least some minimum wait time since last validation of the same NR has expired.
Note 2: To retrieve the CGI measurement for the re-validation, the eNB will start Active ANR mode and use a UE different from the one which needs the handover.

samNumThresRttNR.description: The eNB may autonomously remove a 1xRTT NR corresponding to a 1xRTT neighbour cell, only if the number of sent  1xRTT  mobility measurement activation request on the related CDMA2000 1xRTT carrier frequency of a LTE cell  is larger than or equal to 'samNumThresRttNR ' during the consective time period when the unknown 1xRTT NR is not detected in 1xRTT mobility measurement reports.
samNumThresRttNR.fullName: Sample Number threshold of 1xRTT measurement reports

tTmpBlacklistRttANR.description:
This timer is used for temporary blacklisting of a 1xRTT neighbor Cell for 1xANR on a 1xRTT carrier of the LTE cell.

The timer is started for a 1xRTT neighbor cell, when it is temporarily blacklisted due to auto removal.

When timer expires,  the temporary blacklisting for that 1xRTT neighbor cell is removed.

If value "0" is selected, the temporary blacklisting mechanism is disabled.

utranPrdRevalWaitTmr.description:
If for an UTRAN Neighbour Relation (UtranNR) a UTRAN handover procedure is started and since the last validation of UtranNR at least  the time 'utranPrdRevalWaitTmr' has elapsed, then eNB triggers a re-validation for this UtranNR via CGI measurement (if CGI measurements are allowed).

If 'utranPrdRevalWaitTmr' is set to '0', then no re-validation is triggered.

Note: To limit the load due to re-validations, eNB triggers  re-validation only if at least some minimum wait time since last validation of the same UtranNR has expired.

x2PrdRevalWaitTmr.description:
If for an intra-eNB LTE Neighbour Relation (NR), respectively for an inter-eNB NR with available X2 link a handover preparation is started and since the last validation of the NR at least  the time 'x2PrdRevalWaitTmr' has elapsed, then eNB triggers a re-validation for this NR via CGI measurement (if CGI measurements are allowed).

If 'x2PrdRevalWaitTmr' is set to '0', then no re-validation is triggered.
Note 1: To limit the load due to re-validations, eNB triggers  re-validation only if at least some minimum wait time since last validation of the same NR has expired.
Note 2: To retrieve the CGI measurement for the re-validation, the eNB will start Active ANR mode and use a UE different from the one which needs the handover.

actAlsoForUeBasedANR.description:
Activates the profile for UE-based intra- and/or inter-frequency ANR (LTE556, LTE782) too.

If set to "true" the profile applies for any kind of ANR, that is UE-based and not UE-based. If set to "false" the profile is not applied for UE-based ANR but still applied for not UE-based ANR features (for example LTE492).

anrPrLId.description:
This parameter uniquely identifies an ANRPRL object.

An Automatic Neighbor Relationship Profile (ANRPRL) defines carrier-frequency-specific settings for automatic detection of LTE intra-frequency and inter-frequency neighbor cells.

anrThresRSRPNbCell.description:
If RSRP of a neighbor cell included in ANR measurement "reportStrongestCells"  is greater than anrThresRSRPNbCell, then a cell is accepted by eNB as a neighbor cell for which CGI is needed.

The parameter is relevant only if at least one of the features; LTE782 or LTE556, is activated, that is if actUeBasedAnrIntraFreqLte and/or actUeBasedAnrInterFreqLte is set to "true".
anrThresRSRPNbCell.fullName: ANR power level threshold for neighbor cells

anrThresRSRPNbCellMobEv.description:
Threshold to control detection of neighbour cells via passive ANR.

If a measurement report for the mobility events A3, A4 or A5 is received, then the cell corresponding to an included PCI can be accepted as 'candidate cell for ANR' only if the PCI fulfills the condition:
RSRP(PCI) > anrThres RSRPNbCellMobEv.
The parameter is only relevant if at least one of the features LTE492, LTE782 or LTE556 is activated, i.e. if anrOmExtEnable or actUeBasedAnrIntraFreqLte or actUeBasedAnrInterFreqLte is set to 'true'.

Passive ANR can be switched off by setting the threshold to a very high value.
anrThresRSRPNbCellMobEv.fullName: ANR power level threshold for mobility events

anrThresRSRQNbCell.description:
The eNB will request to resolve the CGI of unknown cells only if the respective RSRQ level measured by the UE is at least equal to anrThresRSRQNbCell.

The parameter is relevant only if at least one of the features; LTE782 or LTE556, is activated, that is if actUeBasedAnrIntraFreqLte and/or actUeBasedAnrInterFreqLte is set to "true".
anrThresRSRQNbCell.fullName: ANR quality threshold for neighbor cells

nrLimitInterFreq.description:
Once the number of LTE inter-frequency neighbor relations of the eNB cell reaches "nrLimitInterFreq", the eNB stops autonomous learning of new neighbor cells via ANR. 
Note: The number of inter-frequency neighbor relations can exceed this limit since new neighbor cells/new neighbor relations still can be configured via O&M and autonomous creation of neighbor relations for already available neighbor cells might occur.

nrLimitIntraFreq.description:
Once the number of LTE intra-frequency neighbor relations of the eNB cell reaches "nrLimitIntraFreq", the eNB stops autonomous learning of new neighbor cells via ANR. 
Note: The number of intra-frequency neighbor relations can exceed this limit since new neighbor cells/new neighbor relations still can be configured via O&M and autonomous creation of neighbor relations for already available neighbor cells might occur.

targetCarrierFreq.description: This parameter describes the FDD/TDD EUTRA absolute radio frequency channel number (EARFCN) of the (downlink) frequency layer this inter-frequency load equalization profile (AMLEPR) is valid for.

anrPrLSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC ANRPRLSPARE.
It uniquely identifies an ANRPRLSPARE instance.
anrPrLSpareId.fullName: Automatic Neighbor Relationship Profile LTE spare

This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.

anrPrWId.description:
This parameter uniquely identifies an ANRPRW object.

An Automatic Neighbor Relationship Profile (ANRPRW) defines carrier-frequency-specific settings for automatic detection of WCDMA neighbor cells.

anrUtraEcNoThres.description: It defines the minimum EcNo level measured by the UE from a UTRAcell required for ordering its CGI decoding. (Mapping between the UE measured EcNo and the SFS values is according to 3GPP TS 25.133/25.123).

anrUtraRscpThres.description:
It defines the minimum power level that a UE should report from a measured UTRA cell for considering the corresponding PCI, respectively PSC, as a possible UTRA neighbor cell candidate. (Mapping between the UE measured RSCP and the SFS values is according to 3GPP TS 25.133/25.123)
The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 25.133:
* -120 dBm means a threshold lower than -120 dBm
* values between -119 dBm and -25 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -24 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -25 dBm

cellsToApplyList.description:
The parameter allows to restrict the ANR profile to certain LTE cells that are identified by their lncelId.
If the parameter is omitted or the list is empty the profile is considered as default profile, which applies to all cells with no dedicated profile.

csfbPsHoAllowed.description: The parameter controls whether CSFB with PS handover to the related neighbor cell is allowed.
csfbPsHoAllowed.fullName: Circuit-switched fallback with PS handover allowed

enableAnrProfile.description: The parameter enables ANR learning for the carrier frequency of the profile.

lnRelWLimitForAnr.description:
The parameter allows limiting the number of WCDMA neighbor relations (LNRELW instances) per UTRAN carrier frequency and LTE cell. 

This limit applies only for ANR created LNRELW instances but does not apply for LNRELW instances, which are manually created via plan file. 

If the limit is already reached or even exceeded by manually created LNRELW instances, no additional LNRELW instances referring to WCDMA neighbor cells with the profile carrier frequency will be added by ANR.

If the number of neighbor relations (LNRELW instances) exceeds the maximum number of WCDMA neighbor cells which might be used by eNB in measurement configurations (limit in 3GPP 36.331) but the limit which ich configured with lnRelWLimitForAnr is not yet reached, then eNB will create new LNLRELW instances with handoverAllowed set to 'forbidden'. This is to ease further manual optimization of neighbour cell blacklisting.
lnRelWLimitForAnr.fullName: Limit for ANR created UTRAN neighbor relations

psHoAllowed.description: The parameter controls whether PS handover to the related neighbor cell is allowed.

psc.description: Single PSC value or first PSC value of a range that is blacklisted.

pscLast.description: Last PSC value if a range of PSC values are blacklisted.
pscLast.fullName: Last primary scrambling code of a range

redirWithSysInfoAllowed.description: The parameter controls whether the related neighbor cell shall be a candidate for providing system information in case of UE redirection to UTRAN.

rncIdAlignment.description: The parameter defines whether the RNC-ID is aligned to the left or right side within Cell Identity.

rncIdType.description: The parameter defines whether the RNC Id is of type 'normal' (12 Bit) or 'extended' (16 Bit).

srvccAllowed.description: The parameter controls whether SRVCC handover to the related neighbor cell is allowed.
srvccAllowed.fullName: Single radio Voice call continuity allowed

srvccHoInd.description:
This parameter selects if SRVCC to a WCDMA target cell is performed as a combined PS and CS SRVCC or whether SRVCC is performed for the CS bearer only.

The value is used if a new LNADJW object is created by eNB because of ANR measurements and if the profile applies for the detecting LTE cell.

The value is only relevant if the feature LTE872 'SRVCC to WCDMA' is deployed. It is highly recommended to set this value properly even if the feature is not yet deployed but shall be deployed in future. Otherwise manual setting in all LNADJW objects becomes necessary later on if the feature LTE872 is activated.
It is a capability of the target UTRAN whether 'combined PS and CS SRVCC' or 'CS SRVCC only' are supported.

utraCarrierFreq.description: The parameter identifies the UTRA carrier frequency for which this ANR profile applies.

anrPrWSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC ANRPRWSPARE.
It uniquely identifies an ANRPRWSPARE instance.
anrPrWSpareId.fullName: Automatic Neighbor Relationship Profile WCDMA spare

name.description:
This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.
name.fullName: Automatic Neighbor Relationship Profile WCDMA spare

value.description:
This is the value of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The allowed parameter values are defined in the feature specification.

The value of this spare parameter must be according to the provided information. It need to be case sensitive. In case the specified value doesn't match the supported values for this spare parameter, the BTS will reject the configuration.
value.fullName: Automatic Neighbor Relationship Profile WCDMA spare

anrPrXId.description:
This parameter uniquely identifies an ANRPRX object.

An Automatic Neighbour Relationship Profile (ANRPRX) defines carrier frequency specific settings for automatic detection of 1xRTT neighbor cells.

anrRttPstrThres.description:
It defines the minimum pilot strength that a UE must report from a measured 1xRTT cell for considering the corresponding unknown PCI as a possible 1xRTT neighbor cell candidate.
Value of this parameter should be tuned according to real field network deployment & 1xRTT mobility service (1xCSFB, 1xSRVCC, etc), to control the speed of 1xRTT neighbour cell detections on the 1xRTT carrier.

Per 3GPP 36.331, the value range of the pilotStrength in the measurement report is 0..63. 63 is the weakest pilot strength, while 0 is the strongest pilot strength.

The formula used by the UE to report the pilot strength is [ -2 * 10 * log (measured pilot strength)].
Therefore 63 maps to -31.5 dB. So 0..63 maps to 0..-31.5 dB.

cellsToApplyList.description:
The parameter allows to restrict the ANR profile only applicable to certain LTE cells which are identified by their lncelId.
If the parameter is omitted or if the list is empty,  the ANR profile is considered as default ANR profile which applies to all LTE cells with no dedicated ANR profile for the related 1xRTT carrier.

e1xCsfbAllowed.description: The parameter controls whether R9 e1xCSFB to the related 1xRTT neighbor cell is allowed.

enableAnrProfile.description: The parameter enables ANR learning for the carrier frequency of the ANR profile in the applicable LTE cells.

lnRelXLimitForAnr.description:
The parameter allows limiting the number of 1xRTT neighbor relations (LNRELX instances) per CDMA2000 1xRTT carrier frequency and LTE cell. 

This limit applies only for ANR created LNRELX instances but does not apply for LNRELX instances, which are manually created via plan file. 

If the limit is already reached or even exceeded by manually created LNRELX instances, no additional LNRELX instances referring to 1xRTT neighbor cells with the profile carrier frequency will be added by ANR.
lnRelXLimitForAnr.fullName: Limit for ANR created 1xRTT neighbor relations

pci.description: Single PCI value or first PCI value of a range which shall be statically blacklisted.

pciLast.description: Last PCI value if a range of PCI values shall be statically blacklisted.
pciLast.fullName: Last physical cell identifier of a range

rttArfcn.description:
Absolute Radio Frequency Number of CDMA2000 1xRTT carrier frequency
The CDMA2000 ARFCN used to indicate the CDMA2000 carrier frequency within a CDMA2000 band, see C.S0002-A.

rttBandClass.description:
Band Class of CDMA2000 1xRTT carrier frequency
The CDMA2000 band class is used to define the CDMA2000 band in which the CDMA2000 carrier frequency can be found, as defined in C.S0057-E [table 1.5-1].
Note: Bandclasses 18, 19, 20 and 21 are not supported by this release.

srvccAllowed.description: The parameter controls whether SRVCC handover to the related 1xRTT neighbor cell is allowed.
srvccAllowed.fullName: Single Radio Voice Call Continuity allowed

antPortId.description: Identifies the specific antenna port in Radio Module for antenna line.

antennaLabel.description:
The user can freely define any site specific information with this parameter. 
Note: The parameter is persistently stored but not used/modified by the BTS.

antennaPathDelayDL.description: The total delay of all the passive units of an antenna line in downlink direction used as the RTT value in delay compensation in BTS.
antennaPathDelayDL.fullName: Antenna round trip delay in download path

antennaPathDelayUL.description: The total delay of all the passive units of an antenna line in uplink direction used as the RTT value in delay compensation in BTS.
antennaPathDelayUL.fullName: Antenna round trip delay in upload path

antennaPathDeltaGroupDelay.description: Defines how much antenna path UL group delay is higher than antenna path DL group delay. If devices like filters, multiplexers or MHAs are used then antennaPathDeltaGroupDelay should be set according to their properties based on technical specifications. For a plain antenna line, without any signal forwarding devices, antennaPathDeltaGroupDelay is expected to be 0ns.

antennaRoundTripDelay.description:
The total delay of all the passive units of an antenna line can be entered into this parameter, which is then used as the RTT value in delay compensation in BTS.
This value is one of factors used to dynamically calculate signal latency between System Module and Antenna. Modifying it may therefore require to change  parameter actDistributedSite to true.
BTS will dynamically decide if BTS restart or dropping of all cells is needed.
Some RF modules require that all ANTL connected to them are configured with the same value of antennaRoundTripDelay. As the list depends on details of HW realization and will change by introduction of new RMOD variants, a list of affected modules will be provided in Operator hints

antlId.description: This parameter defines the specific antenna line in radio unit.

cIBAdvance.description:
Specifies the timing advance to be added to the transmit signal in the designated path to compensate for the transmit signal delay due to a Constant Impedance Block (CIB) in that path. 
This parameter is applicable to the U type (ex-Motorola) radios only.

BTS will dynamically decide if BTS restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

cwaThreshold.description: Defines a configurable current window alarm threshold level on the antenna line. This threshold is active only if there is passive MHA unit on the line. If value is set to 0 then monitoring is disabled. This parameter is used to raise "Mast Head Amplifier above current window".

dcVoltage.description: Defines the voltage level used in the antenna line.

hdlcCommunicationAllowed.description: Defines if communication with AISG compliant devices is enabled/disabled for RET port.

repeaterDelay.description:
Defines the Delay Equalizer delay for cell assigned to the Repeater Interface Unit.
This value is one of factors used to dynamically calculate signal latency between System Module and Antenna. Modifying it may therefore require to change  parameter actDistributedSite to true.

BTS will dynamically decide if BTS restart or dropping of cells is needed.

rxSensitivity.description:
Sensitivity setting for a RF unit.
Parameter is only applicable for radio modules supporting RF sensitivity setting.

totalLoss.description: This parameter contains the total loss.

ulDelay.description: Antenna Line Uplink Delay in nanoseconds, is used to compensate the antenna line UL delay difference between main and diversity Rx branches of the cell. This is needed to avoid gain (i.e. performance) loss due to the time difference between Rx branches data. For example, offset of 1/2 chip period (130ns) introduces diversity gain degradation of about 1dB. Different delays are met e.g. when two radio modules are cross-connected together via RX diversity outputs. User may provide absolute UL delay values for all Rx branches of the cell, or optionally only the positive difference referred to the smallest delay branch and leave smallest delay branch value to zero. It's not required to apply the UL delay when the delay for Rx branches of the cell are about equal. Note: Multiradio Combiner (MRC) delay shall not be included in this parameter. The MRC delays are taken into account as default by the system when the Multiradio Combiner is commissioned into use.
ulDelay.fullName: Uplink delay for the delay compensation

useMeasuredRoundTripDelay.description:
This parameter defines if BTS should use delay values measured by the system or given manually by the operator.
To minimize cell impact this parameter does not imply immidiate delay value usage. New delay values will be applied only after next BTS or RF module reset (manual or autonomous).

vswrAlarmTxPwrThreshold.description:
Defines minimum level of TX power required for raising VSWR (voltage standing wave ratio) related faults.

Note: Default threshold value shall be used in typical cases. The parameter might be adjusted to reduce number of false VSWR alarms only when the alarms are caused by known issues with interferences between antenna lines.

Note: Adjustment of TX power threshold is supported by RP1 Flexi Radio’s Rel2.1 or higher. For other hardware variant units, the parameter is ignored.

Note: During online commissioning, Element Manager will limit maximal allowed value of the parameter basing on maximal TX carrier power supported by the hardware variant, decreasing this value by 10dB additionally.
vswrAlarmTxPwrThreshold.fullName: TX power threshold for VSWR alarms

vswrMajorThreshold.description:
Defines a VSWR (voltage standing wave ratio) major alarm level.
With radio module/RRH rel. 4 restricted range 2.7 - 3.5 shall be used.

If ANTL is connected to a radio with cpriARfSharing set to SECONDARY, vswr alarms cannot be set.

vswrMinorThreshold.description:
Defines a VSWR (voltage standing wave ratio) minor alarm level.
With radio module/RRH rel. 4 restricted range 1.5 - 2.9 shall be used.

If ANTL is connected to a radio with cpriARfSharing set to SECONDARY, vswr alarms cannot be set.

aPucchAddAUeRrHo.description:
Additional margin in automatic PUCCH allocation to be considered for the maximum number of active UEs in the cell accessing the cell via handover with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons".

This additional margin is used also for UEs accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause:   “Reduce load in serving cell” but only when Composite Available Capacity (CAC) in the Cell is bigger than 0. If CAC in the Cell is zero, the HO for "Reduce load in serving cell" are always rejected. This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActUE.
aPucchAddAUeRrHo.fullName: Automatic PUCCH allocation, add number UEs RR HO

aPucchAddAUeTcHo.description: Additional margin in automatic PUCCH allocation to be considered for the maximum number of active UEs in the cell accessing the cell via handover with HO-cause: "Time Critical HO". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActUE.
aPucchAddAUeTcHo.fullName: Automatic PUCCH allocation, add number UEs TC HO

aPucchMinNumEmergencySessions.description:
Minimum number reserved for Emergency Sessions.
This margin increases the thresholds for active UEs, active DRBs and active QCI1-DRBs in the cell. Please note that active QCI1-DRBs thresholds are not considered when actEnhAcAndGbrServices is true.

Note: Any change of actEmerCallRedir or actIMSEmerSessR9 will only be applied in case of other activities leading to LNCEL lock.
aPucchMinNumEmergencySessions.fullName: Automatic PUCCH allocation, min num. emergency sessions

aPucchMinNumRrc.description:
Minimum allocated number of UEs in the cell which may establish a RRC connection.
This is needed for AirScale where resources may be shifted from one cell to the other where needed; for dynamic PUCCH this parameter can control the minimum PUCCH configuration per cell.

In case baseband pooling is activated the value of these parameters may be internally adapted by the system based on the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.
aPucchMinNumRrc.fullName: Automatic PUCCH allocation, min number RRC

aPucchMinNumRrcNoDrb.description: Minimum  number of UEs in the cell which may establish a RRC connection without a DRB establishment (e.g. doing tracking area updates); this parameter is relevant as additional margin for configured maxNumActUe.
aPucchMinNumRrcNoDrb.fullName: Automatic PUCCH allocation, min number RRC No DRB

aPucchSrPeriodUpperLimit.description:
Defines the upper limit of the Scheduling Request periodicity to be used in the cell by the PUCCH algorithm.

The configured value expresses the upper SR periodicity allowed in the LNCEL.
If '20 ms' is configured, the BTS uses 10 ms or 20 ms SR periodicity, where for '40 ms' the BTS uses 10 ms, 20 ms or 40 ms SR periodicity.
aPucchSrPeriodUpperLimit.fullName: Automatic PUCCH allocation, upper SR periodicity

aPucch_FddId.description:
This parameter is the naming atrribute of MOC APUCCH_FDD.
It uniquely identifies a APUCCH_FDD instance.

actLbPucchReg.description:
This parameter activates feature LTE2664 "Load Based PUCCH Region". The feature is working in the cell only if LTE1130 "Dynamic PUCCH allocation" is activated.

As long as no dedicated load-based PUCCH region profile is assigned in parameter lbPucchRPrId of the APUCCH instance, the default profile values are used.

Note: Only if actAutoPucchAlloc of the parent LNCEL instance is activated, the configured value of actLbPucchReg is considered by the BTS.

assignedDeltaPucchShift.description: Delta cyclic shift for PUCCH formats 1/1a/1b automatically assigned by the PUCCH algorithm.
assignedDeltaPucchShift.fullName: Delta cyclic shift used in PUCCH allocation

assignedDeltaPucchShiftCatM.description:
This parameter prompts delta cyclic shift using PUCCH formats 1/1a for Cat-M UEs. The value is calculated by the system and it is not configurable by operator.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE deltaPUCCH-Shift
assignedDeltaPucchShiftCatM.fullName: assigned delta cyclic shift in Cat-M PUCCH allocation

assignedN1PucchAn.description: Indicates the calculated ACK/NACK offset resource from PDCCH CCE by the automatic PUCCH allocation.
assignedN1PucchAn.fullName: ACK/NACK offset used in PUCCH allocation

assignedN1PucchAnCatM.description:
This parameter prompts Cat-M UEs ACK/NACK offset of the PUCCH resource which is calculated by LTE1130 at cell set up. The value is calculated by the system and it is not configurable by operator.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE n1PUCCH-AN-InfoList-r13
assignedN1PucchAnCatM.fullName: assigned ACK/NACK offset in Cat-M PUCCH allocation

assignedN1PucchAnModeBCatM.description:
This parameter prompts Cat-M CE ModeB UEs ACK/NACK offset of the PUCCH resource which is calculated at cell set up. The value is calculated by the system and it is not configurable by operator.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE n1PUCCH-AN-InfoList-r13
assignedN1PucchAnModeBCatM.fullName: Assigned ACK/NACK offset in Cat-M CE ModeB PUCCH allocation

assignedNCqiRb.description: Number of Physical Resource Blocks that are reserved for PUCCH formats 2/2a/2b/3. The value is automatically assigned by the PUCCH algorithm.
assignedNCqiRb.fullName: PUCCH bandwidth for CQI used in PUCCH allocation

assignedNPucchF3Prbs.description: This parameter defines how many PRBs are allocated to Format 3 HARQ process when the cell is configured to support carrier aggregation with more than or equal to three component carriers.
assignedNPucchF3Prbs.fullName: PRBs for HARQ Format 3 used in PUCCH allocation

assignedPhichDur.description: Indicates the duration of PHICH automatically assigned by the PUCCH algorithm.
assignedPhichDur.fullName: PHICH duration used in PUCCH allocation

assignedPhichRes.description: Indicates the PHICH resource size automatically assigned by the PUCCH algorithm.
assignedPhichRes.fullName: PHICH resource used in PUCCH allocation

assignedPrachFreqOff.description: PRACH frequency offset automatically assigned by the PUCCH algorithm. The algorithm consideres the parameter defined in LNCEL prachFreqOff as base, but the real used value in the algorithm is shown in this parameter.
assignedPrachFreqOff.fullName: PRACH frequency offset used in PUCCH allocation

assignedR10CsiConfIndex2Ri.description: This parameter informs about the used Rank Indication (RI) when Dynamic Open Loop or any kind of Closed Loop MIMO is supported in the Scell. When none of those MIMO modes are supported in the Scell, no parameter value will be set by the BTS and is therefore not shown at the manegement GUI.

assignedRiConfigIndex.description: This parameter informs about the used Rank Indication (RI) when Dynamic Open Loop or any kind of Closed Loop MIMO is supported. When none of those MIMO modes are supported in the cell, no parameter value will be set by the BTS and is therefore not shown at the manegement GUI.
assignedRiConfigIndex.fullName: RI configuration index used in PUCCH allocation

assignedSrOffsetCatM.description:
This parameter prompts the offset where the CAT- M dedicated scheduling request region begin. The value is calculated by the system and it is not configurable by operator.

assignedSrOffsetCatM.fullName: assigned SR offset in Cat-M PUCCH allocation

assignedSrPeriodCatM.description:
This parameter prompts scheduling request periodicity for Cat-M UEs. The value is calculated by the system and it is not configurable by operator.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE sr-ConfigIndex
assignedSrPeriodCatM.fullName: assigned SR periodicity in Cat-M PUCCH allocation

lbPucchRPrId.description: Identifier of the Load-Based PUCCH Region Profile which shall be used for the cell. If no value is specified the configuration in the Load-Based PUCCH Region Default Profile LBPUCCHRDPR will be used for the cell if the functionality is activated.

pucchArRateEvalWinLength.description: Length of the evaluation window (in subframes/radio frames) used to assess the PUCCH ACK/NACK repetition or adaptive-rate algorithm's performance before adjusting it.

selectPrachRegion.description: Using this parameter, the operator defines the selected PRACH region. If LTE1130 'Dynamic PUCCH allocation' is activated, the system automatically selects the PRACH PRB offset in this region.
selectPrachRegion.fullName: Selection of PRACH region in automatic PUCCH allocation

lbPucchRPrId.description: Identifier of the Load-Based PUCCH Region Profile which shall be used for the cell. If no value is specified the configuration in the Load-Based PUCCH Region Default Profile LBPUCCHRDPR will be used for the cell if the functionality is activated.

pucchF3Support2CC.description:
This parameter configures the PUCCH format 3 support for 2CC CA configurations for TDD cells.
If the value is configured to 'true' the BTS uses 4 PF3 PRBs at cell setup. If the parameter is configured to value 'false' the BTS won’t configure any PF3 PRB at cell setup. 
In the case of 3CC CA, the BTS always uses fixed 4 PF3 PRBs.

The parameter is applicable for FSMF as well as AirScale.
pucchF3Support2CC.fullName: PUCCH format 3 support for 2 CC CA

selectPrachRegion.description: Using this parameter, the operator defines the selected PRACH region. If LTE1130 'Dynamic PUCCH allocation' is activated, the system automatically selects the PRACH PRB offset in this region.

txCapable.description: This parameter describes if this antenna port is capable of working in tramsmitting mode.

actSnapshotCollection.description:
When this parameter is set to true, the BTS triggers automatic symptom data collection in the following conditions, 'after' the ASI module recovers from:
-Unexpected loss of communication with ASI module, recovered without ASI module reset
-Autonomous ASI module reset for fault recovery

When this parameter is set to false,  automatic symptom data collection is not triggered in the above scenarios.

climateControlProfiling.description:
Climate control Profiling parameter.
Fan speed will be controlled according to module temperature and desired BTS fan profile.
- Low Noise: Minimised noise for low and moderate ambient temperatures
- Optimized Cooling: Maximised unit MTBF (long life) by running fans with maximum speed already in
moderate ambient temperatures
- Linear: An intermediate profile which increases fan speed linearly as temperature increase.
 
It is possible to select fan control profiles independently for each module in the BTS.

If user does not want to define fan profiling or module does not support fan profiles, the BTS manager will not set a value to SCF.

Parameter values are: "Optimized Cooling", "Linear" and "Low Noise". Default value is "Optimized Cooling".

groupName.description:
The user can freely define any site specific information with this parameter. 
Note: The parameter is persistently stored but not used/modified by the BTS.

moduleLocation.description:
Defines a location of the radio module in free text with maximum 50 characters.  Location can be e.g. place or address of the module.

The range represents the number of bytes to store all the characters of the string. If the string is UTF-8 encoded, each character occupies between 1 to 4 bytes, depending upon the language. If ASCII encoded, each character occupies a single byte. The numbers of characters supported in case of UTF-8 encoding is at least 12.

prodCodePlanned.description: This is the product code used by planning tools before BTS is commissioned. After BTS is commissioned, product code parameter (productCode) from autodetected runtime unit is used by BTS SW.

radioMasterDN.description: This parameter defines the distinguished name of the master unit for ASIRMOD. The radio master can be an BBMOD or SMOD_EXT. The SMOD is indirectly connected to the ASIRMOD via the BBMOD.

radioMemAbnormalThreshold.description:
This parameter defines the abnormal memory threshold on the ASI module.
When the memory consumption on the radio module exceeds the abnormal threshold, an alarm with fault ‘Radio memory consumption exceeds abnormal threshold’ is  raised. When the memory consumption on the ASI module falls below the abnormal threshold, the alarm with fault ‘Radio memory consumption exceeds abnormal threshold’ is cleared.
This parameter is defined as a relative value, where the lower bound value of 0% indicates expected average memory consumption.
When abnormal memory threshold is set to 100%, the alarm with fault ‘Radio memory consumption exceeds abnormal threshold’ is not raised and alarm with fault ‘Radio memory consumption exceeds critical threshold’ is directly raised.

bbCardUsage.description:
If bbCardUsage parameter is set to '0' then a given baseband card is not used for hosting any baseband pools.

If bbCardUsage parameter is set to '1' then only one baseband pool is used for a given baseband card.

If bbCardUsage parameter is set to '2' then two baseband pools are used for a given baseband card.

If bbCardUsage is set to '0' then all cells connected to a given baseband card are in operational state 'disabled'

If bbCardUsage is set to '1' then all cells connected to a given baseband card are allocated to one baseband pool.

If bbCardUsage is set to '2' then cells being served by radios connected a given baseband card are distributed to two baseband pools.

If a given baseband card stays not electrically powered no new cells can be allocated to.
bbCardUsage.fullName: Amount of baseband pools being used per baseband card

distRefPoint.description:
This parameter allows to switch off automatic determination of the reference point for antenna line delay calculations and to set the distance to the reference point manually.
This parameter is optional. If required, the parameter should be set to the maximum expected distance  for any RF module or Remote Radio Head served by this BBMOD. 
System behavior is different for OBSAI radios and CPRI radios that support different CPRI dialects (e.g. different behavior between Nokia CPRI radios and other flavors of CPRI).
If this parameter is omitted or set to zero, the BBMOD will be grouped together with other BBMODs or SMODs that have no settings and an automatic reference point calculation for the group will be performed. 
Detailed instructions how to use parameter distRefPoint will be provided to operators in a release note.

prodCodePlanned.description: This is the product code used by planning tools before BTS is commissioned. After BTS is commissioned, product code parameter (productCode) from autodetected runtime unit is used by BTS SW.

radioProtSearchOrder.description:
This parameter allows the operator to define the starting protocol for radio detection between OBSAI and CPRI variants.  

When this parameter is set, the FHS will start the radio protocol detection algorithm with the specified protocol on first startup or following upgrade activation of that module.  The use of this parameter can reduce the radio detection time in configurations where the Operator knows the type of radio deployment. If this parameter is not specified, the FHS will still be able to automatically detect the type of radio protocols in use, although the time to detect the radios may be increased for certain exceptional cases.  In this scenario, the FHS will attempt to use prior radio detection information to select the starting point for protocol searches.

Since this parameter defines the starting point for the search algorithm, it can only decrease the detection time for radios that are attached to the FHS when the algorithm is started. If no radios are attached to the module, the time to detect to the radios will be dependent upon the radio protocol type and the current protocol being probed by the FHS.

Note that if the Operator sets this parameter incorrectly, the radio detection time can be increased following a BTS restart or upgrade activation.

In all scenarios, the BTS will be able to detect the radio protocol with or without the Operator’s use of this parameter.

useFullCapacity.description:
If useFullCapacity flag is set to ‘true’ the full BB capacity (100% of Baseband Module capacity) is enabled.

If useFullCapacity flag is set to ‘false’ the basic BB capacity (50% of Baseband Module capacity) is enabled and the other remaining BB capacity (50%) stays disabled.

The enabled BB capacity can be used only for any cell processing purpose. The disabled BB capacity must stay not in use.

NOTE: The value of parameter is only relevant for AirScale HW and will be ignored by the BTS for other HW.

bbPoolAllocId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC BBPOOLALLOC.
It uniquely identifies a BBPOOLALLOC instance.

bbPoolAllocMode.description:
Defines the baseband pool allocation mode.
In 'automatic' mode the cell is allocated by eNB according to allocation priorities and logical groups configured with parameters 'bbPoolAllocPrioList' and 'bbPoolLogicalGroupId'. In 'manual' mode the cell is allocated to the baseband pool which is configured with parameter 'bbPoolTargetId'.
Manual mode cannot be configured with the very first commissioning because BBPOOL instances will be autonomoulsly created by eNB after first eNB startup.

bbPoolLogicalGroupId.description:
Assigns the cell to a logical baseband pool. In 'automatic' mode eNB will assign cells with same logical group ID to the same baseband pool and cells with different logical group ID to different baseband pools. If the parameter is omitted the cell can be assigned to any pool.
The parameter is not relevant if bbPoolAllocMode is set to ' manual'.

If the logical group ID shall be considered for baseband pool allocation the criterion 'Logical group' must be configured in bbPoolAllocPrioList.

bbPoolTargetId.description:
Defines the physical baseband pool (bbPoolId) the cell shall be allocated to.
The parameter is not relevant if bbPoolAllocMode is set to ' automatic'.

Configuration hint:
eNB performs HW detection and as result all detected ABIA modules become visible as BBMOD instances. Furthermore eNB creates BBPOOL instances related to the detected BBMOD instances. Via Element Manager or NetAct Configurator the existing BBPOOL instances and their IDs (bbPoolId) can be checked. The list of valid bbPoolTargetIds corresponds to these bbPoolIds. For a cell this list is further restricted to the bbPoolIds which are related to the BBMOD instance which serves the cell.
Please note that manual BB pool allocation is meant for special cases and not recommended for customer configurations.

hostingBbPoolId.description:
ID of the baseband pool the cell is allocated to. 

Value '0' means that the cell is not allocated to a baseband pool  (e.g. because no resources are available).

bfdActivation.description:
This parameter activates or deactivates the BFD session.

If set to the value "true", the transmission of BFD control packets towards the remote peer is started and in case of a BFD session failure; alarms are raised. Otherwise, if set to the value "false", the transmission of BFD control packets towards the remote peer is stopped. The BTS discards every received BFD packet for a deactivated BFD instance and all active alarms related to the BFD session are cleared. The BFD session effectively does not exist at all.

bfdAdminUp.description:
This parameter defines the admin state of the BFD session.
If the parameter is set to "false", the session enters the "Admin Down" state where only control messages with state "Admin Down" are sent to the peer. All active alarms of the BFD session are cleared. If the parameter is set to "true", the session leaves the "Admin Down" state. It will reach the "Up" state if the remote peer is also in the "Up" state. If the BFD session fails, alarms are raised for it.
bfdAdminUp.fullName: BFD session admin down state control

bfdDestAddress.description:
This parameter specifies the destination IP address to be used in the BFD session. To be entered in dotted decimal format.

Both IP address formats can be used.
Format: IPv4 address parameter in dotted decimals or IPv6 address parameter acc. to RFC 4291.
bfdDestAddress.fullName: Destination IP address for the BFD session

bfdDestIpAddr.description:
This parameter defines the destination IP address to be used in the BFD session, IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported.
IP version must be the same for source and destination addresses.
IPv4 address format: Dot-decimal notation (x.x.x.x). Example: 10.10.10.10.
IPv6 address format: x:x:x:x:x:x:x:x. Example: ABCD:EF01:2345:6789:ABCD:EF01:2345:6789.
bfdDestIpAddr.fullName: Destination IP address for the BFD session

bfdDetectMult.description: This parameter, when multiplied with the negotiated BFD control word transmission interval, provides the detection time for lost packets in the BFD session. Roughly speaking, the bfdDetectMult is the number of BFD control packets that the BTS may lose in a row, before it will declare the BFD session to be down.
bfdDetectMult.fullName: BFD session lost packets detection time multiplier

bfdDscp.description: This parameter defines the DSCP value assigned to the BFD session traffic.

bfdGrp.description:
This parameter indicates on the BFD group to which the BFD session belongs.
The parameter is a managed object instance identifier (LMOID), referencing an instance of object class BFDGRP. The parameter may remain empty, meaning the BFD session is not bound to a BFD group.
Example:
FTM-1/IPNO-1/BFDGRP-#
where # can be from 1..8.

bfdId.description: This parameter defines the instance identifier of the BFD object. It uniquely identifies the object.

bfdSourceIpAddr.description:
This parameter specifies the source IP address to be used in BFD messages for the BFD session. This can be a network interface IP address or a virtual IP address. To be entered in dotted decimal format.

Both IP address formats can be used.
Format: IPv4 address parameter in dotted decimals or IPv6 address parameter acc. to RFC 4291.
bfdSourceIpAddr.fullName: Source IP address for the BFD session

bfdSourceUdpPort.description:
This parameter specifies the UDP source port to be used in the BFD session.
Note: value range and default value depend on the BFD type. 
- For Multi Hop BFD, the value range is 4784, 49152...65535 and the default value = 4784. 
- For Single Hop BFD the value range is 3784, 49152...65535 and the default value = 3784.
bfdSourceUdpPort.fullName: UDP source port of the BFD session

bfdSrcIpAddrDN.description:
This parameter defines the IPADDRESSV4 (or IPADDRESSV6) object instance which holds the IPv4 (or IPv6) address to be used as source IP address in BFD messages for the BFD session.
The value has to be given as distinguished name (DN).
Example: 
MRBTS-1/TNLSVC-1/TNL-1/IPNO-1/IPIF-1/IPADDRESSV4-1 (or MRBTS-1/TNLSVC-1/TNL-1/IPNO-1/IPIF-1/IPADDRESSV6-1)
bfdSrcIpAddrDN.fullName: Source IP address of the BFD session

bfdSrcUdpPort.description:
This parameter defines the UDP source port to be used in the BFD session.
The value range and default value depend on the BFD type.
The value range for both Multi- and Single Hop BFD is 49152..65535.
For Multi Hop BFD in addition the value 4784 (default) is supported.
For Single Hop BFD in addition the value 3784 (default) is supported.
bfdSrcUdpPort.fullName: UDP source port of the BFD session

bfdType.description:
This parameter defines the type of the BFD session: 
Single Hop - where only one hop is used.
Multi Hop BFD - where more than one hop is used.

desMinTxInt.description: This parameter defines the minimum interval, in milliseconds, to be used by the BTS when transmitting BFD control packets for the BFD session.
desMinTxInt.fullName: Desired minimum BFD control word transmit interval

reqMinRxInt.description: This parameter defines the minimum interval, in milliseconds, between the received BFD control packets that the BTS will support for the BFD session.
reqMinRxInt.fullName: Required minimum BFD control word receive interval

userLabel.description: The label that can be used for a usage description of the BFD session.

bfdDN.description:
This parameter defines which BFD sessions shall form a BFD group.
The value has to be given as distinguished name (DN).
Example: 
MRBTS-1/TNLSVC-1/TNL-1/IPAPP-1/BFD-1
bfdDN.fullName: Reference to one or more BFD sessions

bfdGrpId.description: This parameter defines the instance identifier of the BFD group object. It uniquely identifies the object.

acceptableFrameTypes.description:
If the value of this parameter is "AdmitTagged", the device will discard untagged and Priority-tagged frames received on this interface. If the value is “AdmitAll”, tagged, untagged, and Priority-tagged frames received on this interface will be accepted. Untagged and Priority-tagged frames are assigned to the VLAN defined by the portDefaultVlanId parameter for this interface.
Notes:
1) Priority tagged" frames (IEEE 802.1Q tagged frames with VLAN ID=0) can be configured via the VLAN filter list of parameter l2VlanIdList.
2) Ethernet management frames (i.e. Synchronous Ethernet and Ethernet OAM frames) are always allowed to ingress and egress the Ethernet interface of the layer 2 switch independent of the status of the value of the discardUntagged parameter.

brgPrtId.description: This parameter defines the instance identifier of the bridge port object. It uniquely identifies the object.

ethlkDN.description:
This parameter defines which Ethernet link (ETHLK) shall be used.
The value has to be given as distinguished name (DN).
Example: 
MRBTS-1/TNLSVC-1/TNL-1/ETHSVC-1/ETHLK-1

flushFdbOnLos.description: If this parameter is set to "true", the dynamic MAC address entries in the Forwarding Database (FDB) will be purged when an Ethernet Layer Loss of Signal (LOS) is detected on one of its physical switch-ports.

highValue.description:
This parameter defines the upper value of a contiguous range of VLAN identifiers used for VLAN ingress filtering and egress tagging.
The lower value is defined by parameter 'lowValue'.

For a single VLAN identifier value, the values for lowValue and highValue must be equal.
highValue.fullName: Upper value of VLAN identifier range

l2BurstSize.description:
This parameter defines the maximum burst size in byte(s) that can be transmitted in a single burst of the duration of 1s, in egress direction, for this Ethernet interface on the layer 2 switch.
The supported value range depends on the hardware.
For Flexi BTS applies: 
  - Range and Step: from 0 to 7500000 step 125
  - recommended value: 0
  - the maximum supported value is 6% of the actually configured l2ShaperRate * 1s
  - Value 0 means no bursts are allowed.
For AirScale BTS applies: 
  - only the values listed below must be defined
    32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16 384, 32 768, 65 536, 131 072, 262 144, 524 288, 1 048 576
  - recommended value: 1 048 576

l2ShaperRate.description:
This parameter defines the configurable egress shaper rate, in Kbit/s, for this switch-port.
Note: When the configured shaper rate exceeds the actual available bandwidth of the physical Ethernet interface, then this physical limitation will be applied at the rate shaper so that packet discard happens in a controlled way at scheduler queues only.
Note for FlexiBTS variants: If the configured value is below 1600 Kbit/s, the actually applied shaper rate will be 1560 Kbit/s. If the configured value is above 1500 Kbit/s, the configured value will be applied for the shaper rate.

lowValue.description:
This parameter defines the lower value of a contiguous range of VLAN identifiers used for VLAN ingress filtering and egress tagging.
The upper value is defined by parameter 'highValue'.

For a single VLAN identifier value, the values for lowValue and highValue must be equal.
lowValue.fullName: Low value of VLAN identifier range

portDefaultVlanId.description:
This parameter defines the VLAN identifier that is associated to untagged and priority-tagged frames received at this Ethernet interface (internal switch-port).

Furthermore this parameter determines, that frames associated to this VLAN identifier which are switched and transmitted at this switch-port will be transmitted untagged.

In order to achieve that a received untagged or priority-tagged frame is switched and transmitted via another (external) switch-port, the same VLAN identifier must be configured at the transmission port:
a) for VLAN-tagged transmission: in the VLAN identifier list of that transmit switch-port (see parameter l2VlanIdList) or
b) for untagged transmission: in the portDefaultVlanID of that transmit switch-port.
Else the frame will be discarded.
portDefaultVlanId.fullName: Default VLAN identifier for layer 2 switching

portDefaultVlanPriority.description:
This parameter defines the default VLAN priority assigned to untagged Ethernet frames received at this Ethernet interface (external switch-port)

The priority is used:
- for QoS classification of the frame, depending on the selected qosClassificationCriteria and frame content,
- for L2 priority marking of the frame at egress when the frame is transmitted VLAN-tagged, depending on the transmit port VLAN configuration.

The priority level values range from zero (best effort) to seven (highest).

allowInqScanResp.description:
Allow the site to respond to inquiry scans to provide device name and other info before pairing.  A site that does not respond to inquiry requests will be less visible to casual scans.

        True: Site responds to Bluetooth inquiry requests. Makes for easier range characterization and support for Bluetooth clients that depend on inquiry scan responses.

        False: Requires site operator to know Bluetooth device address and have client which can connect via address.

allowLegacyPairing.description: Allow operator to enable/disable Bluetooth legacy pairing protocol

btoothId.description:
This parameter identifies the Bluetooth Interface.

        The value is always 1.

This is supported only in FlexiZone Micro.

btoothName.description: This parameter allows the operator to customize the Bluetooth name used by the device.

deviceAddress.description:
This parameter specifies the Bluetooth device being whitelisted or blacklisted.

            Note:Format is Bluetooth device address in format of colon separated hex bytes.

deviceStatus.description: This parameter sets the specific Bluetooth device as whitelisted, blacklisted or as neutral entry.

legacyPairingOPTMode.description:
Allow additional control over legacy pairing protocol implementation.

        If legacyPairingOPTMode = -2 (configured PIN mode), the initial bytes of the configured legacyPairingSecret (up to 16 bytes in all after hex unencoding) is used as a fixed legacy PIN;

        Otherwise, counter-based logic adapted from RFC 6238/RFC4226 uses secret B1 derived from legacyPairingSecret as a key for generating a series of site-specific, one time 16 byte PINs based on RFC6238/RFC4226. 

        If legacyPairingOPTMode is set to -1 (rotating PIN mode),  the applicable counter advances based on internal BTS logic.  

        If legacyPairingOPTMode is set between 0 and 214748264 (generated static PIN mode), the applicable counter is fixed to the specified legacyPairingOPTMode value.

legacyPairingSecret.description:
Configures site-specific secrets associated with Bluetooth legacy pairing . The configured secret must be entered as a hex encoded string. For example, binary string 1mA is represented by hex encoding 316D41.

        With Legacy Pairing OTP Mode = -2 (configured PIN mode), legacyPairingSecret can be used to explicitly configure a fixed legacy pairing PIN. For this case, the operator should carefully consider the limitations of any expected Bluetooth peers. A complex PIN is more secure. However, a PIN containing only digits is mostly widely compatible.

        With Legacy Pairing OTP Mode >= -1 (rotating PIN mode or generated static PIN mode), legacyPairingSecret  can be used to assign a custom legacy pairing secret B1 for the legacy OTP algorithm. If legacyPairingSecret is left empty in these modes, secret B1 is set to a default value known to all sites and all Nokia customers.

outOfBandData.description:
This parameter provides additional handling of the specified Bluetooth device.

            The configured data must be entered as a hex encoded string. For example, binary string 1mA is represented by hex encoding 316D41.

pairingOrderNum.description:
This is the order number of the device entry in the pairingRelationships structure.

            User shall enter a unique pairing order number for each Bluetooth device entry. Lower order numbers occur earlier in the structure.

pairingRelationTimer.description:
Allow user to timeout pairing relationship after the configured number of hours.

If it is set to 0: Immediately clear all pairing relationships and connections at time of configuration change; no subsequent pairing or connections allowed until Pairing Relationshio Timout changed to a non-zero value.

If it is set to 169 :  Do not automatically timeout pairing relationships;

If it is set to the value between 1 and 168, the value is the timeout in hours. Once the age of a pairing relationship reaches the timeout, BTS will automatically timeout the pairing relationship. 

If the device is connected at the time of pairing timeout, the device is not forcibly disconnected by the pairing timeout. However, subsequent connection after expired pairing relationship will require a fresh pairing.
