enableA3Event.description:
This parameter controls the enabling/disabling of the A3 measurements for SCell discovery and corresponding A3 event reporting.
The setting of this flag conditions the way how the SCells to add are selected as follows:
-	If the A3 measurement has been enabled on a frequency that the UE can measure without measurement gaps, SCells on such frequency will be added only if detected by the UE with sufficient quality (i.e. with power and quality level above the defined scellMeasThreshRsrq and scellMeasThreshRsrp parameter values).
-	If the A3 measurement for SCell discovery has been not enabled on a frequency, SCells on such frequency are added blindly.
-	If the A3 measurement for SCell discovery has been enabled on a frequency that the UE cannot measure without measurement gaps, SCells on such frequency are added blindly only if there is no choice from the previous two cases. 

The events A3 for SCell discovery measurement are configured with “reportOnLeave” and “reportAmount=1”.

Note: 
If the eNB hosts no Pcells in the inter-eNB CA cluster via sRIO (numSrioLinks set to '1'), the lnBtsId doesn't need to be specified.
If at least one eNB in the inter-eNB CA cluster is connected via X2 (numSrioLinks set to '0'), the lnBtsId must be configured in all items of caClusterEnbList.

The higher the value of nlcvDeltaX2C2, the bigger the penalty, i.e., the smaller the probability that the cells connected over X2/C2 will be selected when adding a new SCell. Note: C2 is used as interface in cloud BTS (cBTS).

numSrioLinks.description:
This parameter defines the number of SRIO links that shall be configured towards the peer eNB in this CA cluster this instance of CAGENB-caClusterEnbList is referring to.

Note: 
If the eNB hosts no Pcells in the inter-eNB CA cluster via sRIO (numSrioLinks set to '1'), the lnBtsId doesn't need to be specified.
If at least one eNB in the inter-eNB CA cluster is connected via X2 (numSrioLinks set to '0'), the lnBtsId must be configured in all items of caClusterEnbList.

If the pathloss is greater than the sum of the threshold defined in parameter pcellUlPathlossThresh and this offset, an UL+DL SCell will be downgraded to a DL-only SCell.

pcellUlPathlossThresh.description:
This parameter defines the threshold for the uplink pathloss in a PCell for the advanced SCell handling.
Only if the pathloss is below this value, an SCell is allowed to be added as a DL+UL SCell.
Otherwise??? as DL-only SCell or not at all?

prbUsageRatioHighThresh.description: When one cell's PRB usage ratio is equal or greater than prbUsageRatioHighThresh, eNB will try to lower it's PRB usage ratio by fast load balance.

capCfgId.description:
This is the instance identifier of the CAPCFG object.
CAPCFG is being used by BTS to report to NetAct SWEM the BTS capacity utilization level required for License Management related operations.

cellsWithIqcDsApplied.description: Number of cells in BTS for which IQ Compression and/or Down Sampling is applied
cellsWithIqcDsApplied.fullName: Number of cells applying IQ Compression and/or Down Sampling

cellsWithOptBbCalcApplied.description: Number of cells in BTS for which the optimized Baseband usage is applied
cellsWithOptBbCalcApplied.fullName: Number of cells applying optimized Baseband usage

enbBbCapacityUsage.description:
Summarized utilization of all available baseband  resources (BBPOOL) within the LTE BTS.
Baseband capacity utilization is calculated by BTS summing all available baseband pools that each have at least one enabled cell mapped to.
The BTS  baseband capacity utilization value is increased by 1 if the particular baseband pool is counted as used.
btsBbCapacityUsage parameter value must be always kept by BTS up to date.
BTS uses the parameter reporting to NetAct SWEM the actual BTS baseband capacity utilization level required for License Management related operations.
enbBbCapacityUsage.fullName: Summarized usage of LTE BB capacity in BTS

enbHwRelease.description:
Indication what the LTE BTS HW release is.
Parameter set by BTS system. Required for LTE License Management operation.

capLimId.description: This is the instance identifier of the CAPLIM object.

enbBbCapacityLimit.description:
The parameter itself is to inform BTS the total number of free Baseband Capacity License Keys in Centralized Licenses Server pool is less than number of License Keys required/requested by BTS Baseband capacity configured currently to be in use.

The parameter value is to inform what the maximum amount is of the LTE Baseband capacity (number of baseband pools) permitted by License Management to stay is use.

Parameter is not designed to be used as the confirmation when the requested (by BTS) number of Baseband Capacity License Keys is fully satisfied/granted by Centralized Licenses Server.

NetAct SWEM is the only instance allowed to create/modified/delete this parameter.

Note: Value '0' means none of requested Baseband resources is granted/permitted to be in use. BTS stays fully limited and all Baseband capacity resources must not be in use.
enbBbCapacityLimit.fullName: Limited number of granted LTE BTS baseband  capacity

hsdpaUsers.description:
This parameter defines the HSDPA Users capacity limitation because of insufficient BTS Data User licenses. The value of "0" means maximum capacity limitation due to missing licenses.

Note: This parameter is updated only by automatic license checks performed in Software Entitlement Management application.

hsupaUsers.description:
This parameter defines the HSUPA Users capacity limitation because of insufficient SBTS Data User licenses. The value of "0" means maximum capacity limitation due to missing licenses.

Note: This parameter is updated only by automatic license checks performed in Software Entitlement Management application.

ipTrafficCapacityLimitEnabled.description: The parameter defines whether the IP capacity limit mechanism is enabled.

maxNumActUEBts.description: The parameter defines the maximum number of active users in the BTS.
maxNumActUEBts.fullName: Maximum number of active users in the BTS

r99CE.description: The parameter defines the maximum number of R99 CE in the BTS.
r99CE.fullName: Maximum number of R99 Channel elements in BTS

a3Offset.description: Margin for the Event A3 SCell discovery measurement- A neighbor becomes offset better than the PCell.

a3TimeToTrigger.description: Time for which the specific criteria for the Event A3 SCell discovery measurement must be met in order to trigger a measurement report.

a3TriggerQuantity.description: Defines which quantity (RSRP or RSRQ) the UE has to use for triggering an event A3 SCell discovery measurement report at the frequency for which the default CA profile is applied.

a6Offset.description: Margin for Event A6 - a neighbor cell becomes better than an SCell.

a6ReportInterval.description: Defines the interval with which measurement reports are sent as long as the specific criteria for the measurement event A6 are met.

a6TimeToTrigger.description: Time for which the specific criteria for the measurement event A6 must be met in order to trigger a measurement report.

caPrId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC CAPR.
It uniquely identifies an instance of the Carrier Aggregation Profile (CAPR).

disableSCellPDCCHOlLa.description: The parameter controls if PDCCH outer loop link adaptation shall be disabled in SCell for a UE with an activated SCell.
disableSCellPDCCHOlLa.fullName: Disable PDCCH outer loop link adaptation in SCell

earfcnDL.description: The (downlink) EARFCN of a PCell in a PCell/SCell combination used for advanced CA aware idle mode load balancing.
earfcnDL.fullName: Downlink EARFCN of the SCell frequency layer

enableA3Event.description:
This parameter controls the enabling/disabling of the A3 measurements for SCell discovery and corresponding A3 event reporting.
The setting of this flag conditions the way how the SCells to add are selected as follows:
-	If the A3 measurement has been enabled on a frequency that the UE can measure without measurement gaps, SCells on such frequency will be added only if detected by the UE with sufficient quality (i.e. with power and quality level above the defined scellMeasThreshRsrq and scellMeasThreshRsrp parameter values).
-	If the A3 measurement for SCell discovery has been not enabled on a frequency, SCells on such frequency are added blindly.
-	If the A3 measurement for SCell discovery has been enabled on a frequency that the UE cannot measure without measurement gaps, SCells on such frequency are added blindly only if there is no choice from the previous two cases. 

The events A3 for SCell discovery measurement are configured with “reportOnLeave” and “reportAmount=1”.

enableA6Event.description: This parameter controls the enabling/disabling of the measurements and corresponding reporting for A6 event.

enableFreqPrioSwap.description: This is a flag to enable or disable a PCell swap based on the frequency layer (EARFCN) priorities defined in the parameters pFreqPrio and sFreqPrio.
enableFreqPrioSwap.fullName: Enable PCell swap based on frequency layer priorities

hysA3Offset.description: Related hysteresis of Margin for the Event A3 SCell discovery measurement - a neighbor becomes offset better than the PCell.
hysA3Offset.fullName: Related hysteresis of offset a3Offset neighbor becomes offset better than serving cell

hysA6Offset.description: Related Hysteresis of Margin for Event A6 - a neighbor cell becomes better than an SCell.
hysA6Offset.fullName: Related hysteresis of offset a6Offset neighbor cell

maxNumScellSwaps.description: Maximum number of blind SCell swaps on the secondary cell (SCell) frequency layer this profile applies to.
maxNumScellSwaps.fullName: Maximum number of blind SCell swaps

sFreqPrio.description:
sFreqPrio enters into the comparison between candidate SCells. This comparison is based on a measure of the average load, and can be biased towards a cell by giving it (or its frequency layer) a higher priority. 
It is also used in the relative comparison to pFreqPrio in the PCell swap algorithm.
Use sFreqPrio = 1 (default) for highest priority, sFreqPrio = 10 for lowest priority.
sFreqPrio.fullName: SCell frequency layer priority for carrier aggregation

scellMeasThreshRsrp.description: RSRP threshold for filtering candidate SCells out of the cells reported by the UE via an event A3 SCell discovery measurement.

scellMeasThreshRsrq.description: RSRQ threshold for filtering candidate SCells out of the cells reported by the UE via an event A3 SCell discovery measurement.

scellPdcchOlLa.description: Selects the outer-loop link-adaptation mode used for PDCCH on the Secondary Cell in carrier aggregation - e.g. adapted per-PCell or independently per-SCell.

caPrSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC CAPRSPARE.
It uniquely identifies an CAPRSPARE instance.

name.description:
This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.

value.description:
This is the value of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The allowed parameter values are defined in the feature specification.

The value of this spare parameter must be according to the provided information. It need to be case sensitive. In case the specified value doesn't match the supported values for this spare parameter, the BTS will reject the configuration.

beamformingInScellAllowed.description: This parameter specifies whether beamforming shall be allowed in the SCell or not.

caRelId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC CAREL.
It uniquely identifies a CAREL instance.
CAREL creation activates Carrier Aggregation in the related cells.
CAREL is created in the LNCEL that will be P-LNCEL (primary cell for Carrier Aggregation). LNCEL contains lcrId of the S-LNCEL (secondary cell for Carrier Aggregation).
Depending on enableAutoLock and enableGrflShdn settings, LNCEL is automatically locked during plan activation for CAREL creation/deletion.

caScellSchedWtFactMinCqi.description: Scheduler weighting factor applied when a UE's Secondary Cell CQI is at or near the minimum reportable value, used to adjust scheduling priority for UEs with poor SCell conditions in carrier aggregation.

lcrId.description: Identity of the cell in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner
lcrId.fullName: Local cell resource ID of cell to be aggregated

lnBtsId.description: Instance identifier of object Macro eNB and used also as telecom parameter of the 3GPP 'Macro eNB ID', which is part of Global eNB ID. In addition it appears as distinguished name (DN) in the planning data at the Element Manager.
lnBtsId.fullName: BTS ID of the parent eNB of the cell to be aggregated

maxNumOfSuppMimoLayer.description:
This parameter defines the maximal number of supported MIMO layer for the SCell.

For SCells handled at the connected eNB in inter-eNB CA configurations, limitations regarding the number of supported SCells with 4-layer are possible. Please refer to the official supported configurations.
In case the link capacity in inter-eNB configurations is exceeded, performance degradations will happen.
maxNumOfSuppMimoLayer.fullName: Maximal number of supported MIMO layers

pcellSwapAllowed.description: This is a flag to allow or forbid swapping the PCell owning this instance of CAREL with the SCell identified by this instance of CAREL.

scellPrio.description: This parameter defines the priority order in which this SCell shall be used in blind SCell configuration. The smaller the value the higher the priority

scellSchedWeightFactorDl.description: A scheduling weight factor applied to this Secondary Cell's downlink scheduler, biasing its relative share of scheduler resources compared to other cells.

caRelSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC CARELSPARE.
It uniquely identifies an CARELSPARE instance.

name.description:
This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.

value.description:

cPlaneLocalIpAddressTrxSig.description: This parameter provides the BTS IPv4 address for Control Plane of TRX.
cPlaneLocalIpAddressTrxSig.fullName: Control Plane lcoal IP address for TRXSIG

channelGroupId.description: This parameter defines the identifier to the CHANNELGROUP object which has the GSM carrier mapping.

gsmCarrierFrequencyInBSC.description:
This parameter defines GSM frequency defied in BSC. For example, Band 1900 ARFN 512 maps to 1930.2 MHz 

In case of RF and BB hopping it contains list of frequencies in comma separated form which is configured per hopping sector. For example 1930.2, 1931.4, 1932.6 indicates that ARFN 512, 518 and 524 are forming one hopping sector with three TRXes.

mainCarrierId.description:
This parameter will indicate the main carrier id under which all replica carriers are defined for a single logical carrier. 
It will increase in sequential order for each logical main carrier.

replicaId.description:
This parameter defines the Replica ID for either Lean GSM or CMST feature.
In Lean GSM, it should be considered as Beam ID.
In Composited Multi Site Transmission (CMST), it should be considered as Node ID.

trxAdminState.description: This parameter defines the GSM TRX administrative state set from BSC.
trxAdminState.fullName: TRX administrative state set from BSC

uPlaneLocalIpAddressCs.description: This parameter provides the BTS IPv4 address for User Plane of TRX for Circuit Switched.
uPlaneLocalIpAddressCs.fullName: User Plane lcoal IP address for TRX CS

uPlaneLocalIpAddressPs.description: This parameter provides the BTS IPv4 address for User Plane of TRX for Packet Switched.
uPlaneLocalIpAddressPs.fullName: User Plane lcoal IP address for TRX PS

amcCStepUpModeBCatM.description:
This parameter defines the stepsize up value for the DL/UL Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation delta C for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB. 
Stepsize down value for delta C can be calculated by using this parameter and DL/UL target BLER.
amcCStepUpModeBCatM.fullName: AMC delta C step size up of Cat-M in CE modeB

amcDeltaCiniModeBCatM.description: This parameter defines the initial value for DL/UL Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation delta C for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB.
amcDeltaCiniModeBCatM.fullName: AMC initial delta C of Cat-M in CE modeB

amcDeltaCmaxModeBCatM.description: This parameter defines the maximum limit for the DL/UL Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation value delta C for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB.
amcDeltaCmaxModeBCatM.fullName: AMC maximum delta C of Cat-M in CE modeB

amcDeltaCminModeBCatM.description: This parameter defines the minimum limit for DL/UL Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation value delta C for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB.
amcDeltaCminModeBCatM.fullName: AMC minimum delta C of Cat-M in CE modeB

catMBPrId.description: This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC CATMBPR, it uniquely identifies an instance of the CATMBPR configuration.

cpInactivityTimerModeBCatM.description:
This parameter defines the time period for the indication of the UE-associated S1 logical connection inactivity DL and UL directions for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB.
C-Plane inactivity timer monitors S1AP interface activity of UE-associated S1 logical connection traffic for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB. It's started with Cat-M UEs in CE modeB UE-associated S1 logical connection establishment and restarted on reception or sending S1AP message that contains NAS PDU IE.
cpInactivityTimerModeBCatM.fullName: C-Plane inactivity timer for Cat-M CE ModeB

defaultPagCeModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the default number of MPDCCH paging repetitions for Cat-M CE ModeB capable UEs if not presented in the paging message from MME.
This information is optional IE and is provided transparently by the serving eNB to the MME at transition to ECM_IDLE together with the respective cell identifier and is provided to the E-UTRAN during paging.
defaultPagCeModeBCatM.fullName: Default number of paging repetition for Cat-M CE ModeB

dlTargetBlerModeBCatM.description: This parameter defines target Block Error Ratio (BLER) for downlink Link Adaptation in percents used for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB.
dlTargetBlerModeBCatM.fullName: DL target BLER of Cat-M in CE modeB

harqMaxMsg3TxModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in UL that is configured for message 3 of the contention-based random access procedure for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB.

Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE maxHARQ-Msg3Tx.
But due to asynchronized HARQ for Cat-M UEs, the RRC IE ‘maxHARQ-Msg3Tx’ will be ignored by Cat-M UEs, therefore this parameter confguration is only used by eNB internally.
harqMaxMsg3TxModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum number of Msg3 HARQ transmissions for Cat-M CE ModeB

harqMaxMsg4TxModeBCatM.description: This parameter specifies the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in DL that is configured for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB at initial access (Message 4).
harqMaxMsg4TxModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum number of Msg4 HARQ transmissions for Cat-M CE ModeB

harqMaxTrDlModeBCatM.description: This parameter specifies the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in DL that is configured for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB.
harqMaxTrDlModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in DL for Cat-M CE ModeB

harqMaxTxUlModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in UL that is configured for Cat-M UEs in CE modeB.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE maxHARQ-Tx.
But due to asynchronized HARQ for Cat-M UEs, the RRC IE ‘maxHARQ-Tx’ will be ignored by Cat-M UEs, therefore this parameter confguration is only used by eNB internally.
harqMaxTxUlModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in UL for Cat-M CE ModeB

inactivityTimerModeBCatM.description: This parameter defines the time period for the indication of the Cat-M UEs in CE modeB inactivity in both DL and UL directions.
inactivityTimerModeBCatM.fullName: Inactivity timer for Cat-M CE ModeB

iniMcsDlModeBCatM.description:
This parameter defines an initial Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) to be used on PDSCH other than BCCH, PCH or random access messages for Cat-M UEs in CE level 2.
The range of MCS value for Cat-M is defined by 3GPP 36.213 table 7.1.7.1-1: "Modulation and TBS index table for PDSCH"
iniMcsDlModeBCatM.fullName: Initial MCS in downlink of Cat-M in CE level 2

iniMcsUlModeBCatM.description:
This parameter defines an initial Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) to be used on PUSCH other than random access message 3 for Cat-M UEs in CE level 2.
The range of MCS value for Cat-M is defined by 3GPP 36.213 table 8.6.1-1: "Modulation, TBS index and redundancy version table for PUSCH"
iniMcsUlModeBCatM.fullName: Initial MCS in uplink of Cat-M in CE level 2

iniPrbUlModeBCatM.description: This Parameter defines the initial amount of maximum PRBs in uplink  for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2.
iniPrbUlModeBCatM.fullName: Initial amount of PRBs in uplink of Cat-M in CE level 2

maxNumRrcModeBCatM.description: This parameter specifies the threshold for the maximum number of Cat-M CE ModeB UEs in the cell which may establish a RRC connection.
maxNumRrcModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum number of Cat-M CE ModeB RRC Connections

mpdcchMaxNumRepCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum numbers of repetitions for M-PDCCH for DL and UL grants of Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 

Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 9.1.5-3. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-NumRepetition-r13.
mpdcchMaxNumRepCatM.fullName: Maximum number of repetition for MPDCCH(UE-SS) for Cat-M CE Level 2

mpdcchMaxNumRepRaModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum number of repetitions for MPDCCH  for RAR, HARQ of Msg3 and Msg4 of Cat-M UEs in CE ModeB. 
This parameter is applicable for both CE Level 2 and CE Level 3, i.e., CE Level 2 and CE Level 3 have same MPDCCH Rmax for Cat-M RAR, HARQ of Msg3 and Msg4 grant.

Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 9.1.5-3. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.211 and TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-NumRepetition-RA-r13.
mpdcchMaxNumRepRaModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum number of repetition for MPDCCH(Random Access) for Cat-M CE ModeB

mpdcchRepLevCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the repetition level of M-PDCCH to determine the repetition number of M-PDCCH for the DL and UL grants for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 

This parameter is used to set the ‘DCI subframe repetition number’ field of the DCI Format 6-1B or DCI Format 6-0B.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 9.1.5-3.
mpdcchRepLevCatM.fullName: Repetition level of M-PDCCH(UE-SS) for Cat-M CE Level 2

mpdcchRepLevPagCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the repetition level of paging message on M-PDCCH for Cat-M UEs mapping to paging CE Level 2.
This parameter is used to set the ‘DCI subframe repetition number’ field of the DCI Format 6-2.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 9.1.5-4 and Table 7.1.11-3.
mpdcchRepLevPagCatM.fullName: Repetition level of M-PDCCH(Paging) for Cat-M CE Level 2

mpdcchRepLevRaCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the repetition level of M-PDCCH to determine the repetition number of M-PDCCH for random access messages(Msg2, HARQ for Msg3, Msg4) for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 

This parameter is used to set the ‘DCI subframe repetition number’ field of the DCI Format 6-1B or DCI Format 6-0B.

Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 9.1.5-3.
mpdcchRepLevRaCatM.fullName: Repetition level of M-PDCCH(Random Access) for Cat-M CE Level 2

numRepPerPreambAttemptCECatM.description:
This parameter defines the number of PRACH repetitions per preamble attempts for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 

Refer to TS 36.321 and TS 36.331 and IE numRepetitionPerPreambleAttempt-r13
numRepPerPreambAttemptCECatM.fullName: Number of PRACH repetitions per attempt for Cat-M CE Level 2

pagAttCeIncreaseModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the unsuccessful Paging Attempt threshold for Cat-M CE ModeB capable UEs. eNB should apply the higher configured paging CE level parameters for MPDCCH and PDSCH in case of unsuccessful Paging Attempt greater than or equal to this.

It is recommended to set to value ‘3’.
pagAttCeIncreaseModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum attempt number for paging message within current coverage level for Cat-M CE ModeB

pagAttCeIncreaseStepModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies Paging coverage level step size to increase when unsuccessful Paging Attempt is greater than or equal to pagAttCeIncreaseModeBCatM for Cat-M CE ModeB capable UEs . 
CE level step increase is not including CE levels with the same paging repetitions configured. Only CE levels with different repetitions are considered as increase step.

It is recommended to set to value ‘1’.
pagAttCeIncreaseStepModeBCatM.fullName: Paging coverage level increase step size for Cat-M CE ModeB capable UEs

pagCEModePrioCatM.description:
This parameter specifies priorities for Cat-M paging records.
If this parameter is set to value 'CE ModeA', then CE ModeA UE is prioritized over CE ModeB UE for Paging .
If this parameter is set to value 'all equal', then CE ModeA UE and CE ModeB UE have the same priority for Paging. 
It is recommended to set pagCEModePrioCatM to 'all equal'.
pagCEModePrioCatM.fullName: Paging send CE Mode priority for Cat-M

pdschMaxNumRepModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum number of repetitions for PDSCH of Cat-M UEs in CE modeB. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 7.1.11-1. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and the optional IE pdsch-maxNumRepetitionCEmodeB-r13.

Note: All Cat-M CE ModeB UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
pdschMaxNumRepModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum numbers of repetition for PDSCH of Cat-M in CE modeB

pdschRepLevModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the repetition level of PDSCH to determine the repetition number of PDSCH messages for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 

This parameter is used to set the 'Repetition Number' field of the DCI Format 6-1B.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 7.1.11-1.
pdschRepLevModeBCatM.fullName: Repetition level of PDSCH for Cat-M CE Level 2

pdschRepLevMsg4ModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the Msg4 repetition level on PDSCH to determine the repetition number of random access Msg4 for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 

This parameter is used to set the 'Repetition Number' field of the DCI Format 6-1B.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 7.1.11-1.
pdschRepLevMsg4ModeBCatM.fullName: Repetition level of Msg4 on PDSCH for Cat-M CE Level 2

pdschRepLevPagCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the repetition level of paging message on PDSCH for Cat-M UEs mapping to paging CE Level 2.
This parameter is used to set the 'Repetition Number' field of the DCI Format 6-2.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212 , 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 7.1.11-3.
pdschRepLevPagCatM.fullName: Repetition level of PDSCH(Paging) for Cat-M CE Level 2

pollPdu.description:
This parameter Poll PDU defines the number of RLC PDUs that are sent on a logical channel before the RLC polling bit is set.
This parameter specifies the parameter pollPDU of [36.331]

prachStartSFCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the PRACH starting subframe for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE prach-StartingSubframe-r13.
If it is set to '0', the optional IE "prach-StartingSubframe-r13" will be dropped in SIB2-BR message for Cat-M UE in CE level2.
prachStartSFCatM.fullName: PRACH Starting subframe for Cat-M CE Level 2

preambMaxNumAttemptCECatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum number of preamble transmission attempts for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 
Refer to TS 36.321 and TS 36.331 and IE maxNumPreambleAttemptCE-r13.
preambMaxNumAttemptCECatM.fullName: Maximum number of PRACH preamble transmission attempts for Cat-M CE Level 2

pucchF1NumRepModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the repetition number of the PUCCH Format 1 for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE pucch-NumRepetitionCE-format1-r13.
pucchF1NumRepModeBCatM.fullName: Repetition number of PUCCH for Cat-M CE Level 2

pucchNumRepMsg4ModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the number of PUCCH repetitions of the HARQ feedback in response to the Msg4 for Cat-M in CE Level 2. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 RRC IE ‘pucch-NumRepetitionCE-Msg4-Level2-r13’.
pucchNumRepMsg4ModeBCatM.fullName: Repetition number of PUCCH for HARQ feedback to Msg4 in Cat-M CE Level 2

puschMaxNumRepModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum number of repetitions for PUSCH of Cat-M UEs in CE modeB. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE pusch-maxNumRepetitionCEmodeB-r13.

Note: All Cat-M CE ModeB UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
puschMaxNumRepModeBCatM.fullName: Maximum numbers of repetition for PUSCH of Cat-M in CE modeB

puschRepLevModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the repetition level of PUSCH to determine the repetition number of PUSCH messages for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 

This parameter is used to set the 'Repetition Number' field of the DCI Format 6-0B.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 8.2b.
puschRepLevModeBCatM.fullName: Repetition level of PUSCH for Cat-M CE Level 2

puschRepLevMsg3ModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the repetition level of PUSCH to determine the repetition number of Msg3 on PUSCH messages for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 

This parameter is used to set the 'Repetition Number' field of the RAR for Msg3.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 Table 6.2d.
puschRepLevMsg3ModeBCatM.fullName: Repetition level of Msg3 on PUSCH for Cat-M CE Level 2

raContResoTimrCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum contention resolution timer for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 
Refer to TS 36.321 and TS 36.331 and IE mac-ContentionResolutionTimer-r13

This parameter is defined per CE Level (1...maxCE-Level-r13) of rach-CE-LevelInfoList-r13.

Note: It is recommended to set raContResoTimrCatM to '960ms' if numCELevelCatM is set to '3' or '4'.
raContResoTimrCatM.fullName: Maximum contention resolution timer for Cat-M CE Level 2

raPreGrCSizeCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the number of RA preambles per cell that are reserved for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2.
Refer to TS 36.321 and TS 36.331 and IEs RadioResourceConfigCommon, RACH-ConfigCommon, firstPreamble-r13, lastPreamble-r13.

This parameter is defined per CE Level (1...maxCE-Level-r13) of rach-CE-LevelInfoList-r13.
raPreGrCSizeCatM.fullName: Number of random access preambles for Cat-M CE Level 2

raRespWinSizeCatM.description:
This parameter defines the random access response window size for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 
Refer to TS 36.321 and TS 36.331 and IEs RadioResourceConfigCommon, RACH-ConfigCommon, RA-ResponseWindowSize-r13.

This parameter is defined per CE Level (1...maxCE-Level-r13) of rach-CE-LevelInfoList-r13.

Note: It is recommended to set raRespWinSizeCatM to '400ms' if numCELevelCatM is set to '3' or '4'.
raRespWinSizeCatM.fullName: Random access response window size for Cat-M CE Level 2

rrcGuardTimerModeBCatM.description: This timer is started when an RRC message for setup, modification or release of a radio bearer is sent to the Cat-M UEs in CE ModeB. When the timer expires, the corresponding procedure is aborted.
rrcGuardTimerModeBCatM.fullName: RRC guard timer radio bearer management for Cat-M CE ModeB

srProhibitTimerModeBCatM.description:
This parameter controls the minimum separation in time between consecutive Scheduling Request transmissions by the Cat-M UEs in CE ModeB. 
It can be used to prevent unwanted repetitions of SRs. The parameter is expressed in number of SR periods. It is sent to the UE in the RRC IE sr-ProhibitTimer-r9.  
Refer to 36.321 sec.5.4.4

srProhibitTimerCatM = 0 means no minimum interval (SRs can be sent at every SR period).
srProhibitTimerModeBCatM.fullName: SR prohibited timer for Cat-M CE ModeB

srbInactivityTimerModeBCatM.description: This parameter defines the time period for the indication of the Cat-M UEs in CE modeB inactivity on signalling radio bearer in both DL and UL directions.
srbInactivityTimerModeBCatM.fullName: SRB inactivity timer for Cat-M CE ModeB

t300ModeBCatM.description:
Timer T300 for Cat-M supervises the RRC connection establishment procedure of Cat-M UEs supoort CE modeB.
Timer T300 supervises the RRC connection establishment procedure. 
Start: Transmission of RRCConnectionRequest
Stop: Reception of RRCConnectionSetup or RRCConnectionReject message, cell re-selection and upon abortion of connection establishment by upper layers

At expiry: Perform the actions as specified in 36.331, 5.3.3.6 

Refer to TS36.331 IE UE-TimersAndConstants: t300-v1310
t300ModeBCatM.fullName: Timer T300 for Cat-M support CE modeB

t301ModeBCatM.description:
Timer T301 for Cat-M supervises the RRC connection re-establishment procedure of Cat-M UEs support CE modeB.
Timer T301 supervises the RRC connection re-establishment procedure. 
Start: Transmission of RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest
Stop: Reception of RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject message as well as when the selected cell becomes unsuitable

At expiry: Go to RRC_IDLE

Refer to TS36.331 IE UE-TimersAndConstants: t301-v1310
t301ModeBCatM.fullName: Timer T301 for Cat-M support CE modeB

t310ModeBCatM.description:
Timer T310 for Cat-M supervises the recovery from physical layer problems(Radio Link Failure) of Cat-M UEs support CE modeB.
Refer to TS36.331 IE UE-TimersAndConstants: t310-v1330
t310ModeBCatM.fullName: Timer T310 for Cat-M support CE ModeB

tDiscardPdcpModeBCatM.description:
This parameter indicates the delay before a PDCP PDU along with the corresponding PDCP SDU is discarded from the buffer for Cat-M UEs in CE ModeB. This timer shall be set in a way that the packet delay defined by the QCI characteristics is kept. The timer can be disabled by setting the parameter to infinity.
This parameter specifies the parameter discardTimer of [36.331]
tDiscardPdcpModeBCatM.fullName: PDCP PDU Timer Discard for Cat-M CE ModeB DRB

tExtendedWaitModeBCatM.description:
tExtendedWaitModeBCatM suppresses the reselection of a cell for a while.
eNB sends this parameter to the Cat-M CE ModeB UE in the message RRC CONNECTION REJECT and RRC CONNECTION RELEASE, and only in case of Delay Tolerant access request. The Cat-M CE ModeB UE will consider access to the cell as barred for the time specified by tExtendedWaitModeBCatM.

tHalfRrcConModeBCatM.description: The minimal time period that the eNB waits for an RRC CONNECTION SETUP COMPLETE message after sending a RRC CONNECTION SETUP message for Cat-M UEs in CE ModeB.
tHalfRrcConModeBCatM.fullName: Timer min lifetime of half-open RRC connection for Cat-M CE ModeB

tL2AckRrcRelModeBCatM.description:
The maximum time period indicates the time after which the RRC L3 releases the RRC connection for Cat-M CE ModeB call only if no positive ack is received from L2 to the RRC CONNECTION RELEASE message.  
This timer has to absorb the potential preceding NAS transmission, which can be approximated via rrcGuardTimerModeBCatM.  This timer is reset to 1.25 second upon reception of L1 HARQ ACK of RRC Connection Release, as per 3GPP R2-169034.
tL2AckRrcRelModeBCatM.fullName: Timer missing L2 ack for Cat-M CE ModeB RRC connection release

tPollRetrDrb.description:
This timer is used by the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll.
This parameter specifies the parameter t-pollRetransmit of [36.331]
tPollRetrDrb.fullName: Timer Poll Retransmit for DRB Cat-M

tPollRetrSrb.description:
This timer is used by the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll.
This parameter specifies the parameter t-pollRetransmit of [36.331]
tPollRetrSrb.fullName: Timer Poll Retransmit for SRB Cat-M

tProhibDrb.description:
This timer is used by the receiving side of an AM RLC entity in order to prohibit transmission of a STATUS PDU.
This parameter specifies the parameter t-StatusProhibit of [36.331]
tProhibDrb.fullName: Timer Status Prohibit for DRB Cat-M

tProhibSrb.description:
This timer is used by the receiving side of an AM RLC entity in order to prohibit transmission of a STATUS PDU.
This parameter specifies the parameter t-StatusProhibit of [36.331]
tProhibSrb.fullName: Timer Status Prohibit for SRB Cat-M

tReordDrb.description:
This timer is used by the receiving side of an AM RLC entity for reordering, PDU loss detection and delay of STATUS PDU transmission. This timer depends on HARQ RTT and number of HARQ retransmissions.
This parameter specifies the parameter t-Reordering of [36.331]

tReordSrb.description:
This timer is used by the receiving side of an AM RLC entity for reordering, PDU loss detection and delay of STATUS PDU transmission. This timer depends on HARQ RTT and number of HARQ retransmissions.
This parameter specifies the parameter t-Reordering of [36.331]

ulTargetBlerModeBCatM.description: This parameter defines target Block Error Ratio (BLER) for uplink Link Adaptation in percents used for Cat-M UEs in CE ModeB.
ulTargetBlerModeBCatM.fullName: UL target BLER of Cat-M in CE modeB

ulsMinTbsModeBCatM.description: This parameter specifies the minimum UL TBS (segment size) during Cat-M CE ModeB link adaptation.
ulsMinTbsModeBCatM.fullName: Minimum UL transport block size for Cat-M CE modeB

a2TimeToTriggerIntraFreqCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the timer to trigger activation of intra frequency measurement for Cat-M.
Duration for which the event A2 must be valid, such that additional Intra-Frequency measurements are activated.
a2TimeToTriggerIntraFreqCatM.fullName: Time to trigger for A2 event to activate Cat-M intra frequency handover measurement

actAcBarringCatM.description:
This parameter activates Static and Automatic Access Class Barring  support for Cat-M.
All activated Wide Band ACB triggers may initiate Cat-M automatic Access Class Barring framework.
actAcBarringCatM.fullName: Activate Access Class Barring for Cat-M

actAmcCatM.description: The parameter enables/disables Cat-M UEs link adapation (LA) algorithm for uplink and downlink respectively. The LA algorithm responsible for selecting the MCS is called Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC) for Cat-M UEs.
actAmcCatM.officialRange:
0: disabled 
1: Downlink AMC enabled 
2: Uplink AMC enabled 
3: Both Downlink and Uplink enabled

actConvVoiceCatM.description: This parameter activates the support of the conversational voice bearer for Cat-M.
actConvVoiceCatM.fullName: Activate support of conversational voice bearer for Cat-M

actDlPciBasedNarBandCatM.description: This parameter activates downlink PCI-based narrowband allocation for Cat-M
actDlPciBasedNarBandCatM.fullName: Activate Downlink PCI based Narrowband allocation for Cat-M

actDynamicRepMpdcchCatM.description: This parameter activates the dynamic repetition support of MPDCCH for Cat-M (non-GBR only).
actDynamicRepMpdcchCatM.fullName: Activate dynamic repetition support of MPDCCH for Cat-M (non-GBR only)

actDynamicRepMpdschCatM.description: This parameter activates the dynamic repetition support of MPDSCH for Cat-M (non-GBR only).
actDynamicRepMpdschCatM.fullName: Activate dynamic repetition support of MPDSCH for Cat-M (non-GBR only)

actDynamicRepMpuschCatM.description: This parameter activates the dynamic repetition support of MPUSCH for Cat-M (non-GBR only).
actDynamicRepMpuschCatM.fullName: Activate dynamic repetition support of MPUSCH for Cat-M (non-GBR only)

actDynamicRepVoLTECatM.description: This parameter activates the dynamic repetition support of VoLTE for Cat-M.
actDynamicRepVoLTECatM.fullName: Activate dynamic repetition support of VoLTE for Cat-M

actEDrxIdleCatM.description:
Parameter to activate or deactivate extended DRX for LTE-M in idle mode in a cell.
BTS synchronization mode shall be set to PhaseSync or LoosePhaseAndTimeSync in order to have the correct feature functionality.
actEDrxIdleCatM.fullName: Activate eDRX in idle mode for LTE-M

actIMSEmerSessCatM.description: This parameter activates the support IMS Emergency sessions for Cat-M UEs.
actIMSEmerSessCatM.fullName: Activate support of IMS emergency sessions for Cat-M UE

actIdleLBCatM.description:
The parameter activates the feature Idle Mode Load Balancing for Cat-M
This flag also activates the following functionalities:
- redistribution of configured share of Cat-M1 UEs between adjacent LTE-M layers using dedicated priorities
- weights controlled LTE-M target layers prioritization, using Weighted Round Robin algorithm (WRR)
actIdleLBCatM.fullName: Activation of idle mode load balancing (IdleLB) for Cat-M

actInterFreqHoCatM.description: The parameter activates the inter-frequency handover for Cat-M.

actIntraFreqHoCatM.description: The parameter activates the intra-frequency handover for Cat-M.

actMultiHarqCatM.description:
This parameter activates the multiple HARQ support for Cat-M.
Cat-M1 UE should be able to schedule 2 HARQ processes on DL in a multi-user (multiple RRC connected users per cell) scenario if the trigger conditions are fulfilled.
Cat-M1 UE should be able to schedule 3 HARQ processes on UL in a multi-user (multiple RRC connected users per cell) scenario if the trigger conditions are fulfilled.
actMultiHarqCatM.fullName: Activate multiple HARQ support for Cat-M

actRLFbasedRCRCatM.description: Activates the feature 'Radio Link Failure (RLF) based RRC connection reestablishment (RCR)' for Cat-M
actRLFbasedRCRCatM.fullName: Activate RLF based RRC connection reestablishment for Cat-M

actSchedBypCatM.description:
The parameter activates Cat-M scheduler bypass function during high PRB loading.
Cat-M performance will be hugely impacted if this feature is enabled. Please use it at your own risk.

actSelMobPrfCatM.description:
The parameter activates the feature 'Selective Mobility Profiles' for Cat-M.

When this parameter is set to 'true' then Cat-M mobility profiles (CATMOPR/CATMODPR) are used to configure HO mobility for Cat-M.
When this parameter is set to 'false':
- if CATMODPR exists, then CATMODPR configuration is used for Cat-M HO mobility.
- CATMOPR configurations are never used.

actSf9InvalidLVRBCatM.description:
This parameter indicates Subframe 9 with paging occasion as Cat-M invalid subframe when localized VRBs are used for SI, paging and RACH messages.
If dlsDciCch is set to 'DCI format 1A' 
-if this parameter is set to 'true' , Subframe 9 is set as Cat-M invalid subframe.
-if this parameter is set to 'false' , Subframe 9 is set as Cat-M valid subframe.
The parameter is not used if dlsDciCch is set to 'DCI format 1C'.
Note: All Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode may be released if this parameter is online modified.
actSf9InvalidLVRBCatM.fullName: Activate SF9 Invalid Subframe in LVRB Cat-M

catMCelId.description: This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC CATMCEL, it uniquely identifies an instance of the CATMCEL configuration.

cellReSelPrioCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the cell reselection priority for Cat-M. Absolute priority of the serving frequency for Cat-M. 
0 means the lowest priority.

dFpucchF1CatM.description:
The parameter defines the transport format dependent offset in power control for PUCCH format 1 for Cat-M UEs.
Refer to TS 36.331 IE deltaF-PUCCH-Format1.

deltaPreMsg3CatM.description:
This parameter specifies power control parameter to  calculate P0_NOMINAL_PUSCH(j=2) for PUSCH (re)transmission corresponding to the random access response grant for Cat-M.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.213 [23, 5.1.1.1] and TS 36.331 and IE deltaPreambleMsg3, Actual value = IE value * 2 [dB].

deltaPreMsg3CatM has the same value range with legacy parameter deltaPreMsg3,  however for Cat-M, its value must consider the repetition gains of M-PRACH and M-PUSCH, and depends thus of the respective repetition levels and the desired Cat-M coverage.
deltaPreMsg3CatM.fullName: Delta preamble random access message 3 for Cat-M

dl3HarqMcsCatM.description: This parameter defines the first MCS index used in downlink 3HARQ after switching 2HARQ to 3HARQ for Cat-M.
dl3HarqMcsCatM.fullName: The first MCS index of downlink 3HARQ for Cat-M.

hysThreshold2IntraFreqCatM.description:
This parameter specifies hysteresis of RSRP threshold of serving cell for starting of intra frequency measurements for Cat-M.
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A2 triggered reporting condition. The IE value is multiplied by 2.
hysThreshold2IntraFreqCatM.fullName: Hysteresis of A2 threshold for Cat-M intra frequency handover measurement

idleLBCelResWeightCatM.description:
Weight factor of the serving cell frequency layer used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing for Cat-M.
When the parameter is not defined, the corresponding carrier is not used in selecting main target for IdleModeMobilityControlInfo for Cat-M load balancing. Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for Cat-M idle mode load balancing, which is matching Cat-M UE capabilities, to be used as main target for Cat-M idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Connection Release message.  All other target frequency for Cat-M idle mode load balancing matching Cat-M UE capabilities and configured in CATMIRFIM subordinated to CATMCEL will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB-BR with kept hierarchy of priorities.  The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
idleLBCelResWeightCatM.fullName: Cell reselection weight factor idle mode load balancing for Cat-M

idleLBPercentageOfUesCatM.description: Percentage of Cat-M UE to be selected for Idle Mode Load Balancing.
idleLBPercentageOfUesCatM.fullName: Percentage of UE for idle mode load balancing for Cat-M

mcc.description: Indicates the Mobile Country Code of the PLMN ID that shall be mapped to a Cat-M Mobility Profile.

mnc.description:
Indicates the Mobile Network Code of the PLMN ID that shall be mapped to a Cat-M Mobility Profile.

The actual range of the MNC depends on the MNC length in the configured entry of the Cat-M Mobility Profiles Mapping List.

mncLength.description: Indicates the length of the Mobile Network Code of the PLMN ID that shall be mapped to a Cat-M Mobility Profile.

moPrIdCatM.description: Identifier of the CatM Mobility Profile, which shall be mapped to one or more SPIDs and/or PLMN IDs.

moProfileSelectCatM.description:
This parameter is used to configure selection method of Cat-M Mobility Profile for mobility procedures. 
If this parameter is set to value 'spid', then SPID received from MME or incoming handover is used for CATMOPR selection.
If this parameter is set to value 'plmn' then CATMOPR selection is based on Cat-M UE's Serving PLMN ID.
If this parameter is set to 'combined' then CATMOPR selection is based on Cat-M UE's Serving PLMN ID and SPID.
moProfileSelectCatM.fullName: Mobility profile selection mode for Cat-M

mpdcchNarBandNumCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the index of the narrow band used in MPDCCH for Cat-M UEs. 
This parameter is used by the UE during the Random Access Procedure (refer to TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-NarrowbandsToMonitor-r13) and during the call (refer to TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-Narrowband-r13).

mpdcchNarBandNumModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the index of the narrow band used in MPDCCH for Cat-M ModeB UEs. 
This parameter is used by the UE during the Random Access Procedure (refer to TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-NarrowbandsToMonitor-r13) and during the call (refer to TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-Narrowband-r13).
mpdcchNarBandNumModeBCatM.fullName: MPDCCH narrowband number for Cat-M CE ModeB

mpdcchStartSfCssCatM.description:
This parameters controls the starting subframe configuration for M-PDCCH common search space for RAR, Msg3 retransmission, PDSCH with contention resolution(Msg4) and PDSCH with RRCConnectionSetup for Cat-M UEs.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.321, TS 36.213 and TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-startSF-CSS-RA-r13.
mpdcchStartSfCssCatM.fullName: MPDCCH Start SF for MPDCCH common search space for Cat-M

mpdcchStartSfUessCatM.description:
This parameters specifies the starting subframe configuration for M-PDCCH UE-specific Search Space UESS for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 0. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.321, TS 36.213, 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-StartSF-UESS-r13.
mpdcchStartSfUessCatM.fullName: MPDCCH Start SF for MPDCCH UE specific search space for Cat-M CE Level 0

mpdcchStartSfUessLev1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the starting subframe configuration for M-PDCCH UE-specific Search Space UESS for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 1. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.321, TS 36.213, 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-StartSF-UESS-r13.
mpdcchStartSfUessLev1CatM.fullName: MPDCCH Start SF for MPDCCH UE specific search space for Cat-M CE Level 1

mpdcchStartSfUessLev2CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the starting subframe configuration for M-PDCCH UE-specific Search Space UESS for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 2. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.321, TS 36.213, TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-StartSF-UESS-r13.
mpdcchStartSfUessLev2CatM.fullName: MPDCCH Start SF for MPDCCH UE specific search space for Cat-M CE Level 2

mpdcchStartSfUessLev3CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the starting subframe configuration for M-PDCCH UE-specific Search Space UESS for Cat-M UEs in CE Level 3. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.321, TS 36.213, TS 36.331 and IE mpdcch-StartSF-UESS-r13.
mpdcchStartSfUessLev3CatM.fullName: MPDCCH Start SF for MPDCCH UE specific search space for Cat-M CE Level 3

numCELevelCatM.description:
This parameter specifies supported number of coverage enhanced levels (CE-level) for Cat-M. The CE Level is decided by the PRACH RSRP threshold.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 "maxCE-Level-r13".
numCELevelCatM.fullName: Number of Coverage Enhancement Levels for Cat-M

p0NomPucchCatM.description:
This parameter specifies cell specific PUCCH nominal power for controlling the mean received SNR for control data in Cat-M UE uplink power control algorithm
Refer to TS 36.213, 5.1.2.1. Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and RRC IE RadioResourceConfigCommon, UplinkPowerControlCommon and p0-NominalPUCCH for SIB2.

p0NomPucchCatM has the same value range with legacy parameter p0NomPucch, however for Cat-M, its value must be aligned with the configured repetition level for M-PUCCH and the desired Cat-M coverage.
p0NomPucchCatM.fullName: Nominal power for Cat-M UE PUCCH TX power calculation

p0NomPuschCatM.description:
This parameter specifies cell specific PUSCH nominal power for controlling the mean received SNR for user data in Cat-M UE uplink power control algorithm
See TS 36.213, 5.1.1.1. Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and RRC IEs RadioResourceConfigCommon, UplinkPowerControlCommon, p0-NominalPUSCH in SIB2.

p0NomPuschCatM has the same value range with legacy parameter p0NomPusch, however for Cat-M, its value must be aligned with the configured repetition level for M-PUSCH and the desired Cat-M coverage.
p0NomPuschCatM.fullName: Nominal power for Cat-M UE PUSCH TX power calculation

pagPdschNarBandNumCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the index of the narrowband used for Cat-M  Paging on PDSCH, sent in DCI Format 6-2. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212, DCI Format 6-2.
pagPdschNarBandNumCatM.fullName: Paging on PDSCH narrowband number for Cat-M

pagPdschNarBandNumModeBCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the index of the narrowband used for Cat-M CE ModeB Paging on PDSCH, sent in DCI Format 6-2. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.212, DCI Format 6-2.
pagPdschNarBandNumModeBCatM.fullName: Paging on PDSCH narrowband number for Cat-M CE ModeB

pdschNarBandNumCatM.description: This parameter specifies the index of the narrow band used in PDSCH for Cat-M UEs.

pdschNarBandNumModeBCatM.description: This parameter specifies the index of the narrow band used in PDSCH for Cat-M ModeB UEs.
pdschNarBandNumModeBCatM.fullName: PDSCH narrowband number for Cat-M CE ModeB

prachPwrRampCatM.description:
This parameter configures the preamble transmit power step size for Cat-M UEs. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331, IE RACH-ConfigCommon and IE powerRampingStep.
prachPwrRampCatM.fullName: Preamble transmit power ramping step for Cat-M

prachRsrpThr1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the RSRP threshold that Cat-M UEs use to separate the Coverage Level 1 (RSRP measurement >= this threshold) and Coverage Level 2 (RSRP measurement < this threshold). 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 IE rsrp-ThresholdsPrachInfoList-r13.

Setting qRxLevMinCe1CatM less than prachRsrpThr1CatM is recommended if numCELevelCatM is set to '3'.

prachRsrpThr2CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the RSRP threshold that Cat-M UEs use to separate the Coverage Level 2 (RSRP measurement >= this threshold) and Coverage Level 3 (RSRP measurement < this threshold). 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 IE rsrp-ThresholdsPrachInfoList-r13.

Setting qRxLevMinCe1CatM less than prachRsrpThr2CatM is recommended if numCELevelCatM is set to '4'.

prachRsrpThrCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the RSRP threshold that Cat-M UEs use to separate the Coverage Level 0 (RSRP measurement >= this threshold) and Coverage Level 1 (RSRP measurement < this threshold). 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE rsrp-ThresholdsPrachInfoList-r13.

- Setting prachRsrpThrCatM to the lowest value -140dBm or less than qRxLevMinCeCatM is recommended if numCELevelCatM is set to '1'. 
- Setting prachRsrpThrCatM larger than qRxLevMinCeCatM is recommended if numCELevelCatM is set to '2'.

prbUtiFilCoeffCatM.description: This parameter defines the filter coefficient used for average PRB load measurements for Cat-M scheduler bypass.
prbUtiFilCoeffCatM.fullName: PRB utilization filtering coefficient used for Cat-M scheduler bypass

puschNarBandNumCatM.description: This parameter specifies the index of the narrow band used in PUSCH for Cat-M UEs.

puschNarBandNumModeBCatM.description: This parameter specifies the index of the narrow band used in PUSCH for Cat-M ModeB UEs.
puschNarBandNumModeBCatM.fullName: PUSCH narrowband number for Cat-M CE ModeB

qQualMinCe1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required RSRQ level for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage.
This is broadcasted in SIB1-BR.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-QualMinRSRQ-CE1-r13 and TS36.304 Qqualmin_CE1.
qQualMinCe1CatM.fullName: Minimum required RSRQ in the cell for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage

qQualMinCeCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required RSRQ level in the cell used by Cat-M UEs in enhanced coverage during cell reselection. 
This is broadcasted in SIB1-BR.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-QualMinRSRQ-CE-r13 and TS36.304 Qqualmin_CE.

If SIB::qQualMinR9 is configured, recommendation setting is less than SIB::qQualMinR9.
qQualMinCeCatM.fullName: Minimum required RSRQ in the cell for Cat-M

qQualMinIntraFCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required RSRQ level for intra-frequency neighbouring E-UTRA cells reselection by Cat-M UEs in enhanced coverage. 
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-QualMinRSRQ-CE-r13 and TS36.304 Qqualmin_CE.
qQualMinIntraFCatM.fullName: Minimum required RSRQ in intra-freq neighbor cells for Cat-M

qQualMinIntraFCe1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required RSRQ level for intra-frequency neighbouring E-UTRA cells reselection for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-QualMinRSRQ-CE1-r13 and TS36.304 Qqualmin_CE1.
qQualMinIntraFCe1CatM.fullName: Minimum required RSRQ in intra-freq neighbor cells for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage

qRxLevMinCe1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required Rx RSRP level for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage.
This is broadcasted in SIB1-BR.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-RxLevMinCE1-r13, delta-RxLevMinCE1-v1360 and TS36.304 Qrxlevmin_CE1.

- Setting qRxLevMinCe1CatM less than prachRsrpThr1CatM is recommended if numCELevelCatM is set to '3'.
- Setting qRxLevMinCe1CatM less than prachRsrpThr2CatM is recommended if numCELevelCatM is set to '4'.
qRxLevMinCe1CatM.fullName: Minimum required RX level in the cell for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage

qRxLevMinCeCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required Rx RSRP level in the cell used by Cat-M UEs in enhanced coverage during cell reselection.
This is broadcasted in SIB1-BR.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-RxLevMinCE-r13 and TS36.304 Qrxlevmin_CE.

- Setting qRxLevMinCeCatM larger than prachRsrpThrCatM is recommended if numCELevelCatM is set to '1'.
- Setting qRxLevMinCeCatM less than prachRsrpThrCatM is recommended if numCELevelCatM is set to '2'.
qRxLevMinCeCatM.fullName: Minimum required RX level in the cell for Cat-M

qRxLevMinIntraFCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required Rx RSRP level for intra-frequency neighbouring E-UTRA cells reselection by Cat-M UEs in enhanced coverage. 
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE SIB3-BR, q-RxLevMinCE-r13 and TS36.304 Qrxlevmin_CE.

Follow legacy implementation, this parameter is unnecessary, refer to SIB1-BR:: q-QualMinRSRQ-CE-r13
qRxLevMinIntraFCatM.fullName: Minimum required RX level in intra-freq neighbour cells for Cat-M

qRxLevMinIntraFCe1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required Rx RSRP level for intra-frequency neighbouring E-UTRA cells reselection for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE SIB3-BR, q-RxLevMinCE1-r13, delta-RxLevMinCE1-v1360 and TS36.304 Qrxlevmin_CE1.
qRxLevMinIntraFCe1CatM.fullName: Minimum required RX level in intra-freq neighbour cells for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage

sNonIntraSearchPR9CatM.fullName: Inter-freq and inter-RAT power meas threshold (Rel9) for Cat-M

sNonIntraSearchQR9CatM.fullName: Inter-freq and inter-RAT quality meas threshold (Rel9) for Cat-M

sNonIntrsearchCatM.description: The parameter defines the threshold (in dB) for Cat-M inter-frequency measurements.
sNonIntrsearchCatM.fullName: Inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurements threshold for Cat-M

siNarBandNumCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the index of the narrowband used for Cat-M System Information messages (SIM) on PDSCH. 
This is not for SIB1-BR but for other SIBx-BR.

Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE si-Narrowband-r13.

siNarBandSelectionCatM.description:
This parameter allows operator to choose the narrowband used for Cat-M System Information messages (SIM) on PDSCH. 
If this parameter is set to value 'ModeA', then siNarBandNumCatM would be same as pdschNarBandNumCatM.
If this parameter is set to value 'ModeB', then siNarBandNumCatM would be same as pdschNarBandNumModeBCatM.

spid.description:
Single SPID value or first SPID value of a range which shall be mapped to a Cat-M Mobility Profile.
3GPP 36.300 defines the following SPID range:
Values 1-128 are Operator specific SPIDs
Values 129-256 are Reference SPID values

spidLast.description:
Last SPID value if a range of SPID values shall be mapped to a Cat-M Mobility Profile.
3GPP 36.300 defines the following SPID range:
Values 1-128 are Operator specific SPIDs
Values 129-256 are Reference SPID values
spidLast.fullName: Last subscriber profile ID of a range

startingCovLevelPagingOptCatM.description:
Starting Coverage Level supports first paging attempt on ECGI only configured for Cat-M cell.  Paging optimization function will send the paging over specific cell for first paging message from MME, and paging over TAC region for re-paging messages from MME.
i.e.
Coverage Level 0 - Paging Optimization support start from coverage level 0 (all levels)
Coverage Level 1 - Paging Optimization support start from coverage level 1
Coverage Level 2 - Paging Optimization support start from coverage level 2
Coverage Level 3 - Paging Optimization support in coverage level 3
If this parameter is not configured, then this function is considered to be disabled.
It is recommended to set startingCovLevelPagingOptCatM to the highest configured Coverage level.
startingCovLevelPagingOptCatM.fullName: Starting Coverage Level to support first paging attempt on ECGI only for Cat-M
startingCovLevelPagingOptCatM.officialRange:
0: Coverage Level 0 
1: Coverage Level 1 
2: Coverage Level 2 
3: Coverage Level 3

t320CatM.description:
T320 for Cat-M defines the validity time of dedicated priorities defined in IdleModeMobilityControlInfo.
Note that this is an optional parameter. If the parameter is not configured, it means the timer 'not used' - interpreted by UE as 'infinity'. i.e, the T320 timer for Cat-M is not sent by eNB to the UE within IMMCI IE and dedicated priorities are not time limited (the UE uses dedicated priorities until another RRC connection is initiated).

tReselEutrCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the value of the cell reselection UE timer on the indicated EUTRAN frequency for Cat-M UEs in enhanced coverage. 
Refer to TS 36.331 and T-ReselectionEUTRA-CE-r13.

thrPrbUtiLowerCatM.description: The parameter defines lower threshold of PRB utilization for resuming normal scheduler function of Cat-M.
thrPrbUtiLowerCatM.fullName: Lower threshold of PRB utilization for resume normal scheduler function of Cat-M

thrPrbUtiUpperCatM.description: The parameter defines upper threshold of PRB utilization for triggering scheduler bypass function of Cat-M.
thrPrbUtiUpperCatM.fullName: Upper threshold of PRB utilization for trigger scheduler bypass function of Cat-M

threshServingLowQR9CatM.description: This parameter specifies the Squal threshold for the serving cell when reselecting towards a lower priority frequency for Cat-M.
threshServingLowQR9CatM.fullName: Q-threshold for reselection towards lower prio RAT/freq for Cat-M

threshSrvLowCatM.description: This parameter specifies the threshold for the serving frequency used in reselection evaluation towards a lower priority EUTRAN frequency for Cat-M.

threshold2IntraFreqCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the RSRP threshold of serving cell for starting of intra frequency measurements for Cat-M.
If value is below threshold2IntraFreqCatM  (event A2) then intra frequency measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold2IntraFreqCatM.fullName: A2 threshold for Cat-M intra frequency handover measurement

ulpcAlphaCatM.description:
This parameter specifies a fractional path loss compensation factor. It controls received SNR variance (fairness) for user data in Cat-M UE uplink power control algorithm.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IEs RadioResourceConfigCommon, UplinkPowerControlCommon, alpha in SIB2.
ulpcAlphaCatM.fullName: Alpha for Cat-M UE PUSCH TX power calculation
ulpcAlphaCatM.officialRange:
0: alpha 0 
1: alpha 0.4 
2: alpha 0.5 
3: alpha 0.6 
4: alpha 0.7 
5: alpha 0.8 
6: alpha 0.9 
7: alpha 1

ulpcIniPrePwrCatM.description:
This parameter configures the initial preamble transmit power parameter for Cat-M UEs. 
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331, IE RACH-ConfigCommon and IE preambleInitialReceivedTargetPower.

ulpcIniPrePwrCatM has the same value range with legacy parameter ulpcIniPrePwr, however for Cat-M, its value must be aligned with the configured repetition level for M-PRACH and the desired Cat-M coverage.
ulpcIniPrePwrCatM.fullName: Preamble Initial Received Target Power for Cat-M

ulpcRarespTpcCatM.description:
This parameter defines
TPC command which is indicated in the Random Access response for Cat-M UEs.
The TPC command is sent in the Random Access Response (RAR) as per section 6.2 of TS36.213.
ulpcRarespTpcCatM.fullName: TPC command in random access response for Cat-M

CATMIRFIM.officialFullName: CAT-M Inter Frequency Idle Mode configuration

catMIrfimId.description: This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC CATMIRFIM; it uniquely identifies an instance of the CATMIRFIM configuration.

dlCarFrqEut.description: eUTRA frequency (max. value ref to 3GPP 36.331 chapter 6.4) as EARFCN value for Cat-M

eutCelResPrio.description: Absolute priority of the EUTRA carrier frequency for Cat-M

eutResTiFHM.description: The field t-ReselectionEUTRA is multiplied with this factor if the Cat-M UE is in High Mobility state as defined in 36.304.
eutResTiFHM.fullName: EUTRA cell reselection timer factor high mobility

eutResTiFMM.description: The field t-ReselectionEUTRA is multiplied with this factor if the Cat-M UE is in Medium Mobility state as defined in 36.304.
eutResTiFMM.fullName: EUTRA cell reselection timer factor medium mobility

idleLBEutCelResWeightCatM.description:
Weight factor of EUTRA carrier frequency used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing for Cat-M.
When the parameter is not defined, the corresponding carrier is not used in selecting main target for IdleModeMobilityControlInfo for Cat-M load balancing. Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for Cat-M idle mode load balancing, which is matching Cat-M UE capabilities, to be used as main target for Cat-M idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Connection Release message.  All other target frequency for Cat-M idle mode load balancing matching Cat-M UE capabilities and configured in CATMIRFIM subordinated to CATMCEL will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB-BR with kept hierarchy of priorities.  The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
idleLBEutCelResWeightCatM.fullName: EUTRA carrier weight factor idle mode load balancing for Cat-M

interFrqQThrHighR9.description: This specifies the quality threshold used by the Cat-M UE when reselecting towards a higher priority frequency than the currently serving frequency.

interFrqQThrLowR9.description: This specifies the quality threshold used by the Cat-M UE when reselecting towards a lower priority frequency than the currently serving frequency.

interFrqThrH.description: This specifies the threshold used by the Cat-M UE when reselecting towards a higher priority frequency X than the currently serving frequency

interFrqThrL.description: This specifies the threshold used by the Cat-M UE in reselection towards frequency X priority from a higher priority frequency

interPresAntP.description: The IE PresenceAntennaPort1 is used to indicate whether all the neighboring cells use Antenna Port 1. When set to TRUE, the Cat-M UE may assume that at least two cell-specific antenna ports are used in all neighboring cells.

interTResEut.description: EUTRA Cell Reselection Timer in normal coverage
interTResEut.fullName: EUTRA cell reselection timer for Cat-M

interTResEutCeCatM.description: EUTRA Cell Reselection Timer in enhanced coverage
interTResEutCeCatM.fullName: EUTRA cell reselection timer for Cat-M CE

mbmsNeighCellConfigInterF.description:
Provides information related to MBSFN configuration of neighbour cells of a non-serving frequency for Cat-M.
00: Not all neighbour cells of this frequency have the same MBSFN subframe allocation
01: No MBSFN subframes are present in all neighbour cells of this frequency
10: The MBSFN subframe allocations of all neighbour cells are identical to or subsets of this frequency

measBdw.description:
The IE AllowedMeasBandwidth is used to indicate the maximum allowed measurement bandwidth common for all neighbouring cells on a
carrier frequency for Cat-M. The values mbw6, mbw15, mbw25, mbw50, mbw75, mbw100 indicate 6, 15, 25, 50, 75 and 100 resource blocks respectively.

pMaxInterF.description: Pmax to be used for the neighbouring E-UTRA cells on this carrier frequency for Cat-M. If Pmax is absent, the maximum power according to the Cat-M UE capability is used.

physCellIdNcl.description: The Physical Cell Identifier is a unique cell identification in a Neighbouring Cell List for Cat-M. It is used to indicate the physical layer identity of the cell, as defined in TS 36.211
physCellIdNcl.fullName: Physical cell identifier in neighbouring cell list

qOffCell.description:
The parameter defines a cell-specific offset (in dB) that is used in the cell reselection procedure for Cat-M. 
This specifies the offset between two cells.

qOffFrq.description: Frequency specific offset for equal priority E-UTRAN frequencies for Cat-M.

qQualMinInterF.description: This parameter specifies the minimum required quality level of inter-frequency neighbor cells for UEs in normal coverage.
qQualMinInterF.fullName: Minimum required RSRQ in inter-freq neighbour cells for Cat-M

qQualMinInterFCe1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required quality level of inter-frequency neighbor cells for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage. 
This is broadcasted in SIB5-BR.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-QualMinRSRQ-CE1-r13 and TS36.304 Qqualmin_CE1.
qQualMinInterFCe1CatM.fullName: Minimum required RSRQ in inter-freq neighbour cells for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage

qQualMinInterFCeCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required quality level of inter-frequency neighbor cells for UEs in enhanced coverage. 
This is broadcasted in SIB5-BR.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-QualMinRSRQ-CE-r13 and TS36.304 Qqualmin_CE.
qQualMinInterFCeCatM.fullName: Minimum required RSRQ in inter-freq neighbour cells for Cat-M CE

qRxLevMinInterF.description: This parameter specifies the minimum required RSRP level of inter-frequency neighbour cells for UEs in normal coverage.
qRxLevMinInterF.fullName: Minimum required RSRP level in inter-freq neighbour cells for Cat-M

qRxLevMinInterFCe1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required RSRP level of inter-frequency neighbour cells for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage. 
This is broadcasted in SIB5-BR.
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE q-RxLevMinCE1-r13, delta-RxLevMinCE1-v1360 and TS36.304 Qrxlevmin_CE1.
qRxLevMinInterFCe1CatM.fullName: Minimum required RSRP level in inter-freq neighbour cells for Cat-M UEs support CE ModeB in enhanced coverage

qRxLevMinInterFCeCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the minimum required RSRP level of inter-frequency neighbour cells for UEs in enhanced coverage. 
Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 IE SIB3-BR, q-RxLevMinCE-r13 and TS36.304 Qrxlevmin_CE.
qRxLevMinInterFCeCatM.fullName: Minimum required RSRP level in inter-freq neighbour cells for Cat-M CE

rangeInterPci.description: Indicates the number of PCIs in the range (including startPCI) for Cat-M. Value n4 corresponds with 4, n12 corresponds with 12 and so on. The Cat-M UE applies value 1 if the field is absent, in which case only the physical cell identity value indicated by start applies.
rangeInterPci.fullName: Number of PCI in inter-frequency range

startInterPci.description: Indicates the lowest PCI in the range for Cat-M

autoAdaptCatM.description:
This parameter offers the possibility to use existing LNCEL configuration as default Cat-M mobility profile.

autoAdaptCatM parameter is considered when CATMODPR applies.
If CATMCEL-actSelMobPrfCatM is set to 'enabled' then CATMODPR applies only when no CATMOPR instance exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the Cat-M UE.
If CATMCEL-actSelMobPrfCatM is set to 'disabled' then CATMODPR applies for all Cat-M UEs.

If autoAdaptCatM is set to 'disabled' :
   - CATMODPR configuration is used for Cat-M HO mobility.
If autoAdaptCatM is set to 'enabled' :
   - all frequencies configured in LNCEL-LNHOIF are to be mearsured.
autoAdaptCatM.fullName: Auto adaptation to frequency layers of all neighbour cells for Cat-M

catMoDPrId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC CATMODPR.
It uniquely identifies a CATMODPR instance.

freqLayListCatM.description:
CatM inter-frequency mobility is restricted to the target frequency layers configured in freqLayListCatM. 

If CATMCEL-actSelMobPrfCatM is set to 'enabled' the restriction applies when a CATMOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE. 

If CATMCEL-actSelMobPrfCatM is set to ‘disabled’ the restriction applies to all UEs.
- No Cat-M Inter Frequency mobility will be provided if the parameter is omitted.
- The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.
freqLayListCatM.fullName: Frequency layer list for Cat-M inter frequency mobility

catMoPrId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC CATMOPR.
It uniquely identifies a CATMOPR instance.

freqLayListCatM.description:
List of downlink carrier frequencies for Cat-M inter frequency mobility.
No Cat-M Inter Frequency mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the profile if the parameter is omitted.
freqLayListCatM.fullName: Frequency layer list for Cat-M inter frequency mobility for Cat-M

actAmcCatM.description: The parameter enables/disables Cat-M UEs link adapation (LA) algorithm for uplink and downlink respectively. The LA algorithm responsible for selecting the MCS is called Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC) for Cat-M UEs.
actAmcCatM.officialRange:
0: disabled 
1: Downlink AMC enabled 
2: Uplink AMC enabled 
3: Both Downlink and Uplink enabled

amcCStepUpModeACatM.description:
The parameter defines the stepsize up value for the DL/UL Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation delta C for Cat-M UEs in CE modeA. 
Stepsize down value for delta C can be calculated by using this parameter and DL/UL target BLER.
amcCStepUpModeACatM.fullName: AMC delta C stepsize up of Cat-M in CE modeA

amcDeltaCiniModeACatM.description: The parameter defines the initial value for DL/UL Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation delta C for Cat-M UEs in CE modeA.
amcDeltaCiniModeACatM.fullName: AMC initial delta C of Cat-M in CE modeA

amcDeltaCmaxModeACatM.description:
The parameter defines the maximum limit for the DL/UL Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation value delta C for Cat-M UEs in CE modeA. 
If the value delta C reaches the maximum limit, DL/UL MCS is increased by one.
amcDeltaCmaxModeACatM.fullName: AMC maximum delta C of Cat-M in CE modeA

amcDeltaCminModeACatM.description:
The parameter defines the minimum limit for DL/UL Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation value delta C for Cat-M UEs in CE modeA. 
If delta C value reaches the minimum limit, DL/UL MCS is decreased by one.
amcDeltaCminModeACatM.fullName: AMC minimum delta C of Cat-M in CE modeA

catMPrId.description: This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC CATMPR, it uniquely identifies an instance of the CATMPR configuration.

cpInactivityTimerCatM.description:
The parameter defines the time period for the indication of the UE- associated S1 logical connection inactivity DL and UL directions.
C-Plane inactivity timer monitors activity on S1AP interface for UE-associated S1 logical connection traffic. It's started with UE-associated S1 logical connection establishment and restarted on reception or sending S1AP message that contains NAS PDU IE.

defPagCycCatM.description:
This parameter specifies cell-specific paging DRX cycle duration for Cat-M UEs. 
Refer TS 36.304 and TS 36.331, IE RadioResourceConfigCommon, IE PCCH-Config and IE defaultPagingCycle. 
Value rf32 corresponds to 32 radio frames, rf64 corresponds to 64 radio frames and so on.

dlMaxHarqTxQci1CatM.description: This parameter specifies the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in DL for Cat-M QCI1-DRB.
dlMaxHarqTxQci1CatM.fullName: DL Maximum number of HARQ transmission for Cat-M QCI1-DRB

dlPathlossChgModeACatM.description: This parameter specifies a trigger condition for power headroom submission due to pathloss change.
dlPathlossChgModeACatM.fullName: Downlink pathloss change for Cat-M in CE modeA

dlTargetBlerModeACatM.description: This parameter defines target Block Error Ratio (BLER) for downlink Link Adaptation in percents used for Cat-M UEs in CE modeA
dlTargetBlerModeACatM.fullName: DL target BLER of Cat-M in CE modeA

harqMaxMsg3TxCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum number of HARQ transmissions used for message 3 of the contention-based random access procedure for Cat-M UEs.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE maxHARQ-Msg3Tx.
But due to asynchronized HARQ for Cat-M UEs, the RRC IE ‘maxHARQ-Msg3Tx’ will be ignored by Cat-M UEs, therefore this parameter confguration is only used by eNB internally.
harqMaxMsg3TxCatM.fullName: Maximum number of Msg3 HARQ transmissions for Cat-M

harqMaxTrDlCatM.description: This parameter specifies the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in DL that is configured for Cat-M UE at initial access (Message 4) and DL data transmission.
harqMaxTrDlCatM.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in DL for Cat-M

harqMaxTxUlCatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in UL that is configured for Cat-M UE at initial access to a specific cell.
Refer to 3GPP TS 36.331 and IE maxHARQ-Tx.
But due to asynchronized HARQ for Cat-M UEs, the RRC IE ‘maxHARQ-Tx’ will be ignored by Cat-M UEs, therefore this parameter confguration is only used by eNB internally.
harqMaxTxUlCatM.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in UL for Cat-M

inactivityTimerCatM.description: This parameter defines the time period for the indication of the Cat-M UE inactivity in both DL and UL directions.

iniMcsDlModeACatM.description:
The parameter defines an initial Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) to be used on PDSCH for other use than BCCH, PCH or random access messages.
The range of MCS value for Cat-M is defined by 3GPP 36.213 table 7.1.7.1-1: "Modulation and TBS index table for PDSCH"
iniMcsDlModeACatM.fullName: Initial MCS in downlink of Cat-M in CE modeA

iniMcsUlModeACatM.description:
The parameter defines an initial Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) to be used on PUSCH for other use than random access message 3 for Cat-M UEs in CE modeA.
The range of MCS value for Cat-M is defined by 3GPP 36.213 table 8.6.1-1: "Modulation, TBS index and redundancy version table for PUSCH"
iniMcsUlModeACatM.fullName: Initial MCS in uplink of Cat-M in CE modeA

maxCrPgDlCatM.description:
The parameter defines the maximum code rate for paging. This maximum code rate is taken into account during PDSCH scheduling.

Note: The amount of paging records being transmitted per paging occasion is limited such that the configured code rate is not exceeded; a single paging record is transmitted in any case.
maxCrPgDlCatM.fullName: Maximum code rate for paging message on PDSCH for Cat-M

maxGbrDlQci1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum value of the GBR in the downlink direction for Cat-M QCI1-DRB.
eNB will reject those EPS bearers with Cat-M QCI1 for which the GBR in downlink direction is greater than this value.
maxGbrDlQci1CatM.fullName: Maximum GBR downlink for Cat-M QCI1-DRB

maxGbrUlQci1CatM.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum value of the GBR in the uplink direction for Cat-M QCI1-DRB.
eNB will reject those EPS bearers with Cat-M QCI1 for which the GBR in uplink direction is greater than this value.
maxGbrUlQci1CatM.fullName: Maximum GBR uplink for Cat-M QCI1-DRB

maxNumActDrbCatM.description: This parameter specifies threshold for the maximum number of established Cat-M DRBs in the cell. The maximum number of established Cat-M DRB include regular Cat-M DRB and emergency Cat-M DRB.
