actNwReqUeCapa.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'Network requested UE radio capabilities'.
The feature'Network requested UE radio capabilities' implements the eNB functionality for 3GPP CR 1515/1630 to 3GPP 36.331.
It is recommended that operator enables this feature if he has configured carrier aggregation in his network.
actNwReqUeCapa.fullName: Activate network requested UE radio capabilities

actOTNRecovery.description:
Activate OTN Link Loss Self-Recovery flag
This parameter specifies the behavior of Optical Network (OTN) recovery actions. When this parameter is set to true, a 1956 fault (critical BER detected on the optical connection to Radio Module) will not trigger the BTS to reset the impacted RF modules immediately. Instead, the BTS will stay in service and attempt to re-adjust the delays within the time limit as specified in OTN Recovery Period. The radios will self-reset if readjustments failed within the time period.

When this parameter is set to false, adjustments will not occur and the BTS will reset the impacted RF modules when fault 1956 is detected.

actOperatorQCI.fullName: Activate support of operator specific QCIs

actOperatorQCIGBR.description: This parameter activates the support of establishment of GBR EPS bearers with QCI in the range of 128…254.
actOperatorQCIGBR.fullName: Activate support of operator specific GBR QCIs

actOptMmeSelection.description:
Activates the optimized MME selection algorithm
If this parameter is set to “true”, the MME selection function distinguishes native and mapped GUMMEIs according to TS 23.401. If UE provides its (old) GUMMEI, the MME selection function based on GUMMEI is restricted to the corresponding RATs. 

If this parameter is set to “false”, the MME selection function does not distinguish native and mapped GUMMEIs. If UE provides its (old) GUMMEI, the MME selection function based on GUMMEI will consider all RATs.

actOptimizedL3Pool.description: Enables an optimised memory/processing pool allocation strategy for Layer 3 (RRC/NAS signalling) processing resources.

actPCMDReport.description:

Although PCMD reporting uses the trace framework the enabling of the feature flag for cell tracing is not a precondition for PCMD reporting.

actPMQAPProfilesExtension.description: Enables an extension to the number/scope of PM QoS Analysis Profiles (PMQAP) supported.

This parameter activates the feature 'ARP based partial admission control for handover'.
If the feature is activated Target eNodeB will perform ARP based partial admission control for incoming handover due to radio reasons and service based handover for emergency services. If partial handover is applied, admission control may decide not to admit E-RABs with vulnerability Pre-Emptable. Nevertheless handover preparation will be accepted

actPlmnUnavailForCellReport.description:

If 'disabled' is selected, the 'No PLMN available for cell(s)' fault report function is disabled.
If 'cell' is selected, the alarm will be reported at cell level. Note: This is risk of alarm flood for cell level alarm report.

actProhibitWcdmaMobPreQci1.description: Enables prohibiting mobility (handover/redirection) to WCDMA before a QCI1 (voice) bearer has been established, ensuring the voice bearer completes setup on LTE first.

actRLFReportEval.description:
This parameter is used for enabling/disabling of the feature "UE Radio Link Failure report evaluation".
When the feature is activated the eNB will trigger the retrieval of RLF reports from UEs if it has received the rlf-InfoAvailable IE either during
- RRCConnectionSetupComplete
- RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete
- RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete
message.

This retrieval is independent whether there is a trace session active to trace these messages or not.

Furthermore, RLF reports are forwarded via RLFIndication message on X2AP interface to the "RLF cell" if applicable, i.e. when the "RLF cell" is different to the current Pcell.

actRLFbasedRCR.description: Activates the feature 'Radio Link Failure (RLF) based RRC connection reestablishment (RCR)'
actRLFbasedRCR.fullName: Activate RLF based RRC connection reestablishment

actRLFbasedRCRConfigL1.description: Enables Layer-1 (physical-layer) specific configuration handling within the RLF-based Radio Configuration Report feature.

actRLFbasedRCREnhanced.description: Activates the feature 'Enhanced Radio Link Failure (RLF) based RRC connection reestablishment (RCR)'
actRLFbasedRCREnhanced.fullName: Activate enhanced RLF based RRC connection reestablishment

actRLFbasedRCREnhancedIntra.description: Enables the enhanced RLF-based Radio Configuration Report feature specifically for intra-frequency mobility scenarios.

actRLFbasedRCRTargetCRNTI.description: Enables including the target cell's C-RNTI information within the RLF-based Radio Configuration Report feature.

actRSRPRSRQHist.description: Parameter actRSRPRSRQHist activates or deactivates the  RSRP and RSRQ Histogram counters

actRadioPosFlexibility.description:
This parameter indicates whether the cell should be mapped to the configured topology RMOD-conneciontList-positionInChain or to the same previously connected radio when there is an OBSAI Optical Transport Network (OTN) topology change between the System/Baseband and Radio Module. 
When actRadioPosFlexibility = false, the BTS will not re-establish the cell if the radio detected is not in the same position as defined in the RMOD-conneciontList-positionInChain.
When actRadioPosFlexibility = true, the BTS will check if an RF module matches the one used prior to the OTN change by its serial number, and based on it re-establishes a cell.

actRedirect.description: This parameter enables the feature UE context release with redirect.
actRedirect.fullName: Enable UE context release with redirect

actReduceAcqiReqTxSkip.description: Enables skipping/reducing transmissions of aperiodic CQI requests under certain conditions, saving control-channel resources.

actRejHoInCellResForOpUse.description: Activates rejection of incoming handovers into a cell that is reserved for operator use (barred to normal subscribers).

actRemoteInterferenceReport.description: Enables Remote Interference Management (RIM) reporting, used to detect and report atmospheric-ducting interference arriving from distant TDD cells (3GPP Rel-16 RIM feature).

actReturnTo5GSA.description: Enables a feature allowing a UE anchored on LTE/EN-DC to be returned/redirected to standalone 5G (5G SA) coverage once conditions permit.

actRrcConnNoActivity.description: This parameter activates the functionality to keep the UE in RRC connected mode even if there is no activity (e.g. during ringtone) until QCI1 establishment triggered protection timer expiry.
actRrcConnNoActivity.fullName: Activate RRC connected mode while no activity

actRrcConnRelDelay.description: Enables adding a deliberate delay before releasing an RRC connection, allowing pending short data bursts to complete before teardown and reducing signalling overhead from immediate reconnection.

actRsrqInterFreqMobility.description: This parameter activates the inter-frequency mobility based on A5 RSRQ measurements.

actRsrqInterRatMobility.description: This parameter activates the inter-RAT mobility based on B2 RSRQ measurements.

actRtPerfMonitoring.description:
This is a feature flag to enable or disable the RT Performance Monitoring Feature and to select which type of RT PM is chosen.
The value All_PM_Counters is used for enabling the LTE1053 feature content, whereas PDCP_SDU_Group is used for specific PM counter subset as required in LTE2054.

actS1Flex.description: This parameter indicates whether S1 Flex feature is enabled or disabled.
actS1Flex.fullName: Activation status of S1 flex feature

actS1InducedX2Closure.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable S 1 Induced X 2 Closure" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actS1OlHandling.description: This parameter activates the S1 Overload Handling feature.

actSIB24.description: Enables broadcasting System Information Block Type 24 (SIB24), which carries GERAN/LTE inter-RAT cell reselection information defined in later 3GPP releases.

actSatBackhaul.description:
The parameter activates the support of satellite connections within S1- and X2 links.

Setting the parameter to 'true' does not indicate that the eNB itself has satellite backhaul. For indication of eNB itself having satellite backhaul its eNB ID must be included in the range of eNB IDs which is configured with the LNSENB parameter satBhEnbIdRanges.

actSdl.description: This is a feature flag to enable or disable the SDL Feature.

actSecRatRep.description: Enables Secondary RAT (e.g. NR) usage reporting to the core network.

actSegUeCapInfo.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Seg User Equipment (mobile device) capability/capacity Info" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actSelMobPrf.description:
This parameter activates the features 'Selective Mobility Profiles' and - in case the LNBTS parameter moProfileSelect is set to 'plmn' or 'combined' - also 'PLMN ID and SPID selected mobility profiles'.

If this parameter is 'true':
- Mobility profiles are used to configure HO mobility, Redirection and Idle Mode Mobility reconfiguration (MOPR/MODPR, MORED/MODRED and MOIMP/MODIMP).

If this parameter is 'false':
- for HO mobility:
   - if MODPR exists, then MODPR configuration is used for HO mobility. Otherwise LNHOIF, LNHOW, LNHOG configuration is used.
   - MOPR configuration is never used.
- for Redirection and Idle Mode Mobility configuration:
   - REDRT, IRFIM, UFFIM, CDFIM and GNFL configuration are always used.
   - MORED, MODRED, MOIMP and MODIMP configurations are never used.

actServBasedMobThr.description:
This parameter activates the features 'Dedicated mobility thresholds for SRVCC' and 'Service based handover thresholds' and activates a mechanism for different points of triggering handover.
Dedicated service based thresholds are used for measurements when UE has QCI1 bearer.
Note: Use of dedicated thresholds is not dependent on SRVCC features being enabled.

actServicePRButiL.description:
This parameter activates/deactivates the following PM counters from feature Additional Layer 1 Performance Measurements:

Group 2: M8011C151-M8011C160, M8011C140-M8011C149, M8011C150, M8011C161

Activation of the other counters from LTE1491 feature is controlled by parameter actL1PM.
actServicePRButiL.fullName: Feature Activation Flag Additional Layer 1 PM Group 2 Counters

actSnChangeSnInit.description: Enables the Secondary Node (SN)-initiated SN Change procedure in EN-DC, allowing the NR secondary node itself to trigger a change of secondary node.

actSpecDupGapNB.description: This parameter activates 3 SA NB-IoT carriers with special duplexing gap in NB-IoT cell
actSpecDupGapNB.fullName: Activate special duplexing gap for NB-IoT standalone

actSplitUeNrCapRetrieval.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Split User Equipment (mobile device) NR (5G New Radio) capability/capacity Retrieval" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actStepAddBearENDC.description: Enables a stepwise (gradual) bearer-addition procedure specifically for EN-DC UEs.

actSubscriberTrace.description: This is a feature flag to enable or disable Subscriber & Equipment Trace feature.

actTM9Block.description: Enables blocking/restricting use of Transmission Mode 9 for UEs, preventing the eNodeB from configuring TM9 (e.g. due to a known interoperability limitation).

actTaHistCounters.description:
The parameter activates the feature 'Timing advance histogram PM counters'
Note: In addition, the measurement M8029 needs to be started in each LNCEL separately.
actTaHistCounters.fullName: Activate timing advance histogram PM counters

actTcpBoost.description: This parameter activates TCP booster function.

actTempHoBlacklisting.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'Temporary handover blacklisting'.
If activated, handover target cells will be temporarily blacklisted for some time in case of consecutive HO preparation failures or a rejected HO preparation with a selected set of cause values.
If the parameter is activated, handover target cells will be temporarily blacklisted for some time in case of consecutive HO preparation failures. Blacklisting time and number of consecutive HO preparation timeouts are configurable. Cells will also be temporarily blacklisted for some time in case of a rejected HO preparation by target eNB with cause value "Radio Network Layer Cause (Cell not Available)", "Miscellaneous Cause (Control Processing Overload)" or "Miscellaneous Cause (Not enough User Plane Processing Resources)".

actTraceOvlProt.description: Activates overload protection for the trace/logging subsystem, preventing excessive tracing from degrading system performance.

actTransmittedBelowGap.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Transmitted Below Gap" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actTransportSeparationLte.description: This parameter configures the use of the feature "Transport Separation for LTE RAN Sharing".
actTransportSeparationLte.fullName: Feature activation flag for transport separation for LTE RAN sharing

actUL256QamForEnDc.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable uplink 256 Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (modulation order) For En Dual Connectivity/DC power (context-dependent)" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actULCAggr.description:
The parameter activates uplink carrier aggregation. The feature can only be activated in addition to downlink carrier aggregation.

If "UL_CA_with_smartSched" is activated, only UEs with pathloss less than ulCaPathlossThr could be scheduled in multiple serving cells for uplink.
Following features in detail are activated:
- LTE1092 "FDD uplink carrier aggregation for 2 CCs"

Note:
For FDD cells UL Carrier aggregation is using only Smart Scheduling, i.e. if the cellTechnology is set to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' and actULCAggr is set to 'UL_CA_without_smartSched' smart scheduling applies.
For TDD cells the bands to be aggregated need to be contiguous in the same band, i.e. only intra-band carrier aggregation is supported.

actULCaForEnDc.description: Enables Uplink Carrier Aggregation to be used together with EN-DC.

actUTCBroadcast.description:
This parameter enables the feature LTE3056 support GPS and UTC time Information broadcast (SIB16).

Note: If SIB16 is configured in this cell, all Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when actUTCBroadcast is modified.
actUTCBroadcast.fullName: Activate GPS and UTC Time Broadcast

actUavSupport.description: Activates special handling for aerial UEs (drones/UAVs), such as adjusted mobility or interference-management behavior.

actUeBasedAnrInterFreqLte.description: This parameter indicates if the 'Intra-LTE Inter-Frequency UE-based ANR' feature is activated by the operator.
actUeBasedAnrInterFreqLte.fullName: Activate UE-based ANR for Inter-frequency LTE

actUeBasedAnrIntraFreqLte.description: This parameter indicates if the 'Intra-LTE Intra-Frequency UE-based ANR' feature is activated by the operator.
actUeBasedAnrIntraFreqLte.fullName: Activate UE-based ANR for intra-Frequency LTE

actUeBasedAnrNr.description: Enables UE-measurement-report-driven Automatic Neighbor Relation detection for NR neighbors, rather than relying only on static/network configuration.

actUeBasedAnrNrHo.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable User Equipment (mobile device) Based Automatic Neighbor Relation NR (5G New Radio) handover" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actUeBasedAnrUtran.description: This parameter indicates if the feature ''UE-based ANR for Inter-RAT UTRAN" neighbour cells is activated by the operator.

actUeCapEndcHo.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable User Equipment (mobile device) capability/capacity E-UTRA-NR Dual Connectivity handover" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actUeLevelMro.description: Feature activation/deactivatin flag of UE Level MRO

actUeLocInfo.description: This parameter activates support of user location information reporting
actUeLocInfo.fullName: Activate support of user location information reporting

actUeThroughputMeas.description: This parameter is used for enabling/disabling of the feature "Addition of MAC measurements to cell trace".

actUeTrigEnDcTakeBack.description: Activates a mechanism allowing the UE to trigger re-establishment ('take back') of its EN-DC secondary NR connection after it was temporarily released.

actUlCoMp.description:
Uplink coordinated multipoint (CoMP) reception activation for the  eNB.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

Configuration rules for FDD:
Distributed sites are only supported if the distance between RRHs is less than 1 km.

Notes for TDD:
Recommendations for balancing increased TDD cell throughput and link level gain (not considered in validation):
If chBw is set to '20MHz' AND dlMimoMode is set to 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)', actUlCoMp is recommended to be configured to 'true'.

Configuration rules for TDD:
Distributed sites are only supported if the distance between RRHs is less than 1 km, with a maximal Doppler shift of 250 Hz.
For 4 Rx UL-CoMP (LTE1691) only cells with 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth are supported.
For 2 Rx, 4 Rx and 8 Rx UL-CoMP (LTE1402, LTE2104 and LTE2128) cells with 10 MHz, 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth are supported

actUlGrantEffTcpBoost.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable uplink Grant Eff Tcp Boost" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actUlInDevCoexGNSS.description: This parameter activates feature "In-Device Coexistence." If this feature is activated, the network supports In-Device Coexistence for uplink carrier aggregation with GNSS for emergency and non-emergency calls.  When triggered, the network suspends SCell uplink scheduling. The feature can only be activated in addition to uplink carrier aggregation.
actUlInDevCoexGNSS.fullName: Activate in-device coexistence for UL CA with GNSS

actUlTraffDrivUlCa.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable uplink Traff Driv uplink carrier aggregation" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actUlTxSkip.description: This parameter activates LTE4066 Low Latency Fast UL Grants
actUlTxSkip.fullName: Activate low latency fast UL grants

actUlpcDiffPusch.description: Enables differentiated uplink power-control settings per PUSCH transmission scenario, rather than a single uniform configuration.

actUplaneOvlHandling.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'U-plane overload handling'.

Three levels of load are defined and, if configured and enabled, countermeasures will be executed according to load level.

actUserLayerTcpMssClamping.description:
This parameter enables/disables the optional feature "User layer TCP MSS clamping" (LTE1240).
When enabled, the MSS in end user TCP SYN packets is reduced to a value avoiding IP fragmentation in the transport layer.
actUserLayerTcpMssClamping.fullName: Activation of user layer TCP MSS clamping

actVendSpecCellTraceEnh.description: Parameter actVendSpecCellTraceEnh activates or deactivates additional vendor specific Cell Trace enhancements (LTE1501, LTE1931, LTE1914).
actVendSpecCellTraceEnh.fullName: Activate vendor specific cell trace enhancements

actVoLTEQualInterFreqMobility.description: This parameter activates the feature LTE3723 'VoLTE quality triggered inter frequency mobility'.
actVoLTEQualInterFreqMobility.fullName: Activate VoLTE quality triggered inter frequency mobility

actVoLTEQualSRVCCtoGsm.description: This parameter activates the feature LTE3443 ' VoLTE quality triggered SRVCC to GSM'.
actVoLTEQualSRVCCtoGsm.fullName: Activate VoLTE quality triggered SRVCC to GSM

actVoLTEQualSrvccToWcdma.description: Enables triggering SRVCC handover to WCDMA based on VoLTE call-quality degradation, in addition to radio-link based triggers.

actVoLteNoEnDc.description: Enables temporarily suspending or blocking EN-DC (secondary NR connection) while a VoLTE call is active, avoiding added complexity/interruption during voice calls.

actVoLteNoEnDcDrop.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable voice (e.g. VoNR/VoLTE -- Voice over NR/LTE) Lte No En Dual Connectivity/DC power (context-dependent) Drop" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actX2gNB128.description: Enables support for up to 128 X2/Xn connections toward gNBs, expanding the X2-to-gNB link-capacity limit for EN-DC deployments beyond the default.

actZUC.description:
Controls optional ZUC ciphering and integrity protection algorithms.
This parameter enables/disables optional ZUC ciphering algorithms.

actZson.description: Activates Nokia's Zero-touch Self-Organizing Network (zSON) feature suite for automated network optimization.

acteNACCtoGSM.description: This parameter enables the feature LTE442 Network Assisted Cell Change from LTE to GSM

allocCriterion.description: Criterion for mapping of cells to baseband pools
allocCriterion.officialRange:
0: Bandwidth 
1: CoMp Set 
2: Frequency 
3: Logical group 
4: Power saving groups 
5: RX antennas 
6: NB-IOT mode 
7: CatM 
8: Cell Technology 
9: Timing groups

allocPriority.description: Priority of the criterion. The higher the value the higher priority.

anrOmExtEnable.description: Optional feature flag for feature LTE492 ANR support for LTE with O&M extension
anrOmExtEnable.fullName: Activate ANR support for LTE with OAM extension

arpOffsetUsageOnBBpool.description: Enables applying an ARP (Allocation and Retention Priority)-based offset when allocating baseband-pool resources, so higher-ARP bearers are prioritised when baseband capacity in a pool is contended.

arpPriority.description:
ARP priority level assigned by eNB to the RRC Connection which is valid until first DRB is established.
The range of the ARP priority level is 1 to 15 with 1 as the highest level of priority.

b1NrRedirectTimer.description: Likely a timer/duration setting related to "b 1 NR (5G New Radio) Redirect Timer" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

b1SupervisionOffset.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "b 1 Supervision Offset" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

bandNumber.description:
bandNumber is the band that UE uses for filtering of CA band combinations except those for CA 2 DL + 1 UL.
bandNumber shall be aligned with the band numbers used in 3GPP TS 36.101 for the definition of CA band combinations.
If operator uses band numbers that require the mapping by MFBI (Multiple Frequency Band Indicator), it is recommened that actMFBI is set to true and operator enters all band numbers into bandNumber that are contained in those CA band combinations of 3GPP TS 36.101 that he wants to use.

bandPrio.description:
BandPrio defines the order in which eNB fills the related bandNumber into the UE Capability Retrieval message to UE. 
BandPrio 1 has the highest priority; BandPrio 16 has the lowest priority.

bbPoolEvalPeriod.description: Period during that the load measurements are evaluated on cell basis. Based on the load measurements the pool manager redistributes the shared resources again.
bbPoolEvalPeriod.fullName: Evaluation period of the pool resources

bbPoolMinResource.description:
Minimum resource share in percent the baseband pool manager shall assign to the cells. The same share shall be assigned for all resources.
This parameter defines the percentage of the dynamic baseband pool resource which is reserved as a minimum resource for all cells allocated to the baseband pool. This reserve is divided up among the cells of the baseband pool. The remaining part of this baseband pool is divided up among the cells based on the averaged load within the cells.

blacklistS1HoEPCFailure.description: If this parameter is set to 'true', eNodeB shall temporarily blacklist S1 Handover target cells in case a S1 Handover preparation is rejected with cause value 'Radio Network Layer Cause (Handover Failure In Target EPC/eNB Or Target System)'.
blacklistS1HoEPCFailure.fullName: Blacklist S1 handover target cells special cause values

blockingState.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "blocking State" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

boostFactorDl.description: This parameter defines the scaling factor for DL scheduling weight. It is used to increase the DL scheduling weight for bearers which have TCP traffic boosting triggered according to tcpServiceDiffConfig settings.

boostFactorUl.description: This parameter defines the scaling factor for UL scheduling weight. It is used to increase the UL scheduling weight for bearers which have TCP traffic boosting triggered according to tcpServiceDiffConfig settings.

btsResetRequest.description:
Reset request for BTS. Whenever a (delta-)plan modifiying or setting this parameter is downloaded, BTS will reset automatically. This parameter is not intended for use by operator, but will be used by NetAct to perform automatic troubleshooting actions, which require a reset of the BTS. 

The value of the parameter as such is not relevant. However, at each new reset request a different value should be selected.
One way to make sure that the new parameter value is different from the last one is to use the current time stamp. Using this scheme will also document the time at which the reset decision was taken. 
However, any other scheme which makes sure the parameter value changes is also possible.

btsType.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "Base Transceiver Station Type" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

cPlaneDscp.description: This parameter defines the differentiated services code point (DSCP) value assigned to the control plane traffic.

caClusterId.description:
Defines the eNBs (system modules) that are combined in carrier aggregation. 
eNBs that host cells that are combined for carrier aggregation are connected via SRIO interface and must have the same caClusterId. No other eNBs in the whole network must have the same caClusterId.

caClusterMemberId.description:
Identifies the eNB within a carrier aggregation cluster. Each eNB inside the a cluster must get a unique member ID.

In combination with measurement based CoMP feature fixed parameter value combinations of caClusterMemberId and btsHotelMemberId are required.
Note: The allowed combinations are independent if the BTS is deployed as single or dual core network element, for deployment related differences please refer to SMOD-btsHotelMemberId.

caClusterNumEnb.description: Specifies the number of eNBs that shall be inter-connected via sRIO cable within a carrier aggregation cluster.
caClusterNumEnb.fullName: Number of eNBs in a carrier aggregation cluster

caConfigRatioOvl1.description:
Carrier Aggregation (CA) SCell configuration ratio in overload level 1. 0% means no SCell configuration requests are handled in overload 1. 100% (or parameter not defined) means all SCell configuration requests are handled normally i.e. no blocking of SCell configuration requests.
SCell deconfiguration requests are not subjected to this ratio and are handled normally.

caIntraCellHoMode.description:
The following intra-cell handover modes to mFBI mapped or native frequency with carrier aggregation needs are supported:

disabled:
intra-cell handover to mFBI mapped or native frequency with CA needs is disabled.

nonCAtoCA:
Intra-cell handover will be performed if there is no CA band combination supported both by UE and eNB for current operating band of the PCell, while there are CA band combinations supported both by UE and ENB for another operating band of the PCell.

moreDLCACapacity:
The mode covers the 'nonCAtoCA' mode. In addition to 'nonCAtoCA' mode Intra-cell handover will be also performed if there are CA band combinations which have more potential DL CA aggregation bandwidth supported both by UE and eNB for PCell on another operating band than current operating band.

caMinDlAmbr.description: This parameter excludes those UEs from carrier aggregation, whose UE-AMBR Downlink is below the caMinDlAmbr threshold .
caMinDlAmbr.fullName: Min UE-AMBR downlink for carrier aggregation

caMinUlAmbr.description: This parameter excludes those UEs from uplink carrier aggregation, whose UE-AMBR Uplink is below the caMinUlAmbr threshold. Downlink carrier aggregation is still possible for the UE when the DL conditions are met.
caMinUlAmbr.fullName: Min UE-AMBR uplink for carrier aggregation

caSchedFairFact.description:
This parameter controls scheduling fairness between UEs with and without activated SCell (S-LNCEL).
This parameter controls scheduling fairness in DL time and frequency domain scheduling between UEs with and without an active SCell. Value 0 means that no fairness is provided; that is UEs with an SCell activated get maximal benefits; and value 1 means that full fairness is provided that is UEs with and without an active SCell will be treated similarly. 
The group of cells that are aggregated should have the same setting for this parameter.

caUlIntraBandAmpr.description:
This parameter defines whether or not A-MPR values as defined in Tables 6.2.4.A-1 and 6.2.4.A-2 of 3GPP 36.101 will be sent to the UE.

If set to 'disabled',
A-MPR values will NOT be sent to the UE.

If set to 'enabled',
A-MPR values will be sent for all bands where A-MPR is defined.
For bands where A-MPR is NOT defined, the parameter does not apply.
caUlIntraBandAmpr.fullName: Additional MPR for UL intra-band carrier aggregation

commLossRecoveryTimer.description: Timer controlling how long the BTS waits after losing communication with the core network/OMC before initiating automatic recovery action.

congWeightAlg.description:
The Parameter congWeightAlg defines a priorization behaviour in layer 2 (MAC) until either the congestion situation ends or until the congestion situation is resolved by higher layers. There are two different algorithms possible:
• qciPrio: Bearers are prioritized in order of their QCI priority.
• arpPrioPerVul: First bearers with ARP vulnerability "preemptable" are prioritized in order of the ARP priority, then the bearers with ARP vulnerability "not preemptable" also in order of ARP priority.

counterGroup.description: This parameter indicates the counter group to which the QCI belongs

defDcnGroupId.description:
The default Dedicated Core Network (DCN) Group Identity per PLMN is optionally configured for rerouting UE to an MME Group when the indicated MME is not available when DÉCOR (actDCN) feature is activated. 

The setting is  valid for all category Ues, Legacy, Cat-M UE and NB-IoT.

defProfIdxAM.description:
Default Profile Index for RLC and PDCP profiles for RLC AM mode.
The indicated RLC and PDCP profile is used for the configuration of a bearer that has been configured in RLC AM in the source cell of a handover, but for which no RLC and PDCP profile has been configured in the target cell.

defProfIdxUM.description:
Default Profile Index for RLC and PDCP profiles for RLC UM mode.
The indicated RLC and PDCP profile is used for the configuration of a bearer that has been configured in RLC UM in the source cell of a handover, but for which no RLC and PDCP profile has been configured in the target cell.

delayTarget.description: DelayTarget is the maximum packet delay value used by the eNB MAC scheduling algorithm.

dlCaPreferred.description:
The parameter defines the preference for SCell addition in case of DL+UL carrier aggregation.
dlCaPreferred is used to decide whether to add an additional downlink SCell when that additional DL SCell will result in an existing DL+UL SCell being reconfigured as a DL only SCell.
dlCaPreferred = 'DLonly'
the eNB will choose to add the additional DL SCell and reconfigure the existing DL+UL SCell to DL only.
dlCaPreferred = 'DLandUL' 
the eNB will choose to keep the existing DL+UL SCell and will NOT add the additional DL Scell.

dlPollByte.description: AM RLC Poll Byte value in DL direction for UE category 1.

drxProfileIndex.description:
This parameter specifies the ID of the corresponding DRX profile
If several EPS bearers are established for an UE, eNB compares the DRX profiles of the QCIs used for those EPS bearers and selects the DRX profile with highest priority

dscp.description:
This parameter configures the DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) value associated with the QCI.
The  DSCP value will be set in each IP packet sent for the related bearer to S-GW or target eNB.

List of IETF based DSCP values (numerical values in decimal):
BE   (=0),
AF11 (=10),
AF12 (=12),
AF13 (=14),
AF21 (=18),
AF22 (=20),
AF23 (=22),
AF31 (=26),
AF32 (=28),
AF33 (=30),
AF41 (=34),
AF42 (=36),
AF43 (=38),
EF   (=46)

dynBlacklistingHoTimer.description: This parameter defines the time for which a neighbor cell shall be dynamically blacklisted if it is considered to be barred, to be under C-Plane or U-Plane overload or to be a sleeping cell

eea0.description: Null ciphering algorithm preference. A lower value represents a lower preference, and 0 does not admit the algorithm.

eea1.description: SNOW 3G-based algorithm preference. A lower value represents a lower preference, and 0 does not admit the algorithm.

eea2.description: AES-based algorithm preference. A lower value represents a lower preference, and 0 does not admit the algorithm.

eea3.description:
ZUC-based algorithm preference.
A lower value represents a lower preference, and 0 does not admit the algorithm.

eia0.description: Null integrity protection algorithm preference. A lower value represents a lower preference and 0 does not admit the algorithm.

eia1.description: SNOW 3G-based algorithm preference. A lower value represents a lower preference, and 0 does not admit the algorithm.

eia2.description: AES-based algorithm preference. A lower value represents a lower preference, and 0 does not admit the algorithm.

eia3.description:
ZUC-based algorithm preference.
A lower value represents a lower preference, and 0 does not admit the algorithm.

emerSessArpPreemCap.description:
ARP Pre-emption Capability used by PLMN ID for emergency Sessions.
This parameter defines whether a service data flow can get resources that were already assigned to another service data flow with a lower priority level.

emerSessArpPreemVul.description: ARP Pre-emption Vulnerablity used by PLMN ID for emergency Sessions. The pre-emption vulnerability information defines whether a service data flow can lose the resources assigned to it in order to admit a service data flow with higher priority level.

emerSessArpPrioLev.description:
ARP priority level used by PLMN ID for emergency sessions.
The range of the ARP priority level is 1 to 15 with 1 as the highest level of priority. For emergency sessions, only ARP priority levels 1-8 may be applied (cf. also to 3GPP TS23.203)

emerSessLimServ.description: Indication if PLMN ID supporting emergency sessions also supports limited service mode
emerSessLimServ.fullName: Emergency sessions limited service mode support

emerSessMcc.description: Mobile Country Code of  PLMN ID supporting emergency sessions

emerSessMnc.description: Mobile Network Code of PLMN ID supporting emergency sessions

emerSessMncLen.description: Length of MNC of the PLMN ID supporting emergency sessions

enableAutoLock.description:
The parameter enables the feature "Automatic locking".

If the feature is enabled, objects are automatically locked and unlocked by eNB if a parameter which requires object locking is modified via delta plan file.

If graceful shutdown is enabled by setting enableGrflShdn to 'enabled', the less service impacting but slower graceful cell shutdown procedure is performed instead of immediate locking.

enableBwComSetChkEnDc.description: Enables a compatibility check on the LTE/NR band-combination set before allowing EN-DC (E-UTRA-NR Dual Connectivity), preventing the eNB from configuring a CA/DC combination the UE or network does not actually support.

enableBwCombCheck.description:
This parameter enables the check of bandwidth combinations according to 36.101
If the bandwidths of the bands of a configured CA configuration are not listed in 36.101 or have not been arranged with operator for any of the bandwidth combination sets signaled by the UE, the UE will not be configured with the CA configuration.
It is recommended to keep this functionality enabled in the field to avoid an erroneous configuration of CA that will cause an ACTIVE-to-IDLE transition of the UE.

enableCombRsrpRsrq.description: This parameter enables combined RSRP and RSRQ threshold check after A5 inter-frequency measurement report is received from UE. When this flag is enabled, handover preparation is triggered only if both RSRP and RSRQ thresholds are met.
enableCombRsrpRsrq.fullName: Enable combined RSRP and RSRQ check

enableERabSetupRed.description:
This parameter enables the U-plane overload countermeasure 'Rejection of E-RAB setup requests) to reduce the amount of active E-RABs dependent on the detected overload level.
Explanation of the values:
none: this countermeasure is disabled
OVL1andL2: this countermeasure is enabled for U-plane overload level 1 and 2.
OVL2only: this countermeasure is enabled for U-plane overload level 2 only.
enableERabSetupRed.fullName: Enable rejection of E-RAB setup requests

enableEnDcRed.description: Configures EN-DC RRC Release with Redirect behaviour for handling certain UE release scenarios in EN-DC context.

enableGrflShdn.description:
The parameter enables the feature 'Graceful Cell Shutdown'.

If the feature is activated an additional administrative state 'shuttingdown' is supported. It allows a less service impacting cell locking.
It allows a less service impacting cell locking respectively cell deactivation e.g. in case of (conditional) eNB restart.
Before entering 'locked' state of the cell the UEs will be motivated to leave the cell by stepwise reduction of the eNodeB cell TX power (DL power).

enableInHoRed.description:
This parameter enables the C-plane overload countermeasure 'Rejection of incoming inter-eNB handover requests' to reduce the amount of active RRC connections. Dependent on the detected overload level, handovers of calls with low-priority bearers and/or GBR bearers shall be rejected. High-priority and emergency sessions will always be processed.
Explanation of the values:
none: this countermeasure is disabled
OVL1andL2: this countermeasure is enabled for C-plane overload level 1 and 2.
OVL2only: this countermeasure is enabled for C-plane overload level 2 only.

enableNonCompBcsChkEnDc.description: Enables or disables a compliance check ('BCS' — likely a bearer/capability configuration check) for EN-DC UE combinations; disabling it relaxes strict capability compliance checking, typically as a compatibility workaround for certain UEs.

enableRrcConnRed.description:
This parameter enables the C-plane overload countermeasure 'Rejection of RRC connection requests' to reduce the amount of active RRC connections dependent on the detected overload level. 
Explanation of the values:
none: this countermeasure is disabled
OVL1andL2: this countermeasure is enabled for C-plane overload level 1 and 2.
OVL2only: this countermeasure is enabled for C-plane overload level 2 only.

enableSuspendSrs.description:
This parameter enables the U-plane overload countermeasure 'Suspend usage of SRS for scheduling' (SRS = sounding reference symbols) to reduce the amount of processing capacity by not considering SRS dependent on the detected overload level.
Explanation of the values:
none: this countermeasure is disabled
OVL1andL2: this countermeasure is enabled for U-plane overload level 1 and 2.
OVL2only: this countermeasure is enabled for U-plane overload level 2 only.
enableSuspendSrs.fullName: Enable suspension of SRS for scheduling

enableTxDivTransmission.description:
This parameter enables the U-plane overload countermeasure 'Tx Diversity Transmission' to reduce the amount of transport blocks sent to the UE dependent on the detected overload level.
Explanation of the values:
none: this countermeasure is disabled
OVL1andL2: this countermeasure is enabled for U-plane overload level 1 and 2.
OVL2only: this countermeasure is enabled for U-plane overload level 2 only.

enbName.description:
Human-readable name of the eNB. It corresponds to the eNB name according to 3GPP 36.413.

The character set is restricted to Printable string according to 3GPP with following supported character:
lower case letters 'a' through 'z', upper case letters 'A' through 'Z', the digits '0' through '9' and the characters ' = ( ) + , - . / : ? and space. 
This is a human-readable name for the eNB.
The character set is restricted to printable string according to 3GPP with following supported characters:
lower case letters 'a' through 'z', upper case letters 'A' through 'Z', the digits '0' through '9' and the characters ' = ( ) + , - . / : ? and space.

endcSchedWeightBoostDl.description: A scheduling weight boost factor applied to the downlink scheduler priority metric for EN-DC UEs, giving them a scheduling advantage relative to LTE-only UEs.

endcSchedWeightBoostUl.description: A scheduling weight boost factor applied to the uplink scheduler priority metric for EN-DC UEs.

enforceTtiBundling.description:
This parameter enables TTI bundling if the QCI is present in the current bearer combination.
If this parameter is set to "true" for any bearer of the current bearer combination, the measurements for TTI bundling are activated and TTI bundling might be activated. Otherwise TTI bundling is not applied.

estCause.description: Establishment Cause of RRC Connection for whcih which ARP parameter assignement is done (valid until first DRB is established).
estCause.officialRange:
0: emergency 
1: highPriorityAccess 
2: mt-Access 
3: mo-Signalling 
4: mo-Data 
5: delayTolerantAccess-v1020

etwsPrimNotifBcDur.description:
Duration during which an ETWS primary Notification is broadcasted.
As the broadcast parameter delivered with Write-Replace Warning Request are not to be used for ETWS primary notification (SIB10), the broadcast duration has to be administered.

forcedDrxTReportCGI.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "forced discontinuous reception T Report CGI" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

forcedPlanFileActivation.description:
Enforces the activation of a plan file independent of the configured plan file activation mode
The setting applies for the respective plan file only, i.e. it is not stored by eNB. The parameter overrules the configured plan file activation mode (LNBTS parameter planFileActivationMode) for a dedicated plan file.

geranDtmCap.description:
This parameter indicates if the target GERAN system supports DTM. This parameter is evaluated during CS fallback to GERAN system via redirection.
This parameter should be set based on the network deployment.
geranDtmCap.fullName: DTM capability of the GERAN target

hpsSessArpMax.description: ARP parameters with a priority level greater or equal hpsSessArpMin AND lower or equal hpsSessArpMax will be regarded as high-priority. If an ARP parameter matches both these conditions and the emergency ARP condition, it will be regarded as emergency ARP parameter.
hpsSessArpMax.fullName: High-priority session ARP priority level maximum

hpsSessArpMin.description: ARP parameters with a priority level greater or equal hpsSessArpMin AND lower or equal hpsSessArpMax will be regarded as high-priority. If an ARP parameter matches both these conditions and the emergency ARP condition, it will be regarded as emergency ARP parameter.
hpsSessArpMin.fullName: High-priority session ARP priority level minimum

ilGrantDelayTcpBoost.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "il Grant Delay Tcp Boost" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

ilGrantGapTcpBoost.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "il Grant Gap Tcp Boost" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

ilGrantGapTcpBoostTxSkip.description: This parameter specifies the Number of TTIs between skippable proactive UL grants triggered for TCP boosting.
ilGrantGapTcpBoostTxSkip.fullName: Improved Latency Gap for proactive grants triggered for TCP boosting

ilGrantGapTxSkip.description: This parameter specifies the Number of TTIs between skippable dummy UL grants triggered by DL SRB transmission/UL data transmission.
ilGrantGapTxSkip.fullName: Improved Latency Gap for grants triggered by DL SRB transmission/UL data transmission

ilMinDataTrigGrantTcpBoost.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "il minute(s)/minimum (context-dependent) Data Trig Grant Tcp Boost" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

ilMinDatvolUlTcpBoost.description: This parameter is the minimum data volume (TBS size) transferred for grants triggered by TCP Boost proactive.
ilMinDatvolUlTcpBoost.fullName: Uplink improved latency minimum data volume TBS size for TCP Boost proactive grants

ilReacTimerUlTcpBoost.description: This parameter is the Improved latency reaction timer in uplink for TCP boosting. It defines the time how long eNB will send to the UE proactive UL grants. Timer is started from every DL packet scheduled over specified QCI for the UE.
ilReacTimerUlTcpBoost.fullName: Uplink improved latency reaction timer of TCP Boost proactive grants sending

ilReacTimerUlTcpBoostTxSkip.description: This parameter is the Improved latency reaction timer in uplink for TCP boosting. It defines the time how long eNB will send to the UE proactive UL grants. Timer is started from every DL packet scheduled over any non GBR QCI for the UE.  ilReacTimerUlTcpBoostTxSkip applies to 'skippable' proactive UL grants only.
ilReacTimerUlTcpBoostTxSkip.fullName: Improved latency reaction timer of TCP Boost proactive grants  UL Tx skippable

ilReacTimerUlTxSkip.description: Improved latency reaction timer in uplink defines the time in which the UE has to send useful data after either the initial skippable dummy UL grant or a previous reception of useful data. If the timer expires the, UE will not get skippable dummy UL grant anymore.
ilReacTimerUlTxSkip.fullName: Improved latency reaction timer of dummy grants  UL Tx skippable

interFreqPCISharing.description: Allows reuse (sharing) of the same Physical Cell Identity across cells on different frequencies at the site/cluster.

keyRefrMarg.description: Defines a threshold for PDCP COUNT supervision. If the remaining COUNT space becomes less than this threshold, the eNB key hierarchy should be refreshed.

l2OHFactorDL.description:
This parameter specifies the overhead factor of the downlink GBR in layer 2. 
eNB increases the GBR in downlink direction for radio layer 2 by the product GBR in downlink direction and L2 Overhead Factor GBR DL/100.

l2OHFactorDl.description:
This parameter specifies the overhead factor of the downlink GBR in layer 2. 
eNB increases the GBR in downlink direction for radio layer 2 by the product GBR in downlink direction and L2 Overhead Factor GBR DL/100. eNB ignores this parameter for  nonGBR Operator QCIs.

l2OHFactorUL.description:
This parameter specifies the overhead factor of the uplink GBR in layer 2. 
eNB increases the GBR in uplink direction for radio layer 2 by the product GBR in uplink direction and L2 Overhead Factor GBR UL/100.

l2OHFactorUl.description:
This parameter specifies the overhead factor of the uplink GBR in layer 2. 
eNB increases the GBR in uplink direction for radio layer 2 by the product GBR in uplink direction and L2 Overhead Factor GBR UL/100. eNB ignores this parameter for  nonGBR Operator QCIs.

lcgid.description:
Logical Channel Group Identifier for buffer status reporting
This parameter is used for configuration of the buffer status reports of UE according [36.321]

lnBtsId.description: Instance identifier of object Macro eNB and used also as telecom parameter of the 3GPP 'Macro eNB ID', which is part of Global eNB ID. In addition it appears as distinguished name (DN) in the planning data at the Element Manager.

lteNrDualConnectSupport.description:
This parameter defines whether or not this QCI is eligible for LTE-NR Dual Connectivity (EN-DC).
If the parameter is configured to "EN-DC" this QCI definition is eligible for eUTRA-New Radio Dual Connectivity.

mainTransportNwId.description: This parameter selects the transport network which shall be used as main transport network.

maxEUTRANCapabilitySize.description:
This parameter limits the size of EUTRAN capability Container which can be included into the S1AP:HANDOVER REQUIRED message which is used to trigger a PS-HO, SRVCC or CSFB by PS-HO towards UTRAN. 
If EUTRAN capabilities in size of OCTETS exceeds this number, EUTRAN capabilities are excluded from the SourceToTargetTransparentContainer.
If maxEUTRANcapabilitySize is set to 0, EUTRAN capabilities are excluded irrespectively of their size.
maxEUTRANCapabilitySize.fullName: Maximum Size for EUTRAN capabilities within handover to UTRAN

maxGbrDl.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum value of the GBR in the downlink direction.
eNB will reject those EPS bearers with QCI1 for which the GBR in downlink direction is greater than this value.

Note: it is not recommended to set this parameter larger than 1024kb/s as handling of QCI1 bearers is optimized for VoLTE calls and corresponding data rates.
Please consult customer documentation for additional information.

FDD only:
In cells with downlink channel bandwidth equal to 1.4 MHz or 3 MHz eNB will limit the downlink GBR to maximum 408 kbit/s.

maxGbrUl.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum value of the GBR in the uplink direction.
eNB will reject those EPS bearers with QCI1 for which the GBR in uplink direction is greater than this value.

Note: it is not recommended to set this parameter larger than 1024kb/s as handling of QCI1 bearers is optimized for VoLTE calls and corresponding data rates.
Please consult customer documentation for additional information.

FDD only:
In cells with uplink channel bandwidth equal to 1.4 MHz or 3 MHz eNB will limit the uplink GBR to maximum 408 kbit/s.

maxNumAnrMoiAllowed.description:
Configures the maximal overall number of ANR managed object instances the eNB shall support.

Note: It is highly recommended in case of reduction of the parameter value, that a gap of 10% from the specified value to the actual number of existing instances exist.
Important:
If the number of neighbor related objects in the target configuration for the eNB (actual eNB configuration and the planned modifications to it) is equal to the value of maxNumAnrMoiAllowed or close by, there is a very high probability that the overload alarm is raised immediately after the plan file has been activated.
maxNumAnrMoiAllowed.fullName: Max number of allowed ANR managed object instances

maxNumClusterUe.description: Maximum number of UEs that can be tracked/grouped within a site or feature-specific 'cluster' construct (e.g. used by zSON or load-balancing features).

maxNumNrCell.description: Likely sets the maximum allowed value for "number of NR (5G New Radio) cell" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

maxNumNrCellgNB.description: Likely sets the maximum allowed value for "number of NR (5G New Radio) Cellg NB" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

maxNumOfLnadjLimit.description:
Configures the overall number of LNADJ instances supported by the eNB.
Note:
For FSMr2 HW the value shall not exceed 128.
For FSMr3 HW there is no hardware specific limitation.
For Flexi Zone Micro the value shall not exceed 256

The parameter shall never be configured to a value higher than the system informs in parameter supportedNumOfLnadj.

maxNumPreEmptions.description:
This parameter limits the number of pre-emptions which the admission of a set of E-RABs (for example at initial context setup, E-RAB setup, handover request) might cause. If this number gets exceeded for an E-RAB set, the admission of this set set will partly or completely fail.
Because each pre-emption takes at least 5ms (but might take more, depending on eNB load), the pre-emption number limitation should be considered carefully to avoid timeouts of procedures which depend on E-RAB admission (in particular handover preperations).

maxParallelIncX2SetupOrECUOvl0.description: Maximum number of parallel handling of incoming X2 Setup or ENB Configuration Update messages when eNB is in overload level 0 (or no overload)
maxParallelIncX2SetupOrECUOvl0.fullName: Max parallel incoming X2 Setup or ENB Config Update handling in Overload-0

maxParallelIncX2SetupOrECUOvl1.description: Maximum number of parallel handling of incoming X2 Setup or ENB Configuration Update messages when eNB is in overload level 1
maxParallelIncX2SetupOrECUOvl1.fullName: Max parallel incoming X2 Setup or ENB Config Update handling in Overload-1

maxParallelOutX2SetupOrECU.description:
Maximum number of parallel handling of outgoing X2 Setup or ENB Configuration Update messages.

The parameter applies for X2 links between eNB and neighbor eNB (X2(eNB)) and for X2 links between eNB and en-gNB (X2(gNB)).
maxParallelOutX2SetupOrECU.fullName: Max parallel outgoing X2 Setup or ENB Config Update

maxRetxThresh.description:
The maximum number of poll retransmission for the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity for DRB. This parameter specifies the parameter maxRetxThreshold of [36.331]. 
This parameter is used by the transmitting side of each AM RLC entity to count the number of transmissions of an AM PDU. It is set so that a radio link failure can be detected by the eNB before the maximum number of transmissions has been reached. The parameter is on a higher level than ARQ and HARQ.
maxRetxThresh.fullName: Max retransmission threshold for AM DRB

maxRetxThreshSrbDL.description:
The maximum number of poll retransmission for the transmitting side (eNB) of an AM RLC entity for SRB. This parameter specifies the parameter maxRetxThreshold of [36.331]. 
This parameter is used by the transmitting side of each AM RLC entity to count the number of transmissions of an AM PDU. It is set so that a radio link failure can be detected by the eNB before the maximum number of transmissions has been reached. The parameter is on a higher level than ARQ and HARQ.
maxRetxThreshSrbDL.fullName: Max retransmission threshold for SRB Downlink

maxRetxThreshSrbUL.description:
The maximum number of poll retransmission for the transmitting side (UE) of an AM RLC entity for SRB. This parameter specifies the parameter maxRetxThreshold of [36.331]. 
This parameter is used by the transmitting side of each AM RLC entity to count the number of transmissions of an AM PDU. It is set so that a radio link failure can be detected by the eNB before the maximum number of transmissions has been reached. The parameter is on a higher level than ARQ and HARQ.
maxRetxThreshSrbUL.fullName: Max retransmission threshold for SRB Uplink

maxX2CfUpRetry.description: The maximum number of times the eNB shall retry the X2 eNB Configuration Update attempts.

mcc.description: Mobile Country Code of the PLMN

microTmpActFeat1.description: Nokia-internal temporary/experimental feature-activation switch used during trials or staged rollouts; the generic name gives no public documentation of its exact function.

microTmpActFeat2.description: A second Nokia-internal temporary/experimental feature-activation switch, companion to microTmpActFeat1, with no publicly documented specific function.

microTmpActFeat3.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "micro Tmp activate/enable Feat 3" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

minIdleTimeScell.description: Likely sets the minimum allowed value for "Idle Time secondary cell" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

mlbSpecialCase.description:
This parameter selects the handling of the CIO adjustment during the handling of special cases.
When set to 'returnAdjustmentToZero' the action for the special case handling will return the delta CIO adjustment to a value of zero.

When set to 'adjustmentPreserved' the action in for the special case handling will leave the delta CIO adjustment at its current value.

The special cases applies when LB Abate Threshold is reached and Cell becomes "balanced".
mlbSpecialCase.fullName: Load balancing special case handling selection

mmeAssignmentMode.description: This parameter enables the eNB, in case only one MME is available at MME selection for the selected PLMN ID, to select this MME even its MME capacity is set to zero.

mnc.description: Mobile Network Code of the PLMN

mncLength.description: Length of MNC in digits.

moProfileSelect.description:
This parameter is used to configure selection method of Mobility Profile for mobility procedures. 
If this parameter is set to value 'spid', then SPID received from MME or incoming handover is used for MOPR selection.
If this parameter is set to value 'plmn' then MOPR selection is based on UE's Serving PLMN ID.
If this parameter is set to 'combined' then MOPR selection is based on UE's Serving PLMN ID and SPID.

multScellReleaseTimer.description:
Defines the multiplication factor to calculate the value of the internal, secondary cell (SCell) release timer (ScellReleaseTimer). 
The timer value is achieved by multiplying this parameter with the value of the SCell deactivation timer (LNBTS-scellDeactivationTimerEnb) as follows: 
ScellReleaseTimer = multScellReleaseTimer * min(scellDeactivationTimerEnb, rf128).

If a SCell is not active for a UE for the duration of the deactivation timer (LNBTS-scellDeactivationTimerEnb) or its estimated channel quality is bad (LNCEL-scellBadChQualThr), the calculated release timer is started and when it expires, the SCell is released.

Note1: Special value '0' means that the ScellReleaseTimer is not started and the SCell is kept configured even if not active or perceived with bad channel quality or as not detected.

Note2: If the ScellReleaseTimer is used, it is recommended to set multScellReleaseTimer to value '5'.
multScellReleaseTimer.fullName: Mult. factor for SCell release timer

nConsecHOPrepTimeouts.description: The parameter is used to determine how many handover preparation attempts towards a neighbour cell must consecutively fail by supervision timer expiry until the neighbor cell is considered as sleeping cell
nConsecHOPrepTimeouts.fullName: Number of consecutive HO preparation timeouts

nCqiDtx.description:
Number of concecutive CQI DTX detections required for RL failure.
The parameter defines the number of consecutive CQI DTX detections causing radio link
failure indication. Special value 0 means that the feature is disabled.
nCqiDtx.fullName: Radio problem indication based on CQI DTX

nCqiRec.description:
Number of concecutive CQIs required for RL recovery.
The parameter defines number of consecutive CQI non-DTX detections causing radio link
failure recovery indication.
nCqiRec.fullName: Radio problem recovery based on CQI DTX

nbrDl.description:
This parameter specifies the nominal bit rate in the downlink direction. It applies only if Scheduling Type has been set to NON-GBR.
Leaving this parameter value empty means the nominal bitrate feature does not apply to this QCI in this direction.

Hint:
It is not recommended to configure to values higher than 5120 kb/s. In LTE FDD Technology, nbrDl values higher than 5120 kb/s are not supported and therefore internally set to 5120 kb/s.

nbrUl.description:
This parameter specifies the nominal bit rate in the uplink direction.  It applies only if Scheduling Type has been set to NON-GBR.
eNB selects the value of prioritizedBitRate for UE configuration that is equal to or higher than nbrUl.
Leaving this parameter value empty means the nominal bitrate feature does not apply to this QCI in this direction.

Hint:
It is not recommended to configure to values higher than 2048 kb/s. In LTE FDD Technology, nbrUl values higher than 2048 kb/s are not supported and therefore internally set to 2048 kb/s.

neighCellIdleConfM.description: Flag controlling a neighbor-cell idle-mode configuration mode used in mobility/reselection management.

neighbCellChkPeriodicity.description:
Periodicity, with which eNB repeats the check if for available X2 links there are neighbor cells with incomplete configuration information. 

If 'neighbCellChkPeriodicity' is set to '0' the check for incomplete configuration information is deactivated.

neighbCellChkStartTime.description:
The parameter configures the local time at which eNB checks if for available X2 links are neighbor cells with incomplete configuration information existing.
As long as enabled, the check for missing configuration information is repeated with a periodicity given by 'neighbCellChkPeriodicity'.

It is recommended to choose a low traffic hour as value for 'neighbCellChkStartTime'.

* If the configured day time is reached, eNb starts an internal timer of length 'neighbCellChkPeriodicity' (if not yet running).
* On expiry, the internal timer is restarted.
* The check for neighbor cells with incomplete configuration information is performed when this internal timer is started for the first time and subsequently when it expires.
* If a neighbor cell with incomplete configuration information is found, the missing information is retrieved via repetition of X2 Setup procedure.

* Neighbor cells with incomplete configuration information may occur only very rarely (i.e. only if eNB is operating for some time at the maximum limit of number of supported managed objects).

nrCellDeactStatIndEndcHo.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "NR (5G New Radio) cell Deact Stat indicator E-UTRA-NR Dual Connectivity handover" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

nrPdcpProfIdx.description: This parameter specifies the ID of the corresponding PDCP profile used for LTE-NR Dual Connectivity.

nrRestrictionOverride.description: Allows overriding a UE-signalled 'NR restriction' capability/indicator (which normally instructs the network not to use NR with that UE), forcing EN-DC/NR usage regardless — an operator override switch.

nullFallback.description: This parameter determines whether a fallback to null ciphering caused by eNB limitations should be accepted (True) or not (False).

numOfBadUlPktsToTrigHoForHfnReset.description: Likely a count/number of "Of Bad uplink Pkts To Trig handover For Hfn reset" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

operationalState.description: Operational state of the eNB, the value is set by system.
operationalState.officialRange:
0: initializing 
1: commissioned 
2: notCommisioned 
3: configured 
4: integrated to RAN 
5: onAir 
6: test

otdoaPhaseErrorThreshold.description:
This parameter specifies the maximum allowable phase error with respect to absolute time at the air interface for the corresponding otdoaProfileList-otdoaSyncSourceType. 
Cells with actOtdoa enabled stop transmitting Positioning Reference Signal (PRS) when the estimated phase error exceeds otdoaProfileList-otdoaPhaseErrorThreshold and the current sync source or the last sync source before holdover corresponds to otdoaProfileList-otdoaSyncSourceType.

otdoaSyncSourceType.description:
This parameter specifies a sync source type allowed for OTDOA service. 
Cells with actOtdoa enabled stop transmitting Positioning Reference Signal (PRS) when the eNodeB switches to a synchronization source other than the ones allowed by otdoaProfileList-otdoaSyncSourceType.

otnRecoveryPeriod.description:
OTN Link Loss Recoverable period without RF Unit Reset
This parameter specifies the time period when an Optical Network (OTN) can be recovered after a link loss without incurring a restart.

pbrNonGbr.description:
Prioritized Bit Rate for non-GBR bearers
This prioritized bit rate is used by UE for the UL scheduling algorithm according [36.321].

pcellSwapBlockTimer.description: This timer is started when a PCell swap target evaluation or handover preparation for a selected carrier aggregated UE failed for any reason. Before the expiry of this timer, any retry of PCell swap for this UE shall be prohibited.

pdcpProfIdx.description: This parameter specifies the ID of the corresponding PDCP profile.

pdcpProfileId.description: Identity of the PDCP profile;  0 specifies an invalid dummy profile.

planFileActivationMode.description:
Controls whether plan file activation is allowed to implicitly trigger eNB restart or to temporarily drop all cells('totalServiceLossAllowed') or is allowed to temporarily drop some cells('partialServiceLossAllowed') or is not allowed to temporarily drop cells ('noServiceLossAllowed')
The meaning of the activation modes is as follows:

totalServiceLossAllowed: Plan file activation is allowed to implicitly trigger eNB restart or to drop all cells if needed.

partialServiceLossAllowed: Plan file activation is not allowed to implicitly trigger eNB restart or to drop all cells but is allowed to temporarily drop some cells.

noServiceLossAllowed: Plan file activation is neither allowed to trigger eNB restart  nor to temporarily drop cells .

Dependent on the setting of the LNBTS parameter enableGrflShdn eNB will either perform direct locking of cell(s) or graceful shutdown according to the feature 'Graceful cell shut down'.

Notes:
The plan file activation mode can be overruled for a particular plan file with the LNBTS parameter forcedPlanFileActivation.

The plan file activation mode is ignored in case of autoconfiguration respectively commissioning of an uncommissioned eNB and in case of full commissioing via BTS Site Manager. Such plan files will be activated in any case.

The feature ‘Automatic lock' shall be activated, i.e. the parameter LNBTS-enableAutoLock shall be set to ‘enabled’ (which is the default value). Otherwise the plan file would be rejected by eNB if cell dropping is needed.

pollPdu.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter pollPDU of [36.331]
The parameter Poll PDU defines the number of RLC PDUs that are sent on a logical channel before the RLC polling bit is set.

preemptionCap.description:
ARP Pre-emption Capability  assigned by eNB to the RRC Connection which is valid until first DRB is established.
This parameter defines whether a service data flow can get resources that were already assigned to another service data flow with a lower priority level.

prio.description: This parameter gives the priority of the EPS bearer according TS23.203.

prioTopoHO.description:
This parameter is used to define priorities between the 3 topology options for intra LTE handover, which are 
1) Intra eNB HO
2) HO via X2
3) HO via S1
It's assumed that Intra eNB HO can not have lower priority than any other topology and S1 HO can not have higher priority than any other topology.

Four relations are possible:
1) all topologies have the same priority -> "all equal"
2) intra eNB HO is prioritized over inter eNB HO where X2-based HO and S1-based HO are not discriminated -> "intra eNB HO prior inter eNB HO"
3) intra eNB HO is prioritized over inter eNB HO where X2-based HO is prioritized over S1-based HO -> "intra prior X2 prior S1"
4) intra eNB HO and X2-based handover are not discriminated but S1-based HO takes lower priority than the others -> "low prio S1"
knownValues: intra eNB HO prior inter eNB HO
prioTopoHO.officialRange:
0: all equal 
1: intra eNB HO prior inter eNB HO 
2: intra prior X2 prior S1 
3: low prio S1

prioritizeVoLTEoverMBMS.description: Determines if VoLTE  target frequencies shall be prioritized  in case of MBMS interested UEs with established QCI#1 bearer as far as VoLTE and MBMS target frequencies are conflicting.

prohibitLBHOTimer.description:
This timer is used for temporary blacklisting of a Target Cell for load-based and service-based handover.
One Target Cell is blacklisted when a handover is rejected because of lack of resources.
The timer is started when the cell is blacklisted.
When timer expires the blacklisting is removed.
Blacklist affects all UEs in the actual source cell.
Blacklist affects Handovers for Load Balancing. (cause "Reduce Load in Serving Cell" ) and Service Based Handovers (cause "Resource Optimisation Handover")
Blacklisted cells are managed internally by eNB and not added to black lists visible to operator.

pureRrcPreempPrioNB.description:
This parameter indicates ARP priority of preempting NB-IoT RRC connection contexts without established DRBs.
The value '15' (no priority) indicates that pure NB-IoT RRC connections will not be selected for preemptions, i.e., LTE4739 for NB-IoT part is disabled.
The value '16' (LowestPrioAboveSCell) indicates that pure NB-IoT RRC connections will be selected for preemption before any wideband UE and only if no SCell context is available.
The value '17' (LowestPrioBelowSCell) indicates that pure NB-IoT RRC connections will be selected for preemption before any wideband UE and before any SCell context.
pureRrcPreempPrioNB.fullName: Preemption priority of pure NB-IoT RRC connections

pwrFallbackCa.description:
Define power class fallback for high power UE in case of CA mode.  

For HPUE, when it is NOT in CA mode, mobility thresholds for high power class is applied.

If pwrFallbackCA = "true", mobility thresholds for normal power class will be applied when HPUE gets into CA mode.
If pwrFallbackCA = "false", mobility thresholds for high power class will be applied when HPUE gets into CA mode

pwsWithEmAreaId.description:
Indicates if the Public Warning Systems (ETWS and/or CMAS) make use of Emergency Area IDs. 
If ETWS or CMAS service is activated, then provision of this parameter is mandatory.

If 'pwsWithEmAreaId' is true, then for each eNB cell provision of at least one 'Emergency Area ID' in the 'emAreaIdList' must be specified. 

If a warning message including 'Emergency Area IDs' is received by eNB and 'pwsWithEmAreaId' is 'false' then this warning message shall not be broadcasted by eNB.

qciSupp.description: This parameter indicates whether the given QCI is supported and enabled

rachAccessForHoFromNr.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "Random Access Channel Access For handover From NR (5G New Radio)" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

rachAccessForHoFromUtran.description:
This parameter selects whether Target eNodeB shall provide and reserve a dedicated RACH preamble for HO from UTRAN. 
In case no dedicated RACH preamble is provided UE will perform contention based RACH access.
If a dedicated RACH preamble is provided UE will perform non-contention based RACH access as for intra LTE handover.
Note that in case eNodeB is configured to reserve a dedicated RACH preamble it may happen that eNodeB runs out of dedicated RACH preambles. 
In this case contention based RACH access will be used as fallback solution.
rachAccessForHoFromUtran.fullName: RACH access for handover from UTRAN
