recoveryResetDelay.description:
Defines the minimal number of seconds after which a recovery reset can be triggered.

Note: When setting the parameter value to 10000 (unlimited delay), the recovery reset will be performed after all snapshot information is collected. This setting must be used with care.

releaseUndetectableScell.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "release Undetectable secondary cell" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

reportTimerIMLBA4.description: Timer to supervise the A4 report. At expiry the A4 event will be deactivated.
reportTimerIMLBA4.fullName: Idle mode load balancing supervision timer for A4 event

resType.description:
The Resource Type indicates whether bearer is a GBR or NON-GBR bearer.
The Resource Type determines if dedicated network resources related to a service or bearer level Guaranteed Bit Rate (GBR) value are permanently allocated.

rlcMode.description: This parameter configures the RLC Mode of the data radio bearer

rlcProfIdx.description: This parameter specifies the ID of the corresponding RLC profile

rlcProfIdx3cc.description: This parameter specifies the ID of the corresponding RLC profile optimized for use with 3 CC Carrier Aggregation.
rlcProfIdx3cc.fullName: RLC profile index for 3 CC CA

rlcProfIdx4cc5cc.description:
This parameter specifies the ID of the corresponding RLC profile optimized for use with 4 CC and 5 CC Carrier Aggregation.
Recommendations:

If a different, optimized RLC profile for 4 CC and 5 CC CA shall be used, it is recommended to use the profile with the ID 7 (default). Note the different default values compared to RLC profiles 1-6.
rlcProfIdx4cc5cc.fullName: RLC profile index for 4 CC and 5 CC CA

rlcProfIdx6cc7cc.description:
This parameter specifies the ID of the corresponding RLC profile optimized for use with 6 CC and 7 CC carrier aggregation.
Recommendations:

If a different, optimized RLC profile for 6 CC and 7 CC carrier aggregation shall be used, it is recommended to use the profile with the ID 8 (default). Note the different default values compared to RLC profiles 1-7.
rlcProfIdx6cc7cc.fullName: RLC profile index for 6 CC and 7 CC CA

rlfBasedRCRdefault.description: Defines the default value for the LNADJ parameter rlfBasedRCRsupported which is used if an LNADJ instance is autonomously created by eNB due to an activated ANR feature.
rlfBasedRCRdefault.fullName: RLF based RRC connection reestablishment default

rohcMaxCid.description:
This parameter configures the maximum number of ROHC contexts used for a data radio bearer in one direction.
The maximum number of ROHC contexts is also restricted by the UE capabilities.

rrcGuardTimer.description: This timer is started when an RRC message for setup, modification or release of a radio bearer is sent to the UE. When the timer expires, the corresponding procedure is aborted.
rrcGuardTimer.fullName: RRC guard timer radio bearer management

s1InducedCellDeactDelayTime.description: If for an eNB cell all configured PLMN IDs are unavailable on S1 interface for the duration given by "s1InducedCellDeactDelayTime", the eNB cell is deactivated.

sCellActivationCyclePeriod.description:
This parameter defines the period of the SCell Activation cycle.
The parameter value is in seconds.
This parameter is not used when "sCellActivationMethod" is set to "blind".

sCellActivationMethod.description:
This parameter defines the method to be used for SCell activation.
The meaning of the values is as follows:
'blind' means that SCell is blindly activated and it is never re-activated after the expiration of the timer sCellDeactivationTimerEnb.
'nonGBRBufferBased' means that SCell activation is triggered depending on the non-GBR data in the buffer. For a UE with two configured SCells, SCell activation is triggered depending on the non-GBR data in the buffer in a joint way, i.e., one MAC CE command activates all SCells.
'nonGBRBufferBasedStepWise' means that for a UE with two configured SCells, SCell activation by one or more separate MAC CE command(s) is triggered depending on the non-GBR data in buffer in a step-wise way. In the first step one SCell is activated depending on the non-GBR data in buffer and after that depending on the non-GBR data in buffer the second SCell is activated if needed.

Note: The period of the SCell activation cycle is configured in sCellActivationCyclePeriod.

With actULCAggr=UL_CA_with_smartSched, a DL&UL sCell's activation will be triggered by eNB to reach fast load balance purpose, this kind of sCell activation trigger scheme works without regard to sCellActivationMethod setting.

sCellDeactivationTimereNB.description:
This timer controls the deactivation of Secondary Cell for Carrier Aggregation configured UEs.

The timer behaves in the same way as the SCell deactivation timer defined in TS 36.321, but result is explicit SCell deactivation by MAC CE instead of implicit SCell deactivation in order to avoid eNB – UE misalignment due to ambiguous HARQ feedback.
The value represents the number of radio frames.
Value "infinity" means that the SCell is never deactivated by sCellDeactivationTimereNB.
sCellDeactivationTimereNB.officialRange:
0: rf2 
1: rf4 
2: rf8 
3: rf16 
4: rf32 
5: rf64 
6: rf128 
7: infinity

sCellpCellHARQFdbkUsage.description:
The parameter selects how the ambiguous HARQ feedback of UE with an active SCell related to DL transmission shall be interpreted for the purpose of controlling 
1) DRX Inactivity Timer, and 
2) radio link problem detection/recovery in PCell.

If set to conservative, the ambiguous HARQ feedback is interpreted as DTX for the purpose of controlling the timer and as DTX for radio link problem detection, the ambiguous HARQ feedback is ignored for radio link problem recovery. 
If set to aggressive, the ambiguous HARQ feedback is interpreted as NACK for the purpose of controlling the timer and as NACK for radio link problem recovery, the ambiguous HARQ feedback is ignored for radio link problem detection. It is expected that the aggressive setting will favor the UE throughput of UEs with an active SCell.
It is expected that the conservative setting will favor cell throughput.
sCellpCellHARQFdbkUsage.fullName: SCell and PCell ambiguous HARQ feedback usage

scellActivationLevel.description:
The parameter configures aggressiveness/conservativeness level of SCell activation. The higher the value of the parameter the more conservative the SCell activation is.
If configured to value X, the meaning is as follows:
if it is estimated that the current UE data in the buffer is more than what can be drained on the PCell/PCell+ currently active SCell during the next X TTIs, then one SCell/one additional SCell will be activated (when sCellActivationMethod is configured to the value 'nonGBRBufferBased' and one SCell is configured for a UE or when sCellActivationMethod is configured to the value 'nonGBRBufferBasedStepWise' and one or two SCells are configured for a UE).
if it is estimated that the current UE data in the buffer is more than what can be drained on the PCell during the next X TTIs, then two SCells will be activated (when sCellActivationMethod is configured to the value 'nonGBRBufferBased' and two SCells are configured for a UE).

Note: This parameter has no effect if sCellActivationMethod is configured to 'blind'.

scellMeasCycle.description: The parameter is used only when an SCell is configured on the frequency indicated by the measObjectEUTRA and is in deactivated state.

schedulBSD.description:
This parameter is used to configure the Bucket Size Duration (BSD) of the UL scheduler
For GBR bearers, schedulBSD in used by eNB and UE for the UL scheduling algorithm according [36.321].
The bucket size of a logical channel is calculated by PBR * BSD.

schedulPrio.description:
Logical Channel Priority for the MAC scheduler
For GBR bearers, schedulPrio in used by UE for the UL scheduling algorithm according [36.321].
Increasing priority values indicate a lower priority.

schedulType.description:
This parameter specifies how the EPS bearer with QCI 5 is scheduled.
For the scheduling type “SIGNALLING” the bearer is handled like SRBs. The MAC LCGID shall be set to 0 and schedulPrio is used for UL and DL scheduling.
For the scheduling type “NON-GBR” the bearer is handled like other non-GBR bearers. The MAC LCGID shall not be to 0 and the schedulWeight is used for DL scheduling.

schedulWeight.description:
This parameter specifies the scheduling weight for eNB schedulers
The scheduling weight is used for MAC scheduling (UL and DL), and MAC logical channel priority handling and multiplexing in DL

schedulWeightDl.description:
This parameter specifies the scheduling weight for eNB DL scheduler.
The DL scheduling weight is used for MAC scheduling and MAC logical channel priority handling and multiplexing

schedulWeightUl.description:
This parameter specifies the scheduling weight for eNB UL scheduler.
The UL scheduling weight is used for MAC scheduling

selectScellMappedBand.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "select secondary cell Mapped Band" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

servBasedHoTimeToTrigger.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "serv Based handover Time To Trigger" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

shutdownStepAmount.description: Number of Steps for Graceful Cell Shutdown

shutdownWindow.description: Time Interval for Stepwise Output Power Reduction for Graceful Cell Shutdown

sibUpdateRateThreshold.description:
SIB update rate threshold which if exceeded will block non-critical SIB updates from being made.
Once the SIB update rate exceeds this threshold, non-critical SIB updates will not be made until the SIB update rate drops below this threshold.  Critical SIB updates will be made regardless of the current SIB update rate.  This parameter only applies to features that support non-critical SIB updates such as the PRACH Power Optimization, and Dynamic PUCCH Allocation features.  The maximum update rate to guarantee that all idle UEs receive the SIB updates is equal to or less than 31 updates per 3 hours.   

Note that this is an optional parameter.  If the operator does not create an instance of this parameter, SIB rate monitoring will be disabled and all SIB updates will be allowed regardless of the SIB update rate.

skipEUTRANCapabilities.description:
This parameter configures the handling of the EUTRAN capabilities in the S1AP:HANDOVER REQUIRED message.
If this parameter is set to true, eNodeB excludes the optional IE containing EUTRAN capabilities from the S1AP:HANDOVER REQUIRED message used to trigger PS-HO, SRVCC or CSFB by PS-HO towards UTRAN.
EUTRAN capabilities are only excluded if they exceed operator configurable limit.
skipEUTRANCapabilities.fullName: Skip EUTRAN UE capabilities on handover to UTRAN

snFieldLengthDL.description:
This parameter configures the length of the SN field for RLC UM procedures in downlink direction.
If UE does not support the value “5bit”, the value “10bit” is used.

snFieldLengthDl.description:
This parameter configures the length of the SN field for RLC AM procedures in downlink direction.
If UE does not support the value '16bit', the value '10bit' is used.

snFieldLengthUL.description:
This parameter configures the length of the SN field for RLC UM procedures in uplink direction.
If UE does not support the value “5bit”, the value “10bit” is used.

snFieldLengthUl.description:
This parameter configures the length of the SN field for RLC AM procedures in uplink direction.
If UE does not support the value '16bit', the value '10bit' is used.

snSize.description:
This parameter configures the size of the SN field in the PDCP header.
If UE does not support the value “15bit”, the value “12bit” will be used. 
This parameter is only used at bearer setup. It is not allowed to modify the PDCP SN size, e.g. at handover.

snSizeDl.description:
This parameter configures the size of the SN field in the PDCP header for DL.
This parameter is only used at bearer setup. It is not allowed to modify the PDCP SN size, e.g. at handover.

snSizeUl.description:
This parameter configures the size of the SN field in the PDCP header for UL.
This parameter is only used at bearer setup. It is not allowed to modify the PDCP SN size, e.g. at handover.

srvccDelayTimer.description:
This parameter defines delay timer for SRVCC procedure trigger after establishment of first QCI#1 bearer for UE. During this timer running, eNodeB shall not start SRVCC procedures to WCDMA/GSM.

In addition this parameter acts as feature activation flag and feature LTE3290 SRVCC trigger enhancement shall be enabled when this parameter is set to any value other than 0.

startArpEnDc.description: This parameter defines starting ARP value for the range of ARP values for which this QCI is eligible for LTE-NR Dual Connectivity (EN-DC).
startArpEnDc.fullName: Starting ARP for EN-DC eligible bearer

statusRepReq.description:
This parameter determines whether a PDCP Status Report is sent from PDCP receiver to PDCP transmitter.
The PDCP Status Report may be sent from eNB to UE (eNB PDCP Status Report) or from UE to eNB (UE PDCP Status Report).

Possible settings:
00 - no Status Report
01 - eNB Status Report
10 - UE Status Report
11 - eNB and UE Status Report
statusRepReq.officialRange:
Bit 0:eNB Status Report:1:N; Bit 1:UE Status Report:1:N; Bit 2::0:; Bit 3::0:; 
Bit 4::0:; Bit 5::0:; Bit 6::0:; Bit 7::0:

stopArpEnDc.description: This parameter defines stop ARP value for the range of ARP values for which this QCI is eligible for LTE-NR Dual Connectivity (EN-DC).
stopArpEnDc.fullName: Stop ARP for EN-DC eligible bearer

supportedCellTechnology.description:
This parameter specifies if the LTE cells the eNB operates shall have single technology (values 'FDD' and 'TDD') or if it shall serves cells in both technologies (value 'mixed_FDD_TDD').

Note:
Only AirScale hardware is capable to support a mixed cell technology configuration.
'mixed_FDD_TDD' is not supported yet.

supportedNumOfAnrMoi.description: Defines the number of system supported ANR managed object instances.
supportedNumOfAnrMoi.fullName: Supported number of ANR managed object instances

supportedNumOfLnadj.description: Defines the number of system supported LNADJ instances (enbControlled + oamControlled).

tChangeMobilityReq.description: This timer controls the mobility change settings procedure at RRM load balancing function. It is started when RRM sends the Mobility Change Request message and it is stopped when RRM receives the expected Mobility Change Ack or Mobility Change Failure message.

tDiscard.description: This parameter indicates the delay before a PDCP PDU along with the corresponding PDCP SDU is discarded from the buffer. This timer should be set in a way that the packet delay defined by the QCI characteristics is kept. The timer can be disabled by setting the parameter to disabled.

tHalfRrcCon.description: The minimal time period during which the internal state and the resources associated with an half-open RRC connection (i.e. one for which no RRC connection setup complete message has yet been received) must not be deleted in the eNB.
tHalfRrcCon.fullName: Timer min lifetime of half-open RRC connection

tHoOverallD.description:
Covers the estimated time taken to send an RRC:CONNECTION RECONFIGURATION message to the UE (no RLC Ack needed)
- send an RRC:CONNECTION RECONFIGURATION COMPLETE message from the UE
THOoverall = T304 + T311 + T301 + THOoverallDelta

tLteNrDualConnectPrep.description:
The parameter specifies the maximum time that the MeNB will wait for the en-gNB message in response to a message sent by the MeNB to the en-gNB. 
This timer supervises the MeNB initiated SgNB addition procedure, the MeNB initiated SgNB modification procedure, the MeNB initiated SgNB release procedure as well as the reception of the SN STATUS TRANSFER following the request from the SgNB to release the SGNB.
During the MeNB initiated SgNB Addition procedure, this timer plays the role of TDCPrep, as defined in 3GPP.
tLteNrDualConnectPrep.fullName: Supervision timer for LTE-NR Dual Connectivity over X2 interface (EN-DC)

tOverbookingAc.description: This parameter defines the duration for the timer which controls the temporary overbooking of RAC and TAC. The timer is started when an E-RAB with QCI#1 is admitted by overbooking in RAC and/or TAC. As long as the timer is running eNodeB tries to get rid of the UE by SRVCC to WCDMA. On expiry of the timer eNodeB triggers the release of the E-RAB admitted by temporary overbooking.

tPollRetr.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter t-pollRetransmit of [36.331]
This timer is used by the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll. This value is used both in UL (by the UE) and in DL (by the eNB).
The used minimum value of the timer shall be larger than the calculated round-trip time with considerations of HARQ retransmissions and out-of-sequence arrival. The value of the timer shall be larger than twice of the timerReorder.

tPollRetrDl.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter t-pollRetransmit of [36.331]
This timer is used by the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll. This value is used by the eNB for downlink data transmission.
The used minimum value of the timer shall be larger than the calculated round-trip time with considerations of HARQ retransmissions and out-of-sequence arrival. The value of the timer shall be larger than twice of the timerReorder.

tPollRetrSrbDL.description: This timer is used by the transmitting side (eNB) of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll for SRB.
tPollRetrSrbDL.fullName: Timer poll retransmit for SRB Downlink

tPollRetrSrbUL.description:
This timer is used by the transmitting side (UE) of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll for SRB.
This parameter specifies the parameter t-pollRetransmit of [36.331].
tPollRetrSrbUL.fullName: Timer poll retransmit for SRB Uplink

tPollRetrUl.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter t-pollRetransmit of [36.331]
This timer is used by the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll. This value is used by the UE for uplink data transmission.
The used minimum value of the timer shall be larger than the calculated round-trip time with considerations of HARQ retransmissions and out-of-sequence arrival. The value of the timer shall be larger than twice of the timerReorder.

tProhib.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter t-StatusProhibit of [36.331]
This timer is used by the receiving side of an AM RLC entity in order to prohibit transmission of a STATUS PDU

tReord.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter t-Reordering of [36.331]
This timer is used by the receiving side of an AM RLC entity for reordering, PDU loss detection and delay of STATUS PDU transmission. This timer depends on HARQ RTT and number of HARQ retransmissions.

tReordIsca.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter t-Reordering of [36.331].
This timer is used during inter-site carrier aggregation by the receiving side of an AM RLC entity for reordering, PDU loss detection and delay of STATUS PDU transmission. This timer depends on HARQ RTT and number of HARQ retransmissions.
tReordIsca.fullName: Timer reordering for inter-site carrier aggr.

tRlcPduDiscard.description: Likely a timer/duration setting related to "t Radio Link Control Pdu Discard" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

tRsrInitWait.description:
This time defines how long the eNB waits for the result of an earlier issued Resource Status Reporting request.
* If the Resource Status Request was send to initiate a Resource Status Reporting, then the eNB will repeat the Resource Status Request after this timer expires if the Resource Status Reporting is still needed by the eNB.
* If the Resource Status Request was send to stop an ongoing Resource Status Reporting, then on timer expiry the eNB will consider the stop request as failed and will locally release the Resource Status Reporting.
tRsrInitWait.fullName: Resource status reporting initiation wait time

tRsrResFirst.description: This defines the maximum time the eNB waits for further cell load measurements before collected cell load measurements are indicated to the requesting cell for the first time.
tRsrResFirst.fullName: Resource status rep. result wait time first reporting

tS1RelOvDeltG.description:
Delta for Supervision Timer For The Execution Phase Of An S1 Handover to GSM
TS1RELOCoverallDelta_GSM is used to calculate the duration of the timer TS1RELOCoverall which is used to guard against failure of the MME to inform the source eNB of the outcome of the UEs attempt to connect to the target during S1 handover to another 3GPP RAT. TS1RELOCoverall is started in the source eNB when the RRC: MOBILITY FROM EUTRA COMMAND message is sent to the UE and is stopped when S1AP: UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND is received from the MME to confirm the outcome. If the timer expires the handover is aborted and the UE context is released. In future releases the UE will be allowed to rejoin the source cell. The duration of TS1RELOCoverall is calculated by adding the value of TS1RELOCoverallDelta_GSM to that of T304_InterRAT. The value of TS1RELOCoverallDelta_GSM should be set to an estimate of an upper bound of the time taken for the RNC to communicate via the MME to the eNB during normal network conditions.
tS1RelOvDeltG.fullName: Delta for supervision timer for HO execution to GSM

tS1RelOvDeltU.description:
Delta for Supervision Timer For The Execution Phase Of An S1 Handover to UTRAN
TS1RELOCoverallDelta_UTRAN is used to calculate the duration of the timer TS1RELOCoverall which is used to guard against failure of the MME to inform the source eNB of the outcome of the UEs attempt to connect to the target during S1 handover to another 3GPP RAT. TS1RELOCoverall is started in the source eNB when the RRC: MOBILITY FROM EUTRA COMMAND message is sent to the UE and is stopped when S1AP: UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND is received from the MME to confirm the outcome. If the timer expires the handover is aborted and the UE context is released. In future releases the UE will be allowed to rejoin the source cell. The duration of TS1RELOCoverall is calculated by adding the value of TS1RELOCoverallDelta_UTRAN to that of T304_InterRAT. The value of TS1RELOCoverallDelta_UTRAN should be set to an estimate of an upper bound of the time taken for the RNC to communicate via the MME to the eNB during normal network conditions.
tS1RelOvDeltU.fullName: Delta for supervision timer for the execution HO WCDMA

tS1RelPrepG.description:
Guard against failure of the MME to respond in preparation phase of S1 handover to GSM
Timer TS1RELOCprep_InterRAT is used to guard against failure of the MME to respond preparation phase of S1 handover to another 3GPP RAT. It is started in the source eNB when the S1AP: HANDOVER REQUIRED message is sent to the MME and is stopped when the S1AP: HANDOVER COMMAND or S1AP: PREPARATION FAILURE message is received in response. If the timer expires the handover is aborted or cancelled.
tS1RelPrepG.fullName: Supervision timer for handover preparation to GSM

tS1RelPrepL.description:
Guard against failure of the MME to respond in preparation phase of  intra LTE S1 handover 
Timer TS1RELOCprep_LTE is used to guard against failure of the MME to respond preparation phase of  intra LTE S1 handover. It is started in the source eNB when the S1AP: HANDOVER REQUIRED message is sent to the MME and is stopped when the S1AP: HANDOVER COMMAND or S1AP: PREPARATION FAILURE message is received in response. If the timer expires the handover is aborted or cancelled.
tS1RelPrepL.fullName: Supervision timer preparation intra LTE S1 HO

tS1RelPrepU.description:
Guard against failure of the MME to respond in preparation phase of S1 handover to another 3GPP RAT
Timer tS1relprepIrat is used to guard against failure of the MME to respond preparation phase of S1 handover to another 3GPP RAT. It is started in the source eNB when the S1AP: HANDOVER REQUIRED message is sent to the MME and is stopped when the S1AP: HANDOVER COMMAND or S1AP: PREPARATION FAILURE message is received in response. If the timer expires the handover is aborted or cancelled.
tS1RelPrepU.fullName: Supervision timer for the preparation HO WCDMA

tX2RelocPrep.description:
Guard against failure of the handover target eNB to respond in preparation phase of X2 handover. This timer is started in the source eNB when the X2AP: HANDOVER REQUEST message is sent to the target eNB and is typically stopped when the X2AP: HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message is received in return.
When the timer expires, the X2AP: HANDOVER CANCEL procedure is started.
tX2RelocPrep.fullName: Supervision timer preparation intra LTE X2 HO

timDelACContPreempt.description:
This timer delays the continuation of the admission control for pre-empted bearers.
If eNB sends the S1AP message E-RAB RELEASE INDICATION for pre-empted bearers to MME, the MME needs time to release the indicated bearers in the EPC. Until the release of a bearer S-GW might still send downlink data packets for this bearer to eNB. The expected avarage time is covered by this timer that delays the continuation of the admisison control by the given timer value.
timDelACContPreempt.fullName: Timer delayed AC continuation At pre-emption

timeConnFailureThreshold.description: The parameter is used to determine whether to consider an RLF Report for Inter-RAT MRO Too Late PM counting. tx2RelODelta.description:
Covers at a minimum the estimated time taken to:
- send an RRC:CONNECTION RECONFIGURATION message to the UE (no RLC Ack needed)
- send an RRC:CONNECTION RECONFIGURATION COMPLETE or RRC:CONNECTION REESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message from the UE
- send an S1AP: PATH SWITCH REQUEST message from the target eNB
Note that this value can be extended to also include the estimated time for the target eNB to complete the full handover completion phase.
TX2RELOCoverall = T304max + T311 + T301 + TX2RELOCoverallDelta

txPathFailureMode.description:
Controls the handling of TX path failures. 
If set to 'keepCellInService' a cell remains enabled as long as the minimum required number of TX path are operating as defined in dedicated features.
If set to 'disableCell' a cell is disabled if at least one TX path is not operable.
Please notice that changing the mode requires 'BTS restart'.

ulCaPathlossThr.description: Pathloss threshold for UE scheduled on single cell for UL CA. When UE’s pathloss is larger than the threshold, then this UE is only scheduled in single cell.
ulCaPathlossThr.fullName: Pathloss threshold UE scheduled on single cell

ulPollByte.description: AM RLC Poll Byte value in UL direction for UE category 1.

ulamcHistMcsT.description: Time window over which the uplink Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC) function maintains a history of MCS selections, used to smooth link-adaptation decisions.

ulamcInactT.description: Inactivity timer for uplink AMC: after this period without uplink activity, the AMC state/history may be reset or a fallback MCS assumed.

ulpcRachPwrRipOffset.description:
Offset added to the Received Interference Power (RIP) level to determine the RACH preamble target power.
The Received Interference Power (RIP) is measured over the PRACH PRBs in the PRACH TTIs and is then averaged over a period of time to generate an average PRACH RIP value. The preamble target power is then calculated by adding the value of this parameter to the average PRACH RIP value.

ulpcRachTgtPwrDelta.description:
Delta to determine if RACH preamble target power should be changed.
If the newly calculated preamble target power has changed from the current SIB2 preambleInitialReceivedTargetPower by more than this parameter, then preambleInitialReceivedTargetPower will be set equal to the newly calculated preamble target power and will be communicated to the UE via SIB2.

ulpcRssiMaxIAw.description: Sets an upper limit for RSSI received from a UE. If exceeded, the next power command indicates -1 dB UL power change even if the current UL power is insufficient for reaching Target SINR.

userLayerTcpMss.description: Configures the TCP Maximum Segment Size used for user-plane-layer TCP connections; 0 typically means use the system/path default rather than an override.

voiceSuppMatchInd.description:
If voiceSuppMatchInd is set to 'supported' (respectively 'notSupported'), then eNB shall set the 'Voice Support Match Indicator' IE in a S1AP: UE RADIO CAPABILITY MATCH RESPONSE message  to 'Supported' (respectively to 'Not Supported')
 If voiceSuppMatchInd is set to 'errorIndication',  then eNB shall answer to a S1AP: UE RADIO CAPABILITY MATCH REQUEST with an ERROR INDICATION message

x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr.description:
eNB generates a random delay time from the interval [0, x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr] for X2 eNB Configuration Update procedure. This random delay time is added to x2CfUpRspTmr while waiting for a X2 eNB Configuration Update Acknowledge from other eNB. It is also added to "Time to Wait" if a failure response is received, before starting another retry of X2 eNB Configuration Update procedure.

If 'x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr' is set to ‘0’, then no random delay is applied. 

The random delay serves to avoid bursts of X2 eNB Configuration Update procedures within the network.
x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr.fullName: X2 configuration update random delay timer

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

actFlexBbUsage.description:
Activation of more flexible base band usage by allowing more enhanced recovery in case of HW failure. If set to 'true', the size of PUCCH PRB may be limited on 10 MHz system bandwidth or lower. It need to be set to 'true' to configure more than 2 cells with FSMD, more than 3 with FSME or FSMF without extension Baseband module, more than 6 with FSMF with extension Baseband module or more than 9 with FSMF+FBBx+FBBC or more than 6 with FSMF+FBBx+FBBC, if there are cells present with any of the following properties: ( (20MHz 4RX and actOptimizedBbUsage set to false) or (4x4 DL MIMO enabled) or UL CoMP 4RX enabled ) ). When set to 'true', range of parameters maxNumActUE and maxNumRrc will be limited for 5 MHz and 10 MHz cells.

AirScale:
actFlexBbusage shall be set to false in any deployment.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if dropping of all cells is needed. 
It is recommended to consider planned site extensions already with first commissioning if limitations for parameters maxNumActUE, maxNumRrc, addAUeTcHo, maxNumRrcEmergency, n1PucchAn, pucchNAnCs and deltaPucchShift are acceptable.

Activate Flexible Baseband Usage on BTS
Activation of more flexible baseband usage by allowing more enhanced recovery in case of HW failure.  Parameter is affecting only into  cells with uplink and downlink channel bandwidth is 5 MHz or 10 MHz. In case parameter is set to 'true', there may be limitations in the amount 
FSMD: value 'false' => up to 2 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 3 cells can be configured.
FSME: value 'false' => up to 3 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 6 cells can be configured.
FSMF: value 'false' => up to 3 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 6 cells can be configured.
FSMF + 1 x Extension Baseband Module: value 'false' => up to 6 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 12 cells can be configured.
FSMF + FBBA + FBBC: value 'true' => up to 18 cells can be configured.

For SRAN only: 
FSMF (4DSP deployment): value 'false' => up to 2 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 4 cells can be configured.

Note: For AirScale the parameter value is not applicable.

actHighRrc.description:

With this parameter it is possible to support higher amount of Active UE on cell. The amount of Active UE cannot exceed maximum number of RRC_connected.
The parameter can be configured to "true" for cell bandwidths of "15 MHz" or "20 MHz" using System module that supports over 840 RRC connected UE.

AirScale:
actHighRrc shall be set to false for any deployment

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

actOptimizedBbUsage.description:
This parameter enables the mapping of 2TX4RX cells to optimized baseband resources

This parameter is valid for FSMr3 HW only.

This parameter applies when there are cells with following properties configured to eNB: 
∙	2TX4RX with 5MHz, 10MHz, 15MHz or 20MHz and ‘LNCEL instance ID’ (LNCEL-lnCelId) is not member of any Uplink CoMP cell list (ULCOMP-ulCoMpCellList)

If there are no corresponding cells configured in the eNB, the parameter doesn't have any impact.

If ‘actOptimizedBbUsage’ is set to 'true' and above conditions are met, corresponding cells will receive optimize baseband resource mapping. 
In all other cases, corresponding cells will receive standard baseband resource mapping. 

With  'actOptimizedBbUsage' set to 'true' it becomes possible to create configurations for 2x2 MIMO with 4Rx diversity for up to 6 cells of 5 or 10 MHz in one basic cell set or up to 3 cells of 15 or 20 MHz in one basic cell set. No additional baseband extension module FBBA or FBBC are needed. This is refered to optimized baseband resource mapping. If parameter is set to 'false', above cells are mapped to FSMF plus FBBC or FBBA, as in all previous releases. This is refered to standard baseband resource mapping.

attachNoPDNConn.description:

Refer to 3GPP TS36.331 and IE attachWithoutPDN-Connectivity-r13

'not support': Attach without PDN Connectivity is not applicable for both CAT-M and NBIoT in this PLMN.
'support': Attach without PDN Connectivity is applicable for both CAT-M and NBIoT in this PLMN
'Cat-M support': Attach without PDN Connectivity is applicable only for CAT-M in this PLMN
'NB-IoT support': Attach without PDN Connectivity is applicable only for NB-IoT in this PLMN

preventPsHOtoWcdma.description:
This parameter can be used to generally prevent the execution of PS-handover towards WCDMA for all UE or to prevent the execution of PS-handover towards WCDMA for all UE without an active VoIP bearer.
If this parameter is set to "All" all UE will be sent to WCDMA by UE Context Release with redirect, even if the UE would be able to perform handover.
If this parameter is set to "NonVoiceOnly" all UE without an established VoIP bearer will be sent to WCDMA by UE Context Release with redirect, even if the UE would be able to perform handover.
This parameter must be configured if handover to WCDMA is activated. It is not needed otherwise.

tempRadioMasterRecovTime.description:
This is the timer started in Temporary Radio Master state after it detects that configured Radio Master has recovered. This is done to ensure that peer tech BTS is stable enough to take over Radio Master role again.
This is the timer started in Temporary Sync Master state after temporary master BTS redetects
SYNC (from Peer Technology BTS ) on RP3-01 ports and before releasing the shared radios. This is done to ensure that
peer tech BTS is stable enough to start taking sync from it.
Zero (0) value indicates that no waiting is desired.

tempRadioMasterTriggerTime.description:
This is the timer started in Radio Slave state after slave BTS detects loss of Radio Master, before it takes over Temporary Master Role and re-establishes cells for the slave. Wait time is used to allow Radio Master to recover from a reset.
If eNB shall be able to enter test dedicated state while it is in Temporary Master role, the parameter must be set to the min value (0), meaning no waiting is desired.

This is the timer started in Sync Slave state after slave BTS detects SYNC loss (from Peer Technology BTS ) on RP3-01 ports. This is done to rule out any maintenance activity planned for peer technology BTS.

antennaElementSpacing.description:
This parameter defines the physical antenna element spacing in millimeter for the specific antenna type defined in dlSectorBFWeightProfName of the list item.
If the relative antenna element spacing is not in range of 0.470...0.525 lambda or 0.620...0.675 lambda CEBB won't be activated.
The relative antenna element spacing = LNBTS-dlSectorBFWeightCusProf-dlSectorAntennaElementSpacing(millimeter)/1000*earfcn(Hz)/(3*10^8 (m/s) ).

csBIAPcellA3Reuse.description:
CSBIA Pell A3 Reuse
if csBIAPcellA3Reuse set to true, UE CSBIA property classification in SCell will reuse the A3 measurement from PCell. Suggest to set to true only in CA scenario 1.

dlOlqcDeltaCqiMax.description: The parameter defines the maximum CQI offset in Outer Loop Link Quality Control (OLQC) for Downlink.
dlOlqcDeltaCqiMax.fullName: Maximum CQI offset for DL OLQC

interferenceOccurRatio.description: Threshold ratio/percentage of measurement occasions in which interference must be detected before the TDD interference-mitigation logic takes action.

lnBts_TddId.description: This is the instance identifier of object LNBTS_TDD. It uniquely defines the object containing TDD technology specific parameter applicable to all TDD cells. It is used only for operation and maintenance purposes.

mMimoVerticalGobFirst.description:
The parameter specifies the first vertical GoB (Grid of Beam) vector for both downlink and uplink MU-MIMO in massive MIMO.
The vertical GoB vector is calculated by first vertical GoB vector and vertical relative GoB vector. For instance:
Vertical GoB                                                  OAM parameters                         Internal Relative value   
Vertical GoB (-15, 0)                                First vertical GoB: -15                  Vertical Relative GoB (0, 15) 

The parameter ‘mMimoVerticalGobFirst’ has relationship with ‘mMimoSectorBFProfName’ setting’s electrical tilt if the vendor specific sector beamforming weight profile is used, reference setting is mMimoVerticalGobFirst = mMimoSectorBFProfName’s Electrical Tilt - 7 degree.
For instance, if mMimoSectorBFProfName = '3:Macro-0 Electrical Tilt-(3)' then
Vertical GoB                                                  OAM parameters                         Internal Relative value   
Vertical GoB (-4, 11)                                First vertical GoB: -4                    Vertical Relative GoB (0, 15)
mMimoVerticalGobFirst.fullName: Massive MIMO vertical GoB (Grid of Beam) first vector

modulusOfWeighforAntGrp0.description: This parameter specifies the modulus of the downlink sector beamforming weight which is one complex number for AntennaGroup0 which belongs to the same polarized direction.
modulusOfWeighforAntGrp0.fullName: Modulus of weight for antenna group 0

modulusOfWeighforAntGrp1.description: This parameter specifies the modulus of the downlink sector beamforming weight which is one complex number for AntennaGroup1 which belongs to the same polarized direction.
modulusOfWeighforAntGrp1.fullName: Modulus of weight for antenna group 1

modulusOfWeighforAntGrp2.description: This parameter specifies the modulus of the downlink sector beamforming weight which is one complex number for AntennaGroup2 which belongs to the same polarized direction.
modulusOfWeighforAntGrp2.fullName: Modulus of weight for antenna group 2

modulusOfWeighforAntGrp3.description: This parameter specifies the modulus of the downlink sector beamforming weight which is one complex number for AntennaGroup3 which belongs to the same polarized direction.
modulusOfWeighforAntGrp3.fullName: Modulus of weight for antenna group 3

numRxWithHighNonGbr.description: Likely a count/number of "receive With High Non Guaranteed Bit Rate" on the LNBTS_FDD object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

numTxWithHighNonGbr.description:
Number of sampled subframes that would require a (another) SCell configuration for serving all the UE non-GBR data traffic 

Note: Special value "0" means that the UE candidate SCells are immediately configured even if not required for serving the UE non-GBR data traffic.
numTxWithHighNonGbr.fullName: Number of sampled subframes with High Non-GBR traffic

phaseOfWeighforAntGrp0.description: This parameter specifies the phase of the downlink sector beamforming weight which is one complex number for AntennaGroup0 which belongs to the same polarized direction.
phaseOfWeighforAntGrp0.fullName: Phase of weight for antenna group 0

phaseOfWeighforAntGrp1.description: This parameter specifies the phase of the downlink sector beamforming weight which is one complex number for AntennaGroup1 which belongs to the same polarized direction.
phaseOfWeighforAntGrp1.fullName: Phase of weight for antenna group 1

phaseOfWeighforAntGrp2.description: This parameter specifies the phase of the downlink sector beamforming weight which is one complex number for AntennaGroup2 which belongs to the same polarized direction.
phaseOfWeighforAntGrp2.fullName: Phase of weight for antenna group 2

phaseOfWeighforAntGrp3.description: This parameter specifies the phase of the downlink sector beamforming weight which is one complex number for AntennaGroup3 which belongs to the same polarized direction.
phaseOfWeighforAntGrp3.fullName: Phase of weight for antenna group 3

preventPsHOtoWcdma.description:
This parameter can be used to generally prevent the execution of PS-handover towards WCDMA for all UE or to prevent the execution of PS-handover towards WCDMA for all UE without an active VoIP bearer.
If this parameter is set to "All" all UE will be sent to WCDMA by UE Context Release with redirect, even if the UE would be able to perform handover.
If this parameter is set to "NonVoiceOnly" all UE without an established VoIP bearer will be sent to WCDMA by UE Context Release with redirect, even if the UE would be able to perform handover.
This parameter must be configured if handover to WCDMA is activated. It is not needed otherwise.

prohibitPsHOtoTdscdma.description:
This parameter can be used to generally prohibit the execution of PS-handover towards TD-SCDMA.
If this parameter is set to true all UE will be send to TD-SCDMA by UE Context Release with redirect, even if the UE would be able to perform handover.
This parameter must be configured if handover to TD-SCDMA is activated. It is not needed otherwise.

rnipDetectionIndIntervalPostTx.description: Measurement interval (ms) used for remote/received interference-power detection indications collected after the cell's own transmission window, part of TD-LTE cross-operator interference mitigation.

rnipDetectionIndIntervalPreTx.description: Measurement interval (ms) used for remote/received interference-power detection indications collected before the cell's own transmission window.

suppExtCqiPeriod.description:
This parameter enables the use of PUCCH configuration to support more RRC connected UEs. 
All cell in this eNB only configurate old PUCCH CSI look-up table(LTE1130) 
If suppExtCqiPeriod is set to 'false’, all TDD cells in the eNB where LTE1130 is activated use the legacy PUCCH CSI look-up table.
If suppExtCqiPeriod is set to 'true’, all TDD cells in the eNB must have LTE1130 activated. In this case a PUCCH CSI look-up table which allows to support more RRC connected UEs is taken into use.

tS1RelPrepTd.description:
Guard against failure of the MME to respond in preparation phase of S1 handover to another 3GPP RAT
Timer TS1RELOCprep_TDSCDMA is used to guard against failure of the MME to respond preparation phase of S1 handover to another 3GPP RAT. It is started in the source eNB when the S1AP: HANDOVER REQUIRED message is sent to the MME and is stopped when the S1AP: HANDOVER COMMAND or S1AP: PREPARATION FAILURE message is received in response. If the timer expires the handover is aborted or cancelled.
tS1RelPrepTd.fullName: Supervision Timer For Preparation HO To TD-SCDMA

txEnableDelayTime.description: Guard delay (ms) inserted before re-enabling transmission on the TDD radio path after a triggering event (e.g. clearing of detected interference or a frame-timing change).

ulamcCStepUp.description: The parameter defines the stepsize up value for the uplink Outer Loop Link Adaption compensation delta C. Stepsize down value for delta C can be calculated by using this parameter and UL target BLER (ulTargetBler, SFS ULAMC_TARGET_BLER (ulamcTargetBler)).
ulamcCStepUp.fullName: UL AMC delta C stepsize up

a1ReportInterval.description:
For the RSRP based A1 event of serving cell for stopping of Inter-RAT (InterFreq)  Measurements the UE performs periodical reporting with this indicated interval

The UE is configured to report this A1 event in an infinite way when this parameter is set, otherwise A1 event will be only reported once.
a1ReportInterval.fullName: A1 report interval for serving becomes better than RSRP

a1TimeToTriggerDeactInterMeas.description:
Time to trigger deactivation of all measurements
Duration for which the event A1 must be valid, such that Inter-Frequency/Inter-RAT measurements are deactivated
a1TimeToTriggerDeactInterMeas.fullName: Time to trigger for A1 to deactivate inter measurement

a2RedirectQci1.description:
This parameter enables and disables A2 based redirection for VoLTE calls when UE has QCI1 bearer.
A2 Redirect measurement will not be activated if UE has QCI1 bearer and this parameter is set to disabled. A2 Redirect measurements will be activated when UE has QCI1 bearer and this parameter is set to enabled, or if UE does not have QCI1 bearer. This parameter does not affect A2 redirect measurement when UE does not have any QCI1 bearer.
a2RedirectQci1.fullName: A2 based redirect for VoLTE calls

a2TimeToTriggerActC2kMeas.description: Time during which specific RSRP criteria for the event A2 needs to be met in order to trigger a measurement report
a2TimeToTriggerActC2kMeas.fullName: Time to trigger for A2 to activate CDMA2000 measurement

a2TimeToTriggerActGERANMeas.description:
Time to trigger activation of GERAN  measurements
Duration for which the event A2 must be valid, such that GSM measurements are activated
a2TimeToTriggerActGERANMeas.fullName: Time to trigger for A2 to activate GERAN measurement

a2TimeToTriggerActInterFreqMeas.description: Duration for which the event A2 must be valid, such that additional InterFrequency measurements are activated
a2TimeToTriggerActInterFreqMeas.fullName: Time to trigger for A2 to activate inter measurement

a2TimeToTriggerActWcdmaMeas.description:
Time to trigger activation of WCDMA  measuremenrts
Duration for which the event A2 must be valid, such that WCDMA measurements are activated
a2TimeToTriggerActWcdmaMeas.fullName: Time to trigger for A2 to activate WCDMA measurement

a2TimeToTriggerMobRsrq.description:
Time to trigger for A2-RSRQ.
Duration for which the event A2-RSRQ must be valid, such that mobility measurements with measurement gaps are activated.
a2TimeToTriggerMobRsrq.fullName: Time to trigger A2-RSRQ to start mobility measurement

a2TimeToTriggerRedirect.description: Duration for which the event A2 must be valid, such that redirect is raised
a2TimeToTriggerRedirect.fullName: Time to trigger for A2 to start redirect procedure

a2TimeToTriggerRedirectRsrq.description:
Time to trigger for A2-RSRQ.
Duration for which the event A2-RSRQ must be valid, such that redirect is raised.
a2TimeToTriggerRedirectRsrq.fullName: Time to trigger for A2 by RSRQ to start redirect

a3Offset.description: Margin for the Event A3 SCell discovery measurement- A neighbor becomes offset better than the PCell.

a3ReportAmount.description: The number of measurement reports the UE sends after an A3 event (neighbor becomes offset better than serving cell) is triggered, before it stops reporting; "infinity" means it keeps reporting as long as the condition holds.

a3ReportInterval.description: This parameter defines the interval with which measurement reports are repeatedly sent as long as the specific criteria for the measurement event A3 are met. Value definitions as stated in 3GPP TS36.331: value MS120 corresponds to 120 ms, MS240 to 240 ms and so on, while value MIN1 corresponds to 1 min, MIN6 to 6 min and so on.

a3TimeToTrigger.description: Time for which the specific criteria for the Event A3 SCell discovery measurement must be met in order to trigger a measurement report.

a3TriggerQuantityHO.description: Defines which quantity (RSRP or RSRQ) the UE has to use for triggering an event A3 measurement report for Intra-frequency handover measurements.

a5ReportAmount.description: The number of measurement reports sent after an A5 event (serving cell worse than threshold1 and neighbor better than threshold2) is triggered.

a5ReportInterval.description: Defines the interval with which measurement reports are repeatedly sent as long as the specific criteria for the measurement event A5 are met. Value definitions as stated in 3GPP TS36.331: value MS120 corresponds to 120 ms, MS240 to 240 ms and so on, while value MIN1 corresponds to 1 min, MIN6 to 6 min and so on.

a5TimeToTrigger.description: Time for which the specific criteria for the measurement event A5 must be met in order to trigger a measurement report. Value definitions as stated in 3GPP TS36.331: value MS0 corresponds to 0 ms, MS40 to 40 ms and so on.

a5TriggerQuantityIntraFreqHO.description: Defines which quantity (RSRP or RSRQ) the UE has to use for triggering an event A5 measurement report for Intra-frequency handover measurements.

acbFurtherPlmnProfileId.description: Instance ID of the access barring profile for each further PLMN
acbFurtherPlmnProfileId.fullName: Further PLMN access class barring profile identifier

acbPrimaryPlmnProfileId.description: Instance ID of the access barring profile for primary PLMN. The primary PLMN ID is unique under eNB, but operator can differentiate the  access barring profile ID for primary PLMN under each cell.
acbPrimaryPlmnProfileId.fullName: Primary PLMN access class barring profile identifier

act3fdd3tddRestrict.description: Restriction of maximum 3 FDD plus 3 TDD inter-frequencies in final frequency list when the UE supports only 3GPP Release 8 and 9.

act4TxFailHandling.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable 4 transmit Fail Handling" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actAcHpsLimits.description: Activates admission-control resource limits reserved for high-priority services, ensuring capacity is set aside for prioritized traffic.

actAcceleratedMobility.description: Enables an accelerated mobility feature that speeds up handover decision/execution for this LTE cell, reducing handover latency.

actAir2Ground.description: Activates Air-to-Ground (A2G) cell functionality, a specialized LTE configuration used to provide in-flight connectivity to aircraft passengers.

actAmle.description: This parameter activates/de-activates the optional feature "Active mode load equalization".

actAmleServCellFilter.description: Enables filtering of candidate serving cells used by Nokia's automatic mobility/load-balancing engine (AMLE), based on a configured RSRP threshold.

actAntPortMap.description:
This parameter controls I/Q data stream mapping to TX antenna ports.
When set to “false”, the I/Q data streams are mapped automatically on TX antenna ports on RF modules.
When set to “true”, the I/Q data streams are mapped on CHANNEL objects in fixed pattern. Manual configuration of antenna line for each CHANNEL is then necessary (by setting CHANNEL.antlDN).

actB1ReturnTo5GSA.description: Enables use of the 3GPP Event B1 inter-RAT measurement to trigger returning a UE from LTE/EN-DC back to standalone 5G coverage.

actCaArchEnhImp.description: Enables a Carrier Aggregation architecture enhancement; the 'on_peak_data_rate_adv' setting optimises the enhancement specifically for advertising/achieving peak data rate.

actCaBlocking.description: This parameter activates the support of load-based carrier aggregation PCell and SCell blocking.
actCaBlocking.fullName: Activate load-based carrier aggregation PCell and SCell blocking

actCaScellSchedWeightFactor.description: Activates use of a configurable scheduling weight factor for Secondary Cells under Carrier Aggregation, letting the operator bias how much scheduler priority SCells receive relative to the PCell.

actCarelCounters.description: Activates collection of performance counters specific to Carrier Aggregation Relation (CAREL) objects.

actCsiRsSubFNonTM9Sch.description:
Activate non-TM9 UEs to be scheduled in CSI-RSI sub-frames. 
If actCsiRsSubFNonTM9Sch is set to 'TRUE':
- Non-TM9 UEs receive transport blocks using lower MCSs in CSI-RS sub-frames compared to normal sub-frames.

If actCsiRsSubFNonTM9Sch is set to 'FALSE':
- Non-TM9 UEs do not receive data in CSI-RS sub-frames because CSI-RS degrade the quality of the transmission.

- TM7 UEs can not be scheduled in CSI-RS sub-frames if csiRsSubfrConf is not TDD specific rsc20, rsc21 nor rsc22.
actCsiRsSubFNonTM9Sch.fullName: Activation of non-TM9 UEs in CSI-RS sub-frames

actDataSessionProf.description: This parameter activates the feature 'Data Session Profiling'.

actDeltaCqiAgingScellChEst.description: Activates an aging/decay adjustment applied to Secondary Cell CQI channel estimates, compensating for measurement reports that grow stale while the SCell is deactivated or infrequently measured.

actDl256QamChQualEst.description:
This parameter activates the channel quality monitoring for 256QAM usage.
Please note that actDl256QamChQualEst must be configured if actModulationSchemeDl is set to ‘256QAM’. It must be either set to ‘true or ‘false’ dependent if quality estimation shall be activated or not.
actDl256QamChQualEst.fullName: Activate channel quality monitoring for 256QAM usage

actDlIsh.description: Determines if the interference shaping sub-functionality shall be active

actDlPwBackoff.description: This parameter is the activation flag of the feature DL dynamic power back-off.

actDlsLdAdaptPf.description: Activates a load-adaptive variant of the downlink scheduler's proportional-fair algorithm, letting scheduling fairness/aggressiveness adapt to current cell load.

actDlsOldtc.description:
Switch to activate/deactivate Outer Loop Delay Target Control (OLDTC) for voice in downlink time domain scheduling.
OLDTC algorithm measures an actual scheduling delay of voice bearer in DL and compares it to a targeted delay. Then, if the measured delay is more than the target, UE priority is increased and in case the measured delay is below the target, the priority is decreased.

actDlsVoicePacketAgg.description: Switch to activate/deactivate voice packet aggregation in downlink scheduler.

actDownSampling.description: This parameter activates down sampling of a cell.

actDrx.description:
Parameter to activate or deactivate the DRX feature in a cell.

Note for the case where periodic subband CQI reporting (periodicCqiFeedbackType) is enabled together with DRX functionality:
It may not be possible to synchronize DRX start offset such that the wideband CQI report is received during the DRX OnDuration (due to periodicities) and that may cause small performance degradation in DL whenever fresh wideband channel quality information cannot be get in time. It is up to an operator whether to prevent activation of periodic subband CQI reporting and DRX in parallel because of this restriction.

It is highly recommended to stay with DRX default values if dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz'.

actDrxDuringMeasGap.description:
This parameter activates the feature DRX with parallel UE measurement gaps.
During measurement gaps, only drxProfile1, drxProfile2 or drxSmartProfile2 can be setup at the UE.

If the UE can't use DRX, then drxProfile1 is used.
Else if SmartDRX can't be used, then drxProfile2 is used else drxSmartProfile2 is used.

actDrxDuringTTIB.description:
This parameter activates the feature DRX during TTI Bundling.
During TTI Bundling, onDurationTimer is set equal to longDRXCycle to keep UE always in active state.

actDynamicDataSessionProf.description: This parameter activates 'Load Based Dynamic Data Session Profiling'. The Data Session Profile feature must activated on the cell, and C-Plane overload handling must be activated before 'Load Based Dynamic Data Session Profiling' can be activated (i.e. MRBTS/LNBTS/LNCEL-actDataSessionProf must be 'true, and MRBTS/LNBTS-actCplaneOvlHandling must be 'true'').

actEDrxIdle.description:
Parameter to activate or deactivate extended DRX in idle mode in a cell.
BTS synchronization mode shall be set to PhaseSync or LoosePhaseAndTimeSync in order to have the correct feature functionality.

This activation parameter is applicable for both WB-LTE and NBIOT cell. For LTE-M there is a separate activation parameter.

actEicic.description:
Activates the features eICIC for macro and small cells
It is recommended (but not required) to also enable feature LTE1617 RLF triggered Handover, when activating LTE1113 in the macro cell in order to allow RRC connection reestablishment without prepared context of small cell CRE UEs. This is useful for UEs located in high CRE values (higher than 6 dB) in the small cell eICIC partners.

actEirpControl.description: Activates automatic control/limiting of the cell's Effective Isotropic Radiated Power (EIRP), used to keep the transmitted power within a regulatory or operator-defined ceiling as antenna/power configuration changes.

actEnDcBlocking.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable En Dual Connectivity/DC power (context-dependent) Blocking" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actEndcHoPrefLay.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable E-UTRA-NR Dual Connectivity handover Pref Lay" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actEndcIntraFreqMdt.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable E-UTRA-NR Dual Connectivity Intra frequency Mdt" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actExtSib1.description: Enables broadcasting an extended format of System Information Block Type 1 (SIB1), supporting additional fields defined in later 3GPP releases.

actFastPdcchAdapt.description: Activates a faster adaptation algorithm for PDCCH format/aggregation-level selection, allowing quicker reaction to changing radio conditions.

actFlexDupGap.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'Flexible duplexing gap'. The feature is only applicable for FDD cells.

If activated non 3GPP compliant duplexing gaps can be configured. Downlink and uplink frequency must nevertheless belong to the same E-UTRA operating band as specified in 3GPP TS36.104.

actFlowCtrlEnh.description: Enables an enhanced flow-control algorithm (e.g. backpressure handling between scheduler/baseband or between the eNB and transport) to reduce buffer bloat and improve throughput stability.

actForcedDrxS1Ho.description: This parameter activates the feature LTE3745, i.e. S1 based mobility to open access Home eNB, CSG and Hybrid cell
actForcedDrxS1Ho.fullName: Activate forced DRX S1 mobility to HeNB/CSG/HybridCell

actGsmSrvccMeasOpt.description:
This parameter activates SRVCC to GSM measurement optimization
This parameter is used for activating SRVCC to GSM measurement optimization.

If actGsmSrvccMeasOpt is set to 
- 'true': LTE inter-freq measurements (e.g. A3/A4/A5/ReportStrongestCell/ReportCGI/etc.) are exclusive with IRAT SRVCC to GSM measurement (B2)
- 'false': LTE inter-freq measurements are allowed to run in parallel with IRAT SRVCC to GSM measurement.
actGsmSrvccMeasOpt.fullName: Activation flag of SRVCC to GSM measurement optimization

actHapPrachCfg.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Hap Physical Random Access Channel configuration" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actHapPrachTaFilt.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Hap Physical Random Access Channel Ta Filt" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actImmciAtTau.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Immci At Tau" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actInactiveTimeForwarding.description: Enables the remaining inactive time functionality.

actIncCarrFor3GPPnonComplUes.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Inc Carr For 3 GP Pnon Compl Ues" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actInterFreqLB.description:
The parameter activates Inter- frequency load balancing (iF-LB) feature.
If the feature iF-LB is activated ("true"), inter-frequency load measurements are performed per cell. Dependent on the actual load situation UEs might be handovered to low loaded neighbor cells (different frequency layer).

actInterFreqSPIDBasedHo.description: Activates inter-frequency handover decisions that take the UE's Subscriber Profile ID (SPID) into account, enabling subscriber-group-specific mobility steering.

actIntraFreqLoadBal.description:
If activated, the intra-frequency load balancing algorithm continuously estimates the cell load, triggering a handover threshold negotiation with the neighbors when the cell load is above a predefined value. The handover threshold negotiation procedure is done over the X2 interface to align the handover thresholds between neighbor cells.
If the feature is deactivated, the "cellIndOffNeighDelta" parameter is implicitly set to 0 in all LNREL objects.

actLBSpidUeSel.description:
The parameter activates SPID based offload UE candidate selection feature. 

The parameter activates SPID based offload UE candidate selection in Connected Mode Load Balancing offload UE selection algorithm.
In the high load situation UEs might be handovered to low loaded neighbor cells (different frequency layer). UE selection for offload is prioritized according to operator defined SPID groups.
actLBSpidUeSel.fullName: Activate SPID based offload UE candidate selection

actLdPdcch.description:
Activate or deactivate the load adaptive number of PDCCH symbols in a cell
The actual OFDM symbol amount used for PDCCH in a TTI is selected from values between the minimum reasonable amount of symbols for the selected DL bandwidth and maximum allowed number of PDCCH symbols (maxNrSymPdcch).

Note for FDD cell:
If the bandwidth is set to '3 MHz'. it is recommended to set the parameter to 'false'.

Note for TDD cell:
Not every sub-frame need adaptive PDCCH symbol adjustment because not every sub-frame has PDSCH.

actMaxNumUeDlNonGbr.description: Activates enforcement of a cap on the maximum number of UEs concurrently scheduled with downlink Non-GBR traffic.

actMcsUpgrade.description: Activates upgrading the MCS index used for scheduling beyond what CQI alone indicates (by one or two steps), an aggressive link-adaptation technique to boost throughput when reliable.

actMfbiDupFre.description: When this parameter is set to "TRUE", the eNB will send both the native and the overlapping band in the Idle Mode Mobility Control IE of RRCConnectionRelease with the same priority. If LTE2754 is not configured (frequency bands priority is not defined), then this parameter is not applicable and will have no effect

actMicroDtx.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'eNode B power saving - Micro DTX'.
It is possible to reduce power consumption by having the power amplifiers associated with a cell shut down during OFDM symbol times that are not used for any DL transmission.
actMicroDtx.fullName: Activate eNode B power saving - Micro DTX

actMicroDtxDrxOptPatterns.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Micro discontinuous transmission discontinuous reception Opt Patterns" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actModulationSchemeDl.description:
Selects the highest modulation scheme for link adaptation use in PDSCH.
If 64QAM is selected this includes also 16QAM and QPSK
If 256QAM is selected this includes also 64QAM, 16QAM and QPSK.
Please note that the LNCEL parameter actDl256QamChQualEst must be configured if 256QAM is selected. It must be either set to ‘true or ‘false’ dependent if quality estimation shall be activated or not.

actModulationSchemeUL.description:
The parameter selects the highest order modulation scheme which is supported in the cell for UL transmissions .

Depending on the setting of actModulationSchemeUl the supported MCS range is determined for the UEs in the cell.

- QPSK: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS10 for all UEs
- 16QAM: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS20 for all UEs
- 16QAMHighMCS: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS24 for all UEs
- 64QAM: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS28 for UEs with 64QAM capability and from MCS0 to MCS20 for UEs without 64QAM capability
- 64QAMand16QAMHighMCS: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS28 for UEs with 64QAM capability and from MCS0 to MCS24 for UEs without 64QAM capability.

actNbrForNonGbrBearers.description: Activates the feature 'Nominal bitrate for non-GBR bearers
actNbrForNonGbrBearers.fullName: Activate nominal bitrate for non-GBR bearers

actOlLaPdcch.description:
Activate / Deactivate Outer loop Link Adaptation for PDCCH
O&M switch for activating / deactivating an additional Outer Loop Link Adaptation for PDCCH. This additional PDCCH Outer Loop Link Adaptation controls the PDCCH link adaptation CQI shift such that the PDCCH and HARQ Response Target BLER is achieved when the OLQC Target BLER is achieved.

actSpatialPucchBundling.description:
This parameter activates the spatial PUCCH bundling according to 3GPP Release 13.
It applies only to UEs configured with more than 5 serving cells.

- If set to 'true', and if UE's transmission mode indicates it will transmit two code words in the cell, then binary AND operation is applied for the two HARQ-ACK bits corresponding to the first and second code words. The spatial-bundled 1 HARQ-ACK bit is concatenated with HARQ-ACK bits of other serving cells and reported to the eNB on PUCCH. For a UE configured with more than 5 serving cells and PUCCH format 3 (not configured with PUCCH format 4/5) when the UE simultaneously reports periodic CSI and HARQ-ACK and/or SR on PUCCH at the same TTI, setting the parameter to 'true' can protect total volume of UCI from exceeding 22 bits without need for downlink 'scheduling avoidance' on all SCells. Note, that if the UE's downlink air condition is not good, e.g., RSRP is low, the 'true' setting can cause the downlink throughput degradation.
- If set to 'false', and if UE's transmission mode indicates it will transmit two code words in the cell, then binary AND operation is not applied for the two HARQ-ACK bits corresponding to the first and second code words. The original 2 HARQ-ACK bits are concatenated with HARQ-ACK bits of other serving cells and reported to the eNB on PUCCH. For a UE configured with more than 5 serving cells and PUCCH format 3 (not configured with PUCCH format 4/5), the 'false' setting allows the downlink 'scheduling avoidance' on all SCells for the UE, when the UE is expected to simultaneously report periodic CSI and HARQ-ACK and/or SR on PUCCH at the same TTI and the total number of UCI bits exceeds 22. 

Please refer to Section 5.2.3 of TS 36.212 for the details of the channel coding for uplink control information on PUCCH.
Note: For time being, this parameter is reserved for testing purposes only and must not be configured in commercial networks.

actSrb1Robustness.description: Activate RRC Signaling Robustness in downlink and uplink

actTaDisconnect.description: Activates automatic disconnection of a UE whose measured Timing Advance exceeds an expected range, used to clear out-of-range or anomalous connections.

actTcpServiceDiff.description: This parameter activates TCP Service Differentiation functionality.

actTcpUlPowerBoost.description: Enables boosting uplink transmit power specifically for UEs carrying TCP traffic, aiming to improve uplink throughput for TCP-based data sessions.

actTtiBundling.description:
Parameter to activate or deactivate the TTI Bundling feature in a cell.

Please note that UEs in TTI bundling mode will typically use higher PDCCH aggregation levels. Cell capacity can most likely be limited by PDCCH capacity. This is especially relevant in case of cells with 3 MHz bandwidth.

actTtibAcqi.description: This parameter activates/deactivates Aperiodic CQI reporting for UEs in TTI bundling mode
actTtibAcqi.fullName: Activate ACQI reporting for TTI bundled UEs

actTtibAdaptUlMinTbs.description: Activates adaptive minimum Transport Block Size selection when TTI-bundling (TTIB) is used on the uplink, part of Nokia's VoLTE coverage-enhancement feature.

actTtibRsc.description:
Parameter to activate RSC (Report Strongest Cell) measurements when TTI Bundling is active. RSC measurements are disabled if parameter is set to false.
This parameter is applicable only if TTI Bundling feature is enabled (actTtiBundling).
actTtibRsc.fullName: Activate RSC Measurements during TTI bundling

actUca.description: Nokia feature-activation flag present on both LTE and NR cells; the exact function behind the 'UCA' abbreviation is not documented, but the naming and shared LTE/NR scope suggest a coverage- or capacity-related optimization toggle.

actUePowerBasedMobThr.description:
This parameter activates the features 'High power UE specific mobility thresholds' and activates a mechanism for different points of triggering handover for high power UE.
Dedicated power based thresholds are used for measurements when UE is identified with high power capability in uplink.
Note: Configuration of dedicated thresholds is not dependent on this feature being enabled.
actUePowerBasedMobThr.fullName: Activate UE uplink power based mobility thresholds

actUl256QamChQualEst.description: Enables uplink channel-quality estimation specifically in support of using 256QAM modulation on the uplink.

actUlDynamicTargetBler.description:
This parameter activates uplink dynamic target BLER for nonGBR traffic.
If set to 'true', target BLER for uplink nonGBR traffic is adapted based on UE channel conditions instead of using a static target BLER as defined by ulTargetBler.

actUlGrpHop.description: Activates uplink group hopping in PUSCH and PUCCH.

actUlLnkAdp.description:
Activates Uplink Link Adaptation and defines Link Adaptation mode
When set to "off" no Uplink link Adaptation function is active at all.
When set to "eUlLa" the extended Uplink Link Adaptation function is  activated.
When set to "fUlLa" the new Fast Uplink Link Adaptation function is  activated.
The other choice "slowAmcOllaATB" allows to set to active all the 3 old components of the UL LA function  as it was up to RL20.

actUlsLdAdaptPf.description: Activates a load-adaptive variant of the uplink scheduler's proportional-fair algorithm, the uplink counterpart of actDlsLdAdaptPf.

actUlsOptimizePrbMcs.description: Activates joint optimization of PRB allocation and MCS selection in the uplink scheduler for improved spectral efficiency.

actVoLteSrcRate.description: This parameter activates LTE2774 'Source rate based UL grant assignment for VoLTE'.
actVoLteSrcRate.fullName: Activate VoLTE source rate based UL assignment

actVoipCovBoost.description: Activates VoIP coverage boosting in UL scheduling, feature LTE2098 "VoLTE uplink coverage boosting".
actVoipCovBoost.fullName: Activation of VoIP coverage boosting in UL scheduling

actVoipCovBoostEnh.description: Activates an enhanced VoIP coverage-boost feature, applying additional techniques (such as more aggressive repetition/link adaptation) to extend VoLTE call coverage at the cell edge.

adaptPdcchDwellTime.description: This parameter determines the minimum time the criteria to decrease the number of PDCCH OFDM symbols must be met in order to decrease the number of PDCCH OFDM symbols.
adaptPdcchDwellTime.fullName: Adaptive PDCCH symbol decrease dwell time

addGbrTrafficRrHo.description:
Additional margin on the threshold "maxGbrTrafficLimit" in case of handover for radio reasons.
The amount of radio resources (PRBs) is calculated in % of the available PRBs depending on the system.
1.4 MHz = 6 DL PRBS*,
3.0 MHz = 15 DL PRBS*,
For 5 MHz system 25 PRBs*,
for 10 MHz system 50 PRBs*,
for 15 MHz system 75 PRBs*,
for 20 Mhz system 100 PRBs* are available.
* reduced by common resources like PUCCH, RACCH, PDCCH, SIBs and so on, which can consume some PRBs (for example three PRBs) in average. 

The parameter is only relevant if "actEnhAcAndGbrServices" is set to True and ignored otherwise.

The "addGbrTrafficRrHo" parameter should be configured significantly lower than the "maxGbrTrafficLimit" parameter to reduce admitting handover traffic and preempting other low prior traffic immediately with next cell local admission requests.
addGbrTrafficRrHo.fullName: Add GBR-DRB traffic for radio reason handover

addGbrTrafficTcHo.description:
Additional margin on the threshold "maxGbrTrafficLimit " in case of handover for time critical reasons. 
The amount of radio resources (PRBs) is calculated in % of the available PRBs depending on the system.
1.4 MHz = 6 DL PRBS*,
3.0 MHz = 15 DL PRBS*,
For 5 MHz system 25 PRBs*,
for 10 MHz system 50 PRBs*,
for 15 MHz system 75 PRBs*,
for 20 Mhz system 100 PRBs* are available.
* reduced by common resources like PUCCH, RACCH, PDCCH, SIBs and so on, which can consume some PRBs (for example three PRBs) in average.

The parameter is only relevant if "actEnhAcAndGbrServices" is set to True and ignored otherwise.

The "addGbrTrafficTcHo" parameter should be configured significantly lower than the parameter maxGbrTrafficLimit to reduce admitting handover traffic and preempting other low prior traffic immediately with next cell local admission requests.
addGbrTrafficTcHo.fullName: Add GBR-DRB traffic for time critical reason handover

The setting is commonly valid for all legacy category UE and Cat-M UE.

If allowPbIndexZero is set to ‘false’ and dlRsBoost is equal to 0dB,  then index 1 is chosen for pbIndexPdsch (instead of index 0) 
(see 36.312 / Table 5.2-1).
It’s for backward compatibility with legacy releases
