altitude.description:
Altitude in meters (coded value)
Relation between coded Altitude N and range of absolute altitudes a (a >= 0 meters) it encodes is the following:

for 0 <= N <= 2^15-2:
N <= a < N+1

for N = 2^15-1:
a >= 2^15-1

According to above relation an encoded value N corresponds to a range of absolute altitudes a in metres

amRlcSnFieldLengthDl.description: Selects the RLC Acknowledged Mode sequence-number field length used in the downlink (e.g. 10-bit vs 5-bit SN format), which determines the RLC transmission window size.

amleMaxNumHo.description: This parameter describes how many active mode load equalization handovers per partner neighbor cell are allowed between two CAC reports received from this cell.
amleMaxNumHo.fullName: Max number of AMLE-based HOs between two CAC updates

amlePeriodLoadExchange.description: This timer defines the periodicity according which neighbor cells are requested to report their available resource status.
amlePeriodLoadExchange.fullName: X2 resource status update periodicity for AMLE

amleServCellThreshRsrp.description: RSRP threshold used to decide whether a cell qualifies as a candidate serving cell in Nokia's automatic mobility/load-balancing engine (AMLE) filtering logic.

amleServCellThreshRsrq.description: RSRQ threshold used by the serving-cell mobility/load evaluation algorithm to judge whether the current serving cell's quality is adequate.

amountBlankedRes.description:
Determines the amount of resources to be blanked for PDSCH scheduling of UE specific transmissions.
Given percentage will be rounded to the next larger integer multiple of the system bandwidth dependent allocation granularity on PDSCH (resource block group size for resource allocation type 0). Position of resources to be blanked is derived dynamically.
Value "0" disables the PDSCH blanking sub-functionality.

antBearingForAoaCalc.description: This parameter describes the antenna normal direction with respect to geographical north in 0.1 degrees clockwise, i.e. from North to East. It is used for Angle-of-Arrival (AoA) calculation for LTE1501 and LTE951 and also used for Left & Right Boundary Angle for LTE2462.

antElementSpacing.description: This parameter defines the spacing between the antenna elements and is necessary for AoA calculation.
antElementSpacing.fullName: Antenna Element Spacing for AoA Calculation

applyFeicicFunctionality.description:
This parameter determines whether an eICIC R11 related CIO shall be applied or not. It is required to set this parameter to the same value in all cells (macro & small cells) between which an eICIC partnership is or shall be established, i.e., within an eICIC area.
applyFeicicFunctionality = 'true': Setting of parameter eIcicMaxCre defines the maximum CIO value for R11 UEs in all small cell eICIC partners. This setting is recommended for operators intending to deploy NOKIA Networks equipped HetNets.

applyFeicicFunctionality = 'false': Setting of parameter eIcicMaxCre defines the maximum CIO value for all UEs in all small cell eICIC partners. This setting is recommended for operators intending to deploy HetNets with macro eNB and small cell eNBs from different vendors.

arpPrioLev.description:
ARP priority level.
The range of the ARP priority level is 1 to 15 with 1 as the highest level of priority.

arpProfId.description: Index pointing to a configured ARP (Allocation and Retention Priority) profile that maps this cell's bearers to specific admission-control/pre-emption behavior.

assignedVoLteQualProfile.description: Instance ID of the assigned VoLTE quality profile (VOLTEQUALPR)

autoRemovalAllowed.description:
This parameter specifies whether the further PLMN is allowed to be autonomously removed from SIB1 in case of the PLMN not supported by eNB cell temporarily (e.g. when C-plane overload)
Feature of autonomous further PLMN removal in SIB1 due to C-plane overload can be deactivated in a specific cell indeed if the flag of all further PLMNs of the cell are set to FALSE.

blacklistTopo.description:
This parameter is introduced to allow blacklisting for X2-Handover only other HO variants are still allowed    
If set to "all" the respective entry in blacklistHoL is valid for all kinds of Handover Topology. If set to "onlyX2", handover to the respective entry in blacklistHoL shall only be excluded as targets for X2-based handover but may still be used as target for S1 based handover.

This parameter is only evaluated for inter eNodeB target cells which can be used as target for X2-Handover as well as for  S1-Handover

blockingState.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "blocking State" on the LNBTS object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

boostGuardTime.description: This parameter defines the maximum amount of time traffic boosting can be applied to a bearer carrying TCP traffic.

caBlockNumRrcConn.description:
This parameter defines in percentage the upper threshold of RRC CONNECTED UEs which can trigger load-based carrier aggregation SCell and PCell blocking in the cell level.
Carrier aggregation blocking becomes ACTIVE if #RRC_Connected UEs in the cell >=  ROUND(caBlockNumRrcConn * maxNumRRC.Cell / 100).

Note: maxNumRRC.Cell - indicates that this is the cell related maxNumRRC RAC limit.
caBlockNumRrcConn.fullName: Cell RRC connection carrier aggregation blocking start threshold

caBlockThresholdGbrDl.description:
Represents the downlink GBR load threshold for load-based carrier aggregation SCell and PCell blocking feature.
The eNB may block SCell and PCell additions in this cell when its load exceeds defined thresholds (PDCCH, GBR, non-GBR).
caBlockThresholdGbrDl.fullName: Cell downlink GBR load carrier aggregation blocking start threshold

caBlockThresholdNonGbrDl.description:
Represents the downlink non-GBR load threshold for load-based carrier aggregation SCell and PCell blocking feature.
The eNB may block SCell and PCell additions in this cell when its load exceeds defined thresholds (PDCCH, GBR, non-GBR).
caBlockThresholdNonGbrDl.fullName: Cell downlink non-GBR load carrier aggregation blocking start threshold

caBlockThresholdPdcch.description:
Represents the PDCCH load threshold for load-based carrier aggregation SCell and PCell blocking feature.
The eNB may block SCell and PCell additions in this cell when its load exceeds defined thresholds (PDCCH, GBR, non-GBR).
caBlockThresholdPdcch.fullName: Cell PDCCH load carrier aggregation blocking start threshold

caPoolId.description:
This parameter defines which PCells and SCells in carrier aggregation shall belong to the same C-RNTI group

In case of LNCEL creation eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.
In any case all cells with the same caPoolId will be temporarily dropped.

cellCapClass.description:
This parameter provides the value that classifies the cell capacity weight relative to other types of cells in the network. The Cell Capacity Class Value only indicates the relative weight of resources that are configured for traffic purposes.
Set this parameter to 100 for the most capable cell type in the network, for example the cells with 20 MHz, 40 W, 4x4 DL MIMO. Set this parameter to lower values for cells with lower capabilities, e.g. 50 for cells with 10 MHz and otherwise same capability.

cellIndOffServ.description:
Cell Individual Offset (CIO) of own served cell for insertion into the CIO Cell List of EUTRA Serving Carrier Measurement Object
Only if  CIO is different from zero, will the eNB  consider it for Measurement Configuration.
cellIndOffServ.fullName: Cell individual offset of own serving cells PCI

cellName.description:
This parameter allows the operator to give a cell a unique name.

The range represents the number of bytes to store all the characters of the string. If the string is UTF-8 encoded, each character occupies between 1 to 4 bytes, depending upon the language. If ASCII encoded, each character occupies a single byte. The numbers of characters supported in case of UTF-8 encoding is at least 20.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.

cellPwrRedForMBMS.description:
This parameter is used to set the power for MBSFN transmission together with antenna maximum TX power and cell power reduction (pMax, dlCellPwrRed).
The total power of MBSFN sub-frames would be cell maximum power - cell power reduction - cell power reduction for MBMS, or  pMax - dlCellPwrRed - cellPwrRedForMBMS.

Note that when defining the values for the pmax-dlCellPwrRed - cellPwrRedForMBMS relationship assume that average transmitted energy (averaged radio module output power) should not go under 25 dBm.
cellPwrRedForMBMS.fullName: Cell power reduction for MBMS transmission

cellReserve.description:
Indicates if the cell/PLMN combination  is reserved for operator use.
Cells reserved for operator use are treated as barred by 'normal' UEs without a USIM with AC 11 or 15 inserted. UEs with AC 11 or 15 USIM inserted are specific operator UEs and thus allowed to camp on and access such cells. The default value is not reserved.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.

cellResetRequest.description:
Reset request for Cell
Will be downloaded with current timestamp to indicated reset request, new request will receive new timestamp and therfeore cause parameter change.
Cell reset will be exceuted automatically, since parameter change requires cell lock/unlock.
String is in human readable format, e.g.
Cell reset requested : YYYYMMDD hhnnss
where YYYYMMDD hhnnss is timestamp.

cellResourceGroupPrId.description: Identifier of the cell resource group profile (CRGPR) instance which shall apply for the cell

cellResourceScellMode.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "cell Resource secondary cell Mode" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

cellResourceSharingMode.description:
The parameter activates the feature LTE1382 'Cell resource groups' and selects the resource sharing mode.
The feature allows pre-reservation of cell resources in admission control per PLMN group.

cellTechnology.description: This parameter identifies of the LNCEL instance shall be used as FDD or TDD cell. Dependent on the configuration of the technology, subordinated classes to the LNCEL have to be configured.

cellType.description:
This parameter allows the operator to specify the size of an LTE cell.

This parameter is used for preparing the UE History IE during an outgoing handover, according to LTE1768.

It will be also considered
if the feature LTE1140 'Intra-frequency load balancing' is activated for deriving the corresponding cellBeta co-efficient.
if the features LTE1113/1496 'eICIC macro'/'eICIC micro' are activated (when eICIC is enabled, macro cell should use ‘large’, micro cell should use ‘very small’, ‘small’ and ‘medium’).
if the feature LTE1768 'Mobility robustness optimization ping-pong' is activated (CellType is included in the UE History IE when preparing a X2 handover).
if the feature LTE1800 'Downlink interference shaping' is activated (when DL Interference shaping is enabled, macro cell should use ‘large’, micro cell should use ‘very small’, ‘small’ and ‘medium’).

confidence.description:
Confidence by which the position is known to be within the shape description expressed as a percentage
Confidence = 0 means no information available

cqiAperEnable.description: O&M switch for enabling / disabling aperiodic CQI / RI / PMI reporting on PUSCH.
cqiAperEnable.fullName: Enable aperiodic CQI reporting on PUSCH

cqiAperMode.description: Corresponds to cqi-ReportingModeAperiodic of 3GPP-36.213. CQI format indicator for aperiodic reporting on PUSCH. The operator can choose one of the 2 family modes available, the MIMO algorithm embedded in RRM chooses the effective mode based on the UE capabilities and the family mode chosen by the operator and forwards this to UE; FTB1 selects the reporting mode 2.x, FTB2 selects the reporting mode 3.x; x is determined by the MIMO algorithm internal in eNB.

cqiPerSbCycK.description:
Periodic subband CQI cycles K.
Between consecutive periodic wideband CQI reporting occurrences each subband CQI report might be transmitted as many times as the parameter shows.

cqiPerSimulAck.description: O&M switch for enabling / disabling simultaneous transmission of periodic CQI / RI / PMI feedback and HARQ ACK/NACK on PUCCH.

creCqiAvg.description: Averaging filter constant for averaging CQI reports sent by UE used for cell range expansion (CRE) tagging for ABS and non-ABS subframes.
creCqiAvg.fullName: Averaging filter constant for CRE tagging

csgType.description:
This parameter enables the CSG (Closed Subscriber Group) functionality for the cell.
A value of openAccess means that the cell is not a CSG cell. 
A value of CSG means that the cell is a CSG cell.

dFpucchF1.description: The parameter defines the transport format dependent offset in power control for PUCCH format 1.

dFpucchF1b.description: The parameter defines the transport format dependent offset in power control for PUCCH format 1b.

dFpucchF2.description: The parameter defines the transport format dependent offset in power control for PUCCH format 2.

dFpucchF2a.description: The parameter defines the transport format dependent offset in power control for PUCCH format 2a.

dFpucchF2b.description: The parameter defines the transport format dependent offset in power control for PUCCH format 2b.

dSrTransMax.description:
This is the maximum number of the allowed dedicated Scheduling Requests. Once this limit is exceeded, UE releases all PUCCH resources.  The value 4n corresponds to 4 transmissions, 8n corresponds to 8 transmissions and so on.

Indirectly provides the UE-specific maximum time within which the UE must receive a valid uplink grant for a new transmission on UL-SCH. If this time expires, the UE releases PUCCH resources and no longer performs a dedicated Scheduling Request, but instead performs a random access Scheduling Request. This time is calculated by cell Scheduling Request periodicity * dedicated SR transmission maximum.

defDcnGroupId.description: The default Dedicated Core Network (DCN) Group Identity per PLMN is optionally configured for rerouting UE to an MME Group when the indicated MME is not available when DÉCOR (actDCN) feature is activated.

defPagCyc.description:
The default paging cycle defines the cell-specific paging DRX cycle duration. It also determines the maximum paging DRX duration applicable in the cell. 
Referred to as ' T ' in TS 36.304. Value rf32 corresponds to 32 radio frames, rf64 corresponds to 64 radio frames and so on.

defaultLnRelGnbCellId.description: Specifies the default LNRELGNBCELL instance which shall be used for dual connectivity when coverage based NR cell selection is not in use.
defaultLnRelGnbCellId.fullName: Default NR cell for dual connectivity

degreesOfLatitude.description:
Latitude in degrees (coded value)
Relation between coded Degrees of latitude N and range of absolute latitudes X (0° <= X <= 90°) it encodes is the following:

for 0 <= N <= 2^23-2:
N <= 2^23/90*X < N+1

for N = 2^23-1:
N <= 2^23/90*X <= N+1

According to above relation an encoded value N corresponds to a range of absolute latitudes X in degrees

degreesOfLongitude.description:
Longitude in degrees
(coded value)
Relation between coded Degrees of longitude N and range of absolute longitudes X (-180° <= X < +180°) it encodes is the following:

N <= 2^24/360*X < N+1

N is coded in 2's complement binary on 24 bits.

According to above relation an encoded value N corresponds to a range of absolute longitudes X in degrees

deltaCqiAgingWinScellChEst.description: Aging window length used when estimating delta-CQI for Secondary Cell (SCell) channel quality in carrier aggregation, controlling how quickly old CQI samples are discarded.

deltaCqiTargetScellChEst.description: Target delta-CQI offset applied when estimating SCell channel quality, used to bias the link-adaptation algorithm's CQI-based estimate for the secondary carrier.

deltaLbCioMargin.description: This parameter defines the minimum signal difference between the target and the source cell required for triggering an intra-frequency CIO adjustment due to load unbalance.
deltaLbCioMargin.fullName: Minimum margin for load balancing CIO adjustment

deltaPreMsg3.description:
Used for the calculation of P0_NOMINAL_PUSCH(j=2) for PUSCH (re)transmission corresponding to the random access response grant.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.

deltaTfEnabled.description: Enabling/disabling of the transport format dependent offset on a per UE basis. If this parameter is "true", PUSCH power calculation in UE uplink power control equation (P1) takes the Transport Block size in account during the power calculation.
deltaTfEnabled.fullName: Enabled TB size impact to UE PUSCH power calculation

deprioType.description:
deprioType indicates whether the current frequency or RAT is to be de-prioritised.
Deprioritise current frequency/RAT during RRC Connection rejection procedure, UE would select other frequency layer/RAT instead of repeating connection requests to current frequency/RAT.

directionOfAltitude.description: Represents height above resp. depth below WGS84 ellipsoid surface

dl256QamDeactChQualThr.description: MCS threshold for deactivating 256QAM for the UE. Value refers to legacy MCSs so it needs to be converted eNB internally.
dl256QamDeactChQualThr.fullName: MCS threshold for deactivating 256QAM for the UE

dl256QamReactChQualThr.description: MCS threshold for reactivating 256QAM for the UE. Value refers to legacy MCSs.
dl256QamReactChQualThr.fullName: MCS threshold for reactivating 256QAM for the UE

dlAdaptPfLoadThresh.description: Downlink cell-load threshold (percentage) at which the adaptive Proportional-Fair scheduler switches its behavior/parameters.

dlCaCqiWindow.description: This parameter determines the minimum time a UE must meet the CQI threshold defined by dlCaMinPcellCqi Addition CRL20777 or dlCaMinPcellCqiQci1 on PCell End CRL20777 before it can be considered a candidate for adding an Scell.

dlCaMinPcellCqi.description:
This parameter determines the minimum Pcell CQI for a UE with no established QCI1 bearer to be considered a candidate for adding an SCell.
If parameter is set to 0, a UE with no established QCI1 bearer can be considered a candidate for adding an Scell without checking its PCell CQI.

dlCaMinPcellCqiQci1.description:
This parameter determines the minimum PCell CQI for a UE with an established QCI1 bearer to be considered a candidate for adding an SCell.
If parameter is set to 0, a UE with an established QCI1 bearer can be considered a candidate for adding an SCell without checking its PCell CQI.
If parameter is set to 15, a UE with an established QCI1 bearer is blocked from being considered a candidate for adding an SCell.
dlCaMinPcellCqiQci1.fullName: SCell add DL CQI threshold for QCI1

dlCellPwrRed.description:
Sets the power reduction from the antenna maximum TX power.

Cell locking is not required if dlCellPwrRed  is changed by 0.2 dB or less. If the feature ‘Automatic Locking (LTE830)’ is activated, eNB will not perform cell locking in this case. 
The user can define a lower cell output power with the cell power reduction parameter. Reduction is deducted from the antenna maximum TX power.
Note: This parameter used for NB-IoT standalone cell.
Hint for TDD cell:
If dlCellPwrRed is modified by 0.2 dB or less, more often than 32 times within 3 hours, a valueTag overflow occurs. As consequence the changed System Information (SIB2 ff.) might sporadically not be read by UEs which come back to the cell and have stored valid system information from 3h validity rule viewpoint.

dlInterferenceEnable.description: The parameter dlInterferenceEnable is used for enabling and disabling interference generation in downlink.

dlInterferenceLevel.description: The dlInterferenceLevel parameter defines percentage of physical resource blocks (PRB) that are used for downlink data and interference transmission.
dlInterferenceLevel.fullName: Interference level for generated downlink interference

dlInterferenceModulation.description: The dlInterferenceModulation parameter defines modulation scheme to be used for generated downlink interference. That is, for a non-existing UE the downlink interference is transmitted.

dlMaxBoostBytes.description: This parameter defines the amount of downlink data to be sent (for a bearer which is being TCP boosted in the downlink) after which downlink TCP boosting for the bearer is stopped.

dlMinBoostBytes.description: This parameter defines the minimum amount of downlink data which must be sent (after downlink TCP traffic has been detected on a certain bearer) in order to start downlink TCP boosting for the bearer.

dlOlqcEnable.description: O&M switch for enabling / disabling downlink Outer loop Link Quality Control which is acting based on the 1st transmission HARQ result, that is, 1st transmission BLER.

dlPathlossChg.description: This is a trigger condition for power headroom submission due to pathloss change; named ULATB_DLPL_CHANGE in RRM SFS.

dlPcfichBoost.description: Transmission power of the Physical Control Format Indicator Channel is boosted by set value

dlPhichBoost.description:
Transmission power of the Physical Hybrid ARQ Indicator Channel is boosted by set value.

Hint for downlink-only cell operating in an unlicensed band as defined in parameter actUnlicensedAcc it is recommended to set this parameter to ‘0 dB’.

dlPwBackoffApp.description: This parameter value determines to which PRBs with modulation (QPSK and QAM) that back-off is applied. If dynamic DL power back-off is applied in case of paired UEs in MU-MIMO scenarios it shall be applied for the paired UEs disregard to the used modulation. Same principle is uses for the single UE multi layers case with different modulation schemes for the two layers.

dlPwBackoffThreshold.description: If sum of all PRBs per TTI with EVM limited higher order modulation schemes is above this defined threshold parameter (calculated in % of the DL system bandwidth), then a dynamic power back-off shall be applied . A PRB is considered as a PRB with EMV limited higher order modulation scheme as soon as one layer for multi-layer cases or as soon as one UE for MU-MIMO cases is using an EVM limited higher order modulation scheme.
dlPwBackoffThreshold.fullName: Threshold for applying DL power backoff

dlScellConfigLevel.description: Configuration aggressiveness level controlling how readily downlink Secondary Cells (SCells) are configured for UEs under carrier aggregation.

dlSrbCqiOffset.description:
Provides the CQI link adaptation offset applied to downlink transmissions containing SRB1 messages. 

The more negative the value, the more conservative the MCS and PDCCH aggregation level will be for the downlink SRB1 message transmissions

dlTargetBler.description: Defines target Block Error Ratio (BLER) for downlink Link Adaptation in percents. Used with downlink Outer loop Link Quality Control (OLQC) functionality.

dlamcCqiDef.description: Defines the default Channel Quality Indicator (CQI) value for downlink Link Adaptation use. Default CQI is used when there is no valid CQI available, that is, a CQI report is not received or it is too old.

dlamcEnable.description: O&M switch for enabling / disabling downlink Adaptive Modulation and Coding.

dlsDciCch.description:
Parameter to configure whether common channel signalling (SI, paging RACH ) use DCI format 1A or 1C on PDCCH.

If the value of the parameter is set to 'DCI format 1C' distributed VRBs are used for SI, paging and RACH.

If the value of the parameter is set to 'DCI format 1A' localized (not distributed) VRBs are used for SI, paging and RACH.
dlsDciCch.fullName: DCI format for common channel transmission

dlsOldtcTarget.description:
Target value for Outer Loop Delay Target Control.
This parameter defines a probability of packets exceeding a set delay target.

dlsPdschNbrCongDetAct.description:
This parameter activates PDSCH congestion control for NBR traffic.

It is highly recommended to configure the value to 'true' if 'Nominal bitrate for non-GBR bearers' is activated, i.e. if actNbrForNonGbrBearers is set to 'true'.
dlsPdschNbrCongDetAct.fullName: PDSCH congestion control for NBR traffic

dlsPfAlphaHigh.description: Alpha coefficient used by the downlink Proportional-Fair scheduler at high cell-load conditions, controlling the trade-off between fairness among UEs and maximizing cell throughput.

dlsPfAlphaLow.description: Alpha coefficient used by the downlink Proportional-Fair scheduler at low cell-load conditions, controlling the trade-off between fairness among UEs and maximizing cell throughput.

dlsPfAlphaMid.description: Alpha coefficient used by the downlink Proportional-Fair scheduler at mid cell-load conditions, controlling the trade-off between fairness among UEs and maximizing cell throughput.

dlsUsePartPrb.description:
Determines whether PRBs partly allocated for transmission of Primary (PSS) and Secondary synchronization Signals (SSS) and Physical Broadcasting Channel (BPCH) should be used in dynamic scheduling.

It is recommended to stay with the default value 'PRBs with PSS or SSS and PBCH used' if dlChBw is set to  '3 MHz'.

Value "not used" mean that partial PRBs are not used.
exampleValues: PRBs with PSS or SSS and PBCH used
knownValues: PRBs with PSS or SSS used
PRBs with PSS or SSS and PBCH used
dlsUsePartPrb.officialDefault: PRBs with PSS or SSS and PBCH used (2)
dlsUsePartPrb.officialRange:
0: not used 
1: PRBs with PSS or SSS used 
2: PRBs with PSS or SSS and PBCH used
dlsUsePartPrb.resolvedDefault: PRBs with PSS or SSS and PBCH used

drxInactivityT.description:
Configures the Inactivity Timer for DRX.
The Inactivity Timer determines the number of consecutive PDCCH-subframes for which the UE monitors the PDCCH after decoding an UL or DL resource assignment on PDCCH for an initial data transmission.

drxLongCycle.description:
Configures the long DRX cycle. It is recommended to use carefully the 40 ms value, as so far tested UEs are not able to do ReportCGI measurement with this cycle size. 
The long DRX cycle determines the periodic repetition of the DRX On Duration.

drxOnDuratT.description:
Configures the On Duration Timer for DRX.
The On Duration determines the number of consecutive PDCCH-subframes at the beginning of a DRX cycle during which the UE monitors the PDCCH.

drxProfileIndex.description:
DRX profile index.
Uniquely identifies a DRX profile.

drxProfilePriority.description:
DRX profile priority.

Applied to identify the DRX profile to be used if a UE has multiple bearers established.
Note: Modification of DRX profile priority is not recommended; preparation for future use.

drxRetransT.description:
Configures the Retransmission Timer for DRX.
The Retransmission Timer determines the maximum number of PDCCH-subframes a UE monitors the PDCCH as soon as a retransmission in DL is expected by the UE.

eIcicAbsAdaptationBeta.description:
This parameter is used in the ABS adaptation algorithm as a weighting factor to bias towards more or less ABS.
Though possible, it is not recommended to set this parameter to values higher than 2. The higher the value of this parameter, the more seldom the switch to a higher ABS pattern will occur.
The impact of this parameter on the ABS adaptation result is closely related to the number of established eICIC partnerships. Example: eIcicAbsAdaptationBeta = 1 and four established partnerships results to the same algorithm outcome as eIcicAbsAdaptationBeta = 2 and eight established partnerships.

eIcicAbsAdaptationThreshold0To1.description:
Threshold to switch from MP0 to MP1
A higher value of this parameter leads to fewer cases where the ABS pattern MP1 is switched on.
eIcicAbsAdaptationThreshold0To1.fullName: Threshold to switch from MP0 to MP1

eIcicAbsDeltaAdjustment.description:
This parameter defines a threshold used in the ABS adaptation algorithm for switching from higher to lower muting pattern ratios and vice versa. 
A higher value of parameter eIcicAbsDeltaAdjustment means that the MP will be switched at a later point.

eIcicAbsPatChangeDelayT.description: Schedulers in the macro cell apply the new ABS pattern after said timer has expired. This is valid only when new pattern has a smaller ABS ratio than the previous one.
eIcicAbsPatChangeDelayT.fullName: Delay timer for applying a new ABS pattern

eIcicCioAdaptAlgo.description: Defines whether the CIO adjustment for eICIC is statically configured or adapted to the current load conditions.

eIcicCreDelta.description:
This parameter is used in the scheduler for tagging UE’s location w.r.t cell’s range expansion (CRE) area based on the non-ABS related CQI value. The sum of this parameter and the non-ABS related CQI value determined by the DL link adaptation sets the CQI threshold for UEs tagged as 'CRE' to be re-tagged as 'non-CRE'. 
Said tagging is used in the prioritized scheduling of UEs during ABSs.
eIcicCreDelta.fullName: Threshold for re-tagging UEs from CRE to non-CRE

eIcicMaxCre.description:
This parameter determines the maximum allowed CIO adjustment, i.e., the maximum cell range expansion for the eICIC partner cells, equal for all eICIC partners. Once this value is reached, only reducing the CIO adjustment is allowed.

For applyFecicFunctionality = 'false', the maximum allowed value is 6dB. For applyFecicFunctionality = 'true', a value larger than 8 dB is recommended in order to exploit the FeICIC capabilities of R11 UEs.

eIcicMaxMutePattern.description:
Highest allowed muting pattern
For dynamic ABS adaptation this parameter defines the maximum pattern the algorithm can go to. 
When LTE907 TTI bundling is enabled in the macro cell together with LTE1113 it is recommended not to exceed value 'mp4'.
eIcicMaxMutePattern.officialRange:
1: mp1 
2: mp2 
3: mp3 
4: mp4 
5: mp5 
6: mp6

eIcicMaxNumPartners.description: Maximum number of allowed eICIC partnerships, i.e. number of entries in the list for eICIC partnerships
eIcicMaxNumPartners.fullName: Maximum number of allowed eICIC partnerships

eIcicMp0DelayT.description:
Transition to MP0 is monitored by this timer. On its expiry ABS is switched off.
5 s provides time to process 50 UEs, 10 s provides time to process 100 UEs, etc.

eIcicPartnerCacAbsTarget.description: Defines operator’s preference on eICIC partner target ABS load during eICIC operation.
eIcicPartnerCacAbsTarget.fullName: Preference on eICIC partner target ABS load

eIcicPartnerCacTarget.description: Defines operator’s preference on eICIC partner target load during eICIC operation.
eIcicPartnerCacTarget.fullName: Preference on eICIC partner target load

eTputFilterConfig.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "e Tput Filter Config" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

eTputInitMcs.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "e Tput Init Modulation and Coding Scheme" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

eUlLaAtbPeriod.description: When not externally triggered by Outer Loop Link Adaptation (OLLA), the Adaptive Transmission Bandwidth (ATB) algorithm will be activated  when the amount of  TTI events here defined has been reached.
eUlLaAtbPeriod.fullName: Extended uplink link adaptation ATB periodicity

eUlLaBlerAveWin.description:
Averaging window for BLER in E-ULA.
It is expressed in number of TTI when UE has been actively scheduled
eUlLaBlerAveWin.fullName: Extended uplink link adaptation BLER averaging window

eUlLaDeltaMcs.description: Defines how many MCS indexes above the minimal MCS index are required before ATB may increase the amount of allocable PRBs
eUlLaDeltaMcs.fullName: Extended uplink link adaptation delta MCS

eUlLaLowMcsThr.description: Defines the lowest possible MCS index before Adaptive Transmission Bandwith (ATB) algorithm may act and decrease the amount of allocable PRBs.
eUlLaLowMcsThr.fullName: Extended uplink link adaptation low MCS threshold

eUlLaLowPrbThr.description:
Defines the lowest possible amount of allocable PRBs
This shall be always bigger than or equal to redBwMinRbUl
eUlLaLowPrbThr.fullName: Extended uplink link adaptation low PRB threshold

eUlLaPrbIncDecFactor.description:
Incremental and decremental factor for the Adaptive Transmission Bandwidth's calculation of allocable PRBs
Multiplying the amount of PRBs by this factor the total amount of allocable PRBs is decreasing. 
Dividing the amount of PRBs by this factor, then the number of allocable PRB is increasing
eUlLaPrbIncDecFactor.fullName: Extended uplink link adaptation PRB factor

ecidMeasSupervisionTimer.description:
Timer to guard against gathering of all measurements requested by eSMLC for Location Services.

Supported measurements are
- Angle of Arrival (AoA)
- Timing Advance Type 2
- Timing Advance Type 1
- RSRP measurement (periodic/reportStrongestCells)
- RSRQ measurement (periodic/reportStrongestCells)

The timer is stopped when all collected measurements are ready to be sent to the eSMLC.
ecidMeasSupervisionTimer.fullName: Overall supervision timer for ECID measurements

eirpReduction.description: Amount by which the cell's Effective Isotropic Radiated Power is reduced from its maximum, e.g. for regulatory compliance or coordinated power control between sectors.

emAreaIdList.description:
An element of the emAreaIdList identifies an Emergency Area ID (emAreaId) of the eNB cell.
Multiple emAreaId's may be configured for the eNB cell.

An 'emAreaId' ID may be used in signalling messages received via S1-i/f to indicate the set of cells with emergency impact (e.g. which have to broadcast the warning message). 
If e.g. a WRITE-REPLACE WARNING REQUEST message with 'emAreaId' is received, the warning message shall be broadcasted by an eNB cell if 'pwsWithEmAreaId' is true and the 'emAreaId' received in the request message matches with the 'emAreaId' assigned to the eNB cell.

enableAmcPdcch.description: The parameter defines the switch for enable/disable Channel Quality Indicator (CQI) based Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC) for PDCCH link adaptation. If the parameter is disabled, default aggregation is used implicitly.
enableAmcPdcch.fullName: Enable AMC for PDCCH link adaptation

enableBetterCellHo.description: Flag if better cell HO is enabled.

enableCovHo.description: Flag if coverage HO is enabled.

enableLowAgg.description:
The parameter determines the enabling/disabling switch for automatic selection of lower aggregation during PDCCH scheduling. This means that a required aggregation level which is defined from UE's Channel Quality Indicator (CQI) reports may be downgraded by one step without any other particular reason (e.g. blocking due to UE hash function or overall space). Assigning of lower aggregation decreases number of blocked UEs in case of PDCCH resource deficiency, and gives possibility for greater number of PDCCH messages per TTI. A corresponding increase in PDCCH power compensates caused degradation in PDCCH code robustness.
 
There are some restrictions for utilitizing the automatic lower aggregation for an UE:  
- the required aggregation shall be at least 4,
- enableAmcPdcch and enablePcPdcch shall be enabled, and
- used PDCCH capacity for all uplink and downlink allocations shall exceed a limit defined by the threshold pdcchLowAggTh of total PDCCH capacity for allocated number of PDCCH symbols in TTI

The parameter will be ignored in FDD cells if dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz'.
enableLowAgg.fullName: Enable lower aggregation selection for PDCCH LA

enablePcPdcch.description: The parameter defines the switch for enabling / disabling power control on PDCCH. If the parameter is disabled, a flat downlink Power Spectral Density (PSD) is used.

enableVoLteUePcellSwap.description: Defines whether or not UEs with ongoing VoLTE calls can be considered as candidates by the PCell swap selection algorithm.
enableVoLteUePcellSwap.fullName: Enable carr. aggr. UEs with VoLTE calls for PCell swap

enbId.description: Identity of the eNB in the ECGI of the eICIC macro partner
enbId.fullName: ID of the eNB in the ECGI of the eICIC macro partner

energySavingState.description:
Energy Saving state of the cell.
The Energy Saving state value is set by the eNB.
energySavingState.officialRange:
0: notEnergySaving 
1: energySaving 
2: reducedEnergySaving 
4: switchingOffRTX 
3: switchingOff 
5: switchingOnTX

eutraCelId.description:
The  E-UTRAN cell identifier is unique within one PLMN and has a length of 28 bits. The leftmost 20 bits of the value correspond to the value of the eNB ID (parameter lnBtsId) and the 8 rightmost bits correspond to the value of the local cell resource ID (lcrId). This parameter cannot be set by operator, it is calculated system internally and is only readable.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.

expectedCellSize.description: This parameter determines the appropriate counter histogram range (set), which should be aligned with the expected size of the cell from preceeding network planning.

fUlLAAtbTrigThr.description:
The parameter defines  the threshold under which the OLLA DCM triggers an earlier ATB calculation.
It has always values <=0.
fUlLAAtbTrigThr.fullName: Fast uplink link ATB trigger threshold

fastPdcchAdaptBlockedUeThreshold.description: Number of PDCCH-blocked UEs that must be observed before the fast PDCCH-capacity adaptation mechanism reacts to relieve congestion.

fastPdcchAdaptStepDownSize.description: Step size by which PDCCH capacity/aggregation is reduced during a 'fast adaptation' down-step when control-channel congestion eases.

fastPdcchAdaptStepUpSize.description: Step size by which PDCCH capacity/aggregation is increased during a 'fast adaptation' up-step when control-channel congestion is detected.

filterCenterTx.description:
This parameter defines absolute TX frequency in kHz for overriding normal filter center frequency tuning.

This parameter can be used to override normal filter tuning to minimize noise to neighboring frequency band. If the parameter value is not defined, TX filter frequency is evaluated as an average of the configured center frequencies.

eNB restart will be only performed if the optional parameter is configured in case of cell creation or is modified for an existing cell.

filterCoeff.description: Filter coefficient for RSRP measurements used to calculate path loss as specified in [3GPP-36.213. 5.1.1.1].  Value fc0 corresponds to k = 0, fc1 corresponds to k = 1, and so on.

filterCoefficientCSFBCpichEcn0.description:
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for UTRA-WCDMA CSFB Cpich-Ecn0
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for Cpich-Ecn0 within the measurement quantity configuration of UTRA-WCDMA
filterCoefficientCSFBCpichEcn0.fullName: Filtering coefficient used for CSFB Cpich-Ecn0

filterCoefficientCSFBCpichRscp.description:
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for UTRA-WCDMA CSFB Cpich-RSCP
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for Cpich-RSCP within the measurement quantity configuration of UTRA-WCDMA
filterCoefficientCSFBCpichRscp.fullName: Filtering coefficient used for CSFB Cpich-RSCP

filterCoefficientCpichEcn0.description:
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for UTRA Cpich-EcNo
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for Cpich-EcNo within the measurement quantity configuration of UTRA.

filterCoefficientCpichEcNo within quantity configuration of UTRA is an optional IE
filterCoefficientCpichEcn0.fullName: Filtering coefficient used for cpich ecN0

filterCoefficientCpichRscp.description:
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for UTRA Cpich-RSCP
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for Cpich-RSCP within the measurement quantity configuration of UTRA

filterCoefficientCpichRscp within quantity configuration of UTRA is an optional IE
filterCoefficientCpichRscp.fullName: Filtering coefficient used for cpich RSCP

filterCoefficientRSRP.description: Specifies the filtering coefficient used for RSRP (to be set in  QuantityConfigEUTRA)

filterCoefficientRSRQ.description: Specifies the filtering coefficient used for RSRQ (to be set in  QuantityConfigEUTRA)

filterCoefficientRSSI.description:
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for RSSI
Specifies the filtering coefficient used for RSSI within the measurement quantity configuration of GERAN

freqEutra.description:
It is used to specify the eUTRA Frequency (max value refer to 36.331)
This parameter must be configured for a inter frequency cell. It will be taken as a intra frequency cell if this parameter is set to ownCarrierFreq.

gbrCongHandling.description:
Determines if and on which layer congestion handling is applied if congestion is detected by layer 2.
It is highly recommended to configure the value '"l2andl3" if 'Enhanced AC and GBR services' are activated, that is if "actEnhAcandGbrServices" equals True.

grpAssigPUSCH.description:
The parameter defines the assigned PUSCH or NPUSCH group.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
grpAssigPUSCH.fullName: Group assignment for PUSCH or NPUSCH

harqMaxMsg3.description:
Indicates the maximum number of HARQ transmissions used for message 3 of the contention-based random access procedure.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
harqMaxMsg3.fullName: Maximum number of message 3 HARQ transmissions

harqMaxTrDl.description:
Indicates the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in DL that is configured for each UE at initial access to a specific cell.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
harqMaxTrDl.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in DL

harqMaxTrSignalingDl.description: Indicates the maximum number of HARQ transmissions for DL transmissions containing Signaling traffic. Signaling traffic is defined as belonging to an SRB, a signaling bearer or  containing a TAC MAC control element.
harqMaxTrSignalingDl.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in DL for Signaling

harqMaxTrUlTtiBundling.description: Indicates the maximum number of transmissions that is configured for a UE in TTI bundling operation.
harqMaxTrUlTtiBundling.fullName: Max number of UL HARQ transmissions during TTI bundling

harqMaxTrVoLteDl.description: Indicates the maximum number of HARQ transmissions for DL transmissions containing VoLTE traffic.
harqMaxTrVoLteDl.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in DL for VoLTE

harqMaxTxUl.description:
Indicates the maximum number of HARQ transmissions in UL that is configured for each UE at initial access to a specific cell.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
harqMaxTxUl.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in UL

highLoadGbrDl.description:
This parameter defines the high load for the DL GBR resources. The value represents a percentage of PRBs available to GBR in the cell. 

A cell is considered 'non-balanced' if any load component has reached its highLoad threshold.

highLoadNonGbrDl.description:
This parameter defines the high load for the DL non-GBR resources. The value represents a percentage of the non-GBR load scale 0 and 100. 

A cell is considered 'non-balanced' if any load component has reached its highLoad threshold.

highLoadPdcch.description:
This parameter defines the high load for the PDCCH. The value represents a percentage of the available PDCCH resources in the cell.

A cell is considered 'non-balanced' if any load component has reached its highLoad threshold.

hopModePusch.description: This parameter defines if hopping is only inter-subframe or both inter- and intra-subframe.

hsScenario.description:
Defines highspeed train scenario for a cell. 
Scenario 1 (open space scenario) and scenario 3 (tunnel scenario). 

Scenarios are described in 36.104 Annex B.3 and 36.141 Annex B.3:
Scenario 1: Open space
Scenario 3: Tunnel for multi-antennas

hysA3Offset.description: Related hysteresis of Margin for the Event A3 SCell discovery measurement - a neighbor becomes offset better than the PCell.
hysA3Offset.fullName: Related hysteresis of offset a3Offset for RSRP intra F

hysThreshold2C2k.description:
Related hysteresis of threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of CDMA2000-eHRPD or CDMA2000-1XRTT measurements

Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A2 triggered reporting condition.
hysThreshold2C2k.fullName: Related hysteresis of RSRP threshold 2 for CDMA2000

hysThreshold2GERAN.description:
Related Hysteresis of Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of GERAN measurements
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A2 triggered reporting condition. The IE value is multiplied by 2.
hysThreshold2GERAN.fullName: Related hysteresis of threshold th2 GERAN for RSRP

hysThreshold2InterFreq.description:
Related Hysteresis of Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of inter frequency measurements
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A2 triggered reporting condition. The IE value is multiplied by 2.
hysThreshold2InterFreq.fullName: Related hysteresis of threshold th2 interFreq for RSRP

hysThreshold2MobRsrq.description:
Related Hysteresis of Threshold for RSRQ of serving cell for mobility measurements activation.
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A2-RSRQ triggered reporting condition. 
The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.331:  IE value = value [dB]  * 2
hysThreshold2MobRsrq.fullName: Related hysteresis of threshold Th2 for RSRQ mobility

hysThreshold2Wcdma.description:
Related Hysteresis of Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of WCDMA measurements
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A2 triggered reporting condition. The IE value is multiplied by 2.
hysThreshold2Wcdma.fullName: Related hysteresis of threshold th2 WCDMA for RSRP

hysThreshold2a.description:
Related Hysteresis of Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for stopping of Inter-RAT (InterFreq)  Measurements
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A1 triggered reporting condition. The IE value is multiplied by 2.
hysThreshold2a.fullName: Related hysteresis of threshold th2a for RSRP

hysThreshold3.description:
Related Hysteresis of Handover Margin for Coverage Handover of Intra-Frequency
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A5 triggered reporting condition. The IE value is multiplied by 2.
This parameter applies to both RSRP based and RSRQ based A5 Intra frequency measurement.
hysThreshold3.fullName: Related hysteresis of thresholds th3 and th3a

hysThreshold4.description:
Related Hysteresis of Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for redirection trigger
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A2 triggered reporting condition. The IE value is multiplied by 2.
hysThreshold4.fullName: Related hysteresis of threshold th4 for RSRP

hysThreshold4Rsrq.description:
Related Hysteresis of Threshold for RSRQ of serving cell for redirection trigger.
Parameter is used within the entry and leave condition of the A2-RSRQ triggered reporting condition.
The IE value is multiplied by 2.
hysThreshold4Rsrq.fullName: Related hysteresis of threshold Th4 for RSRQ

hysteresisLoadDlGbr.description: This parameter defines the hysteresis when determining whether DL GBR resource load is balanced or unbalanced. The value represents a percentage of the available DL PRBs in the cell.
hysteresisLoadDlGbr.fullName: Hysteresis for DL GBR resource load measurement

hysteresisLoadDlNonGbr.description: This parameter defines the hysteresis when determining whether DL Non-GBR resource load is balanced or unbalanced. The value represents a percentage of the available DL PRBs in the cell.
hysteresisLoadDlNonGbr.fullName: Hysteresis for DL Non-GBR resource load measurement

hysteresisLoadPdcch.description: This parameter defines the hysteresis when determining whether PDCCH load is balanced or unbalanced. The value represents a percentage of the available PDCCH resources in the cell.

iFLBA4ActLim.description: The signal-quality limit (RSRP/RSRQ) used to trigger the 3GPP Event A4 measurement report specifically for the Inter-Frequency Load Balancing (IFLB) function.

iFLBBearCheckTimer.description:
Timer is started when S1AP sends back Initial Context Setup Response. After Timer expiration it is checked whether or not the UE has a QCI1 bearer.

The value 31 indicates that QCI1 (VOIP) bearer are not excluded from the Inter Frequency Load Balancing. Note that when QCI1 check is not performed, there is 1s wait timer before start Load Balancing.
In LTE1387 UEs with QCI1 (VOIP) bearer are excluded from the Inter Frequency Load Balancing. As the bearer establishment takes some time, SW has to wait before making a check.
iFLBBearCheckTimer.fullName: Inter-frequency load balancing QCI1 Bearer check timer

iFLBCandSelUpdateTimer.description: This cell level timer  is started when the already existing trigger for the Connected Mode Load Balancing offload is reached. The evaluation of SPID groups priority is done at the expiry of the iFLBCandSelUpdateTimer.
iFLBCandSelUpdateTimer.fullName: SPID based offload UE candidate selection update timer

iFLBHighLoadGBRDL.description:
High Load for usage of GBR Uu I/F resources in DL direction.
High Load is the treshold that controls the Inter Frequency Load Balancing.

If iFLBHighLoadGBRDL and iFLBHighLoadNonGBRDL and iFLBHighLoadPdcch are set to 100%, the cell will never enter active Inter Frequency Load Balancing state.
iFLBHighLoadGBRDL.fullName: Inter-frequency load balancing GBR high load DL

iFLBHighLoadNonGBRDL.description:
High Load for usage of nonGBR Uu I/F resources in DL direction.
High Load is the treshold that controls the Inter Frequency Load Balancing.

If iFLBHighLoadGBRDL and iFLBHighLoadNonGBRDL and iFLBHighLoadPdcch are set to 100%, the cell will never enter active Inter Frequency Load Balancing state.
iFLBHighLoadNonGBRDL.fullName: Inter-frequency load balancing non-GBR high load DL

iFLBHighLoadPdcch.description:
High Load for usage of PDCCH Uu I/F resources
High Load is the treshold that controls the Inter Frequency Load Balancing.

If iFLBHighLoadGBRDL and iFLBHighLoadNonGBRDL and iFLBHighLoadPdcch are set to 100%, the cell will never enter active Inter Frequency Load Balancing state.
iFLBHighLoadPdcch.fullName: Inter-frequency load balancing PDCCH high load

iFLBLoadStepGBRDL.description:
Represents the additional load amount above iFLBHighLoadGBRDL. With the SPID based offload UE candidate selection feature UE selection for offload is prioritized according to operator defined SPID groups. If the Load for usage of GBR Uu I/F resources in DL direction exceeds iFLBHighLoadGBRDL plus iFLBLoadStepGBRDL then next SPID Groups are added for offload (gradually according to SPID Group priority for offload).
High Load is the treshold that controls the Inter Frequency Load Balancing.
iFLBLoadStepGBRDL.fullName: Inter-frequency load balancing GBR high load DL threshold step

iFLBLoadStepNonGBRDL.description:
Represents the additional load amount above iFLBHighLoadNonGBRDL. With the SPID based offload UE candidate selection feature UE selection for offload is prioritized according to operator defined SPID groups. If the Load for usage of nonGBR Uu I/F resources in DL direction exceeds iFLBHighLoadNonGBRDL plus iFLBLoadStepNonGBRDL then next SPID Groups are added for offload (gradually according to SPID Group priority for offload).
High Load is the treshold that controls the Inter Frequency Load Balancing.
iFLBLoadStepNonGBRDL.fullName: Inter-frequency load balancing non - GBR high load DL threshold step

iFLBLoadStepPdcch.description:
Represents the additional load amount above iFLBHighLoadPdcch. With the SPID based offload UE candidate selection feature UE selection for offload is prioritized according to operator defined SPID groups. If the Load for usage of PDCCH Uu I/F resources in DL direction exceeds iFLBHighLoadPdcch plus iFLBLoadStepPdcch then next SPID Groups are added for offload (gradually according to SPID Group priority for offload).
High Load is the treshold that controls the Inter Frequency Load Balancing.
iFLBLoadStepPdcch.fullName: Inter-frequency load balancing Pdcch high load threshold step

iFLBRetryTimer.description:
This timer is assigned to all active UEs to trigger a cyclical re-check if they can be inter-frequency or UTRAN load balancing candidates.
The basic value given by the operator is dynamically adapted depending on number of active UEs in the cell to restrict the timer expiry rate
iFLBRetryTimer.fullName: Inter Freq Load Bal Retry Timer

iFServiceBasedHoRetryTimer.description:
The parameter defines the inter-frequency service based handover retry timer. The value is assigned to all active UEs to trigger a cyclical re-check if they can be inter-frequency service based HO candidates. The timer is only applicable when Service Based HO feature is switched on and QCI1 bearer is established for UE. 
The basic value given by the operator is used directly as timer expiry rate.
iFServiceBasedHoRetryTimer.fullName: Inter-freq. service based HO retry timer

idleLBCapThresh.description: Only if the Composite Available Capacity (CAC) is below or equal to this threshold, idle mode load balancing actions shall be triggered.
idleLBCapThresh.fullName: Idle mode load balancing capacity threshold

idleLBCapThreshCaUe.description: Only if the Composite Available Capacity (CAC) is below or equal to this threshold, idle mode load balancing for CA capable UEs actions shall be triggered.
idleLBCapThreshCaUe.fullName: Idle mode load balancing capacity threshold for CA capable UEs

idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv.description:
Composite Available Capacity (CAC) threshold used to start/stop advanced CA-aware idle mode load balancing actions.

Only if the CAC value is greater than this threshold (but still smaller than or equal to idleLBCapThreshCAUe), advanced idle mode load balancing for CA capable UEs actions shall be triggered. If the CAC value is smaller than or equal to this threshold, non-CA-aware idle mode load balancing shall be used.

Note: For idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv equal to ‘0’ or '100', CAC value calculation is not triggered if not otherwise requested. For idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv equal to ‘0’, LTE4154 is then active under all load conditions, while for idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv equal to ‘100’, LTE4154 is then not active under all load conditions.
idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv.fullName: Threshold for advanced Idle mode load balancing capacity for CA capable UEs

idleLBCapThreshUeTM9.description: Capacity threshold (percentage) used by idle-mode load-balancing logic specifically for UEs configured in Transmission Mode 9 (TM9, e.g. beamforming/dual-layer).

idleLBCelResWeight.description:
Weight factor of the serving cell frequency layer used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing.
When the parameter is not defined, the corresponding carrier is not used in selecting main target for IdleModeMobilityControlInfo for load balancing. Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.  All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured in LNCEL, IRFIM, UFFIM, CDFIM and GNFL will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities.  The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
idleLBCelResWeight.fullName: Cell reselection weight factor idle mode load balancing

idleLBCelResWeight2CC.description:
Weight factor of the serving cell frequency layer used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing for 2CC CA UEs.
When the parameter is not defined, the corresponding carrier is not used in selecting main target for IdleModeMobilityControlInfo for load balancing. 
Decision which CC type used in IE sent to UE depends on UE Capabilities and other CC type configuration parameters.

Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.  All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured in LNCEL, IRFIM, UFFIM, CDFIM and GNFL will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities or with dedicated priority value configured by operator.

The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
idleLBCelResWeight2CC.fullName: Cell reselection weight factor for idle mode load balancing for 2CC CA UEs

idleLBCelResWeight3CC.description:

When the parameter is not defined, the corresponding carrier is not used in selecting main target for IdleModeMobilityControlInfo for load balancing. 
Decision which CC type used in IE sent to UE depends on UE Capabilities and other CC type configuration parameters.

Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.  All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured in LNCEL, IRFIM, UFFIM, CDFIM and GNFL will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities or with dedicated priority value configured by operator.

The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
idleLBCelResWeight3CC.fullName: Cell reselection weight factor for idle mode load balancing for 3CC CA UEs

idleLBCellReSelPrio.description:
Absolute priority of the serving cell frequency layer used for idle mode load balancing.
For this parameter, 6.8 is the highest priority and 0 the lowest.

Note:
According to 3GPP 36.304, carriers in different RATs must have different Cell Reselection Priorities.
idleLBCellReSelPrio.fullName: Serv cell carr freq prio for idle mode load balancing

idleLBCellReSelPrio2CC.description:
Absolute priority of the serving cell frequency layer used for idle mode load balancing for 2CC CA UEs.
For this parameter, 6.8 is the highest priority and 0 the lowest.
When the parameter is not defined, the corresponding carrier is not used in algorithm for Secondary target selection for IdleModeMobilityControlInfo IE. Decision which CC type used in IE sent to UE depends on UE Capabilities and other CC type configuration parameters.

idleLBPercCaUe.description: Percentage of UE to be selected for Idle Mode Load Balancing for CA capable UEs.
idleLBPercCaUe.fullName: Percentage of UE for idle mode load balancing for CA capable UEs

idleLBPercUeTM9.description: The percentage of idle-mode UEs that support Transmission Mode 9 (TM9, used for advanced MIMO/CA) that are targeted for idle-mode load balancing redirection.

idleLBPercentageOfUes.description: Percentage of UE to be selected for Idle Mode Load Balancing.
idleLBPercentageOfUes.fullName: Percentage of UE for idle mode load balancing

ilReacTimerUl.description: Improved latency reaction timer in uplink defines the time in which the UE has to send useful data after either the initial dummy grant or a previous reception of useful data. If the timer expires the, UE will not get dummy grant anymore.

inactivityTimer.description: Defines the time period for the indication of the UE inactivity in both DL and UL directions.

inactivityTimerMult.description:
Used for internal calculation of a new UE inactivity timer. 
With LTE1819, the eNB decides on the value of the RRC inactivity timer based on recent UE activity. Either the existing inactivityTimer value or the new internally calculated value inactivityTimerMult * inactivityTimer is applied. The new calculated value is greater than the inactivityTimer by definition.

inactivityTimerPubSafety.description:
Defines the time period for the indication of the UE inactivity in both DL and UL directions for UE with public safety bearer QCI65 or QCI66 or QCI69.
With LTE2611, for the UEs with QCI65 or QCI66 or QCI69 established, inactivityTimerPubSafety value is used instead of existing inactivityTimer value.
With LTE2612, for the UEs which has expressed interest in sidelink communication, inactivityTimerPubSafety value is used instead of existing inactivityTimer value.
inactivityTimerPubSafety.fullName: Inactivity timer for public safety bearer

inactivityTimerQci5Sign.description:
Inactivity timer for QCI5 data radio bearers carrying signalling traffic (as determined by scheduling type setting of the bearer).
This inactivity timer is triggered by any traffic being carried on QCI5 bearer in DL or UL (if scheduling type of qciTab5 is "signalling").
It allows, e.g., to prevent UE inactivity detection during the ringing phase of a voice call establishment.
inactivityTimerQci5Sign.fullName: Inactivity timer for QCI5 bearer with signalling traffic

incIRATHeadroom.description: Number of Measurement Ids and Report-Configuration Ids statically reserved for Inter-RAT measurements

iniDl256QamChQualEst.description: Intial decision period for channel quality estimation.
iniDl256QamChQualEst.fullName: Initial decision period for channel quality estimation

iniMcsDl.description:
Initial downlink modulation and coding scheme for NB-IoT UEs.

Note: 
The highest MCS used in downlink NPDSCH transmission of Rel-13 NB-IoT UE is 12.
The highest MCS used in downlink NPDSCH transmission of Rel-14 NB-IoT UE is 13.

iniMcsUl.description: Initial uplink modulation and coding scheme for NB-IoT UEs.

iniPrbsUl.description: Defines the initial amount of maximum PRBs in uplink.
iniPrbsUl.fullName: Initial amount of PRBs in uplink

ishPrId.description:
The instance ID of the DL interference shaping profile that shall be used for subscribers served by this LNCEL.

As a default, a profile with ishPrId = 0 will be used if not configured otherwise.

latitudeSign.description: Distinguishes between north and south latitude

lbLoadFilCoeff.description: This parameter defines the filter coefficient used for each of the load measurements (exponential filter).

lcrId.description: Identity of the cell in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner
lcrId.fullName: ID of the cell in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner

lnCelId.description:
Instance identifier of the object LNCEL. This parameter is used only for O&M purposes.

Important Note:
If the lnCelId shall be modified it is recommended to use BTSSM. The BTSSM will automatically perform a full commissioning instead of a delta commissioning. Otherwise 2 plan file operations are required because LNCEL as well as the related LCELL object must be deleted and recreated. Those two objects are strongly coupled and must be created and deleted in common.

loadBalancingProfile.description: This parameter selects the cell load balancing profile. From the profile parameters controlling the cell load condition will be derived.

longPeriodScellChEst.description:
Defines the long decision period for collecting the MCS samples from the SCell, before deciding about its channel quality. The long decision period applies after the first SCell good channel quality estimation. 

Within the specified decision period, one MCS sample is taken  every 25 ms.
longPeriodScellChEst.fullName: Long decision period for  channel quality est.

lowLatencyAddlUeThreshold.description: Additional-UE-count threshold used to decide when low-latency scheduling treatment can be extended to more UEs in the cell.

lowerMarginCio.description: This parameter defines the minimum value that a CIO can assume, when changed autonomously by the eNB during e.g. the intra-frequency load balancing function.
lowerMarginCio.fullName: Cell individual offset change lower margin

lteNrDssMode.description: Selects the Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS) role/mode of this cell when the same carrier spectrum is shared between LTE and NR (e.g. which RAT leads resource allocation on the shared carrier). "none" means DSS is not used on this cell.

lteNrDualConnectSupport.description:
This parameter defines the LTE-NR DC capability for UEs using this mobility profile.

The value 'all' shall be used if this mobility profile shall not differentiate between the UE capability with respect to LTE-NR DC, precondition LTE4088 is activated.
The value 'EN-DC_capable' will limit the use of this mobility profile to UEs which are EN-DC-capable.
The value 'EN-DC_not_capable' will limit the use of this mobility profile to UEs which are not EN-DC-capable.

lteUIFzmArea.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "lte UI Fzm Area" on the LNCEL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

maxBitrateDl.description:
Maximum Bit Rate that shall not be exceeded in DL (configured value is limitation on TTI base, i.e., a calculation on maximum bitrate per TTI is done).
This parameter is only effective if parameter mbrSelector of the same cell object is set to value 'OaM'.
This parameter has no effect for UEs having DL carrier aggregation activated. For CA UEs the limitations are taken from the 3GPP standard TS 36.306 considering the UE's category. Due to that the range of this parameter is not adapted to higher possible transmission rates defined in 3GPP Rel.10 and beyond.

maxBitrateUl.description:
Maximum bit rate that shall not be exceeded in UL (configured value is converted to and applied as a per TTI limit).
This parameter is only effective if parameter mbrSelector of the same cell object is set to value 'OaM'.
The parameter has no effect (over multiple carriers) for UEs having UL carrier aggregation activated.

maxCrPgDl.description:
The parameter defines the maximum code rate for paging. This maximum code rate is taken into account during PDSCH scheduling.

Note:
The amount of paging records being transmitted per paging occasion is limited such that the configured code rate is not exceeded; a single paging record is transmitted in any case.

maxCrRa4Dl.description:
The parameter defines the maximum code rate for random access procedure messages 4 (SRB0 message). This maximum code rate is taken into account during PDSCH scheduling.

Note:
For small bandwidth system a sufficient number of HARQ retransmission or according segmentation is applied in order to reach to the configured code rate.
maxCrRa4Dl.fullName: Maximum code rate for random access message 4

maxCrRaDl.description:
The parameter defines:
- the maximum code rate for contention based random access procedure messages 2 (RA response) for FDD.
- the maximum code rate for contention based and for contention free random access procedure messages 2 (RA response) for TDD.

This maximum code rate is taken into account during PDSCH scheduling.

Note:
For small bandwidth system the number of RAR records per RAR message is limited such that the configured code rate is not exceeded; a single RAR record is transmitted in any case.
maxCrRaDl.fullName: Maximum code rate for random access message 2

maxCrRaDlHo.description:
The parameter defines the maximum code rate for contention free random access procedure messages 2 (RA response). This maximum code rate is taken into account during PDSCH scheduling.

Note:
For small bandwidth system the number of RAR records per RAR message is limited such that the configured code rate is not exceeded; a single RAR record is transmitted in any case.
maxCrRaDlHo.fullName: Maximum code rate for contention free random access message 2

maxCrSibDl.description:
The parameter defines the maximum code rate for System Information Broadcast. This maximum coderate is taken into account during PDSCH scheduling.

Recommendation for FDD-cells:
For cells with a bandwidth of 1.4 MHz the code rate should be >= 0.12 as lower code rates may not be reached.

maxDlPwBackoffValue1.description: This parameter defines the maximum DL power back-off for 64QAM and/or 256 transmissions depending on configuration.

maxDlPwBackoffValue2.description: This parameter defines the maximum DL power back-off for QAM256 transmissions depending on configuration.

maxGbrTrafficLimit.description:
Maximum radio resource consumption (PRBs) for GBR traffic in UL and DL
The amount of radio resources (PRBs) is calculated in % of the available PRBs depending on the system.
1.4 MHz = 6 DL PRBS*,
3.0 MHz = 15 DL PRBS*,
For 5 MHz system 25 PRBs*
for 10 MHz system 50 PRBs*
for 15 MHz system 75 PRBs*
for 20 Mhz system 100 PRBs* are available
* reduced by common resources like PUCCH, RACCH, PDCCH, SIBs etc. which can consume some PRBs (e.g. 3 PRBs) in average.

The parameter is only relevant if "actEnhAcAndGbrServices" is set to 'true' and ignored otherwise.

maxGbrTrafficLimit is also used for 1.4 and 3 MHz cells (for 1.4. only for congestion handling). 
The parameter should be set to a high % value otherwise rather no GBR traffic will be possible in a 1.4 MHz or 3 MHz cell.

maxLbPartners.description: Defines the maximum number of LB partner candidates that a cell will establish LB partnerships with.
maxLbPartners.fullName: Maximum number of load balancing partner candidates

maxNbrTrafficLimit.description:
Maximum combined radio resource consumption (PRBs) for GBR and NBR traffic in UL and DL.
The amount of radio resources (PRBs)  is calculated in % of the available PRBs depending on the system.
For 5 MHz system  25 PRBs*,
for 10 MHz system 50 PRBs*,
for 15 MHz system 75 PRBs*,
for 20 Mhz system 100 PRBs* are available.
* reduced by common resources like PUCCH, RACCH, PDCCH, SIBs etc. which can consume some PRBs (e.g. 3 PRBs) in average.

maxNumCaUeScell.description: Threshold for the maximum number of UEs, which use that cell as SCell.
maxNumCaUeScell.fullName: Maximum number of CA guest UEs in SCell

maxNumIFCarrMeas.description: Maximum increased number of inter frequency carriers to be measured simultaneously
maxNumIFCarrMeas.fullName: maximum number of inter frequency carriers to be measured

maxNumScells.description:
Maximum number of secondary cells (SCells, S-LNCELs) a UE can get configured in DL carrier aggregation in addition to the primary cell (PCell, P-LNCEL).

Note: For time being, the value 5 is reserved for testing purposes only and must not be used in commercial networks.
maxNumScells.fullName: Max number of secondary cells for DL carrier aggr

maxNumUeDlNonGbrAddl.description: Maximum number of additional non-GBR (best-effort) UEs the downlink scheduler will admit for simultaneous scheduling beyond its baseline capacity.

maxNumUeProactiveUl.description: This parameter is the maximum amount of UE proactive Ul grants per TTI (all kinds of skippable and incapable of skipping Ul grants). Value of zero means proactive scheduling is turned off.
maxNumUeProactiveUl.fullName: Maximum amount of UE proactive Ul grants per TTI

maxNumUeProactiveUlNonTxSkip.description: This parameter is the maximum amount of all kinds of incapable of skipping proactive UL grants per TTI. Value of zero means  incapable of skipping proactive UL grants are not allowed.
maxNumUeProactiveUlNonTxSkip.fullName: Maximum number of UE proactive grants to UE incapable of skipping UL grant

maxNumVoLteProactUlGrantsPerTti.description:
This is the maximum number of simultaneous users (both TTIB and non TTIB) which can have a VoLTE proactive UL grant per TTI. Value of zero means VoLTE proactive UL grants are turned off.

The following values are allowed for FDD cells:
1.4 MHz: 0...3
3 MHz: 0...3
5 MHz:  0...3
10 MHz: 0 .. 7
15 MHz: 0 .. 8
20 MHz: 0 .. 10

The following values are allowed for TDD cells:
10 MHz: 0 .. 7
15 MHz: 0 .. 8
20 MHz: 0 .. 10
maxNumVoLteProactUlGrantsPerTti.fullName: Maximum number of VoLTE proactive UL grants per TTI

maxPdcchAgg.description: This parameter defines the maximum allowed aggregation per UE to be required by PDCCH Link Adaptation.

maxPdcchAggHighLoad.description: This parameter defines the maximum allowed aggregation per UE to be required by PDCCH Link Adaptation when there is high PDCCH loading.
maxPdcchAggHighLoad.fullName: Max PDCCH Aggregation During High PDCCH Load

maxPdcchAggHighLoadQci1.description: Maximum PDCCH aggregation level applied to QCI1 (VoLTE) UEs when the cell is under high control-channel load, trading control-channel robustness for capacity.

maxPdcchAggHighLoadSrb.description: Maximum PDCCH aggregation level applied to Signalling Radio Bearer (SRB) transmissions when the cell is under high control-channel load.

maxPdcchAggQci1.description: Maximum PDCCH aggregation level applied to QCI1 (VoLTE) UEs under normal (non-high) load conditions.

maxPdcchAggSrb.description: Maximum PDCCH aggregation level applied to Signalling Radio Bearer (SRB) transmissions under normal load conditions.

maxPdcchCqiShift.description: This parameter defines the upper limit of the dynamically adjusted CQI shift used in PDCCH Outer Loop Link Adaptation (OLLA).

maxPeriodicCqiIncrease.description: This parameter clips the CQI increase as a result of a periodic CQI report.

maxPhyCces.description: This parameter defines the maximum number of physical CCEs per UE to be allocated on PDCCH

maxPrbsPerNbrUe.description:
Maximum number of PRBs allocated for NBR traffic per UE in UL and DL.
The amount of radio resources (PRBs)  is calculated in % of the available PRBs depending on the system.
For 5 MHz system  25 PRBs*,
for 10 MHz system 50 PRBs*,
for 15 MHz system 75 PRBs*,
for 20 Mhz system 100 PRBs* are available.
* reduced by common resources like PUCCH, RACCH, PDCCH, SIBs etc. which can consume some PRBs (e.g. 3 PRBs) in average.

maxTcpUlPowerBoostUEs.description: Maximum number of UEs that may simultaneously use the uplink TCP power-boost feature in this cell.

mbrSelector.description:
Selects whether the UE Capability or O&M parameters limits the Maximum Bitrate UL and Maximum Bitrate DL
if UE capabilities respectively the UE categories are used the limit is per UE; if the O&M parameters are used the limit is for all UEs in the cell.
In case of using DL carrier aggregation for an UE this selector is ignored and in any case the standardized limits (3GPP 36.306) are used for max. number of transport block bits per TTI in DL.

mcc.description: MCC in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner
mcc.fullName: MCC in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner

mdtxAggressiveness.description:
This parameter controls the decision between using a standard muting pattern and applying no muting. If the estimated PRB usage in the upcoming pattern period exceeds the value mdtxAggressiveness, no muting is applied in this upcoming period.

It is recommended to set the parameter value to 0.4 in FDD cells and to 0.8 in TDD cells.

If micro DTX operates with rel4 RF units (LTE1891 fallback-mode), the parameter value is internally limited to 0.6

mdtxPdcchSymb.description:
Number of PDCCH symbols left non-muted by micro-DTX, if the cell is empty.
Temporarily overrides the maxNrSymPdcch value for muted subframes, when eNB is in mdtxMinimumState and cell has at least 10 MHz bandwidth. Small values can lead to reduced PRACH performance.
mdtxPdcchSymb.fullName: Number of non-muted PDCCH symbols if cell is empty

measQuantityCSFBUtra.description:
Defines which quantity to use for Event B1 measurements towards this frequency set in QuantityConfigUTRA-FDD.
The quantities used to evaluate the triggering condition for the event.
cpich-RSCP corresponds to CPICH_RSCP in TS 25.133 for FDD, and P-CCPCH_RSCP in TS 25.123 for TDD.
cpich-EcN0 corresponds to CPICH_Ec/No in TS 25.133 for FDD only, and is not applicable for TDD.
This parameter refers to event B1 for CSFB to WCDMA.
measQuantityCSFBUtra.fullName: Measurement quantity for UTRA-CSFB FDD measurements

measQuantityUtra.description:
Defines which quantity to use for Event B2 measurements towards this frequency set in QuantityConfigUTRA

The quantities used to evaluate the triggering condition for the event.
cpich-RSCP corresponds to CPICH_RSCP in TS 25.133  for FDD.
cpich-EcN0 corresponds to CPICH_Ec/No in TS 25.133 for FDD.
This parameter refers to event B2 for HO to WCDMA.
measQuantityUtra.fullName: Measurement quantity used for UTRA FDD measurements

measScaleFactor.description:
measurement scaling factor for all measurements for scaling the measurement performance of UEs supporting  increased monitoring
(scaling factor 8 or 16 to be configured in UE as per 3GPP TS 36.133 or disabled)
measScaleFactor.fullName: measurement scaling factor for all measurements

microTmpActFeat1.description: Nokia-internal temporary/experimental feature-activation switch used during trials or staged rollouts; the generic name gives no public documentation of its exact function.

microTmpActFeat2.description: A second Nokia-internal temporary/experimental feature-activation switch, companion to microTmpActFeat1, with no publicly documented specific function.

minBitrateDl.description: Minimum bit rate that shall be granted in DL TTI.

minBitrateUl.description: Minimum bit rate that shall be granted in UL TTI.

minInactivityTimeThresh.description:
Defines the minimum remaining inactivity time below which the UE will be released if a handover is attempted during that time. 
Setting the value to 0 effectively disables this functionality.

minPdcchCqiShift.description: This parameter defines the lower limit of the dynamically adjusted CQI shift used in PDCCH Outer Loop Link Adaptation (OLLA).

minTcpPacketSize.description: This parameter defines the minimum size threshold for a TCP packet. TCP packet size must exceed this threshold in order for the packet to considered in TCP restart/stop boosting logic.

mlbEicicOperMode.description: This parameter selects the cell load evaluation profile. The selected profile controls the cell resources that are included in the determination of the load condition. In addition, the parameter is used to define the set of UEs that will receive the adjusted CIO value.
mlbEicicOperMode.fullName: Mode for calculating the CAC in load bal. and eICIC

mnc.description: MNC in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner
mnc.fullName: MNC in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner

mncLength.description: MNC length in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner
