mncLength.fullName: MNC length in the ECGI of the eCICI macro partner

moPrId.description: Identifier of the Mobility Profile, which shall be mapped to one or more SPIDs and/or PLMN IDs.

mobStateParamNCelChgHgh.description: The number of cell changes to enter the high mobility state. Corresponds to NCR_H in TS 36.304.

mobStateParamNCelChgMed.description: The number of cell changes to enter the medium mobility state. Corresponds to NCR_M in TS 36.304.

mobStateParamTEval.description: The duration for evaluating criteria to enter mobility states. Corresponds to TCRmax in TS 36.304. Value in seconds, s30 corresponds to 30 s and so on.

mobStateParamTHystNorm.description: The additional duration for evaluating criteria to enter the normal mobility state. Corresponds to TCRmaxHyst in TS 36.304. Value in seconds, s30 corresponds to 30 s and so on.

msg3ConsecutiveDtx.description:
Message 3 HARQ re-transmissions are enabled with parameter 'msg3ConsecutiveDtx' non-zero values.

HARQ re-transmissions are enabled with the non-zero value of the parameter.
Setting the parameter 'msg3ConsecutiveDtx' to '0' disables layer 2 dtx functionality, and message 3 HARQ re-transmissions.
msg3ConsecutiveDtx.fullName: Maximum number of message 3 DTX detections

msg3DtxOffset.description:
Message 3 DTX offset.
PUSCH SINR offset for DTX detection on layer 2.

multCioAdaptExecEicic.description:
This value is multiplied by (multLoadMeasRrmEicic * tLoadMeasX2Eicic) to define the execution periodicity of the CIO adaptation algorithm for eICIC in relation to the ABS algorithm for eICIC.

It is recommended to execute the CIO adaptation algorithm less frequent than the ABS adaptation algorithm due to following aspects:
i.) CIO changes take longer time to show in the HetNet area (UEs must be reconfigured and HOs must be executed) as compared to an ABS pattern change,
ii.) eNB processing load is increased due to UE reconfiguration.

multLoadMeasRrm.description: This value is multiplied by tLoadMeasX2 to define the periodicity with which the collected available resource reports from the enquired neighbor cells are evaluated

multLoadMeasRrmEicic.description: This value is multiplied by tLoadMeasX2Eicic to define the periodicity with which the collected available resource reports from the enquired neighbor cells are evaluated by the eNB cell and the periodicity of the ABS algorithm.
multLoadMeasRrmEicic.fullName: Load measurement RRM timer multiplier for eICIC

n310PubSafety.description:
Constant n310PubSafety is the maximum number of consecutive "out of sync" indications received from lower layers for UE with established public safety bearers QCI65/66.
With feature LTE2611 for UEs with established QCI65/66, settings of n310PubSafety will be configured in RRC Connected mode (overwriting SIB2 N310 value) via RRC Connection Reconfiguration message.

Note:
If n310PubSafety is not configured, then the N310 value for the UE are determined based on whether QCI 1 has been established and LNCEL-n310Qci1 is configured.  If LNCEL-n310Qci1 is not configured or if QCI-1 is not established, the value from LNCEL-n310 is used.

n310Qci1.description:
Constant n310Qci1 is the maximum number of consecutive "out of sync" indications received from lower layers for UE with established QCI1 bearer.
With feature LTE1569 for UEs with established QCI1, settings of n310Qci1 will be configured in RRC Connected mode (overwriting SIB2 T310 value) via RRC Connection Reconfiguration message.

nOverbookingRac.description: This parameter sets a limit for the number of QCI#1 bearers which may be admitted by RAC in a LTE cell by temporary overbooking in parallel

nbIoTMode.description:
The parameter determine FDD NB-IoT (NarrowBand Internet of Things) operation mode.
eNB will dynamically decide if deployment change is needed and which cells are affected by the possible deployment change

nbIotLinkedCellId.description: Local cell resource ID of the paired host cell or NB-IoT cell (inband or guardband)
nbIotLinkedCellId.fullName: Local cell resource ID of the paired host cell or NB-IoT cell

nbrCongHandling.description:
Determine if congestion handling shall be applied if congestion is detected by layer 2.
It is highly recommended to configure the value to 'true' if 'Nominal bitrate for non-GBR bearers' is activated, i.e. if actNbrForNonGbrBearers is set to 'true'.

nbrUlDlSF.description: The scaling factor for nominal bitrates for uplink and downlink ( actNbrForNonGbrBearers is set to ‘true’ ). The uplink scaling impacts as well other uplink bearers in the same logical channel group,but schedulingWeight remains unmodified for them.
nbrUlDlSF.fullName: scaling factor for nominal bitrates for UL and DL

nomNumPrbNonGbr.description: Defines the value of the non-GBR bearer weights sum that leads to a non-GBR load value of 100%. Example: set nomNumPrbNonGbr = 1/20 if a weight sum of 200 with 10 PRBs available for non-GBR traffic shall be considered 100% load.
nomNumPrbNonGbr.fullName: Nominal number of PRBs for load balancing

numCaUeThreshold.description: Defines the threshold for the maximum allowed number of carrier aggregated UEs in the source PCell, which triggers the PCell swap process. The PCell swap process is triggered when the number of carrier aggregated UEs is greater than or equal to this threshold. It is also used in the PCell swap criteria to select SCells as candidates for the PCell swap.
numCaUeThreshold.fullName: Threshold for number of carr. aggr. UEs for PCell swap

offsetFreqIntra.description:
Offset value applicable to the EUTRA serving carrier frequency.
The IE Q-OffsetRange is used to indicate a cell or frequency specific offset to be applied when evaluating candidates for cell re-selection or when evaluating triggering conditions for measurement reporting.

operationalState.description: Operational state of the eNB, the value is set by system.

orientationOfMajorAxis.description: Orientation of major axis of uncertainty ellipsoid measured clockwise from north

p0NomPucch.description: This parameter defines the cell specific nominal power to be used for PUCCH power calculation in UE uplink power control equation (P2), for controlling mean received SNR for control data.
p0NomPucch.fullName: Nominal power for UE PUCCH TX power calculation

p0NomPusch.description:
This parameter defines the cell specific nominal power for the PUSCH or NPUSCH. Used for P0_PUSCH calculation in UE uplink power control equation (P1) for controlling the mean received SNR for user data during (re)transmission corresponding to a received PDCCH with DCI format 0 associated with a new packet transmission. This parameter is used to control mean received SNR for user data.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
p0NomPusch.fullName: Nominal power for UE PUSCH or NPUSCH TX power calculation

p0NomPuschIAw.description:
P0 setting that is broadcast in SIB2 if interference-aware UL-PC is activated.
ulpcAlpha must be set to "alpha 1" for interference-aware UL-PC.
p0NomPuschIAw.fullName: Nominal PUSCH P0 for interference-aware UL-PC

pFreqPrio.description: pFreqPrio enters into the optional trigger condition between a PCell and candidate SCells for PCell swapping. The swapping can be triggered additionally to other conditions if the frequency layer priority of candidate SCells (CA/D/PR-sFreqPrio) is higher than the frequency layer priority of the PCell. Use pFreqPrio = 1 (default) for highest priority, pFreqPrio = 10 for lowest priority.
pFreqPrio.fullName: PCell frequency layer priority for carrier aggregation

pMax.description:
This parameter defines the maximum output power of the cell per antenna carrier in dBm. The maximum output power is the maximum value for the linear sum of the power of all downlink physical channels that is allowed to be used in a cell. The reference point is the antenna connector.
The most common configurable dBm values correspond to following Watt:
10.0 dBm =  10 mW
37.0 dBm =   5 W
39.0 dBm =   8 W
40.0 dBm =  10 W
41.8 dBm =  15 W
43.0 dBm =  20 W
44.3 dBm =  27 W
44.8 dBm =  30 W
46.0 dBm =  40 W
46.5 dBm =  45 W
47.8 dBm =  60 W
49.0 dBm =  80 W

For low power RRH the carrier power value is used for repeater(s) connected to low power RRH, where the carrier power value in RRH is fixed. For example FHCB output power is fixed to 10 mW (10 dBm) and FHEC output power is fixed to 1 mW (0 dBm).

Note for LTE-GSM sharing configurations:
45W and 80W power level is only supported in LTE dedicated configuration.

Note: The allowed cell power value which are allowed to be configured depend on the used hardware variant. During online commissioning the BTS Site Manager will based on the hardware variant support only the allowed values. Please refer to the documentation where per variant the supported power values are specified.

Note: for RF sharing configurations:
When same antenna line is shared with other technology it needs to be ensured that maximum supported power per antenna line is not exceeded.
Note: This parameter used for NB-IoT standalone cell.

pagingNb.description: Paging nB defines the number of possible paging occasions per radio frame, i.e. the density of paging occasions.  This parameter is used to calculate the number of paging occasions within one paging DRX duration, which in turn is used to calculate the paging occasion.
pagingNb.officialRange:
2: oneT 
3: halfT 
4: quarterT 
5: oneEighthT 
6: oneSixteenthT 
7: oneThirtySecondT

pcellSwapMaxHoRate.description: Defines the maximum number of outgoing PCell swap handovers per measurement period (HO rate per 500ms) allowed to be executed from a source PCell.
pcellSwapMaxHoRate.fullName: Threshold for rate of HOs allowed for PCell swap

pdcchAggDefUe.description: The parameter defines default aggregation for UE to be used in PDCCH Link Adaptation when enableAmcPdcch has been disabled or when enableAmcPdcch has been enabled and there is no valid Channel Quality Indicator (CQI) available due to an expiry of the timer determining CQI remembering.

pdcchAggDefUeQci1.description: Default PDCCH aggregation level assigned to a QCI1 (VoLTE) UE before any dynamic link-adaptation adjustment.

pdcchAggDefUeSrb.description: Default PDCCH aggregation level assigned for SRB (signalling) transmissions before any dynamic link-adaptation adjustment.

pdcchAggMsg4.description: The parameter defines the reserved number of Control Channel Elements (CCEs) for dedicated Random Access Message 4 assignment on PDCCH.

pdcchAggPaging.description: PDCCH aggregation for paging defines how many CCEs shall be used for one PDCCH.

pdcchAggPreamb.description: The parameter defines the aggregation level by means of control channel elements (CCEs) for preamble assignments on PDCCH. The preamble assignment is message 0 sent during the non-contention based Random Access procedure if DL data arrives during UL out-of-sync.
pdcchAggPreamb.fullName: PDCCH aggregation level for preamble assignments

pdcchAggRaresp.description:
The parameter defines:
- the PDCCH aggregation (number of CCEs used for one PDCCH) for contention based random access procedure messages 2 (RA response) for FDD.
- the PDCCH aggregation (number of CCEs used for one PDCCH) for contention based and for contention free random access procedure messages 2 (RA response) for TDD.
pdcchAggRaresp.fullName: PDCCH aggregation for random access response message

pdcchAggRarespHo.description:
PDCCH aggregation for contention free Random Access response message and minimum PDCCH aggregation for HARQ retransmissions of a non-contention based Random Access Procedure initial transmission defines how many effective CCEs (actual CCEs + CCE power boost) are used for one PDCCH:
Value of 4 = 4 CCEs + 0 dB power boost
Value of 8 = 8 CCEs + 0 dB power boost
Value of 12 = 8 CCEs + 1.8 dB power boost
Value of 16 = 8 CCEs + 3 dB power boost
pdcchAggRarespHo.fullName: PDCCH aggregation for contention free random access response message

pdcchAggSib.description: PDCCH aggregation for secondary system information defines how many CCEs should be used for one PDCCH.
pdcchAggSib.fullName: PDCCH aggregation for secondary system information

pdcchAlpha.description:
The parameter defines the limit for PDCCH allocations. PDCCH UE-specific search space capacity is multiplied by this factor.

Note for FDD cells:
The parameter will be ignored if dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz'.
If dlChBw equals '3 MHz' it is recommended to set the parameter to '1.0'.

pdcchCongDetActDl.description:
This parameter activates PDCCH congestion control for Downlink NBR traffic.

It is highly recommended to configure the value to 'true' if 'Nominal bitrate for non-GBR bearers' is activated, i.e. if actNbrForNonGbrBearers is set to 'true'.
pdcchCongDetActDl.fullName: PDCCH congestion control for DL NBR traffic

pdcchCongDetActUl.description:
This parameter activates PDCCH congestion control for Uplink NBR traffic.

It is highly recommended to configure the value to 'true' if 'Nominal bitrate for non-GBR bearers' is activated, i.e. if actNbrForNonGbrBearers is set to 'true'.
pdcchCongDetActUl.fullName: PDCCH congestion control for UL NBR traffic

pdcchCqiOffsetQci1.description: CQI offset applied when computing the required PDCCH aggregation level for QCI1 (VoLTE) UEs, biasing the link-adaptation decision.

pdcchCqiShift.description:
The fine-tuning parameter for adjustment of measured and averaged CQI towards lower or higher aggregation in PDCCH Link Adaptation. 

The parameter gives the initial starting point for PDCCH shift dynamic control in case actOlLaPdcch is true.

The configured PDCCH CQI shift value is automatically adjusted for control channels boosting in need basis.

pdcchCqiShift4Tx.description: An offset ("shift") applied to the CQI-to-MCS mapping used for PDCCH/scheduling decisions when the cell is configured for 4-antenna (4Tx) transmission.

pdcchHarqTargetBler.description:
BLER target for PDCCH outer loop link adaptation in percent.
Defines target Block Error Ratio (BLER) of PDCCH and UL HARQ response for initial downlink transmissions for PDCCH Outer Loop Link Adaptation in percents.
If PDCCH OLLA is additionally based on PUSCH TX/DTX detection, the parameter defines target Block Error Ratio (BLER) of PDCCH and PUSCH missed detection for initial uplink transmissions for PDCCH Outer Loop Link Adaptation in percents.
pdcchHarqTargetBler.fullName: PDCCH and HARQ response target BLER

pdcchOrderConfig.description: This parameter enables/disables PDCCH order usage for UEs in out of sync state. If set to 'enabled' or if not configured, PDCCH order can be triggered for any traffic type. If set to 'disabled', PDCCH order is not triggered for DL user data but is still triggered for RRC signaling.

pdcchUlDlBal.description:
PDCCH allocation balance initial between UL and DL for load adaptive PDCCH

The parameter determines initial value the PDCCH allocation balance constant between uplink and downlink. The Load Adaptive PDCCH algorithm optimizes the value depending on the actual load distribution between DL and UL
In fact, the PDCCH UE-specific search space capacity is divided into uplink and downlink based on the parameter before dynamic schedulings. 
The parameter pdcchUlDlBal (PDCCH LA UL DL allocation balance constant) has been originally introduced as fixed factor of split of UL and DL PDCCH resources. When Usage Based PDCCH is activated by means of parameter actLdPdcch, the pdcchUlDlBal parameter is used as an initial value of the split and as a sort of target value of the algorithm adapting the split.

Note for FDD cells:
Please note that the parameter is ignored if dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz'.
pdcchUlDlBal.fullName: PDCCH LA UL DL allocation balance initial value

perDl256QamChQualEst.description: Decision period for channel quality estimation.
perDl256QamChQualEst.fullName: Decision period for channel quality estimation

periodicCqiFeedbackType.description:
Parameter determines if Wideband CQI or UE_selected subband CQI report mode for periodic CQI reporting on PUCCH or PUSCH should be used.
If periodicCqiFeedbackType is set to UE_selected subband CQI this means that UEs supporting subband CQI (prooved via check of FGI) use it and UEs which do not support subband CQI will use wideband CQI.

Note for the case where periodic subband CQI reporting is enabled together with DRX functionality (actDrx): 
It may not be possible to synchronize DRX start offset such that the wideband CQI report is received during the DRX OnDuration (due to periodicities) and that may cause small performance degradation in DL whenever fresh wideband channel quality information cannot be get in time. It is up to an operator whether to prevent activation of periodic subband CQI reporting and DRX in parallel because of this restriction.

phyCellId.description: This is the physical cell ID of the cell served by the neighbor eNB.

phyCellIdRange.description: Indicates the number of PCIs in the range (including startPCI). If Parameter rangePCI is only one, PCI (startPCI) is specified.
phyCellIdRange.fullName: Range of physical cell id range

phyCellIdStart.description: Indicates the lowest PCI in the range
phyCellIdStart.fullName: Start of physical cell id range

prachDetThresScaling.description: A scaling factor (percentage) applied to the PRACH preamble detection threshold, tuning the sensitivity of the random-access preamble detector.

preRegLoadBalFactor.description: Each eHRPD sector-ID which is configured for preregistration is associated with this loadbalancing factor to allow for loadbalancing according to a weighted round robin mechanism when selecting the sector-ID of the eHRPD-AN for Pre-Registration
preRegLoadBalFactor.fullName: Loadbalancing factor for pre-registration with eHRPD

preempProfileId.description: Identifier of the preemption profile (PREEMPPR) instance which shall apply for the cell

preventCellActivation.description:
This parameter prevents cell activation. 
If this parameter is set to true, then the cell can't be set to unlocked.
Note: This parameter used for NB-IoT standalone cell.

prsBandwidth.description: PRS Bandwidth in terms of PRBs

prsMutingInfo.description:
The prsMutingInfo is a bit string consisting of 16 bit. Only the first prsMutingInfoPatternLen bits will be taken into account starting from prsMutingInfoBit1.
This means the first prsMutingInfoPatternLen bits of the prsMutingInfo bit string will determine the PRS Muting Info pattern with a given periodicity. Details of the description can be found in TS36.355.
Muting configuration allows to increase the reuse of the PRS signal. PRS of individual cells can be muted in order to increase hearability of cells with the same frequency reuse.

WebUI:
When prsMutingInfoBit is not ticked (meaning bit has value “0”), respective PRS occurrence is muted, and when prsMutingInfoBit is ticked (meaning bit has value “1”), respective PRS occurrence is transmitted (not muted).

prsMutingInfoPatternLen.description: The prsMutingInfoPatternLen determines how many PRS Muting Info Bits are used to describe PRS muting sequence. The sequence starts from the prsMutingInfoBit1 and it corresponds to the first positioning occasion, prsMutingInfoBit2 corresponds to second positioning occasion and so on.

prsPowerBoost.description:
Power Boosting for PRS increases hearability and allows for a more flexible use of the DL Tx power.

With de-boosting it is possible to lower PRS power in interference sensitive areas.
PRS power is related to DL RS power, and when prsPowerBoost is set to value 0dB, and dlRsBoost is set to same 0dB value, PRS and DL RS has same power in each TX Antenna. 

Note also the case when actPrsTxDiv is TRUE. Power is same in each TX Antenna, but as PRS is transmitted at the same time from each used TX Antenna, sum of PRS power over all TX Antennas are higher. To compensate power in TxDiv case, prsPowerBoost can be set to proper value. See examples below:

Example 1:
dlMimoMode is set to TxDiv, value -3 dB sets the sum of PRS power to equal to DL RS power.

Example 2:
dlMimoMode is set to 4-way TxDiv, value -6 dB sets the sum of PRS power to equal to DL RS power.

Example 3:
dlMimoMode is set to Closed Loop MIMO (4x2), value -3 dB sets the sum of PRS power to equal to DL RS power.

puschAckOffI.description: The parameter defines the delta offset index for the decoding of the HARQ ACK / NACK information on PUSCH channel.
puschAckOffI.fullName: PUSCH decoding offset index for ACK

puschCqiOffI.description: The parameter defines the delta offset index for the decoding of the Channel Quality Indicator (CQI) / precoding matrix indicator information on PUSCH channel.
puschCqiOffI.fullName: PUSCH decoding offset index for CQI

puschHarqMode.description: This parameter determines the default PUSCH HARQ retransmission mode.

puschLoadHysteresis.description:
Prevents ping-pong behavior if the PUSCH load varies only slightly between a number of candidate cells for PCell Swap. The hysteresis is configured as a percentage of the PUSCH load index. Once triggered, the PCell Swap feature will attempt to reduce PUSCH load until the PUSCH load index falls below the configured threshold, minus the configured hysteresis percentage. So, with puschLoadIndexThr = 0.5 and puschLoadHyst = 0.2 (20%), PCell Swap attempts will stop if puschLoadIndex falls below (1-0.2)*0.5 = 0.4

It is also used in the PCell swap criteria to select SCells as candidates for the PCell swap.
puschLoadHysteresis.fullName: PUSCH load index hysteresis for PCell swap

puschLoadIndexThr.description:
This parameter defines the threshold value against which puschLoadIndex is compared. The PCell swap process is triggered when the puschLoadIndex is greater than or equal to this threshold. This threshold is used as one criterion for switching into "PCell Swap Active" state, and also for candidate cell selection. PUSCH load index is a measure of the cell's load situation, for PUSCH only. puschLoadIndex is the ratio a/b of the values:
a: average number of UEs found in each TTI that are available for scheduling and have data in UL buffers of bearers in non-GBR logical channel groups (i.e., waiting for non-GBR service), set to 0.001 if the measured value is smaller;
b: average number of UL PRBs which are available (after resources have been allocated for GBR bearers and for the duty parts of nonGBR bearers with nominal bit rate, NBR) for non-GBR traffic.
Higher values indicate higher PUSCH load in the cell. 
PUSCH load index increases with the number of UEs waiting for nonGBR service. It also increases with each GBR / NBR bearer that is admitted in the cell and is given resources in the scheduling rounds for GBR and duty parts of NBR bearers. Conversely, the UL load index decreases with decreasing numbers of UEs with nonGBR traffic, and with decreasing number and bandwidth of GBR / NBR bearers.
UL load index can vary across a wide value range because the average number of UEs can range from fractions of 1 up to several hundreds, and because GBR/NBR bearers can consume any number between zero and almost all of the cell’s UL resources.
puschLoadIndexThr.fullName: PUSCH load index threshold for PCell swap

puschRiOffI.description: The parameter defines the delta offset index for the decoding of the Rank Indicator information on the PUSCH channel.
puschRiOffI.fullName: PUSCH decoding offset index for rank indicator

qci1DlTargetBler.description: Dedicated BLER target for DL LA in % for QCI1

qci1HarqMaxTrDl.description:
Indicates the dedicated Maximum number of HARQ transmission for QCI1 in DL,  when in RRC_Connect mode in the cell.
This setting is used not only at a QCI1 bearer setup and when the UE's throughput falls below a calculated throughput threshold
qci1HarqMaxTrDl.fullName: eVTT Maximum number of HARQ transmission in DL for QCI1

qci1HarqMaxTrUl.description: Indicates the dedicated Maximum number of HARQ transmission for QCI1 in UL, which is configured for each UE when in RRC_Connect mode in the cell.
qci1HarqMaxTrUl.fullName: Maximum number of HARQ transmission in UL for QCI1

qci1ProtectionTimer.description:
The timer determines the maximum time between QCI1 bearer establishment and the release of the UE to RRC idle mode. 
QCI1 establishment starts a configurable timer which keeps the UE in RRC connected mode even if there is no activity (e.g. during ringtone) until timer expiry.

qci1ReconStopTimer.description: Dedicated HARQ and BLER reconfiguration timer for QCI1. When this timer expires UL-S and/or DL-S are entitled to perform a reconfiguration of HARQ and BLER parameters if  throughput measures of the UE are such that require they reconfiguration.
qci1ReconStopTimer.fullName: HARQ and BLER reconfiguration timer for QCI1

qci1RrcRelDelayTimer.description: Delay timer (seconds) applied before releasing the RRC connection once the only remaining activity was a QCI1 (VoLTE) bearer, avoiding rapid connect/release cycling.

qci1TgtThreshPrId.description:
Identifier of the Target Threshold Profile, which shall be used for the cell for calls with QCI-1 bearer.

Note: The referred Target Threshold Profile Managed Object Instance must exist.

qci1ThroughputFactorDl.description: Multiplication factor for the QCI1 traffic (based on GBR) to achieve the qci1MaxThroughputDl.
qci1ThroughputFactorDl.fullName: Multiplication factor for the QCI1 traffic in downlink

qci1ThroughputFactorUl.description: Multiplication factor for the QCI1 traffic (based on GBR) to achieve the qci1MaxThroughputUl.
qci1ThroughputFactorUl.fullName: Multiplication factor for the QCI1 traffic in uplink

qci1UlTargetBler.description: Dedicated Target BLER for AMC UL for QCI1
qci1UlTargetBler.fullName: UL AMC target BLER for QCI1

rInstDlHigh.description: Upper instantaneous downlink data-rate threshold used by scheduler/QoS-control logic, e.g. to detect high-throughput conditions.

rInstDlLow.description: Lower instantaneous downlink data-rate threshold used by scheduler/QoS-control logic, e.g. to detect low-throughput/stalled conditions.

rInstUlHigh.description: Upper instantaneous uplink data-rate threshold used by scheduler/QoS-control logic.

rInstUlLow.description: Lower instantaneous uplink data-rate threshold used by scheduler/QoS-control logic.

raContResoT.description: The maximum contention resolution timer parameter defines the maximum amount of time allowed for contention resolution.

raLargeMcsUl.description:
Defines the Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) to be used for large size random access message 3 in case of initial access or handover.

The size of the large size Random Access Msg3 may be restricted depending on the setting of raLargeMcsUl. For FDD cells with smaller bandwidth following applies:
- for '1.4 Mhz': if raLargeMcsUl is equal to the default, the TBS of Msg3 is 328 bit  
- for '3 Mhz': if raLargeMcsUl is equal to the default, the TBS of Msg3 is 504 bit
raLargeMcsUl.fullName: Large size random access MCS in uplink

raMsgPoffGrB.description:
Path loss threshold in dB required for selecting one of the two groups of Random Access preambles.
The UE will only use preambles from group B if it needs to send a large Msg3 AND its measured path loss is less than Pmax - PREAMBLE_INITIAL_RECEIVED_TARGET_POWER - DELTA_PREAMBLE_MSG3 - messagePowerOffsetGroupB (see 36.321 ch 5.1.2)
raMsgPoffGrB.fullName: RA message power offset for group B selection
raMsgPoffGrB.officialRange:
0: -infinity 
1: 0 dB 
2: 5 dB 
3: 8 dB 
4: 10 dB 
5: 12 dB 
6: 15 dB 
7: 18 dB

raNondedPreamb.description: This parameter determines the total number of non-dedicated RA preambles that a UE can select from (i.e. for contention based RA). The minimum cannot be zero.

raPreGrASize.description: Defines the size of the Random Access preambles Group A.
raPreGrASize.fullName: Random access preambles group A size

raRespWinSize.description:
Random Access Response Window Size parameter defines the window size for the random access response in TTIs.

Notes: 
For FDD cells if eICIC feature is activated a value higher than default 7 is recommended to be used.

For TDD cells with ...
- Preamble format 0:
If the UL/DL configuration is 1 then the raRespWindowSize must be set to a value greater than or equal to 5.
If the UL/DL configuration is 2 then the raRespWindowSize must be set to a value greater than or equal to 4.
- Preamble format 1:
If the UL/DL configuration is 1 and the special subframe configuration is 5 then the raRespWindowSize must be set to a value greater than or equal to 4.
- Preamble format 2:
If the UL/DL configuration is 1 and the special subframe configuration is 5 then the raRespWindowSize must be set to a value greater than or equal to 4.
- Preamble format 4:
If the UL/DL configuration is 1 and the special subframe configuration is 7 then the raRespWindowSize must be set to a value greater than or equal to 3.
If the UL/DL configuration is 1 and the special subframe configuration is 5 then the raRespWindowSize must be set to a value greater than or equal to 6.
If the UL/DL configuration is 2 and the special subframe configuration is 7 then the raRespWindowSize must be set to a value greater than or equal to 3.
If the UL/DL configuration is 2 and the special subframe configuration is 5 then the raRespWindowSize must be set to a value greater than or equal to 5.

raSmallMcsUl.description: Defines the Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) to be used for the small size random access message 3 in case of UL or DL data arrival.
raSmallMcsUl.fullName: Small size random access MCS in uplink

raSmallVolUl.description: Defines the data volume to be used for small size Random Access message 3 in case of UL or DL data arrival.
raSmallVolUl.fullName: Small size random access data volume in uplink

rand.description:
Defines the random challenge value.
This parameter is sent in the  RRC CSFBParametersResponseCDMA2000 messages during CDMA2000 1xRTT pre-registration procedure; and it is also sent in the RRC HandoverFromEUTRAPreparationRequest  and S1AP UPLINK S1 CDMA2000 TUNNELING during the 1x Circuit Switched Fallback (1xCSFB) and 1x Single Radio Voice Call Continuity (1xSRVCC) procedure.

rcAmbrMgnDl.description: The parameter determines the multiplier for non-GBR (non-Guaranteed Bit Rate) radio bearers AMBR (Aggregated Maximum Bit Rate) in order to consider overhead caused by PDCP and RLC layers.

rcAmbrMgnUl.description: Margin factor for the comparison of the measured AMBR and the UE AMBR in uplink.
rcAmbrMgnUl.fullName: Rate capping AMBR margin in uplink

rcEnableDl.description: The parameter switches the rate capping functionality on/off in downlink direction. Rate capping functionality in downlink restricts non-GBR (non-Guaranteed Bit Rate) radio bearers bitrate to AMBR (Aggregated Maximum Bit Rate).

rcEnableUl.description: Enabling/disabling of rate capping in uplink.

redBwEnDl.description: The parameter switches Restricted RB Assignment functionality on/off in the downlink direction. When the functionality is enabled, the UE-specific PRB assignment is restricted to a limit defined in the redBwMaxRbDl parameter.

redBwMaxRbDl.description: This parameter defines the maximum UE-specific PRB assingment per TTI in downlink. Note that this value will be rounded up in the RRM algorithm to fit the system bandwidth dependent RGB granularity.
redBwMaxRbDl.fullName: Maximum number of PRBs assigned in downlink

redBwMaxRbUl.description:
Defines the maximum number of PRBs which may be assigned to a UE scheduled in UL when restricted PRB assignment in uplink is enabled.
Note that the actual amount of PRBs in UL allocation must be of the form 2^i*3^j*5^k where i, j and k are non-negative integers, so effectively the value will be rounded down to the next value complying with the rule.

Please note that the default value is not suitable for all bandwidths. The recommended values are:
- if ulChBw is set to '1.4 MHz':6
- if ulChBw is set to '3 MHz': 15
- if ulChBw is set to '5 MHz': 25
- if ulChBw is set to '10 MHz': 50
- if ulChBw is set to '15 MHz': 75
- if ulChBw is set to '20 MHz':100
redBwMaxRbUl.fullName: Maximum number of PRBs assigned in uplink

redBwMinRbUl.description:
Defines the minimum number of PRBs which may be assigned to a UE scheduled in UL when restricted PRB assignment in uplink is enabled. However, a lower number of PRBs is allowed if the transport block size with this number of PRBs and the MCS selected by AMC would exceed the UE capabilities. 
Note that the actual amount of PRBs in UL allocation must be of the form 2^i*3^j*5^k where i, j and k are non-negative integers, so effectively the value will be rounded up to the next value complying with the rule.
redBwMinRbUl.fullName: Minimum number of PRBs assigned in uplink

redBwRpaEnUl.description: Enabling/disabling the restricted PRB assignment functionality in uplink.
redBwRpaEnUl.fullName: Enable restricted PRB assignment in uplink

reportAmountPerLoc.description: Number of periodic ReportStrongestCells measurement reports configured at the UE for Location Services
reportAmountPerLoc.fullName: Report amount periodical meas for location

reportIntervalPerLoc.description: Time interval between two consecutive periodic ReportStrongestCells measurement reports configured at the UE for Location Services
reportIntervalPerLoc.fullName: Report interval periodical meas for location

reqMaxCCsDlOffset.description: An offset applied to the requested maximum number of downlink component carriers in a Carrier Aggregation configuration.

respectIncMonLimits.description:
If set to true this parameter the configuration of E-UTRA carrier measurements in the UE stops when the increased carrier monitoring limits will be exceeded (as per 3GPP TS 36.133 these are 8 FDD E-UTRA, 8 TDD E-UTRA, 6 FDD UTRA and 7 TDD UTRA and a total of 12 carriers).
Otherwise E-UTRA carriers measurements will be configured as per configured amount of carriers of LTE4259 for Inter-Frequency and Inter-RAT.

rttCellId.description:
Defines the cell ID
Defines the cell ID used by this cell to build the CDMA2000 1xRTT reference cell ID when tunnelling the CDMA2000-PDU message from UE to the proper destination node in the CDMA2000 RAT via MME.

rttCellIdInfo.description:
This parameter indicates whether 1x cell Identifier shall be used  by this cell to build IE “CDMA2000 1xRTT Pilot List” when sending UPLINK S1 CDMA2000 TUNNELING message to the MME during e1xCSFB and 1xSRVCC Handover preparation procedure.
Value 0 means "000":  A Cell Identifier field is not included for this pilot. The pilot is an actual 1x pilot.

Value 1 means "001": A 1x Cell Identifier field is included for this pilot. The pilot is an actual 1x pilot.

LNRELXs created by feature LTE2562(O&M assisted CDMA2000 1xRTT ANR ) are only intended to be used in rttCellIdInfo  '000' mode.

rttCsfbType.description: Defines the 1xCSFB type which shall be used in the cell. If set to forbidden, 1xCSFB is not allowed; if set to R81xCsfbEnforced, R8 1xCSFB with redirection shall be enforced; if set to R9e1xCsfb, R9 enhanced 1x Circuit Switched Fallback (e1xCSFB) will be attempted.

rttMarketId.description:
Defines the Market ID
Defines the Market ID used by this cell to build the CDMA2000 1xRTT reference cell ID when tunnelling the CDMA2000-PDU message from UE to the proper destination node in the CDMA2000 RAT via MME.

rttSectorId.description:
Defines the sector ID
Defines the sector ID used by this cell to build the CDMA2000 1xRTT reference cell ID when tunnelling the CDMA2000-PDU message from UE to the proper destination node in the CDMA2000 RAT via MME.

rttSwNo.description:
Defines the switch number 
Defines the switch number used by this cell to build the CDMA2000 1xRTT reference cell ID when tunnelling the CDMA2000-PDU message from UE to the proper destination node in the CDMA2000 RAT via MME.

sCellReleaseLoadMargin.description: Load margin (percentage) below which a UE's Secondary Cell (SCell) can be released/deactivated as part of carrier-aggregation resource management.

sbHoMode.description:
This parameter is used to configure in which mode Service Based HO will select UEs to be candidates for Service Based HO.
If this parameter is set to 'all', then all UEs with QCI1 will be candidates for SB HO.
If this parameter is set to 'ec', then all UEs with QCI1 and emergency ARP will be candidates for SB HO.
If this parameter is set to 'ec_no_rstd', then all UEs with QCI1 and emergency ARP, which do not support RSTD in UE Capabilities, will be candidates for SB HO.

scellBadChQualEstimations.description: Number of consecutive poor channel-quality estimations on a Secondary Cell that will trigger a corrective action such as SCell deactivation.

scellBadChQualThr.description:
Defines the maximum modulation and coding scheme (MCS) index estimated for transmission from the secondary cell (SCell) to infer that the SCell is detected with bad channel quality by the served UE. If the estimated MCS index is smaller than this threshold for the pre-defined decision period  (shortPeriodScellChEst  or longPeriodScellChEst ), data transmission from the SCell is suspended and, depending on the configured multScellReleaseTimer parameter value,  multScellReleaseTimer is started. 
The "MCS" mentioned here is the "wideband MCS", i.e. it is assumed that all the PRBs are used for transmission.
scellBadChQualThr.fullName: Threshold for a SCell detected -  bad channel quality

scellChQualThreshold.description:
Defines the minimum modulation and coding scheme (MCS) index applied for transmission from the SCell to infer that the SCell has sufficient good channel quality to accept the UE for PCell swap.
The quality thresholds are intended for pre-rel.12 UEs. For rel.12 UEs configured for 256QAM usage in the DL, an internal conversion is operated by the eNB.
scellChQualThreshold.fullName: Threshold for SCell channel quality for PCell swap

scellFastSchedulingSelect.description: This parameter selects the fast downlink SCell scheduling method after SCell activation in the PCell.

scellGoodChQualThr.description:
Defines the minimum modulation and coding scheme (MCS) index estimated for transmission from the secondary cell (SCell) to infer that the SCell is detected with good channel quality by the served UE. If the estimated MCS index is greater than this threshold for the pre-defined decision period (shortPeriodScellChEst or longPeriodScellChEst), data transmission from the SCell is resumed and multScellReleaseTimer is stopped if running.
The "MCS" mentioned here is the "wideband MCS", i.e. it is assumed that all the PRBs are used for transmission.
scellGoodChQualThr.fullName: Threshold for a SCell detected -  good channel quality

scellNotDetectableThr.description:
Defines the maximum modulation and coding scheme (MCS) index estimated for transmission from the secondary cell (SCell) to infer that the SCell is not detectable by the served UE. If the estimated MCS index is smaller than this threshold for the pre-defined decision period (shortPeriodScellChEst  or longPeriodScellChEst ), data transmission from the SCell is suspended and, depending on the configured multScellReleaseTimer parameter value, the SCell is released.
The "MCS" mentioned here is the "wideband MCS", i.e. it is assumed that all the PRBs are used for transmission.
scellNotDetectableThr.fullName: Threshold for a not detectable Scell

scellStateForPcellSwap.description: Defines the state of the SCell in which a PCell swap is allowed. Possible configurations are to allow it for any configured SCells or for activated SCells only.
scellStateForPcellSwap.fullName: State of the SCell for which PCell swap is allowed

schedulingWeightSF.description: The scaling factor for scheduling weight for uplink and downlink (actNonGbrServiceDiff is set to 'true').  The uplink scaling impacts as well other uplink bearers in the same logical channel group, but schedulingWeight remains unmodified for them.

sectorID.description:
This Parameter contains the HRPD Sector ID used for HRPD handover pre-registration and defined as specified in 3GPP2 C.S0024-A.

The parameter must be added as character string in hexadecimal notation with leading '0x'.
It is used to populate the CDMA2000 sector ID (128 bits) using hexadecimal characters.

In addition to the leading '0x' it shall only contain hexadecimal characters '0' to '9', 'A' to 'F', 'a' to 'f'.

The format of Sector ID equals the format of an IPv6 address but without colons.

shortPeriodScellChEst.description:
Defines the short decision period for collecting the MCS samples from the SCell, before deciding about its channel quality. The short decision period applies when the SCell channel quality has not yet been estimated as good.

Within the specified decision period, one MCS sample is taken  every 25 ms.
shortPeriodScellChEst.fullName: Short decision period for channel quality est.

spid.description:
Single SPID value or first SPID value of a range which shall be mapped to a Mobility Profile.
3GPP 36.300 defines the following SPID range:
Values 1-128 are Operator specific SPIDs

Values 129-256 are Reference SPID values
Reference SPIDs have the following meaning:
SPID 256 High prio to eUTRA, Medium prio to UTRAN, Low prio to GERAN
SPID 255 High prio to UTRAN, Medium prio to GERAN, Low prio to eUTRA
SPID 254 High prio to GERAN, Medium prio to UTRAN, Low prio to eUTRA

spidLast.description:
Last SPID value if a range of SPID values shall be mapped to a Mobility Profile.
3GPP 36.300 defines the following SPID range:
Values 1-128 are Operator specific SPIDs

Values 129-256 are Reference SPID values
Reference SPIDs have the following meaning:
SPID 256 High prio to eUTRA, Medium prio to UTRAN, Low prio to GERAN
SPID 255 High prio to UTRAN, Medium prio to GERAN, Low prio to eUTRA
SPID 254 High prio to GERAN, Medium prio to UTRAN, Low prio to eUTRA
spidLast.fullName: Last subscriber profile ID of a range

syncDeboost4Tx.description: An adjustment applied to reduce ('de-boost') the transmit power of synchronization signals relative to nominal cell power, e.g. to manage interference or power budget.

t301Guard.description:
Timer t301Guard supervises the UE Context Fetch procedure at the eNB. 
Start: Receipt of RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest from UE
Stop: Reception of X2 Handover Request from failure eNB (for UE context fetch)

At expiry: send RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject to the UE

t301Qci1.description:
Timer T301 supervises the RRC connection re-establishment procedure for UEs with QCI1 bearer. 
Start: Transmission of RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest
Stop: Reception of RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject message as well as when the selected cell becomes unsuitable

At expiry: Go to RRC_IDLE

This parameter is applicable only if actConvVoice is set to 'true' in the same cell. 
If this parameter is not configured (while actConvVoice is set to 'true'), then SIB-t301 parameter is used for UEs with QCI1 bearer as well.

t302.description:
eNB sends this parameter to the UE in the message RRC CONNECTION REJECT.
The UE will consider access to the cell as barred for the time specified by t302.

t304InterRAT.description: This timer value is used eNodeB internally to estimate the time the UE may spend to access the target WCDMA system after receiving RRC:MOBILITY FROM EUTRAN COMMAND before starting RRC Re-Establishment. It is used eNodeB internally to calculate the supervision timer for the Handover Execution Phase (TS1RELOCoverall)

t304InterRATGsm.description:
This timer value is used eNodeB internally to estimate the time the UE may spend to access the target GSM system after receiving RRC:MOBILITY FROM EUTRAN COMMAND before starting RRC Re-Establishment. It is used eNodeB internally to calculate the supervision timer for the Handover Execution Phase (TS1RELOCoverall)
Despite this timer is transparently provided by GERAN Target system its value is needed in LTE to calculate TS1RELOCOverall

t304IntraLte.description: Timer T304 supervises the successful completion of a handover or cell change.

t304eNaccGsm.description:
3GPP defined Timer T304 (used for RRC Re-Establishment) for the case of eNACC to GSM
This timer value is passed to the UE in an RRC: MobilityFromEUTRANCommand message and is used by the UE to identify CCO Failure
t304eNaccGsm.fullName: Timer T304 for eNACC to GSM

t310PubSafety.description:
Timer t310PubSafety supervises the recovery from physical layer problems for UE with established public safety bearers QCI65/66.
With feature LTE2611 for UEs with established QCI65/66, settings of t310PubSafety will be configured in RRC Connected mode (overwriting SIB2 T310 value) via RRC Connection Reconfiguration message.

Note:
If t310PubSafety is not configured, then the T310 value for the UE are determined based on whether QCI 1 has been established and LNCEL-t310Qci1 is configured.  If LNCEL-t310Qci1 is not configured or if QCI-1 is not established, the value from LNCEL-t310 is used.

t310Qci1.description:
Timer t310Qci1 supervises the recovery from physical layer problems for UE with established QCI1 bearer.
With feature LTE1569 for UEs with established QCI1, settings of t310Qci1 will be configured in RRC Connected mode (overwriting SIB2 T310 value) via RRC Connection Reconfiguration message.

t312.description:
Timer T312 supervises the recovery from physical layer problems when a measurement report has been triggered for a measurement identity for which T312 has been configured, while T310 is running. This parameter is used in intra-frequency measurement object.

It is recommended that the value of this parameter be smaller than SIB-t310.

t320.description: T320 defines the validity time of dedicated priorities defined in IdleModeMobilityControlInfo.

t325.description:
t325 indicates the period for which either the current carrier frequency or E-UTRA is deprioritised. 
The UE shall be able to store a deprioritisationrequest for up to 8 frequencies (applicable when receiving another frequency specific deprioritisation request before T325 expiry).

tC2KMeasReport.description: Defines the amount of time the eNodeB waits for a measurement report for 1x Circuit Switched Fallback (CSFB) to be received from the UE.

tC2KRelocOverallHrpd.description: This timer value is used for eNodeB internally to estimate the time the UE may spend to access the target HRPD system after receiving RRC:MOBILITY FROM EUTRAN COMMAND before starting RRC Re-Establishment. eNodeB internally use this value to calculate the supervision timer for the eHRPD optimized Handover Execution Phase (TC2KRelocOverall).
tC2KRelocOverallHrpd.fullName: CDMA2000 HRPD Handover Relocation Execution Timer

tC2KRelocPrep.description: Defines the amount of time the eNodeB waits for the Downlink CDMA2000 Tunneling message after sending the Uplink Handover Preparation Transfer message (received from the UE) to the MME.

tC2KRelocPrepHrpd.description: This timer value defines the amount of time the eNodeB waits for the Downlink CDMA2000 Tunneling message from MME after forwarding the dedicatedInfoCDMA2000-HRPD PDU in UplinkHandoverPreparationTransfer message (received from UE) to MME.
tC2KRelocPrepHrpd.fullName: CDMA2000 HRPD Handover Relocation Preparation Timer

tC2kRelocExec.description: Defines the amount of time the eNodeB waits to release the UE context after sending the Mobility From Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (EUTRA) Command message to the UE.

tExtendedWait.description:
tExtendedWait suppresses the reselection of a cell for a  while.
eNB sends this parameter to the UE in the message RRC CONNECTION REJECT and RRC CONNECTION RELEASE, and only in case of Delay Tolerant access request. The UE will consider access to the cell as barred for the time specified by tExtendedWait.

tLoadMeasX2.description: This timer defines the periodicity according which neighbor cells are requested to report their available resource status
tLoadMeasX2.fullName: Load measurement X2 timer for MLB

tLoadMeasX2Eicic.fullName: Load measurement X2 timer for eICIC

tPageCorrInt.description:
A RRC connection setup request which is correlated to (i.e. matches by s-TMSI) a S1 paging with priority will be prioritized ("emergency callback"). The timer determines the maximum time between the S1 paging and its correlated RRC connection setup request.
When the parameter is set to value "0" any correlation is disabled.

tPeriodicBsr.description: Time period of the periodic Buffer Status Report for the reporting of the UE transmission buffer utilization.

tPeriodicPhr.description: UE configuration for sending periodic power headroom reports.

tPingPong.description: This parameter defines the maximum time interval which may elapse from when a UE has left a cell by handover till when it returns to that cell by another handover in order to consider such event as a PingPong

tProhibitPhr.description: Minimum intermediate time between two consecutive Power Headroom Reports.

tReTxBsrTime.description: Time when the regular BSRs are repeated when the UE has data available for transmission and no corresponding UL grant is received so far.

tStoreUeCntxt.description:
This timer is started when an UE enters a cell by handover or RRC Re-Establishment.

The timer controls how long the context needed to send an X2AP: HANDOVER REPORT is stored in the new cell after handover.
No special action is triggered on timer expiry

tULHOPrepTransfer.description: Defines the amount of time the eNodeB waits to receive  an Uplink (UL) Handover Preparation Transfer message from the UE after sending a Handover From EUTRA Preparation Request message to the UE.

tUlHoPrepTransferHrpd.description: The timer value defines the amount of time the eNodeB waits to receive an UlHandoverPreparationTransfer message from UE after sending a HandoverFromEUTRAPreparationRequest message to the UE.
tUlHoPrepTransferHrpd.fullName: CDMA2000 HRPD UL Handover Preparation Transfer Timer

taMaxOffset.description: Determines the maximum allowed Time Alignment offset. If the value is exceeded, TA command is sent to the UE to adjust UL timing.

taTimer.description: Determines the number of subframes after which a UE assumes it is out-of-sync in UL if no Time Alignment command was received.

taTimerMargin.description:
The parameter defines lead with respect to the taTimer expiration time for starting to send the periodic Timing Advance Command.

Recommended default values:
for FDD cell: 2000
for TDD cell: 87

If taTimer is set to 'infinity', this parameter defines the lead time with respect to the expiration of a 10.24 seconds timer for starting to send the periodic Timing Advance Command

tac.description: This is the tracking area code of the cell served by the neighbor eNB.

targetLoadGbrDl.description:
Target load for usage of GBR Uu I/F resources in DL direction.

If all load components (GBR, non-GBR, PDCCH) indicated by the load evaluation profile selected  in 'mlbEicicOperMode' are below their individual target load values, a cell is considered having its load balanced.
Target Load represents the operating point = load at which the cell should work according to its dimensioning and the traffic model.
Because of using the minimum of the values, if either targetLoadGbrDl or targetLoadNonGbrDl or targetLoadPdcch are set to 0%, the cell will never offer any available capacity for Load Balancing to its neighbor cells.

targetLoadNonGbrDl.description:
Target load for usage of nonGBR Uu I/F resources in DL direction.

If all load components (GBR, non-GBR, PDCCH) indicated by the load evaluation profile selected  in 'mlbEicicOperMode' are below their individual target load values, a cell is considered having its load balanced.
Target Load represents the operating point = load at which the cell should work according to its dimensioning and the traffic model.
Because of using the minimum of the values, if either targetLoadGbrDl or targetLoadNonGbrDl or targetLoadPdcch are set to 0%, the cell will never offer any available capacity for Load Balancing to its neighbor cells.

targetLoadPdcch.description:
Target load for usage of PDCCH Uu I/F resources.

If all load components (GBR, non-GBR, PDCCH) indicated by the load evaluation profile selected  in 'mlbEicicOperMode' are below their individual target load values, a cell is considered having its load balanced.
Target Load represents the operating point = load at which the cell should work according to its dimensioning and the traffic model.
Because of using the minimum of the values, if either targetLoadGbrDl or targetLoadNonGbrDl or targetLoadPdcch are set to 0%, the cell will never offer any available capacity for Load Balancing to its neighbor cells.

targetSelMethod.description: Selection method for the target frequency/layer for idle mode load balancing.
targetSelMethod.fullName: Cell reselection method for idle mode load balancing

tgtThreshPrId.description:
Identifier of the Target Threshold Profile which shall be used for the cell.

Note: The referred Target Threshold Profile Managed Object Instance must exist.

threshold1.description:
Threshold Th1 for RSRP
If RSRP of serving cell is greater than Th1, only the serving cell is measured.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold2C2k.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of CDMA2000-eHRPD or CDMA2000-1XRTT measurements

Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If value below threshold2Cdma2k (event A2) then CDMA2000-eHRPD or CDMA2000-1XRTT measurements are started.
Value-Range follows 3GPP TS 36.133 chapter 9.1.4

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold2C2kQci1.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of CDMA2000-1XRTT measurements when UE has QCI1 bearer.
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. For a UE with QCI1 bearer and if RSRP value is below threshold2CkQci1 (event A2) then CDMA2000-1XRTT measurements are started.
If actServBasedMobThr (LTE2112/LTE64) is disabled or this parameter is not configured, then threshold2C2k(LTE738) is used 

Value-Range follows 3GPP TS 36.133 chapter 9.1.4

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold2C2kQci1.fullName: RSRP threshold 2 For CDMA2000 during QCI1

threshold2GERAN.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of GERAN Measurements
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If the value is below threshold2GERAN (event A2) , GERAN measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold2GERANQci1.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of GERAN Measurements when UE has QCI1 bearer

Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. For a UE with QCI1 bearer, if value is below threshold2GERANQci1 (event A2) then GERAN measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold2GERANQci1.fullName: Threshold th2 GERAN for RSRP during QCI1

threshold2InterFreq.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of inter frequency measurements
If value is below threshold2InterFreq  (event A2) then inter frequency measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold2InterFreqHpue.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of inter frequency measurements when HPUE has no QCI1 bearer. 
Defines the threshold for serving cell RSRP of A2 event, as a trigger to start Inter-Frequency handovers. If value is below threshold2InterFreqHpue  (event A2) then inter frequency measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold2InterFreqHpue.fullName: Threshold th2 interFreq for RSRP of the high power UE

threshold2InterFreqQci1.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of inter frequency measurements when UE has QCI1 bearer
Defines the threshold for serving cell RSRP of A2 event, as a trigger to start Inter-Frequency handovers. If value is below threshold2InterFreqQci1 (event A2) and if UE has QCI1 bearer then inter frequency measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold2InterFreqQci1.fullName: Threshold Th2 InterFreq for RSRP during QCI1

threshold2MobRsrq.description:
Threshold for RSRQ of serving cell. If RSRQ of serving value < threshold2MobRsrq then mobility measurements with measurement gaps are activated.
The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB

threshold2Wcdma.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of WCDMA Measurements
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If the value is below threshold2Wcdma (event A2) , WCDMA measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold2WcdmaQci1.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of WCDMA Measurements when UE has QCI1 bearer

Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. For a UE with QCI1 bearer, if value is below threshold2WcdmaQci1 (event A2) then WCDMA measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold2WcdmaQci1.fullName: Threshold th2 WCDMA for RSRP during QCI1

threshold2a.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for stopping of Inter-RAT (InterFreq)  Measurements
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If Inter-RAT (InterFreq) measurements are active and value exceeds Th2a (event A1) then  Inter-RAT measurements are stopped. Th2_XXX <= Th2a for XXX= InterFreq, WCDMA, GSM, CDMA2000-HRPD

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold2aHpue.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for stopping of Inter-Frequency (Inter-RAT) Measurements when HPUE has no QCI1 bearer
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If Inter-Frequency (Inter-RAT) measurements are active and RSRP value exceeds threshold2aHpue (event A1) then Inter-Frequency (Inter-RAT) measurements are stopped. 

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold2aHpue.fullName: Threshold th2a for RSRP of the high power UE

threshold2aQci1.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for stopping of Inter-RAT and Inter-Frequency Measurements when UE has QCI1 bearer
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. For a UE with QCI1 bearer, if Inter-RAT and Inter-Frequency measurements are active and RSRP value exceeds threshold2aQci1 (event A1) then  Inter-RAT measurements are stopped. 

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold2aQci1.fullName: Threshold th2a for RSRP During QCI1

threshold2aRsrq.description:
Threshold for RSRQ of serving cell for stopping of Inter-RAT (Inter-Freq) measurements.
The RSRP based A1 event reports also the RSRQ value which is compared with this threshold in eNB.
When RSRP of serving cell becomes better than threshold2a the UE sends the A1 event. If the reported RSRQ of that A1 event of serving cell is also better than this configured threshold2aRsrq in eNB then InterFreq and InterRAT measurements are de-activated. 
This check is done at each time the A1 report is received in eNB until either the RSRQ value fits or the leaving condition for this A1 event is fullfilled.

The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB

threshold3.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If RSRP of serving cell is lower than threshold3 and RSRP of neighbor cell is greater than threshold3a, a handover is triggered.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold3RsrqIntraFreq.description:
Threshold for RSRQ of serving cell. If RSRQ of serving cell is lower than threshold3RsrqIntraFreq and RSRQ of neighbor cell is greater than threshold3aRsrqIntraFreq, a handover is triggered.

The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
* -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
* values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
* -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB"
threshold3RsrqIntraFreq.fullName: Threshold th3 for RSRQ Intra frequency

threshold3a.description:
Threshold for RSRP of intra-frequency neighbor cell. If RSRP of serving cell is lower than threshold3 and RSRP of neighbor cell is greater than threshold3a, a handover is triggered.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold3aRsrqIntraFreq.description:
Threshold for RSRQ of intra-frequency neighbor cell. If RSRQ of serving cell is lower than threshold3RsrqIntraFreq and RSRQ of neighbor cell is greater than threshold3aRsrqIntraFreq, a handover is triggered.

The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
* -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
* values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
* -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB"
threshold3aRsrqIntraFreq.fullName: Threshold th3a for RSRQ Intra Frequency

threshold4.description:
Threshold for RSRP of intra-frequency neighbor cell. If RSRP of serving value < Th4 then re-direct is triggered.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold4Rsrq.description:
Threshold for RSRQ of intra-frequency serving cell. If RSRQ of serving value < Th4Rsrq then re-direct is triggered. 

The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB

timeBetweenTcpPackets.description: This parameter defines the minimum time which must elapse between two large TCP packets (defined as having size > minTcpPacketSize) in order to stop TCP boosting for a certain bearer.

timeNextBoostingRound.description: This parameter defines the minimum time without a large TCP packet (defined as having size > minTcpPacketSize) which must elapse after TCP boosting of a certain bearer has stopped. TCP boosting for the same bearer can be restarted only after this minimum time has elapsed.

timeToTriggerSfHigh.description: The timeToTrigger in ReportConfigEUTRA and in ReportConfigInterRAT are multiplied with the scaling factor applicable for the UE's speed state, that is, if the UE is in the high mobility state as defined in TS 36.304 .

timeToTriggerSfMedium.description: The timeToTrigger in ReportConfigEUTRA and in ReportConfigInterRAT are multiplied with the scaling factor applicable for the UE's speed state, that is, if the UE is in the medium mobility state as defined in TS 36.304.

tmSwitchProfileId.description:
Instance ID of the assigned transmission mode switch profile.

The profile contains CQI thresholds for switching between transmission modes.

tmpActFeat1.description: A generic, Nokia-internal placeholder activation flag (its name suggests a temporary/staging feature switch used during feature rollout or lab testing) rather than a stable, documented feature toggle.

tmpActFeat2.description: A Nokia-internal temporary feature-activation bitmask/register used to enable specific feature toggles or workarounds; individual bit meanings are not publicly documented.

tmpParam15.description: Generic, undocumented Nokia-internal tuning parameter (placeholder name); its specific function cannot be determined from the name, class, or example values alone.

tmpParam16.description: Generic, undocumented Nokia-internal tuning parameter (placeholder name); its specific function cannot be determined from the name, class, or example values alone.

tmpParam4.description: Generic, undocumented Nokia-internal tuning parameter (placeholder name); its specific function cannot be determined from the name, class, or example values alone.

tmpParam5.description: Generic, undocumented Nokia-internal tuning parameter (placeholder name); its specific function cannot be determined from the name, class, or example values alone.

tmpParam6.description: Generic, undocumented Nokia-internal tuning parameter (placeholder name); its specific function cannot be determined from the name, class, or example values alone.

ttiBundlingBlerTarget.description: BLER target value for link adaption while in TTI Bundling mode

ttiBundlingBlerThreshold.description: Controls the BLER threshold for switching UEs from non-bundling mode into TTI-Bundling mode

ttiBundlingSinrThreshold.description:
SINR threshold for switching UEs from TTI-Bundling mode into non-TTI-bundling mode

This threshold value is used if ttibOperMode = any of (blerBasedNoMeasGap, blerBasedTtibOnAllowed, blerBasedTtibOnOffAllowed ), together with threshold conditions for current MCS and the estimated number of PRBs that the UE can handle. 
If ttibOperMode = any of (sinrBasedNoMeasGap, sinrBasedTtibOnAllowed, sinrBasedTtibOnOffAllowed), this parameter has no function and TTI Bundling mode switches are controlled by the ttiBundlingSinrThresholdIn and ttiBundlingSintrThresholdOut parameters.

ttibAltUlPrbThreshold.description:
This parameter determines the minimum gain which must be achieved by using interference-aware scheduling (IAS)or channel-aware scheduling (CAS)  for UEs in  TTI bundling mode, which looks for spectrum positions with minimized interference. If the achieved gain is smaller than this threshold, UEs in TTI bundling mode are given UL grants in alternating positions on the spectrum, for added diversity gain. 
If parameter is set to 0, a UE in  TTI bundling mode is always given UL grants using interference-aware scheduling (IAS) or channel-aware scheduling (CAS).
ttibAltUlPrbThreshold.fullName: Alternating UL PRB threshold for TTI bundling mode

ttibMinDelayAfterBearerSetup.description:
This parameter determines the minimum time a UE in non TTI bundling mode must spend after VoLTE bearer setup before it can enter TTI bundling mode.

If ttiOperMode is set to any of (sinrBasedNotWithMeasGap, sinrBasedTtibOnAllowed, sinrBasedTtibOnOffAllowed),  UE enters TTI bundling mode only after ttibMinDelayAfterBearerSetup subframes have elapsed since VoLTE Bearer Setup.

Setting this parameter to zero disables this functionality, i.e. a UE can enter TTI bundling mode as soon as the VoLTE bearer is established.
ttibMinDelayAfterBearerSetup.fullName: Minimum time to enter TTI bundling after Bearer Setup

ttibMinUlPrb.description:
This parameter defines the minimum number of uplink PRBs which can be allocated to a UE in TTI bundling mode.
Setting this parameter to 3 means that the number of UL PRBs for a UE in TTI bundling is fixed at 3. This is because 3GPP limits the number of PRBs for a UE in TTI bundling to a maximum of 3.
ttibMinUlPrb.fullName: Minimum number of UL PRBs in TTI bundling

ttibOperMode.officialRange:
0: blerBasedNotWithMeasGap 
1: blerBasedTtibOnAllowed 
2: blerBasedTtibOnOffAllowed 
3: sinrBasedNotWithMeasGap 
4: sinrBasedTtibOnAllowed 
5: sinrBasedTtibOnOffAllowed

ttibSinrDwellTimeIn.description:
This parameter determines the minimum time the SINR measurement for a UE must be below the threshold before it can enter SINR-based TTI bundling mode.

If ttiOperMode is set to any of (sinrBasedNotWithMeasGap, sinrBasedTtibOnAllowed, sinrBasedTtibOnOffAllowed),  UE enters TTI bundling mode only after SINR measurement is below ttibSinrThresholdIn for ttibSinrDwellTimeIn consecutive subframes.
ttibSinrDwellTimeIn.fullName: Minimum time to enter SINR based TTI bundling

ttibSinrDwellTimeOut.description:
This parameter determines the minimum time the SINR measurement for a UE must be above the threshold before it can leave SINR-based TTI bundling mode.

If ttiOperMode is set to any of (sinrBasedNotWithMeasGap, sinrBasedTtibOnAllowed, sinrBasedTtibOnOffAllowed),  UE leaves TTI bundling mode only after SINR measurement is above ttibSinrThresholdOut for ttibSinrDwellTimeOut consecutive subframes.
ttibSinrDwellTimeOut.fullName: Minimum time to exit SINR based TTI bundling

ttibSinrThresholdIn.description:
If ttibOperMode is configured to use SINR-based conditions, this is the threshold for switching UEs from normal (non-TTI-Bundling) mode into TTI-bundling mode. The calculation also includes the UE’s power headroom, so essentially this threshold condition looks at how much energy the UE can deliver at the eNB’s receiver input. 
If ttibOperMode is configured to use BLER-based conditions, this parameter is not used.
ttibSinrThresholdIn.fullName: SINR threshold for entering TTI bundling mode

ttibSinrThresholdOut.description:
If ttibOperMode is configured to use SINR-based conditions, ttibSinrThresholdOut is used the threshold value for leaving TTIB mode.
if ttibOperMode is configured to use BLER-based conditions, this parameter is not used.
ttibSinrThresholdOut.fullName: SINR threshold for leaving TTI bundling mode

ttibUlsMaxPacketSeg.description: Maximum number of packet segments allowed for a TTI-bundled uplink transmission (TTI Bundling improves UL coverage, e.g. for VoLTE at cell edge).

ttibUlsMinTbs.description: This parameter defines the minimum UL TBS (segment size) for TTI bundled UEs.
ttibUlsMinTbs.fullName: Minimum UL TBS for UEs for TTI bundled UEs

ueCntxtPreempGuardT.description: ueCntxtPreempGuardT timer guards completion of UE context pre-emption procedure. The eNB internal resources are released at its expiry even if there are pending UE or MME transactions. The recommended value is at least 300ms and should be smaller than SIB-t300, CATMPR-t300ModeACatM, LNBTS-tS1RelPrepL and LNBTS-tX2RelocPrep.

ueLevelMroOffset.description:
UE Level MRO Offset parameter as a configurable offset being added to a CIO value of neighbor cell to avoid further unnecessary handovers when a ping-pong handover is detected between a serving cell and neighbor cell.
Value range: -3…0 step 1, where “0” makes no change in reality in the configured cell by adding 0 value, and Unit in dB.

ulAdaptPfLoadThresh.description: Uplink cell-load threshold (percentage) at which the adaptive Proportional-Fair scheduler switches its behavior/parameters.

ulCaMinPcellSinr.description:
This parameter determines the minimum PCell UL  SINR for a UE  with no established QCI1 bearer  to be considered a candidate for adding an Scell.
If parameter is set to 0, a UE  with no established QCI1 bearer  can be considered a candidate for adding an Scell without checking its PCell  UL SINR.

ulCaMinPcellSinrQci1.description:
This parameter determines the minimum PCell UL SINR for a UE with an established QCI1 bearer to be considered a candidate for adding an SCell.
If parameter is set to 0, a UE with an established QCI1 bearer can be considered a candidate for adding an SCell without checking its PCell UL SINR.
ulCaMinPcellSinrQci1.fullName: SCell add UL SINR threshold for QCI1

ulCaSinrWindow.description: This parameter determines the minimum time a UE must meet the UL SINR threshold defined by ulCaMinPcellSinr or ulCaMinPcellSinrQci1 before it can be considered a candidate for adding an Scell.

ulCacIgnore.description: This parameter indicates whether the Uplink CAC will be ignored or used in load balancing related calculations.

ulCacSelection.description:
This parameter selects the value to report in the Resource Status Update message for the uplink CAC.
When set to 'ulFixedCac' the uplink CAC reported in the X2 Resource Status Update will be the value set in ulStaticCac.

When set to 'ulReflectDlCac' the uplink CAC reported in the X2 Resource Status Update will be set to the same value as the downlink CAC.

ulMaxBoostBytes.description: This parameter defines the amount of uplink data to be received (for a bearer which is being TCP boosted in the uplink) after which uplink TCP boosting for the bearer is stopped.

ulMinBoostBytes.description: This parameter defines the minimum amount of uplink data which must be received (after uplink TCP traffic has been detected on a certain bearer) in order to start uplink TCP boosting for the bearer.

ulRsCs.description: Defines cyclic shift of uplink reference signals.

ulScellConfigLevel.description: Configuration aggressiveness level controlling how readily uplink Secondary Cells are configured for UEs under carrier aggregation.

ulSinrLowThreshold.description: Defines the threshold for UL Signal-to-Interference-and-Noise-Ratio (SINR) below which a carrier aggregated UE is not considered for PCell swap by the source PCell.
ulSinrLowThreshold.fullName: UL SINR threshold for PCell swap

ulStaticCac.description: This parameter defines the uplink CAC value that will be sent in the X2 Resource Status Update message when ulCacSelection is set to 'ulFixedCac'.

ulTargetBler.description: Defines target Block Error Ratio for uplink Adaptive Modulation and Coding.

ulamcAllTbEn.description:
O&M switch for enabling/disabling the counting of all Transport Blocks instead of the 1st transmission Transport Blocks for defining Uplink Adaptive Modulation and Coding inner loop factor (UEs in non-TTI bundling mode), BLER measurements (UEs in TTI bundling mode). 
If set to false, only HARQ feedback for initial transmissions is considered in UL AMC.
If set to true, HARQ feedback for initial transmissions and for retransmissions is considered in UL AMC.
ulamcAllTbEn.fullName: Enable all TBs in UL AMC

ulamcSwitchPer.description: The parameter defines the period in sent Transport Blocks (TBs) when uplink Adaptive Modulation and Coding inner loop functionalities should be executed. Depending on the parameter ulAmcEnableAllTbs, all TBs or 1st transmission TBs have been calculated for the period. MCS increase/decrease based on the UL AMC inner loop factor can be only done after the period ends.

ulatbEventPer.description: The parameter defines the period in MCS increase/decrease events when uplink Adaptive Transmission Bandwidth (ATB) functionality should be performed. MCS change events are calculated and UL ATB functionality is executed every time the event counter reaches the value defined in the parameter.

ulpcAlpha.description:
Used as a fractional path loss compensation factor: alpha. It controls received SNR variance (fairness) for user data and sounding reference symbol.
Alpha can't control the fractional pathloss compensation for the sounding in the case PUSCH masking is activated (actPuschMask equal to 'true') as SRS is disabled in this case.

Recommended default values are
- for FDD cell: 'alpha 1'
- for TDD cell: 'alpha 0.8'.

Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
ulpcAlpha.officialRange:
0: alpha 0 
1: alpha 0.4 
2: alpha 0.5 
3: alpha 0.6 
4: alpha 0.7 
5: alpha 0.8 
6: alpha 0.9 
7: alpha 1

ulpcCEBalanceIAw.description: Controls Target SINR in interference-aware UL-PC: provides a tilt in the balancing between Target SINR in cell-center and Target SINR at cell-edge. Target SINR determines the max. throughput, therefore higher values increase cell-center throughput at the cost of cell-edge throughput, and vice versa.

ulpcLowlevCch.description: Lower threshold of the power control window for the RSSI (signal level) for PUCCH component
ulpcLowlevCch.fullName: Lower RSSI threshold for PUCCH power command decision

ulpcLowlevSch.description: Lower threshold of the power control window for the RSSI (signal level) for PUSCH / SRS component
ulpcLowlevSch.fullName: Lower RSSI threshold for PUSCH power command decision
