ulpcLowqualCch.description: Lower threshold of the power control window for the SINR (signal quality) for PUCCH component
ulpcLowqualCch.fullName: Lower SINR threshold for PUCCH power command decision

ulpcLowqualSch.description: Lower threshold of the power control window for the SINR (signal quality) for PUSCH / SRS component
ulpcLowqualSch.fullName: Lower SINR threshold for PUSCH power command decision

ulpcMinQualIAw.description:
Minimum quality measure for interference-aware UL-PC. Target SINR for UEs in poor conditions cannot go below a limit defined by this parameter even if they generate higher UL interference.
Defines a minimum quality level in linear scale that is a multiplier to a reference SINR calculated from ulpcRefPwrIAw and the UE's UL signal plus noise.
ulpcMinQualIAw.fullName: Minimum UL quality for interference-aware UL-PC

ulpcMinWaitForPc.description: Minimum number of TTIs (ms) that must pass before another UL power decision is made for a UE.
ulpcMinWaitForPc.fullName: Minimum waiting time for next UL-PC decision

ulpcRarespTpc.description: TPC command indicated in the Random Access response related to Random Access message 3 or 1st scheduled uplink transmission.
ulpcRarespTpc.fullName: TPC command in random access response

ulpcReadPeriod.description:
Time interval for sending averaged RSSI and SINR values to the decision matrix to determine power corrections in closed-loop uplink power control.
The value range is split in two parts: 
Values 10 ... 1000 indicate that discontinuous filtering is ON (i.e. during times of inactivity, RSSI/SINR target values will drift towards their window centers); filter read-out period = parameter value
values 1010 ... 2000 indicate that discontinuous filtering is OFF; filter read-out period = parameter value - 1000.

ulsFdPrbAssignAlg.description:
Scheduler Type for FD scheduler
Defines the scheduling method which shall be applied in frequency domain for the scheduler in UL
- the "RoundRobinFD" scheduler assigns the physical resources equally fair to the UEs selected by the TD scheduler until the PRBs are sufficient for the service or the physical resources of the cell are exhaust
- the "ExhaustiveFD" scheduler assigns in the priority sequence defined by the TD scheduler as many physical resources as possible to the UEs until the number of PRBs are sufficient for the service or the resources of the cell are exhaust
- the "MixedFD" scheduler is a joint FD scheduler which assigns the PRBs for SRB and GBR bearers by the exhaustive FD scheduler and the PRBs for the nonGBR bearers by the Round Robin FD scheduler to the UEs.

ulsMaxPacketAgg.description:
Maximum number of aggregated VoIP packets in UL (with Inter Arrival Time of 20 ms)
Defines the maximum number of VoIP packets which may be aggregated for UL transmission based on a IAT of 20 ms. If the IAT of the VoIP packets is 10 ms the maximum packet aggregation is {1,3,5,7}.
Note that values of the parameter are {1,2,3,4} regardless of Inter Arrival Time, therefore following mapping is used to configure UL Packet Aggregation for IAT of 10ms – ulsMaxPacketAgg value (aggregation level with IAT of 10ms) -> 1 (1), 2 (3), 3 (5), 4 (7).

ulsMinTbs.description:

The upper limit of the range is defined equal to the TBS belonging to modulation order 2 and 10 PRBs.

ulsSchedMethod.description:
Defines the scheduling method which shall be applied in the cell for the UL branch.
Selects the method for the scheduling of the UEs in UL. 
For FDD cells, three methods can be chosen - the channel unaware UL scheduler, the interference aware UL scheduler and the channel aware UL scheduler.
For TDD cells, two methods can be chosen - the channel unaware UL scheduler and the channel aware UL scheduler.

actFastMimoSwitch.description:
Enables 'Fast Adaptive MIMO Switching' for Closed Loop MIMO modes based on PMI/RI reports sent by UEs if actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'true'.
Enables 'Dynamic MIMO Switching' if actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false'.
actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'true': Activation of 'Fast Adaptive MIMO Switching'
'Fast adaptive MIMO Switching' supports fast rank selection and fast codebook based precoding of data transmission using closed loop feedback of precoding matrix indicator (PMI) in combination with rank indicator (RI). PMI and RI reporting delays shall be minimized by periodic and aperiodic reports sent by UEs in order to optimize PMI closed loop gains in combination with optimized rank selection.  

actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false': Activation of 'Dynamic MIMO Switching'
'Dynamic MIMO Switching' supports RI and CQI based rank selection after filtering of CQI and RI reports sent by the UE. 'Dynamic MIMO Switching' is using RI and CQI thresholds for rank selection by comparison with filtered values. The threshold parameters 'mimoClCqiThD', 'mimoClCqiThU', 'mimoClRiThD', 'mimoClRiThU' are activated and used for rank switching.

Downlink MIMO mode must be set to 'Closed Loop Mimo'. No other modes are supported.

For better performance it is recommended to activate also the feature LTE980 '4Rx IRC for 4RX Path'.

actRepeaterMode.description:
Defines mode of the the radio module or RIU unit.

The "actRepeaterMode" parameter value Coupled needs to be used for coupled mode cells (R type configuration), value Dedicated for dedicated mode cells (cell have resources only from RIU unit) and value None for all other cells (cells do not have resources from RIU unit).

Possible modes are None, Dedicated and Coupled.

The Coupled is supported only with Configuration Type R.

The RIU is able to work either in Dedicated or Coupled mode also in case a RF unit is chained via it.

Super cell configurations are not released in conjunction with Repeater Interface Units.


If a new LNCEL instance is created with repeater mode ‘Dedicated’ then eNB will not trigger eNB restart but only ‘cell locking’.

actSdlc.description:

Note: A cell that is using a "supplemental downlink carrier" is using a carrier located in any FDD band. SDLC cells are operated on downlink only and can be used only as secondary cells (SCells) in downlink carrier aggregation. Otherwise, the cells appears as barred to UEs.
When local restrictions for uplink apply, also carriers on other frequencies might be configured for downlink operation only.

Carriers that are for use on downlink only are specified/indicated by LNBTS-sdlcFreqList.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

activatedMimoTM.description:
This parameter configures the selection of the Closed Loop MIMO transmission mode TM4 or TM9 depending on the capability of the UE. Up to 4 spatial multiplexing layers can be supported based on TM4 (MIMO4x4-TM4) or TM9 (MIMO4x4-TM9, MIMO8x2-8pTM9 or MIMO8x4-8pTM9).

The following settings for the parameter activatedMimoTM are supported to configure the selection of the transmission mode for closed loop single user downlink MIMO modes configurations:
- activatedMimoTM == "TM4": all UEs select TM4 
- activatedMimoTM == "TM9": all TM9 capable UEs select TM9; all other legacy Rel.8,9 UEs select TM4
- activatedMimoTM == "TM9_maxLayer": UEs supporting up to 4 spatial multiplexing layers based on TM9 and maximum two layers based on TM4 select transmission mode 9. All other UEs select TM4.

Notes: 
(1) The parameter 'activatedMimoTM' is configurable for several Closed Loop Mimo modes (dlMimoMode: "Closed Loop MIMO (4x4) OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'" and "Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)" Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)") to control the selection of the transmission mode.
(2) The setting  activatedMimoTM == "TM9_maxLayer" is only configurable if dlMimoMode=="Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)".

addNumDrbRadioReasHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active DRBs in the cell accessing the cell via HO with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActDrb.
Hand over traffic shall have some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..1650 (recommended: 60)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..2400 (recommended: 90)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..1890 (recommended: 60)

AirScale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1800 (recommended: 60)
- for 15MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..3600 (recommended: 90)

The range of this parameter may be adapated considering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.

- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..1650 (recommended: 90)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..2400 (recommended: 135)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..1890 (recommended: 90)

AirScale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions):
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1800 (recommended: 90)
- for 15MHz and 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..3600 (recommended: 135)

The range of this parameter may be adapated considering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.

addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active GBRs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumQci1Drb.
Hand over traffic shall have some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum additional margin depends on the Uplink-downlink configuration of the cell. The following values are allowed:
(1) tddFrameConf  is set to '1'(sa1)
Max value: 300 for 10 MHz and 400 for 15 MHz and 20 MHz
Default value: 16 for 10 MHz and 15 MHz and 20 MHz

(2) tddFrameConf  is set to '2'(sa2)
Max value: 150 for 10 MHz and 200 for 15 MHz and 20 MHz
Default value: 12 for 10 MHz and 15 MHz and 20 MHz

AirScale:
The maximum additional margin depends on the Uplink-downlink configuration of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..150 (recommended: 16)
- for 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..200 (recommended: 16)
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..150 (recommended: 12)
- for 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..200 (recommended: 12)
the range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling
addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo.fullName: Add number QCI1 DRB for radioReasHo

addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active GBRs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "Time Critical HO". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumQci1Drb.
The parameter is only relevant if "actEnhAcAndGbrServices" is set to False and ignored otherwise.

Hand over traffic has some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum additional margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:

Values for AirScale (FSMr3 in brackets)

blankedPucch.description:
Defines the pointer to PRB from where the CQI-allocation shall start in order to leave some PRBs free and therefore to avoid interference with neighbor bands. 
When set to 0 the feature 'Flexible UL Bandwidth'  is deactivated.

The 'blankedPucch' is the number of blanked PUCCH PRBs, counted inward from the band edges, and indicating the sum of PRBs from upper and from lower edge. They are counted into (i.e. part of) the nCqiRb value.
When set to values different from 0 all the PRBs from 0 up to 'blankedPucch' value are not utilized by the PUCCH allocation algorithm for allocating the periodic CQI.
In other words all those PRBs up to blankedPucch are skipped by the periodic CQI allocation algorithm.
 
Example: blankedPucch = 6 would mean that CQI-allocation will start from the seventh PRB, the PRB #6. 
All the PRB up to the PRB#6 excluded (3 at each BW edge accordingly to PUCCH physical allocation policy) are left free, to avoid interferences with neighbor bands supported by other radio technologies.

The configuration of the blanked PRBs region in one operators network shall be the same for all the cells having same E-UTRA Operating Band, same channel bandwidth and same center carrier frequency (i.e. same Transmission bandwidth configuration according to 3GPP-36.104).

In case of simultaneous activation of feature LTE46 'Channel-aware Scheduler (UL)', SRS configuration must avoid that SRS signal is sent within the blanked RF area. 

This parameter is ignored by the system if LTE3230 UL interference offsets is activated. LTE3230 uses its own pre-defined configuration data.

This parameter is ignored by the system if feature LTE4738-RP001783 is active (that is if actDynamicSharedSpectrum == TRUE). Instead, in LTE4738-RP001783, blankedPucch is internally set by eNodeB to: blankedPucch= 2 * max(numBlankDlPrbsDown, numBlankDlPrbsUp).

dlChBw.description:
Downlink channel bandwidth defines the DL bandwidth for the eNode-B transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks.
The downlink channel bandwidth mapping to number of Physical Resource Blocks is:
1.4 MHz = 6 DL PRBS
3.0 MHz = 15 DL PRBS
5.0 MHz = 25 DL PRBS 
10.0 MHz = 50 DL PRBS 
15.0 MHz = 75 DL PRBS
20.0 MHz = 100 DL PRBS

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

Following configuration rules need to be considered:

FSMD:
maximum downlink channel bandwidth is 10 MHz if more than 2 cells are configured.

FSME: 
maximum downlink channel bandwidth is 10 MHz if more than 3 cells are configured.

Cell bandwidth 1.4 MHz:
- is not supported with FSMD/FSME

If a 'SuperCell' is activated (actSuperCell set to 'true') the bandwidth usage is limited to 5 MHz, 10 MHz, 15 MHz and 20 MHz.

dlpcMimoComp.description:
Sets the compensation in 'TXDiv', '4-way TXDiv', 2x2 MIMO SM, 4x2 MIMO SM , 4x4 MIMO SM, 8x4 MIMO SM case into the DL power control.
Compensation of MIMO Coverage effects for MIMO Spatial Multiplexing and MIMO Diversity 
The parameter determines the power compensation factor for antenna-specific maximum power in case of a downlink transmission using at least two TX antennas. This means that every single subcarrier power determined for multiple TX antenna transmission is reduced by this factor. The parameter does not apply in case of a single TX (TM1) transmission, and thus neither affects the power of cell-specific reference signal transmission. Note that only the limited set of dlpcMimoComp values (-3dB, 0dB, 1.77dB, 3dB, 4.77dB, 6dB) can be communicated to the UE due to p-a signaling restrictions and the extended range has been determined only for finetuning purposes. Please be informed that Nokia does not quarantee a successful DL transmission using amplitude dependent modulations, especially 64QAM, if other values than the values presented in the limited set (-3dB, 0dB, 1.77dB, 3dB, 4.77dB, 6dB) are used. 
Please note, that if the Cell-Specific Reference Symbol Power Boost is activated by setting the dlRsBoost parameter, only the values 0dB and 3dB are allowed for dlpcMimoComp.

fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.description:
The four layer MIMO average spectral efficiency is used by the throughput check during SCell addition as follows .
If the throughput metric after the SCell addition is greater than the throughput metric before the SCell addition then this SCell addition is admitted. Otherwise this SCell addition is rejected. The throughput metric is the sum of xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff*bandwidth of the UE’s serving cells. Where xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with two layer MIMO on a given serving cell respectively xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with four layer MIMO on a given serving cell.

A reasonable value of the parameter can be derived from the existing KPI LTE_5747a "DL Spectral efficiency" as follows. The KPI shall be collected in conditions where all UEs are four layer MIMO capable in this cell in order not to underestimate the average value (with dlMimoMode set to "Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)" or "Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)").

The throughput check is not used by setting the parameter value to "0.5" i.e. any SCell addition will be always admitted by the check if twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff = fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff in all involved cells.
fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.fullName: Four layer MIMO average spectral efficiency

highLoadGbrDl.description:
This parameter defines the high load for the DL GBR resources. The value represents a percentage of PRBs available to GBR in the cell. 

A cell is considered 'non-balanced' if any load component has reached its highLoad threshold.

highLoadNonGbrDl.description:
This parameter defines the high load for the DL non-GBR resources. The value represents a percentage of the non-GBR load scale 0 and 100. 

A cell is considered 'non-balanced' if any load component has reached its highLoad threshold.

highLoadPdcch.description:
This parameter defines the high load for the PDCCH. The value represents a percentage of the available PDCCH resources in the cell.

A cell is considered 'non-balanced' if any load component has reached its highLoad threshold.

maxNumActDrb.description:
Threshold for the maximum number of established DRBs in the cell. 

The maximum number of established DRBs depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..1650 (recommended: 600)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..2400 (recommended: 900)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..1890 (recommended: 900)

AirScale:
The maximum number of established DRBs depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1800 (recommended: 600)
- for 15MHz and 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..3600 (recommended: 900)

The range of this parameter may be adapated considering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.

maxNumActUE.description:
Threshold for the maximum number of UEs in the cell with established DRB.
The maximum number of UEs in the cell with established DRB.

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..550 (recommended: 200)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..800 (recommended: 300)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..630 (recommended: 200)

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..600 in AirScale (recommended: 200)
- for 15MHz and 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1200 in AirScale (recommended: 300)

In case baseband pooling is activated the value of these parameters may be internally adapted by the system based on the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.

maxNumCaConfUe3c.description:
Threshold to limit the maximum number of carrier aggregation configured UEs in a PCell (P-LNCEL); 3c (3 carriers) indicates that these UEs have 1 PCell (P-LNCEL) and 2 or 3 SCells (S-LNCEL).
Carrier aggregated UEs with 2 or more SCells need a higher amount of resources (PUCCH) compared with single carrier UEs as long as UL signalling is done only via PCell. That's why the information 3c is relevant.

In case the threshold is modified online and the value is decreased, existing CA-UEs may stay in the cell, but the new value applies to new admission checks only.
maxNumCaConfUe3c.fullName: Max number carrier aggr configured UEs 3 Carriers

maxNumCaConfUeDc.description:
Threshold to limit the maximum number of carrier aggregation configured UEs in a PCell (P-LNCEL); Dc (Double carrier) indicates that these UEs have 1 PCell (P-LNCEL) and only 1 SCell (S-LNCEL).
Carrier aggregated UEs with 1 SCell  need double amount of UL resources compared with single carrier UEs as long as UL signalling is done only via PCell. That's why the information Dc is relevant.

In case the threshold is modified online and the value is decreased, existing CA-UEs may stay in the cell, but the new value applies to new admision checks only.
maxNumCaConfUeDc.fullName: Max number Carrier Aggr configured UEs double carrier

maxNumQci1Drb.description:
Threshold for the maximum number of established QCI1-GBR-DRBs in the cell.
The parameter is only relevant if ""actEnhAcAndGbrServices"" is set to 'false' and ignored otherwise.
QCI1-DRBs are additional data radio bearers in the cell and are also checked against the threshold maxNumActDrb. 

The maximum additional margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:

Values for AirScale (FSMr3 in brackets)
1.4 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 10 (10)
3 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 60 (60)
5 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 200 (200)
10 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 200 (400)
15 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 300 (500)
20 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 300 (600)

Please note that the default value is not suitable for all bandwidths. The recommended values are:


1.4 MHz bandwidth 5
3 MHz bandwidth 25
5 MHz bandwidth 75
10 MHz bandwidth 100
15 MHz bandwidth  100
20 MHz bandwidth 100

Dependencies:
maxNumQci1Drb + max( addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo) must be less than the margin values for the used bandwidth (see values above (10, 60, 200, 400, 500, 600))

multNumUeHighPrioUciGrant.description:
The parameter limits the number of UCI-only grants scheduled per TTI. 
The product multNumUeHighPrioUciGrant* maxNumUeUl defines the max. number of UEs eligible for high priority UCI-only grants allowed per TTI.
The result of the product multNumUeHighPrioUciGrant* maxNumUeUl shall be rounded down to the next integer number.
multNumUeHighPrioUciGrant.fullName: Adjust max number of high prio UCI-only grants per TTI

The parameter is used in the UL scheduler to determine candidate UEs for a) low priority UCI-only grants and b) high priority UCI-only grants.
Higher values of this parameter lead to longer timer periods until UE becomes a candidate for low/high priority UCI-only grant.
multUciGrant.fullName: Adjust timer for low and high priority UCI-only grants

numBlankDlPrbsUp.description: Number of downlink Physical Resource Blocks (PRBs) blanked at the upper end of the spectrum
numBlankDlPrbsUp.fullName: Number of downlink PRBs blanked at the upper end of the spectrum

numOfCsiRsAntennaPorts.description:
Number of CSI-RS ports 
In 3GPP 2,4,8 CSI-RS ports are supported. 
Currently 4 ports for LTE1987 are supported.
Currently 8 ports for LTE4300 are supported.

pMaxSubCell.description: This parameter defines the maximum output power of the subcell per antenna carrier in dBm.

pdcchLoadLevel.description:
The PDCCH load level configures the percentage of used PDCCH CCEs on all available PDCCH CCEs.
Used PDCCH CCEs include all CCEs of CSS/USS space and dummy PDCCHs. 
This parameter will not restrict normal PDCCH allocation. Only when normal PDCCH load has not reach the level defined by this parameter, dummy PDCCHs will be added.
This parameter is mandatory when actPdcchLoadGen is set to "true".

pdcchLoadPsdOffset.description:
This paramter defines the dummy PDCCH PSD offset to flat PSD. 
Maximum dummy PDCCH PSD is calculated based on flat PSD and this offset. 
If there is not enough power remaining for dummy PDCCHs, smaller dummy PDCCH PSD will be used.
This parameter is mandatory when actPdcchLoadGen is set to "true".

prachCS.description:
Preamble cyclic shift defines the configuration which is used for preamble generation. The configuration determines how many cyclic shifts are needed to generate preamble. 
Configuration also defines the zero correlation zone and respective maximum cell range.

prachConfIndex.description: Defines allowed system frame and subframe numbers for random access attempts, and the preamble format.

prachFreqOff.description:
Defines the location in frequency for the PRACH transmissions.
For UL scheduling its recommended that PRACH is located next to PUCCH either on the lower or upper edge of the bandwidth because UL PRB allocation for UE consist of consecutive PRBs. If there is a small gap between PUCCH and PRACH PRBs, UL scheduler cannot utilize those PRBs effectively. prachFreqOffset for each bandwidth should be set aligned with the parameters determining the number of PRBs for PUCCH, so that PRACH is located next to PUCCH.
It is recommended to set the value such that PRACH does not overlap with PUCCH RBs and is located adjacent to PUCCH; thus recommended parameter alternatives are: 
1) roundup((MaxPucchResourceSize+blankedPucch)/2) if it is located at the lower edge, or
2) ulChBw(in PRBs)-6-roundup((MaxPucchResourceSize+blankedPucch)/2 ) if it is located at the upper edge of the PUSCH area

The MaxPucchResourceSize in above defines the maximum number of allocated PUCCH RBs, and it defined in nCqiRb parameter.

prachHsFlag.description:
High speed flag for PRACH preamble generation determines whether an unrestricted or a restricted set has to be used by the UE.
false = Unrestricted; true  = Restricted

prsConfigurationIndex.description:
Determines the periodicity and offset of the PRS occasions for FDD

PRS period based on the configured value of prsConfigurationIndex:
7, 14, 27, 47, 67, 87, 107, 127, 147, 151: 160 ms period
471: 320 ms period
1111: 640 ms period
2391: 1280 ms period
The periodicity and offset can be computed according to 3GPP TS 36.211 Rel9

Note: All Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode may be released when this parameter is online modified.

prsNumDlFrames.description: Number of DL Frames that are used for PRS per PRS occasion for FDD. With this PRS transmission can be repeated within a PRS occasion in order to increase the hearability of PRS

pucchNAnCs.description:
Number of cyclic shifts for PUCCH formats 1/1a/1b in a resource block used for a mix of formats 1/1a/b and 2/2a/2b.
This parameter is one of the parameters in a set which defines the maximum PUCCH allocation called as MaxPucchResourceSize.
pucchNAnCs.fullName: PUCCH cyclic shift for mixed formats

redFreqOffset.description: This parameter defines the reduced frequency offset from carrier center frequency to sub-block edge at both downlink and uplink direction. However, uplink direction is not applicable for supplemental downlink carrier.

remCandSubCellUlSinrHys.description:
Defines the UL SINR hysteresis on top of candSubCellUlSinrOffset for candidate subcell to be removed.
If the SINR gap between serving subcell and current candidate subcell is larger than candSubCellUlSinrOffset plus this parameter this candidate subcell will be changed to measurement-only subcell.
remCandSubCellUlSinrHys.fullName: UL SINR Hys for removing candidate subcell

repCandSubCellUlSinrHys.description:
Defines the UL SINR hysteresis to replace candidate subcell by a measurement subcell.
If one measurement-only subcell's SINR is larger than current candidate subcell's SINR plus repCandSubCellUlSinrHys, this measurement-only subcell will replace current candidate subcell as new candidate subcell.
repCandSubCellUlSinrHys.fullName: UL SINR Hys for replacing candidate subcell

rfSensitivity.description:
Sensitivity setting for a RF unit.
Sensitivity of a RF unit can be deteriorated with this parameter. Parameter is only applicable to cells created from radio module(s) supporting RF sensitivity setting.

rootSeqIndex.description: The premable generation is started from the Root Sequence which is pointed by the logical root sequence number. 64 preambles can be transmitted in the PRACH frame. If one root is not enough to generate all the 64 preambles, then the consecutive number is selected until the full set is generated. RACH root sequence is cell specific information and neighbouring cells should have a different value. RACH root sequence is transmitted in system information.

selectOuterPuschRegion.description:
This parameter activates the feature LTE825 'Uplink outer region scheduling' by selecting the target UL outer scheduling region for PUSCH and PRACH. When the feature is activated, additional PRBs in the outer region of the UL spectrum are allocated for PUSCH and PRACH scheduling.
The feature LTE825 'Uplink outer region scheduling' is deactivated if parameter is set to 'None'.
The outer region is conform to the blanked PUCCH PRBs.

slimRfFilterDL.description: Selects the downlink RF filtering profile applied at the radio, controlling filter characteristics (e.g. roll-off/steepness) used to manage adjacent-channel interference; 'Nominal' selects the standard/default profile.

slimRfFilterUL.description: Selects the uplink RF filtering profile applied at the radio, analogous to slimRfFilterDL.

srsActivation.description: Activates/Deactivates srs (sounding reference symbol) feature in Cell.

srsPwrOffset.description:
UE specific power offset to be used for Sounding Reference Signal transmission power calculation in UE uplink power control equation (P3).

Note: The actual power offset depends on value of deltaTfEnabled.
For deltaTfEnabled = 'true' (KS = 1.25) the actual parameter value is "srsPwrOffset-3" corresponding to the dB-range of -3 dB to 12 dB in steps of 1 dB. For deltaTfEnabled = 'false' (KS = 0) the actual parameter value is "-10.5 + 1.5 * srsPwrOffset" value corresponding to the dB-range -10.5 dB to 12 dB in steps of 1.5 dB.
srsPwrOffset.fullName: Power offset for SRS transmission power calculation

subCellId.description: This parameter defines the subcell for which the maximum transmission power shall be defined.

subCellSwitchUlSinrHys1.description:
Defines the UL SINR hysteresis for subcell switch.
The parameter defines the UL SINR hysteresis for subcell switch from candidate to serving subcell. It will be used in conjunction with subcellSinrFiltConst1.
It is recommended to keep the parameter set to default values.
subCellSwitchUlSinrHys1.fullName: UL SINR hysteresis for subcell switch 1

subCellSwitchUlSinrHys2.description:
Additional UL SINR hysteresis for subcell switch.
The paramter defines an additional UL SINR hysteresis for subcell switch from candidate to serving subcell. It is applicable when prachHsFlag is set to true and will be used in conjunction with subcellSinrFiltConst 2.
It is recommended to keep the parameter set to the default value.
subCellSwitchUlSinrHys2.fullName: UL SINR hysteresis for subcell switch 2

subcellSinrFiltConst1.description:
Coefficient of the exponential filter applied to SINR measurements from the subcells.
The value of subcellSinrFiltConst1 determines the settling time of the filter applied to SINR measurements. It is used in conjunction with parameter subCellSwitchUlSinrHys1.
If prachHsFlag is set to false, a default value of 0.9 shall be used.
If prachHsFlag is set to true, a default value 0.3 shall be used.
It is recommended to keep the parameter set to the default values.

subcellSinrFiltConst2.description:
Additional coefficient of the exponential filter applied to SINR measurements from the subcells.
The value of subcellSinrFiltConst2 allows additional tuning of the settling time of the filter applied to SINR measurements. It is used in conjunction with parameter subCellSwitchUlSinrHys2 and applicable when prachHsFlag is set to true.
It is recommended to keep the parameter set to the default value.

syncSigTxMode.description: The parameter determines whether NB-IoT Primary and Secondary Synchronization Signals (NPSS, NSSS) are transmitted into a cell via one antenna port (SingleTx) or via all antenna ports using TX diversity with Precoding Vector Switching (PVS).

twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.description:
The two layer MIMO average spectral efficiency is used by the throughput check during SCell addition as follows .
If the throughput metric after the SCell addition is greater than the throughput metric before the SCell addition then this SCell addition is admitted. Otherwise this SCell addition is rejected. The throughput metric is the sum of xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff*bandwidth of the UE’s serving cells. Where xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with two layer MIMO on a given serving cell respectively xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with four layer MIMO on a given serving cell.

A reasonable value of the parameter can be derived from the existing KPI LTE_5747a "DL Spectral efficiency" with dlMimoMode set to "Closed Loop Mimo" or "Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)" or "Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)".

The throughput check is not used by setting the parameter value to "0.5" i.e. any SCell addition will be always admitted by the check if twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff = fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff in all involved cells.
twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.fullName: Two layer MIMO average spectral efficiency

uLMeasAlphaBase.description:
Basic value for alpha. This value is recalculated according cqiPerNp and used in the exponetial filters for UL measurements.
The value of uLMeasAlphaBase determines the setteling time of the UL measurement filter and should be chosen according uLMeasN.

uLMeasHystJT.fullName: UL measurement joint transmission region hysteresis

uLMeasHystSuMu.fullName: UL measurement SU MU transmission region hysteresis

uLMeasN.description:
Defines the number of samples to be received before measurement evaluation and switching the filter to state reliable.

After N samples a new evaluation of region/group assignment is triggered.
A larger value of uLMeasN leads to less variance of location estimation.

uLMeasThrJtCsiRs.description: Defines the threshold of the UE  UL pathloss ratio to both tx point of a Liquid Cell. It separates the Joint transmission region and the single transmission region.
uLMeasThrJtCsiRs.fullName: UL measurement joint transmission region threshold

uLMeasThrSuMuCsiRs.description:
Defines the threshold of the UE  UL pathloss ratio to both tx point of a Liquid Cell. It separates the single user transmission region and the multi user transmission region.
The smallest value must be set equal greater than uLMeasThrJTCsiRs.
uLMeasThrSuMuCsiRs.fullName: UL measurement SU MU transmission region threshold

ulChBw.description:
Uplink channel bandwidth defines the UL bandwidth for the eNB transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks.

If a 'SuperCell' is activated (actSuperCell set to 'true') the bandwidth usage is limited to 5 MHz, 10 MHz, 15 MHz and 20 MHz.
Uplink channel bandwidth defines the UL bandwidth for the eNB transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks.

The uplink channel bandwidth mapping to number of Physical Resource Blocks is: 
1.4 MHz = 6 UL PRBS
3.0 MHz = 15 UL PRBS
5.0 MHz = 25 UL PRBS 
10.0 MHz = 50 UL PRBS 
15.0 MHz = 75 UL PRBS
20.0 MHz = 100 UL PRBS

Maximum 10 MHz uplink channel bandwidth may be used with single FSMD to configure more than 2 cells or with single FSME to configure more than 3 cells.

1.4 MHz and 3.0 MHz uplink channel bandwidth is only supported  on FSMF.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

ulCombinationMode.description:
Identifies the uplink combination mode.

Recommendations for balancing increased cell throughput and link level gain:
If dlMimoMode is set to 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)', ulCombinationMode is recommended to be configured to 'IRC'.

ulInterferenceOffset.description:
This parameter adds an interference value to the UL measurements, to bias the selection of the UE's preferred scheduling area away from a PRB region with power restrictions.
Value (in percent of the A-MPR or equivalent power reduction) that the UL scheduler adds to the measured UE's UL interference in a PRB range where UL Tx power restrictions apply (A-MPR etc., from TS36.101), on top of the value needed to compensate the UL power reduction given by the scenario identified by ulPwrRestrScen (band18_26: 1.5 dB; band30_NS21: 3 dB; band13_NS07: {8dB or 12dB for lower PUSCH region depending on UL grant size, 0dB or 12dB for center PUSCH region depending on UL grant size, 0dB for upper PUSCH region}; band1_NS05: {11dB for lower PUSCH region, 0dB or 3dB or 5dB for center PUSCH region depending on UL grant size, 1dB or 5dBdB for upper PUSCH region depending on UL grant size}). Example: an offset of +50% adds 0.75 dB on top of the 1.5 dB that is required for compensation in the band18_26 scenario.
This serves to bias the selection of the UE's preferred scheduling area away from the PRB range with Tx power restrictions. No offset is added to PM counter values.

ulpcRarespTpc.description: TPC command indicated in the Random Access response related to Random Access message 3 or 1st scheduled uplink transmission.
ulpcRarespTpc.fullName: TPC command in random access response

ulsMaxCrSmallPusch.description: Nokia RAN configuration parameter related to "uls maximum Cr Small Physical Uplink Shared Channel" on the LNCEL_FDD object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

ulsPuschMaskLength.description: Length of the PUSCH mask in the UL spectrum. The length is defined by number of PRBs.

ulsPuschMaskStart.description: Start PRB of the PUSCH mask in the UL spectrum.
ulsPuschMaskStart.fullName: Start PRB of the PUSCH mask

a2TimeToTriggerActTdscdmaMeas.description:
Time to trigger activation of TD-SCDMA  measurements
Duration for which the event A2 must be valid, such that TD-SCDMA measurements are activated
a2TimeToTriggerActTdscdmaMeas.fullName: Time to trigger for A2 to activate TD-SCDMA measurement

act1TxIn2Tx.description: This is to activate Dual transmission mode 1 operation when 2 Tx RF unit can be used for two times 1Tx transmission in Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS)

act2CrsIn4Tx.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable 2 Crs In 4 transmit" on the LNCEL_TDD object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

act4RxForHighSpeedUEs.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable 4 receive For High Speed U Es" on the LNCEL_TDD object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actAdaptPrbNumForDlRetx.description: Enables dynamically adapting the number of PRBs allocated to a downlink HARQ retransmission, instead of using a fixed allocation size, to improve retransmission efficiency.

actAdptSectorBfWeight.description: Enables adaptive adjustment of beamforming weights per sector, used with Massive MIMO/AAS antennas to continuously optimise beam shape for the sector's traffic conditions.

actAutoPucchAlloc.description:
This parameter activates the automatic PUCCH configuration of the LNCEL. When activated a limited set of PUCCH parameter need to be configured in class MPUCCH belonging to the cell, all other parameter are assigned by the system itself automatically.

For disabled functionality the standard PUCCH remain available.

Note: Only if actAutoPucchAlloc of the LNCEL_FDD instance is activated, the configured value of actLbPucchReg is considered by the BTS.

actBfFallback.description:
Active/deactive the functionality of beamforming fallbacking
If actBfFallback is set to true, fallback functionality from beamforming to TxDiv is activated based on the thresholds defined in mimoBfslCqiThD and mimoBfslCqiThU.

actCEBB.description:
This parameter activates feature LTE1783 "Constrained Beamforming" per individual cell.

Constrained Beamforming in the cell will be functional only if the relative antenna element spacing of the antenna used for the cell is in range 0.470...0.525 lambda or 0.620...0.675 lambda.
Calculation:
relative antenna element spacing [lambda] = antennaElementSpacing [mm]/1000*earfcn[Hz]/(3*10^8 [m/s])

actDlAdaptNumOfMuLayers.description: Enables adaptively selecting the number of MU-MIMO spatial layers used for downlink scheduling, rather than a fixed number.

actDlBfUeHighBlerMitigation.description: Enables a mitigation mechanism that adjusts downlink beamforming for UEs experiencing a high Block Error Rate, aiming to restore link reliability.

actDlMuGainMax.description:
MU gain can be maximized by pairing as many RBGs as possible at the cost of violating legacy weighted round robin criterion.
GBR performance will not be affected by MU maximization.
This parameter is used for 8T8R DL MU MIMO.

actDlMuMimo.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate DL MU-MIMO in a cell. It is used to support TM8 or TM9 MU-MIMO.

actDlMuMimoZF.description: Enables use of Zero-Forcing (ZF) precoding for downlink MU-MIMO scheduling, a precoding technique that nulls interference between co-scheduled users.

actDlNewtxSchedBasedOnBuffer.description: Enables scheduling new (non-retransmission) downlink transmissions based on actual data buffer occupancy rather than a fixed/blind scheduling approach.

actDlOllaEnhForBfModeCtrl.description: Enables an enhancement to the downlink Outer Loop Link Adaptation (OLLA) algorithm specifically for controlling beamforming mode selection.

actDlOllaInitEnhForTm8RankSwitch.description: Enables an enhancement to how the downlink OLLA algorithm is (re)initialised when a UE performs a MIMO rank switch under Transmission Mode 8 (dual-layer beamforming).

actDlPreGrouping.description: Enables 'pre-grouping' of UEs for downlink MU-MIMO scheduling, pre-selecting suitable UE pairs/groups before the final per-TTI scheduling decision.

actDlQoeEnhance.description: Enables a downlink Quality-of-Experience enhancement feature that influences scheduling/link adaptation to improve perceived application performance for end users.

actDlRetxSchedBasedOnPdcchCap.description: Enables scheduling downlink retransmissions with awareness of remaining PDCCH capacity, avoiding retransmissions being blocked by control-channel congestion.

actDldynTargetBler.description:
This parameter activates the function of downlink dynamic target BLER 
When this parameter is set to 'true', downlink dynamic target BLER shall be activated for the UEs configured with TM2/3/4/7, the relationship of CQIstepup and CQIstepdown shall update according to different target BLER in corresponding to the current modulation order. When DL dynamic target BLER and 256QAM feature (LTE2479) are activated together, the 256QAM capable UEs shall use the legacy algorithm instead of dynamic target BLER algorithm.

actDualOllaForTM8.description: Enables a dual, per-layer Outer Loop Link Adaptation algorithm specifically for Transmission Mode 8 (dual-layer beamforming), improving link adaptation accuracy on each spatial layer independently.

actExtCellHs.description: Enables an extended cell configuration/handling mode ('Hs' likely High-Speed or extended-range), affecting how the cell handles large coverage radius or fast-moving UEs in a TDD deployment.

actExtNcs.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Ext Ncs" on the LNCEL_TDD object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

actExtendedDelayToUseBfWeightTimer.description: Enables an extended hysteresis delay before newly computed beamforming weights are applied/switched to, reducing the frequency of beam changes.

actFastMimoSwitch.description:
Enables 'Fast Adaptive MIMO Switching' for Closed Loop MIMO modes based on PMI/RI reports sent by UEs if actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'true'.
Enables 'Dynamic MIMO Switching' if actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false'.
actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'true': Activation of 'Fast Adaptive MIMO Switching'
'Fast adaptive MIMO Switching' supports fast rank selection and fast codebook based precoding of data transmission using closed loop feedback of precoding matrix indicator (PMI) in combination with rank indicator (RI). PMI and RI reporting delays shall be minimized by periodic and aperiodic reports sent by UEs in order to optimize PMI closed loop gains in combination with optimized rank selection.  

actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false': Activation of 'Dynamic MIMO Switching'
'Dynamic MIMO Switching' supports RI and CQI based rank selection after filtering of CQI and RI reports sent by the UE. 'Dynamic MIMO Switching' is using RI and CQI thresholds for rank selection by comparison with filtered values. The threshold parameters 'mimoClCqiThD', 'mimoClCqiThU', 'mimoClRiThD', 'mimoClRiThU' are activated and used for rank switching.

actMMimo.description: This parameter activates Massive MIMO with AAS mMIMO capable antenna system.

actMMimoVirtualResLB.description: Enables load balancing of resources across the virtual sectors/beams created by a Massive MIMO antenna array.

actPdcchLoadGen.description: This parameter controls the activation or deactivation of "Inter cell load generation for PDCCH".

actPdcchMultiplexing.description: Enables multiplexing multiple UEs' control information more efficiently onto the PDCCH control channel.

actRIAvoidance.description: This paramter activates 'TDD Remote Interference Avoidance' feature
actRIAvoidance.fullName: Activate TDD Remote Interference Avoidance feature

actRIMitigation.description: This is a feature flag to activate TDD Remote Interference Mitigation feature
actRIMitigation.fullName: Activate TDD Remote Interference Mitigation feature

actRIPAlarming.description: Parameter actRIPAlarming activates/deactivates RIP alarming in the LNCEL instance. RIP alarms for the LNCEL instance are only send if the parameter is set to value 'true'.

actReduceWimaxInterference.description:
Activates reduced WiMax interference.

Under scenario which have WiMAX co-existence, the parameter shall be set to true to indicate the co-existence of WiMAX.

Under scenario which has no WiMAX co-existence but has other vendor's TD-LTE in co-existence there are two options:
  - (1) to activate feature LTE1913, which requires configuring 'actReduceWimaxInterference' to 'true'  
  - (2) to activate feature LTE1388 to support SSP=4. This solution is preferred in this scenario, since it does not sacrifice the last symbol of normal uplink subframe #3 and #8.

actSFN.description: This parameter activates the combination of normal cells to one Single Frequency Network cell, in which same PCI is used for all subcells of the SFN cell.

actSdlc.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'Supplemental downlink carrier'.
Note: A cell that is using a "supplemental downlink carrier" is using a carrier located in any FDD band. SDLC cells are operated on downlink only and can be used only as secondary cells (SCells) in downlink carrier aggregation. Otherwise, the cells appears as barred to UEs.
When local restrictions for uplink apply, also carriers on other frequencies might be configured for downlink operation only.

Carriers that are for use on downlink only are specified/indicated by LNBTS-sdlcFreqList.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

actServRlqTputInterFreqLB.description: Activates use of combined Radio Link Quality and throughput criteria for inter-frequency load-balancing decisions on this TDD LTE cell.

actSuperCell.description: Activates the transmission of duplicated data streams via different RRHs in downlink, and the combination of uplink signals received from different RRHs.

actTmSwitch.description:
Activate or deactivate the dynamic transmission mode switch function
dlMimoMode is needed to be set to { 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' or  'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' } to enable TM3/TM9 mode switch because csiRsConfigInfo will only be configured when dlMimoMode is set to { 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' or  'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' }.

actUlMuMimo.description: This parameter activates or deactivates UL MU-MIMO in a cell.

actUlPwrRestrScn.description:
This parameter activates the feature A-MPR for "band48_NS27" by selecting a preconfigured UL power restriction scenario.
Use this parameter to select an UL power restriction defined in 3GPP TS36.101. An interference offset value must be present if actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none'.
actUlPwrRestrScn.fullName: Activate UL Power Restriction Scenario mask

actUlSps.description: Activation of UL Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) for UEs with Quality of Service Class Identifier 1 (QCI-1) bearers.

activatedMimoTM.description:
This parameter configures the selection of the Closed Loop MIMO transmission mode TM4 or TM9 depending on the capability of the UE. Up to 4 spatial multiplexing layers can be supported based on TM4 (MIMO4x4-TM4) or TM9 (MIMO4x4-TM9, MIMO8x2-8pTM9 or MIMO8x4-8pTM9).

The following settings for the parameter activatedMimoTM are supported to configure the selection of the transmission mode for closed loop single user downlink MIMO modes configurations:
- activatedMimoTM == "TM4": all UEs select TM4 
- activatedMimoTM == "TM9": all TM9 capable UEs select TM9; all other legacy Rel.8,9 UEs select TM4
- activatedMimoTM == "TM9_maxLayer": UEs supporting up to 4 spatial multiplexing layers based on TM9 and maximum two layers based on TM4 select transmission mode 9. All other UEs select TM4.

Notes: 
(1) The parameter 'activatedMimoTM' is configurable for several Closed Loop Mimo modes (dlMimoMode: "Closed Loop MIMO (4x4) OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'" and "Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)" Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)") to control the selection of the transmission mode.
(2) The setting  activatedMimoTM == "TM9_maxLayer" is only configurable if dlMimoMode=="Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)".

addNumDrbRadioReasHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active DRBs in the cell accessing the cell via HO with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActDrb.
Hand over traffic shall have some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..1650 (recommended: 60)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..2400 (recommended: 90)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..1890 (recommended: 60)

AirScale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1800 (recommended: 60)
- for 15MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..3600 (recommended: 90)

The range of this parameter may be adapated considering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.

addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active DRBs in the cell accessing the cell via HO with HO-cause: "Time Critical HO". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActDrb.
Hand over traffic shall have some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions):
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..1650 (recommended: 90)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..2400 (recommended: 135)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..1890 (recommended: 90)

AirScale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions):
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1800 (recommended: 90)
- for 15MHz and 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..3600 (recommended: 135)

The range of this parameter may be adapated considering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.

addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active GBRs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumQci1Drb.
Hand over traffic shall have some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum additional margin depends on the Uplink-downlink configuration of the cell. The following values are allowed:
(1) tddFrameConf  is set to '1'(sa1)
Max value: 300 for 10 MHz and 400 for 15 MHz and 20 MHz
Default value: 16 for 10 MHz and 15 MHz and 20 MHz

(2) tddFrameConf  is set to '2'(sa2)
Max value: 150 for 10 MHz and 200 for 15 MHz and 20 MHz
Default value: 12 for 10 MHz and 15 MHz and 20 MHz

AirScale:
The maximum additional margin depends on the Uplink-downlink configuration of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..150 (recommended: 16)
- for 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..200 (recommended: 16)
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..150 (recommended: 12)
- for 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..200 (recommended: 12)
the range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling
addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo.fullName: Add number QCI1 DRB for radioReasHo

addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active GBRs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "Time Critical HO". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumQci1Drb.
The parameter is only relevant if "actEnhAcAndGbrServices" is set to False and ignored otherwise.

Hand over traffic has some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum additional margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:

Values for AirScale (FSMr3 in brackets)
1.4 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 10 (10)
3 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 60 (60)
5 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 200 (200)
10 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 200 (400)
15 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 300 (500)
20 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 300 (600)

Note that the default value is not suitable for all bandwidths. The recommended values are:

1.4 MHz bandwidth  3
3 MHz bandwidth  8
5 MHz bandwidth 15
10 MHz bandwidth 20
15 MHz bandwidth 30
20 MHz bandwidth 40

Dependencies:
maxNumQci1Drb + max( addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo) must be less than the margin values for the used bandwidth (see values above. (10, 60, 200, 400, 500, 600))
addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo.fullName: Add number QCI1 DRB for timeCriticalHo

alarmThresholdCrossingTime.description:
Parameter alarmThresholdCrossingTime defines when a RIP alarm will be raised or cleared. When the RIP value is above/below the alarm threshold for the alarm threshold crossing time (e.g. 5 minutes) then the RIP alarm will be raised/cleared.
This parameter is used  for RIP alarms for Uplink Subframe and Special Subframe (applicable for TDD cell only).

alarmThresholdSpecialSF.description: Parameter alarmThresholdSpecialSF defines the threshold for the RIP alarming for special subframe. If the measured RIP value is above/below the threshold for at least Alarm Threshold Crossing Time (e.g. 5 minutes) an alarm with severity major is raised/cleared.

alarmThresholdULSF.description: Parameter alarmThresholdULSF defines the threshold for the RIP alarming for UL subframe. If the measured RIP value is above/below the threshold for at least Alarm Threshold Crossing Time (e.g. 5 minutes) an alarm with severity major is raised/cleared.

amrVoiceBRThreshold.description:
Voice call determination threshold for AMR WB as well as AMR NB.
For a QCI-1 bearer, if GBR requirement from S1AP is higher than amrVoiceBRThreshold, it is assumed this QCI-1 bearer carries a  AMR WB voice call, else it is assumed this QCI-1 bearer carries a AMR NB voice call.

A correct GBR requirement from S1AP is the precondition for correct SPS TBS selection. 
This parameter setting should refer to core network setting according to 3GPP TS26.114.

beamformingType.description:
Defines the beamforming type for which srsBandwidth and srsUePeriodicity are valid.
Two elements of srsDlMimoModeDepConf with same beamformingType are not allowed.

bfCqiThDown.description:
CQI threshold for switching from dual codeword to single codeword in case of TM8
If the current CQI is less than or equal to bfCqiThDown, OR current rank is less than or equal to bfRankThDown, then switching from dual codeword to single codeword for TM8.

bfCqiThUp.description:
CQI threshold for switching from single codeword to dual codeword in case of TM8
If the current CQI is bigger than bfCqiThUp, AND current rank is bigger than bfRankThUp, then switching from single codeword to dual codeword for TM8.

bfRankThDown.description:
Rank threshold for switching from dual codeword to single codeword in case of TM8.
If the current CQI is less than or equal to bfCqiThDown, or current rank is less than or equal to bfRankThDown, then switching from dual codeword to single codeword for TM8.

bfRankThUp.description:
Rank threshold for switching from single codeword to dual codeword in case of TM8
If the current CQI is bigger than bfCqiThUp, AND current rank is bigger than bfRankThUp, then switching from single codeword to dual codeword for TM8.

candSubCellUlSinrOffset.description:
Defines the maximum UL SINR offset to serving for candidate sub-cell selection.
If the SINR gap between serving sub-cell and a second sub-cell is less than this offset the second sub-cell can be selected as candidate sub-cell.
candSubCellUlSinrOffset.fullName: UL SINR offset for candidate sub-cell

chBw.description:
Channel Bandwidth defines the Downlink and Uplink bandwidth for the eNode-B transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks which is transmitted in the MIB. The Channel Bandwidth mapping to Number of Physical Resource Blocks is: 1.4 MHz = 6 PRB; 3.0 MHz = 15 PRB; 5.0 MHz = 25 PRB; 10.0 MHz = 50 PRB; 15.0 MHz = 75 PRB; 20.0 MHz = 100 PRB.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

cqiAperPollT.description: A polling period/interval controlling how often the scheduler triggers aperiodic CQI reports from UEs.

cqiAperPollTxSkip.description: Number of aperiodic CQI polling transmissions the scheduler skips, used to reduce PDCCH/UL-grant overhead spent polling for channel-quality reports.

cqiPerSbPeriodFactor.description:
If the periodicity of CQI/PMI reporting is N (in subframes),the wideband first precoding matrix indicator report has period
cqiPerSbPeriodFactor * N.

csBIALeftNeighborCell.description: Left Neighbor's LNCEL instance ID values as references to the Left Neighbor cell (LNCEL) of one cell

csBIARightNeighborCell.description: Right Neighbor's LNCEL instance ID values as references to the Right Neighbor cell (LNCEL) of one cell

csiRepSubmode.description: If a UE configured with TM9 and with 8 CSI-RS ports and configured periodic CSI reporting mode 1-1, mode 1-1 is configured to be either "submode1" or "submode2".

csiRsPwrOffset.description: Defines the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to CSI-RS EPRE

csiRsResourceConf.description: Defines the cell specific CSI-RS configuration for normal cyclic prefix
csiRsResourceConf.officialRange:
0: rsc0 
1: rsc1 
2: rsc2 
3: rsc3 
4: rsc4 
5: rsc5 
6: rsc6 
7: rsc7 
8: rsc8 
9: rsc9 
20: rsc20 
21: rsc21 
22: rsc22

csiRsSubfrConf.description:
Defines the cell specific CSI-RS subframe configuration 
0-4: 5ms period
5-14: 10ms period
15-34: 20ms period
35-74: 40ms period
75-154: 80ms period

Note: 
when CSI-RS periodicity is 5ms, CSI-RS subframe offset is csiRsSubfrConf(subframes)
when CSI-RS periodicity is 10ms, CSI-RS subframe offset is csiRsSubfrConf minus 5(subframes)
when CSI-RS periodicity is 20ms, CSI-RS subframe offset is csiRsSubfrConf minus 15(subframes)

dlInterferenceSpatialMode.description:
This parameter specifies the spatial mode for the downlink interference.

If dlMimoMode is set to 'SingleTX' then one element of the structure must be present with dlInterferenceSpatialMode 'SingleTx'.
If dlMimoMode is set to 'TXDiv', '4-way TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' , 'Closed Loop Mimo', 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' then one element of the structure must be present with dlInterferenceSpatialMode 'TXDiv'.
If dlMimoMode is set to 'Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' then both elements of the structure must be present, one with dlInterferenceSpatialMode 'TXDiv' and the other with dlInterferenceSpatialMode 'Single Stream Beamforming'.

This parameter indicates the CQI threshold above which the TM7, TM8 or TM9 UE can be selected as DL MU-MIMO candidate. This parameter is commonly used for both 8T8R and massive MIMO DL MU MIMO.
In 8T8R DL MU MIMO, this parameter indicates the CQI threshold above which the TM8 or TM9 UE can be selected as DL MU-MIMO candidate, This DL MU-MIMO candidate must be rank 1 UE.
In Massive MIMO DL MU MIMO, this parameter indicates the CQI threshold above which the TM7 or TM8 UE can be selected as DL MU-MIMO candidate.

"customized profile" means the operator can set the downlink sector beamforming weights via O&M interface.
Each profile name maps to the downlink sector beamforming weight of the specific antenna type(predefined profile) or the customized sector beamforming weight profile.

dlpcMimoComp.description:
Sets the compensation in 'TXDiv', '4-way TXDiv', 2x2 MIMO SM, 4x2 MIMO SM , 4x4 MIMO SM, 8x4 MIMO SM case into the DL power control.
Compensation of MIMO Coverage effects for MIMO Spatial Multiplexing and MIMO Diversity 
The parameter determines the power compensation factor for antenna-specific maximum power in case of a downlink transmission using at least two TX antennas. This means that every single subcarrier power determined for multiple TX antenna transmission is reduced by this factor. The parameter does not apply in case of a single TX (TM1) transmission, and thus neither affects the power of cell-specific reference signal transmission. Note that only the limited set of dlpcMimoComp values (-3dB, 0dB, 1.77dB, 3dB, 4.77dB, 6dB) can be communicated to the UE due to p-a signaling restrictions and the extended range has been determined only for finetuning purposes. Please be informed that Nokia does not quarantee a successful DL transmission using amplitude dependent modulations, especially 64QAM, if other values than the values presented in the limited set (-3dB, 0dB, 1.77dB, 3dB, 4.77dB, 6dB) are used. 
Please note, that if the Cell-Specific Reference Symbol Power Boost is activated by setting the dlRsBoost parameter, only the values 0dB and 3dB are allowed for dlpcMimoComp.

fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.description:
The four layer MIMO average spectral efficiency is used by the throughput check during SCell addition as follows .
If the throughput metric after the SCell addition is greater than the throughput metric before the SCell addition then this SCell addition is admitted. Otherwise this SCell addition is rejected. The throughput metric is the sum of xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff*bandwidth of the UE’s serving cells. Where xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with two layer MIMO on a given serving cell respectively xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with four layer MIMO on a given serving cell.

A reasonable value of the parameter can be derived from the existing KPI LTE_5747a "DL Spectral efficiency" as follows. The KPI shall be collected in conditions where all UEs are four layer MIMO capable in this cell in order not to underestimate the average value (with dlMimoMode set to "Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)" or "Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)").

The throughput check is not used by setting the parameter value to "0.5" i.e. any SCell addition will be always admitted by the check if twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff = fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff in all involved cells.
fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.fullName: Four layer MIMO average spectral efficiency

maxNumActDrb.description:
Threshold for the maximum number of established DRBs in the cell. 

The maximum number of established DRBs depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..1650 (recommended: 600)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..2400 (recommended: 900)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..1890 (recommended: 900)

AirScale:
The maximum number of established DRBs depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1800 (recommended: 600)
- for 15MHz and 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..3600 (recommended: 900)

The range of this parameter may be adapated considering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..550 (recommended: 200)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..800 (recommended: 300)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..630 (recommended: 200)

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..600 in AirScale (recommended: 200)
- for 15MHz and 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1200 in AirScale (recommended: 300)

maxNumCaConfUe3c.description:
Threshold to limit the maximum number of carrier aggregation configured UEs in a PCell (P-LNCEL); 3c (3 carriers) indicates that these UEs have 1 PCell (P-LNCEL) and 2 or 3 SCells (S-LNCEL).
Carrier aggregated UEs with 2 or more SCells need a higher amount of resources (PUCCH) compared with single carrier UEs as long as UL signalling is done only via PCell. That's why the information 3c is relevant.

In case the threshold is modified online and the value is decreased, existing CA-UEs may stay in the cell, but the new value applies to new admission checks only.

maxNumCaConfUeDc.description:

Carrier aggregated UEs with 1 SCell  need double amount of UL resources compared with single carrier UEs as long as UL signalling is done only via PCell. That's why the information Dc is relevant.

In case the threshold is modified online and the value is decreased, existing CA-UEs may stay in the cell, but the new value applies to new admision checks only.
maxNumCaConfUeDc.fullName: Max number Carrier Aggr configured UEs double carrier

QCI1-DRBs are additional data radio bearers in the cell and are also checked against the threshold maxNumActDrb. 

The maximum additional margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:

Values for AirScale (FSMr3 in brackets)
1.4 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 10 (10)
3 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 60 (60)
5 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 200 (200)
10 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 200 (400)
15 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 300 (500)
20 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 300 (600)

Please note that the default value is not suitable for all bandwidths. The recommended values are:


1.4 MHz bandwidth 5
3 MHz bandwidth 25
5 MHz bandwidth 75
10 MHz bandwidth 100
15 MHz bandwidth  100
20 MHz bandwidth 100

Dependencies:
maxNumQci1Drb + max( addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo) must be less than the margin values for the used bandwidth (see values above (10, 60, 200, 400, 500, 600))
