Maximum number of UEs for UL Scheduler in each TTI, including only SPS scheduling UE.
The maximum number of UL SPS UE is the part of maxNumUeUl. The margin between maxNumSPSUeUl and maxNumUeUl is left for dynamic scheduling. Dynamic scheduling is mandatory for UE which cannot be SPS scheduled. 

Both maxNumSPSUeUl and ulSpsMaxNumPrb will limit the SPS usage in the cell.

Range depends on chBw and actUlSps value as follows:
chBw = '10 MHz' or '15 MHz' or '20 MHz', value range is restricted to 0...19

Recommended value for the different bandwidth are:
10 MHz = 6
15 MHz = 8
20 MHz = 8
maxNumSpsUeUl.fullName: Maximum number of SPS scheduled UEs for UL scheduler

maxNumUeDl.description:
This is the maximum number of simultaneous users scheduled in a TTI in downlink.

The following values are allowed:

1.4 MHz bandwidth  1.. 7
3 MHz bandwidth: 1..7
5 MHz bandwidth  1 .. 7
10 MHz bandwidth 1 .. 14
15 MHz bandwidth 1 .. 17
20 MHz bandwidth 1 .. 20

Please note that the default value is not suitable for all bandwidths.
maxNumUeDl.fullName: Maximum amount of users per TTI in DL

maxNumUeDlDwPTS.description:
Maximum Number of UEs for DL Scheduler in special sub-frames
Range depends on chBw value as follows: 
- chBw = '10 MHz', value range is restricted to 0…10 (recommended: 7)
- chBw = '15 MHz', value range is restricted to 0…12 (recommended: 8)
- chBw = '20 MHz', value range is restricted to 0…12 (recommended: 8)

if the following features are excluded: 
- LTE1558/LTE1830/LTE1562 carrier aggregation
- LTE42/473/585 DRX
- LTE1042 nominal bitrate for non-GBR
- LTE493/541 Beamforming
- LTE568 DL 4x2 SU MIMO
- LTE1543 DL SU MIMO 8x2 with TM9

- chBw = '15 MHz', value range is restricted to 1…12 (recommended: 12)
- chBw = '20 MHz', value range is restricted to 1…12 (recommended: 12)

AirScale:
Maximum Number of UEs for DL Scheduler in special sub-frames
Range depends on chBw value as follows: 

- chBw = '10 MHz', value range is restricted to 1…7 (recommended for each bandwidth: 7)
- chBw = '20 MHz', value range is restricted to 1…8 (recommended: 8)

the range for maxNumUeDlDwPTS may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration,i.e. the value of actBbPooling
maxNumUeDlDwPTS.fullName: Maximum amount of users per TTI in DL DwPTS

maxNumUeUl.description:
Maximum Number of UEs for UL Scheduler in each TTI, including dynamic scheduling UE and Semi-Persistent-Scheduling UE.
Range and default value depend on chBw and actUlSps.


AirScale:
the range for maxNumUeUl may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration,i.e. the value of actBbPooling
maxNumUeUl.fullName: Maximum amount of users per TTI in UL

measGapPattern.description: This parameter defines measurement gap pattern scheme for Inter-Frequency Measurements.

mimoBfCqiAvg.description:
Averaging filter constant for CQI measurements in beamforming
If dlMimoMode is not 'Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming' and actTmSwitch is set to 'FALSE', mimoBfCqiAvg is not defined and the default value is used implicitly.

mimoBfCqidlComp.description:
CQI Compensation applied to Measurements when reported RI=2 in dual layer beamforming
If dlMimoMode is not configuired to 'Dual Stream Beamforming', mimoBfCqidlComp does not need to be specified.
mimoBfCqidlComp.fullName: CQI compensation in dual layer beamforming

mimoBfdlRiAvg.description:
Averaging filter constant for RI measurements in dual layer beamforming 
If dlMimoMode is not 'Dual Stream Beamforming' mimoBfdlRiAvg is not defined and the default value is used implicitly.
mimoBfdlRiAvg.fullName: RI averaging constant in dual layer beamforming

mimoClCqiThD.description: CQI Threshold for fallback to closed loop MIMO single codeword transmission (in CQI) in case of activated 'Dynamic MIMO Switch' (i.e. actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false'). Not applicable if actFastMimoSwitch set to 'true'.
mimoClCqiThD.fullName: CQI threshold for fallback to CL MIMO 1 CW mode

mimoClCqiThU.description: CQI Threshold for activation of closed loop MIMO dual codeword transmission (in CQI) in case of activated 'Dynamic MIMO Switch' (i.e. actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false'). Not applicable if actFastMimoSwitch set to 'true'.
mimoClCqiThU.fullName: CQI threshold for activation of CL MIMO 2 CW mode

mimoClRiThD.description: Rank Threshold for fallback to closed loop MIMO single codeword transmission in case of activated 'Dynamic MIMO Switch' (i.e. actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false'). Not applicable if actFastMimoSwitch set to 'true'.
mimoClRiThD.fullName: Rank threshold for fallback to CL MIMO 1 CW mode

mimoClRiThU.description: Rank Threshold for activation of closed loop MIMO dual codeword transmission in case of activated 'Dynamic MIMO Switch' (i.e. actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false'). Not applicable if actFastMimoSwitch set to 'true'.
mimoClRiThU.fullName: Rank threshold for activation of CL MIMO 2 CW mode

mimoOlCqiThD.description: CQI threshold for fallback to Open Loop MIMO diversity (in CQI).
mimoOlCqiThD.fullName: CQI threshold for fallback to MIMO diversity

mimoOlCqiThU.description: CQI threshold for activation of Open Loop MIMO Spatial Multiplexing (in CQI).
mimoOlCqiThU.fullName: CQI threshold for activation of OL MIMO SM

mimoOlRiThD.description: Rank threshold for fallback to Open Loop MIMO diversity.
mimoOlRiThD.fullName: Rank threshold for fallback to MIMO diversity

mimoOlRiThU.description: Rank threshold for activation of Open Loop MIMO Spatial Multiplexing.
mimoOlRiThU.fullName: Rank threshold for activation of OL MIMO SM

nSrsDtx.description:
Number of consecutive SRS DTX detections required for RL Failure
The parameter defines number of consecutive SRS DTX detections causing radio link failure indication. Special value 0 means that the feature is disabled.

nSrsRec.description:
Number of consecutive SRS required for RL recovery
The parameter defines number of consecutive SRS non-DTX detections causing radio link failure recovery indication

numOfCsiRsAntennaPorts.description:
Number of CSI-RS ports 
In 3GPP 2,4,8 CSI-RS ports are supported. Currently supported values are 8 ports for LTE1543 and LTE2068 and 4 ports for LTE1515 and LTE1987.

numSfRIUpPts.description: This parameter indicates the monitoring window length (number of subframe) of Remote Interference detection and disappearance in UpPTS.
numSfRIUpPts.fullName: The monitoring window length (the number of subframe) of Remote Interference detection and disappearance in UpPTS.

p0NomPuschSps.description:
Cell specific PUSCH nominal power for controlling the mean received SNR for user data in SPS UE uplink power control algorithm.
The parameter defines the cell specific nominal power for the PUSCH. Used for P0_PUSCH calculation in SPS UE uplink power control equation for controlling the mean received SNR for user data during (re)transmission. For all the PUSCH transmissions that are CRC scrambled by the SPS C-RNTI shall use this value.

Note:
If Interference-aware UL power control is disabled, the parameter value shall equal to p0NomPusch.
If Interference-aware UL power control is enabled, the parameter value shall equal to p0NomPuschIAw.
p0NomPuschSps.fullName: Nominal power for SPS UE PUSCH TX power calculation

pdcchFactorForDLReTxPdcBlk.description: Scaling factor applied to PDCCH resource allocation for downlink retransmissions when the control channel is blocked/congested, part of TDD scheduler tuning.

pdcchLoadLevel.description:
The PDCCH load level configures the percentage of used PDCCH CCEs on all available PDCCH CCEs.
Used PDCCH CCEs include all CCEs of CSS/USS space and dummy PDCCHs. 
This parameter will not restrict normal PDCCH allocation. Only when normal PDCCH load has not reach the level defined by this parameter, dummy PDCCHs will be added.
This parameter is mandatory when actPdcchLoadGen is set to "true".

pdcchLoadPsdOffset.description:
This paramter defines the dummy PDCCH PSD offset to flat PSD. 
Maximum dummy PDCCH PSD is calculated based on flat PSD and this offset. 
If there is not enough power remaining for dummy PDCCHs, smaller dummy PDCCH PSD will be used.
This parameter is mandatory when actPdcchLoadGen is set to "true".

pdcchUtilThForDlReTx.description: PDCCH utilization threshold above which downlink HARQ retransmissions receive special (throttled or prioritized) treatment.

pdschServSubCellRsrpAvg.description: Averaging filter constant for equivalent DL RSRP for DL serving subcell determination
pdschServSubCellRsrpAvg.fullName: Averaging filter constant for equivalent DL RSRP

pdschServSubCellTh.description: DL RSRP offset threshold for DL serving subcell determination

pdschServSubCellUpdateT.description: DL serving subcell update timer to avoid too frequent switch of DL serving subcells

prachCS.description:
Preamble cyclic shift defines the configuration which is used for preamble generation. The configuration determines how many cyclic shifts are needed to generate preamble. 
Configuration also defines the zero correlation zone and respective maximum cell range.

prachConfIndex.description: Defines allowed system frame and subframe numbers for random access attempts, and the preamble format.

prachFreqOff.description:
Defines the location in frequency for the PRACH transmissions.
For UL scheduling its recommended that PRACH is located next to PUCCH either on the lower or upper edge of the bandwidth because UL PRB allocation for UE consist of consecutive PRBs. If there is a small gap between PUCCH and PRACH PRBs, UL scheduler cannot utilize those PRBs effectively. prachFreqOffset for each bandwidth should be set aligned with the parameters determining the number of PRBs for PUCCH, so that PRACH is located next to PUCCH.
It is recommended to set the value such that PRACH does not overlap with PUCCH RBs and is located adjacent to PUCCH; thus recommended parameter alternatives are: 
1) roundup((MaxPucchResourceSize+blankedPucch)/2) if it is located at the lower edge, or
2) ulChBw(in PRBs)-6-roundup((MaxPucchResourceSize+blankedPucch)/2 ) if it is located at the upper edge of the PUSCH area

The MaxPucchResourceSize in above defines the maximum number of allocated PUCCH RBs, and it defined in nCqiRb parameter.

prachHsFlag.description:
High speed flag for PRACH preamble generation determines whether an unrestricted or a restricted set has to be used by the UE.
false = Unrestricted; true  = Restricted

prsConfigurationIndex.description:
Determines the periodicity and offset of the PRS occasions for FDD

PRS period based on the configured value of prsConfigurationIndex:
7, 14, 27, 47, 67, 87, 107, 127, 147, 151: 160 ms period
471: 320 ms period
1111: 640 ms period
2391: 1280 ms period
The periodicity and offset can be computed according to 3GPP TS 36.211 Rel9

Note: All Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode may be released when this parameter is online modified.

prsNumDlFrames.description: Number of DL Frames that are used for PRS per PRS occasion for FDD. With this PRS transmission can be repeated within a PRS occasion in order to increase the hearability of PRS

pucchNAnCs.description:
Number of cyclic shifts for PUCCH formats 1/1a/1b in a resource block used for a mix of formats 1/1a/b and 2/2a/2b.
This parameter is one of the parameters in a set which defines the maximum PUCCH allocation called as MaxPucchResourceSize.
pucchNAnCs.fullName: PUCCH cyclic shift for mixed formats

puschHopOffset.description: The PUSCH hopping offset parameter defines the offset used for PUSCH frequency hopping, expressed in a number of resource blocks.

remCandSubCellUlSinrHys.description:
Defines the UL SINR hysteresis on top of UL SINR offset for removing candidate sub-cell.
If the SINR gap between serving sub-cell and current candidate sub-cell is larger than candSubCellUlSINROffset plus this parameter this candidate sub-cell will be changed to measurement sub-cell.
remCandSubCellUlSinrHys.fullName: UL SINR hysteresis for removing candidate sub-cell

repCandSubCellUlSinrHys.description:
Defines the UL SINR hysteresis to replace candidate sub-cell by a measurement sub-cell.
If one measurement sub-cell's SINR is larger than current candidate sub-cell' this measurement sub-cell will replace current candidate sub-cell as new candidate sub-cell.
repCandSubCellUlSinrHys.fullName: UL SINR hysteresis for replacing candidate sub-cell

riaProfId.description:
Instance ID of the assigned RIAPR profile.
RIAPR contains Remote Interference Avoidance functional parameters which is subordinate under LNBTS.
riaProfId.fullName: Instance ID of the assigned RIAPR profile

rootSeqIndex.description: The premable generation is started from the Root Sequence which is pointed by the logical root sequence number. 64 preambles can be transmitted in the PRACH frame. If one root is not enough to generate all the 64 preambles, then the consecutive number is selected until the full set is generated. RACH root sequence is cell specific information and neighbouring cells should have a different value. RACH root sequence is transmitted in system information.

rrmPdcchUtilCoeff.description: Coefficient used by Radio Resource Management to gauge or cap PDCCH channel-element utilization when making scheduling/admission decisions.

rruPort1AntId.description: To indicate which of the physical antenna index shall be connected to RRU port 1 via the RF cable.
rruPort1AntId.fullName: RRU physical antenna port1 antenna index

rruPort2AntId.description: To indicate which of the physical antenna index shall be connected to RRU port 2 via the RF cable.
rruPort2AntId.fullName: RRU physical antenna port2 antenna index

rruPort3AntId.description: To indicate which of the physical antenna index shall be connected to RRU port 3 via the RF cable.
rruPort3AntId.fullName: RRU physical antenna port3 antenna index

rruPort4AntId.description: To indicate which of the physical antenna index shall be connected to RRU port 4 via the RF cable.
rruPort4AntId.fullName: RRU physical antenna port4 antenna index

rruPort5AntId.description: To indicate which of the physical antenna index shall be connected to RRU port 5 via the RF cable.
rruPort5AntId.fullName: RRU physical antenna port5 antenna index

rruPort6AntId.description: To indicate which of the physical antenna index shall be connected to RRU port 6 via the RF cable.
rruPort6AntId.fullName: RRU physical antenna port6 antenna index

rruPort7AntId.description: To indicate which of the physical antenna index shall be connected to RRU port 7 via the RF cable.
rruPort7AntId.fullName: RRU physical antenna port7 antenna index

rruPort8AntId.description: To indicate which of the physical antenna index shall be connected to RRU port 8 via the RF cable.
rruPort8AntId.fullName: RRU physical antenna port8 antenna index

rxCalibrationConfiguration.description: The parameter defines where the RX calibration for optimized coexistence with WiMAX Networks shall be executed by the eNodeB.

scaleNumSubGrp.description: Scaling factor applied to the number of scheduling sub-groups used in TDD beam/UE grouping.

sectorBeamGrpWeight.description: Weight assigned to a sector's beam group when the scheduler allocates resources across beam groups in an AAS/beamforming TDD cell.

sfnDlAlg.officialRange:
0: static broadcasting 
1: PDSCH adaptive selective transmission

simUlSpsPf3.description:
Enable a UE simultaneously having PUCCH format 3 resource assigned and UL SPS activated.
This parameter provides a tradeoff between VoLTE performance in case of CA, and UL PRB efficient usage.

If set to 'true', a UE assigned PUCCH format 3 can simultaneously have UL SPS activated.

If set to 'false', when a UE assigned PUCCH format 3, its UL SPS shall be de-activated.
simUlSpsPf3.fullName: Enable sim. UL SPS and PUCCH format 3 for a UE

spectrumEffThd.description:
This parameter specifies the spectrum efficiency threshold which works as a criteria for adding a UE to a UE pairing and ensure the gain of spectrum efficiency.
The spectrumEffThd shall be set to 1.0 by default and further optimized by simulation.
This parameter is used for 64T64R DL MU MIMO.

srsActivation.description: Activates/Deactivates srs (sounding reference symbol) feature in Cell.

srsBandwidth.description:
Defines together with srsBwConf (srs bandwidth configuration)  the bandwidth for srs for non beamforming or beamforming configured UEs . Please refer to table 5.5.3.2-1 to 5.5.3.2-4 in 3GPP TS36.211. This depends on the value of LNCEL-srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsBeamformingType.

If LNCEL-srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsBeamformingType is set to 'nonBeamforming', then srsBandwidth defines the bandwidth of one SRS symbol for UEs which are configured to the RRC transmission mode tm1 to tm4.
If LNCEL-srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsBeamformingType is set to 'beamforming', then srsBandwidth defines the bandwidth of one SRS symbol for UEs which are configured to the RRC transmission mode tm7 or tm8.

srsBwConf.description:
Defines together with the channel bandwidth (chBw) and the srsBandwidthNonBf (srs bandwidth for non beamforming users) or srsBandwidthBf (srs bandwidth for beamforming users) the bandwidth of one srs symbol. 
Please refer to table 5.5.3.2-1 to 5.5.3.2-4 in 3GPP TS36.211 for different system bandwidth.
If dlMimoMode is set to a beamforming mode ("Single Stream Beamforming" or "Dual Stream Beamforming") , than srsBandwidthForNonBf is chosen to define the bandwidth of one srs symbol for UEs which rrc transmission mode is set to tm0 to tm4. srsBandwidthForBf is chosen to define the bandwidth of one srs symbol for UEs which rrc transmission mode is set to tm7 or tm8. 
If dlMimoMode is set to a non beamforming mode  ("SingleTX", "TXDiv", "4-way TXDiv", "Dynamic Open Loop MIMO", "Closed Loop Mimo" or "Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)"), than srsBandwidthForNonBf is chosen to define the bandwidth of one srs symbol for all UEs.

srsDuration.description: Defines the Ue transmission duration for srs. Only indefinite duration is supported.

srsHoppingBw.description:
Defines the srs hopping bandwidth. If srsHoppingBw >= srsBandwidthforNonBf than for non beamforming users frequency hopping is disabled.
If srsHoppingBw < srsBandwidthforNonBf than for non beamforming users frequency hopping is enabled.
If srsHoppingBw >= srsBandwidthforBf than for beamforming users frequency hopping is disabled.
If srsHoppingBw < srsBandwidthforBf than for non beamforming users frequency hopping is enabled.

srsOnTwoSymUpPts.description:
Active/deactive srs transmission on 2 symbols of UpPts. If srsOnTwoSymUpPts is set to true, then srs transmission on 2 symbols of UpPTS is allowed.
If srsOnTwoSymUpPts is set to false, then the transmission of srs in two symbols of upPTS is not allowed. This parameter is only used in case srs periodicity of Ue is set to 2ms.
srsOnTwoSymUpPts.fullName: SRS transmission on 2 symbols of UpPTS act/deact

srsPwrOffset.description:
UE specific power offset to be used for Sounding Reference Signal transmission power calculation in UE uplink power control equation (P3).

Note: The actual power offset depends on value of deltaTfEnabled.
For deltaTfEnabled = 'true' (KS = 1.25) the actual parameter value is "srsPwrOffset-3" corresponding to the dB-range of -3 dB to 12 dB in steps of 1 dB. For deltaTfEnabled = 'false' (KS = 0) the actual parameter value is "-10.5 + 1.5 * srsPwrOffset" value corresponding to the dB-range -10.5 dB to 12 dB in steps of 1.5 dB.
srsPwrOffset.fullName: Power offset for SRS transmission power calculation

srsSimAckNack.description: Activates/Deactivates SRS and Ack/Nack simultaneous transmission. If this parameter is set to true, in uplink the transmission of srs and ack/nack is allowed in the same TTI.

srsSubfrConf.description: Defines the cell specific srs subframe configuration as specified in 3GPP TS36.211 table 5.5.3.3-2.

srsUePeriodicity.description:
Defines the UE periodicity for srs in which the UE will provide srs to the eNB.
If LNCEL-srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsBeamformingType is set to 'nonBeamforming' then this parameter defines the periodicity for UEs which are configured to the RRC transmission mode tm1 to tm4.
If LNCEL-srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsBeamformingType is set to 'beamforming' then this parameter defines the periodicity for UEs which are configured to the RRC transmission mode tm7 or tm8.

subCellSwitchUlSinrHys.description: The parameter defines the UL SINR hysteresis for sub-cell switch.
subCellSwitchUlSinrHys.fullName: Uplink SINR hysteresis for sub-cell switch

subCellUlSinrAvgT.description: The parameter defines the time length as the filter coefficient for averaging UL UE SINR per RRH on SRS, PUSCH and PUCCH for sub-cell switch.
subCellUlSinrAvgT.fullName: Filter coefficient for averaging UL UE SINR

syncSigTxMode.description: The parameter determines whether NB-IoT Primary and Secondary Synchronization Signals (NPSS, NSSS) are transmitted into a cell via one antenna port (SingleTx) or via all antenna ports using TX diversity with Precoding Vector Switching (PVS).

t304InterRatTd.description: This timer value is used eNodeB internally to estimate the time the UE may spend to access the target TD-SCDMA system after receiving RRC:MOBILITY FROM EUTRAN COMMAND before starting RRC Re-Establishment. It is used eNodeB internally to calculate the supervision timer for the Handover Execution Phase (TS1RELOCoverall)
t304InterRatTd.fullName: Timer t304 for handover to TD-SCDMA

tddFrameConf.description:
The TDD Uplink-downlink Configuration parameter indicates the uplink-downlink subframe configuration in TDD.
The Subframe Assignment need to be configured according to 3GPP 36.211. The parameter is transmitted in the System Information Broadcast and corresponds to the subframeAssignment (sa#) as specified in 3GPP 36.331.
Currently only Subframe assignment 1 and 2 (sa1, sa2) are supported.

tddSpecSubfConf.description:
The TDD Special Subframe Configuration parameter is used for the configuration of DwPTS, GP and UpPTS in the special subframe. The configured Special Subframe Pattern is transmitted in the System Information Broadcast and corresponds to the specialSubframePatterns (ssp#) as specified in 3GPP 36.331. 
Special Subframe Patterns 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 9 (ssp3: 11:2:1, ssp4: 12:1:1, ssp5: 3:9:2, ssp6: 9:3:2, ssp7: 10:2:2, ssp9: 6:6:2) are supported.

For DCM, Special Subframe Patterns 0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 are supported.

threshold2Tdscdma.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell for start of TD-SCDMA Measurements
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If value below threshold2Tdscdma (event A2) then TD-SCDMA measurements are started.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

timeChInfoValid.description:
Time period during which channel information is valid
timeChInfoValid indicates that the maximum time during which the measurement channel information is valid. 
If timeChInfoValid is set to 0, the measurement channel information is always invalid.
If timeChInforValid is set to infinite, the measurement channel information is always valid.
timeChInfoValid.fullName: Time Period for Channel Information Valid

tmSwitchProfileId.description:
Instance ID of the assigned transmission mode switch profile.

The profile contains CQI thresholds for switching between transmission modes.

twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.description:
The two layer MIMO average spectral efficiency is used by the throughput check during SCell addition as follows .
If the throughput metric after the SCell addition is greater than the throughput metric before the SCell addition then this SCell addition is admitted. Otherwise this SCell addition is rejected. The throughput metric is the sum of xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff*bandwidth of the UE’s serving cells. Where xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with two layer MIMO on a given serving cell respectively xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with four layer MIMO on a given serving cell.

A reasonable value of the parameter can be derived from the existing KPI LTE_5747a "DL Spectral efficiency" with dlMimoMode set to "Closed Loop Mimo" or "Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)" or "Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)".

The throughput check is not used by setting the parameter value to "0.5" i.e. any SCell addition will be always admitted by the check if twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff = fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff in all involved cells.
twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.fullName: Two layer MIMO average spectral efficiency

txDisableThreshold.description: RSSI/interference level above which the TDD transmitter is automatically disabled, part of an interference-avoidance or remote-interference-management mechanism.

txEnableThreshold.description: RSSI/interference level below which the TDD transmitter is automatically re-enabled after having been disabled by txDisableThreshold, forming a hysteresis pair.

uciOnlyMaxCodeRate.description: Maximum code rate for UCI only transmissions in UL.
uciOnlyMaxCodeRate.fullName: Maximum code rate for UCI-only TX in UL

ulCombinationMode.description:
Identifies the uplink combination mode.

Recommendations for balancing increased cell throughput and link level gain:
If dlMimoMode is set to 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)', ulCombinationMode is recommended to be configured to 'IRC'.

ulMuMimoMCSOffset.description: This parameter specifies UL MU-MIMO MCS compensate offset.

ulMuMimoOrthThreshold.description: The orthogonality factor between two UEs shall be bigger than ulMuMimoOrthThrehold.

ulMuMimoPRBDiffThreshold.description: This parameter specifies UL MU-MIMO PRB differential threashold.

ulMuMimoSinrThreshold.description: SINR threshold above which UEs can be selected as the candidate users of UL MU-MIMO.

ulSpsInterval.description:
Specifies the radio resource allocation period for Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS).
Although 3GPP supports several values, only 20 msec is supported.

ulSpsMaxNumPrb.description:
Cell level maximum number of PRB for UL SPS.
Specifies the maximum number of uplink Physical Resource Blocks (PRB) per Transmission Time Interval (TTI) which can be allocated to Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS).
The maximum number of ulSpsMaxNumPrb depends on the bandwidth and PUCCH/PRACH PRB number of the cell. The parameter setting shall consider the dynamic scheduling UE and adaptive retransmission PRB requirement.

The recommended value is 20.

Both maxNumSpsUeUl and ulSpsMaxNumPrb will limit the SPS usage in the cell.

ulSpsMaxPrbPerUeNB.description: Specifies the maximum allowed number of PRB for the AMR NB Voice over IP (VoIP) of a single UE per TTI when Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) is activated.
ulSpsMaxPrbPerUeNB.fullName: Uplink SPS max PRB per UE for AMR NB

ulSpsMaxPrbPerUeWB.description: Specifies the maximum allowed number of PRB for the AMR WB Voice over IP (VoIP) of a single UE per TTI when Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) is activated.
ulSpsMaxPrbPerUeWB.fullName: Uplink SPS max PRB per UE for AMR WB

ulSpsMinVoicePktSize.description:
Threshold of the size of a Voice Over IP (VoIP) talkspurt packet in the uplink direction.
Specifies the minimum size of a Voice Over IP (VoIP) talkspurt packet in the uplink direction. If the estimated uplink buffer size of the Logical Channel Group (LCG) including Quality of Service (QoS) Class Identifier 1 (QCI-1) traffic is larger than defined by the ulSpsMinVoicePktSize parameter, uplink Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) allocation for the UE is attempted. The parameter should be set to the value between the size of SID packet and AMR payload packet.
ulSpsMinVoicePktSize.fullName: Uplink SPS minimum voice packet size

ulSpsNumEmptyTransmissions.description:
Uplink SPS number of empty transmissions before implicit release.
Specifies number of consecutive empty transmissions before the eNodeB assumes the uplink Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) allocation is released. UE automatically releases the UL SPS allocation once it reaches this number of consecutive empty transmissions.
ulSpsNumEmptyTransmissions.fullName: UL SPS number of empty transmissions

ulSpsQci1ThroughputFactor.description:
ulSpsQci1ThroughputFactor is used to set the threshold of the ratio (total UL TP)/(QCI1 bearers provided UL TP): Only if the ratio <= ulSpsQci1ThroughputFactor, UE can be activated with UL SPS. Total UL TP here is counted in the eNB at the moment when the check is done.
With a small ulSpsQci1ThroughputFactor, it means UL SPS can be applied on a UE which has little data transmission besides QCI1 bearer in UL.
With a big ulSpsQci1ThroughputFactor, it means UL SPS can be applied on a UE even who has lots of data transmission besides QCI1 bearer in UL.

When no value is defined for the parameter, whenever the eNB tries to activate UL SPS for a UE, it doesn't check UE's total UL TP at all for the cell.

ulSpsTwoIntervalConfig.description:
Trigger of two-intervals-Semi-Persistent Scheduling in uplink.
Although 3GPP supports both "true" and "false", only  value "true" is supported to get better performance.

ulSpsVoicePktTbsNB.description:
Specifies the the way to determine Transport Block Size (TBS) used to calculate the number of PRB and MCS for uplink Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) allocation in the case of AMR NB payload.
- small means select TBS with assumption short RLC header in use and no MCA CE included, eNB estimates the TBS with no other overheads consideration such as Power Headroom Report, Buffer Status Report or extra RLC/MAC overhead and with rlcProf101-snFieldLengthUL is set to "5bit" and pdcpProf101-snSize is set to "7bit". 

- big means select TBS with assumption long RLC header in use and MacCEs included, eNB estimates the TBS with Power Headroom Report and Buffer Status Report. If rlcProf101-snFieldLengthUL is set to "10bit" and pdcpProf101-snSize is set to "12bit", longRLC_and_MacCE is recommended.

This parameter setting is a tradeoff between SPS PRB cost and dynamic scheduling (PDCCH cost),  ulSpsVoicePktTbsNB=small result in small TBS,  and small TBS will save PRB and may cost more PDCCH.
Note: dynamic scheduling may trigger between two SPS_Reserved_TTIs.
ulSpsVoicePktTbsNB.fullName: Uplink SPS allocation transport block size for AMR NB

- big means select TBS with assumption long RLC header in use and MacCEs included, eNB estimates the TBS with Power Headroom Report and Buffer Status Report. If rlcProf101-snFieldLengthUL is set to "10bit" and pdcpProf101-snSize is set to "12bit", longRLC_and_MacCE is recommended.

This parameter setting is a tradeoff between SPS PRB cost and dynamic scheduling (PDCCH cost), ulSpsVoicePktTbsNB=small result in small TBS, and small TBS will save PRB and may cost more PDCCH.

b2Threshold1GERAN.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If RSRP of serving value < b2Threshold1GERAN and RSRP of  GERAN neighbour cell > b2Threshold2RssiGERAN
then handover is triggered (B2 event)

Receive level threshold for serving cell in B2 event. Used in measurement event
type B2 where the event is triggered if the serving cell becomes worse than
b2Threshold1GERAN  AND the GERAN neighbour cell becomes better than b2Threshold2GERAN.
Set in  ReportConfigInterRAT for GERAN

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
b2Threshold1GERAN.fullName: Threshold1 GERAN for RSRP of serving cell

b2Threshold1GERANQci1.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell when UE has QCI1 bearer. If RSRP of serving value < b2Threshold1GERANQci1 and RSRP of  GERAN neighbour cell > b2Threshold2RssiGERANQci1
then handover is triggered (B2 event).

Receive level threshold for serving cell in B2 event when UE has QCI1 bearer. Used in measurement event type B2 where the event is triggered if the serving cell becomes worse than b2Threshold1GERANQci1 AND the GERAN neighbour cell becomes better than b2Threshold2RssiGERANQci1.
Set in ReportConfigInterRAT for GERAN.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
b2Threshold1GERANQci1.fullName: Threshold1 GERAN for RSRP of  serving cell during QCI1

b2Threshold1RsrqGERAN.description:
Threshold1 for RSRQ of serving cell. If RSRQ of serving cell is less than b2Threshold1RsrqGERAN, then the first entering condition of the B2 event is fullfilled.
If also for the second entering condition the measurement results of RSSI of GERAN neighbour cell is greater than b2Threshold2RssiGERAN, then handover is triggered.

The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB

b2Threshold1RsrqGERANQci1.description:
Threshold1 for RSRQ of serving cell for B2-UTRA event when UE has QCI1 bearer. If RSRQ of serving cell is less than b2Threshold1RsrqGERANQci1, then the first entering condition of the B2 event is fulfilled.
If also for the second entering condition the measurement results of RSSI of GERAN neighbor cell is greater than b2Threshold2RssiGERAN, then handover is triggered.
The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB
b2Threshold1RsrqGERANQci1.fullName: RSRQ B2 GERAN threshold1 during QCI1

b2Threshold2RssiGERAN.description:
Threshold for RSSI of GERAN neighbour cell. If RSRP of serving value < b2Threshold1 and RSSI of  GERAN neighbour cell > b2Threshold2RssiGERAN
then handover is triggered (B2 event). 


Receive level threshold for GERAN neighbour cell in B2 event. Used in measurement event type B2 where the event is triggered if the serving cell becomes worse than b2Threshold1 AND the GERAN neighbour cell becomes better than b2Threshold2RssiGERAN.
Set in  ReportConfigInterRAT for GERAN.
Note: The mapping for RSRP based GERAN thresholds is different from the one defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 and are defined in TS 45.008

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 45.008:
* -110 dBm means a threshold lower than -110 dBm
* values between -109 dBm and -48 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -47 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -48 dBm
b2Threshold2RssiGERAN.fullName: Threshold2 GERAN for RSSI neighbour cell

b2Threshold2RssiGERANQci1.description:
Threshold for RSSI of GERAN neighbour cell when UE has QCI1 bearer. If RSRP of serving value < b2Threshold1GERANQci1 and RSSI of  GERAN neighbour cell > b2Threshold2RssiGERANQci1
then handover is triggered (B2 event).

Set in ReportConfigInterRAT for GERAN.
Note: The mapping for RSRP based GERAN thresholds is different from the one defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 and are defined in TS 45.008

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 45.008:
* -110 dBm means a threshold lower than -110 dBm
* values between -109 dBm and -48 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)

For ARFCN values not associated with one of these bands, the indicator is not relevant.

Field encoded as a bit map, where bit N is set to "0" if a BCCH carrier with NCC = N-1 is not permitted for monitoring and set to "1" if the BCCH carrier with NCC = N-1 is permitted for monitoring; N = 1 to 8; bit 1 of the bitmap is the leading bit of the bit string.
nccperm.officialRange:
Bit 0:NCC 7:0:N; Bit 1:NCC 6:0:N; Bit 2:NCC 5:0:N; Bit 3:NCC 4:0:N; 
Bit 4:NCC 3:0:N; Bit 5:NCC 2:0:N; Bit 6:NCC 1:0:N; Bit 7:NCC 0:0:N

This parameter defines the related inter-frequency group priority(i.e group ID) within the whole group profiles
The smaller the value the higher the priority, i.e value "1" means highest priority and value "12" means "no group" (lowest priority, assigned with default profile).

The smaller the value the higher the priority, i.e value "1" means highest priority and value "16" means lowest priority.

t312.description:
Timer T312 supervises the recovery from physical layer problems when a measurement report has been triggered for a measurement identity for which T312 has been configured, while T310 is running. This parameter is used in inter-frequency measurement object.

It is recommended that the value of this parameter be smaller than SIB-t310.

threshold3InterFreq.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If RSRP of serving value < threshold3InterFreq and RSRP of neighbour cell > threshold3aInterFreq 
then handover is triggered (A5 event)
Receive level threshold for serving cell in A5 event. Used in measurement event
type A5 where the event is triggered if the serving cell becomes worse than
threshold3InterFreq AND the neighbour cell becomes better than threshold3aInterFreq.
Set in  ReportConfigEUTRA

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
threshold3InterFreq.fullName: Threshold th3 for RSRP inter frequency

PCCPCH-RSCP is defined in TS 25.123 for TDD.
Set in  ReportConfigInterRAT for TD-SCDMA.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 25.123:
* -120 dBm means a threshold lower than -120 dBm
* values between -119 dBm and -25 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -24 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -25 dBm
b1ThresholdCSFBUtraRscp.fullName: Threshold CSFB to TD-SCDMA for PCCPCH-RSCP

maxNumCsfbTargets.description:
Defines the maximum number of target cells per frequency for CS fallback with PS-HO.

b1ThresholdCSFBUtraEcn0.description:
Threshold for UTRA neighbor cell on the current frequency, considered to be good and reported in the measurement result of B1 event.
Applicable only if measQuantityUTRA-FDD=cpich-EcN0.
cpich-EcN0 corresponds to CPICH_Ec/No in TS 25.133 for FDD only, and is not applicable for TDD.
Set in  ReportConfigInterRAT for WCDMA.
Parameter is optional depending on measQuantityCSFBUtraFdd.

The dB value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 25.133:
* -24 dB means a threshold lower than -24 dB
* values between -23.5 dB and 0 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value – 0.5 dB)
* 0.5 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to 0 dB
b1ThresholdCSFBUtraEcn0.fullName: Threshold CSFB to UTRA-WCDMA for EcN0 neighbor cell

b1ThresholdCSFBUtraRscp.description:
Threshold for UTRA neighbor cell on the current frequency, considered to be good and reported in the measurement result of B1 event.
Applicable only if measQuantityUTRA-FDD=cpich-RSCP. 
cpich-RSCP corresponds to CPICH_RSCP in TS 25.133  for FDD, and P-CCPCH_RSCP in TS 25.123 for TDD.
Set in  ReportConfigInterRAT for WCDMA.
Parameter is optional depending on measQuantityCSFBUtra.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 25.133:
* -120 dBm means a threshold lower than -120 dBm
* values between -119 dBm and -25 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -24 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -25 dBm
b1ThresholdCSFBUtraRscp.fullName: Threshold CSFB to UTRA-WCDMA for RSCP neighbour cell

b1TimeToTriggerCSFBUtraMeas.description:
Duration for which the RSRP based event B1 must be valid. For further important notice see the Additional Description.

Time for which the specific criteria for the RSRP based measurement event B1 must be met in order to trigger a measurement report.

Important Note: Since the B1 event for the purpose of CSFB shall be reported by the UE as fast as possible not the full range of up to 5120 ms for TTT shall be applicable. Recommended value would be up to and not higher than 256 ms. Hence the range ist restricted.
b1TimeToTriggerCSFBUtraMeas.fullName: Time to trigger UTRA-CSFB measurement report

b2Threshold1RsrqUtra.description:
Threshold1 for RSRQ of serving cell. If RSRQ of serving cell is less than b2Threshold1RsrqUtra, then the first entering condition of the B2 event is fullfilled.
If also for the second entering condition the measurement results of RSCP or EcN0 of  WCDMA neighbour cell are greater than b2Threshold2UtraRscp or b2Threshold2UtraEcn0 (depending on the configured quantity)
then handover is triggered.

The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB

b2Threshold1RsrqUtraQci1.description:
Threshold1 for RSRQ of serving cell for B2-UTRA event when UE has QCI1 bearer. If RSRQ of serving cell is less than b2Threshold1RsrqUtraQci1, then the first entering condition of the B2 event is fulfilled.
If also for the second entering condition the measurement results of RSCP or EcN0 of  WCDMA neighbor cell are greater than b2Threshold2UtraRscp or b2Threshold2UtraEcn0 (depending on the configured quantity) then handover is triggered.
The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB
b2Threshold1RsrqUtraQci1.fullName: RSRQ B2 UTRA threshold1 during QCI1

b2Threshold1Utra.description:

then handover is triggered (B2 event)

b2Threshold1RsrqRtt.description:
Threshold1 for RSRQ of serving cell. If RSRQ of serving cell is less than b2Threshold1RsrqRtt, then the first entering condition of the B2 event is fullfilled.
If also for the second entering condition the measurement results of pilot strength of CDMA2000-1XRTT  neighbour cell is greater than b2Threshold2PstrRtt, then handover is triggered.
The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB

b2Threshold1Rtt.description:
Threshold for RSRP of serving cell. If RSRP of serving value < b2Threshold1Rtt and pilotStrength of  1XRTT neighbour cell > b2Threshold2PstrRtt
then handover is triggered (B2 event)

Receive level threshold for serving cell in B2 event. Used in measurement event
type B2 where the event is triggered if the serving cell becomes worse than
b2Threshold1Rtt  AND the 1XRTT neighbour cell becomes better than b2Threshold2PstrRtt.
Set in  ReportConfigInterRAT for CDMA2000-1XRTT.
Value-Range follows 3GPP TS 36.133 chapter 9.1.4

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
b2Threshold1Rtt.fullName: Threshold1 CDMA2000-1XRTT for RSRP of serving cell

b2Threshold2PstrRtt.description:
CDMA2000 pilot strength threshold for 1XRTT SRVCC measurements, the ratio of pilot power to total power in the signal bandwidth of a CDMA2000 forward channel. 
See C.S0005-A (section 2.6.6.2.2) for CDMA2000 1xRTT.


The pilotStrength of 1XRTT SRVCC maps onto the 3GPP parameter b2-Threshold2CDMA2000 with 0 as the strongest and with 63 (-31.5 dB) as the weakest pilot strength.

The CDMA2000 band class is used to define the CDMA2000 band in which the CDMA2000 carrier frequency can be found, as defined in C.S0057-E [table 1.5-1].
Note: Bandclasses 18, 19, 20 and 21 are not supported by this release.

Setting this limit controls measurement object configuration and inhibits long measurement times.

rttSearchWindowSize.description: Provides the search window size to be used by the UE for the neighbouring pilot, see C.S0005-A.

rttStrengthThresh.description:
Defines the pilot  strength threshold  for enhanced CSFB to CDMA2000 1xRTT.
In 3GPP TS36.331, pilotStrength's range is [0 .. 63] which is different from current value range of paramter "rttStrengthThresh". The reason is that : in future phase 2 e1xCsfb feature, this parameter may be re-used as AggregatedThreshold which include strengths from multiple PNs and AggregatedThreshold 's value range is [-18 .. 63]. 

The formula used by the UE to report the pilot strength is [ -2 * 10 * log (measured pilot strength) ].
Therefore 63 maps to -31.5 dB. So [-18..63] maps to [9..-31.5] dB.

The parameter controls handover blacklisting. The instance of LNREL and the related cell relationship, defined by ECGI, identifies the specific cell to cell relation. The parameter allows HO for this neighbor relation, only S1 HO or no HO at all.
The blacklisting applies in addition to blacklisting via the LNCEL parameter blacklistHoL.

ccaThreshold.description:
This parameter is used by the eNB to derive the maximum energy detection threshold "DataThresh_max" beyond which no PDCCH/PDSCH transmission is allowed from a cell in frequency band #46.

"DataThresh_max" is calculated taking the minimum between the configured ccaThreshold parameter value and the applied "Xthresh_max" (see lteUWiFiCoexistence parameter for details).

dcsAvgWindowTime.description:
This parameter defines the effective window size (in time) the CCA sample data are filter-averaged for CCA failure rate evaluation.

The actual filter averaging ("smoothing") coefficient of the exponential moving average (EMA) filter is dynamically determined based on the received CCA sample pattern such that the overall effective averaging window size of dcsAvgWindowTime is maintained.

Note: Default value '0' changes the filtering from EMA to LMA (linear moving average).

enableLaaDsPadding.description:
This parameter enables or disables the padding of blank symbols of the discovery signal transmitted on an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode with random data. Enabling of the padding prevents other devices operating on the frequency of an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode from acquiring the channel during the silent symbols of the discovery signal transmission (e.g., symbol 2, 3, 9, 10). It also increases the total transmitted power per symbol and therefore reduces the possibility of transmission collision between LTE and other technologies (e.g., Wi-Fi). It is recommended to enable the discovery signal padding if an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode is expected to co-exist with other radio technologies (e.g., Wi-Fi).
Note 1: This parameter takes effect only if the unlicensed cell is operated in 'LAA' mode, i.e., actUnlicensedAcc is set to 'LAA'.
Note 2: For definition of an 'unlicensed cell', please, see its definition at parameter actUnlicensedAcc.

lteUWiFiCoexistence.description:
This parameter indicates whether or not the eNB has to share frequency band #46 with other systems (e.g., Wi-Fi). eNB will adapt accordingly the maximum continuous transmission period as per 3GPP TS 36.213 and derive which formula for the maximum energy detection threshold “Xthresh_max” to apply as follows:

If lteUWiFiCoexistence is set to 'no WiFi':
"XThresh_max" corresponds to the maximum energy detection threshold defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 when absence of any other technology sharing the carrier can be guaranteed on a long-term basis. If this formula applies, the parameter ccaThresholdXr corresponds to the "Xr" factor of the 3GPP specification.

If lteUWiFiCoexistence is set to 'WiFi':
"XThresh_max" corresponds to maximum energy detection threshold defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 when absence of any other technology sharing the carrier cannot be guaranteed on a long-term basis. If this formula applies, the parameter ccaThresholdXr does not play any role.

The so derived “XThresh_max” is then used in combination with the parameters ccaThreshold and ccaThreholdDrs to calculate the maximum energy detection thresholds (“DataThresh_max” and “DrsThresh_max”) that the eNB will apply to decide about transmission.

nonGbrThreshUnlicensed.description:
This parameter is used for calculating the minimum amount of data “MinBufferedData” which should be buffered in the unlicensed SCell for a given Channel Access Priority Class before considering its transmission.
“MinBufferedData” for data of a given Access Priority Class “P” is derived from nongbrThreshUnlicensed as follows:

For lteUItuRegion = 'USA'
    MinBufferedData = nonGbrThreshUnlicened * (Tmcot,p -1)/10,
For lteUItuRegion = 'Japan'
    MinBufferedData = nonGbrThreshUnlicened * (min(4, Tmcot,p -1))/10,
where: “Tmcot,p” corresponds to the maximum continuous transmission time allowed for the respective Access Priority Class “P”, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.213.

If this parameter is set to '0', no threshold before data transmission is applied.

Note: For definition of an 'unlicensed cell', please, see its definition at parameter actUnlicensedAcc.
nonGbrThreshUnlicensed.fullName: Min. non-GBR data for using unlicensed carrier

efssEventThreshold.description:
This parameter defines the threshold value for the amount of allowed errored seconds within the measurement time interval defined by efssEventWindow. 
If the number of errored frame seconds that occurred during the defined measurement interval exceeds the threshold number,
the OAM operation transmits an OAM PDU Event Notification message for that event.
efssEventThreshold.fullName: Errored frame seconds summary event threshold

efssEventWindow.description:
This parameter defines the measurement time interval for counting errored frame seconds. 
If the number of errored frame seconds that occurred during the defined measurement interval specified by efssEventWindow exceeds the threshold number specified in parameter efssEventThreshold, 
the OAM operation transmits an OAM PDU Event Notification message for that event.
efssEventWindow.fullName: Errored frame seconds summary event time interval

eventRepetition.description: This parameter defines how often the OAM operation repeats the transmission of OAM Events Notifications to its peer to increase the probability that they are received by the peer. The parameter defines the total number of repetitive transmissions of such messages.

eventSupportEnabled.description: This parameter defines whether the OAM operation supports Link OAM events.

lOamPrfId.description: This parameter defines the instance identifier of the ethernet application object. It uniquely identifies the object.

localPeerMode.description:
The parameter defines the mode of the OAM operation on the local peer.  It might be operating in active mode or passive mode.
In active mode, the OAM operation will  initiate the discovery process itself.
In passive mode, the OAM operation will only respond to a remotely initiated discovery process.

loopBackSupportEnabled.description:
The parameter allows to enable/disable the link OAM loopback support.

If enabled, the BTS will announce the loopback support in the discovery process, it accepts and processes the received OAM loopback control PDUs.
If disabled, the BTS will not announce loopback support in the discovery process, all received OAM loopback PDUs will be ignored.

Note: In active mode it is possible to activate the remote loopback function regardless of whether loopBackSupportEnabled is set to true.

loopBackTimeout.description: This parameter defines the timeout in seconds for a loopback operation initiated locally or by the remote peer.

testFrameRate.description: This parameter defines the number of frames per second the OAM operation will send during the loopback operation for Link OAM.

testFrameSize.description: This parameter defines the ethernet frame size of the test messages sent during loopback operation for Link OAM.

userLabel.description: This parameter defines the label that can be freely used for a text description of the link OAM profile

As a consequence, set-up of MBMS connections may be rejected by MB-TAC in case no sufficient transport bandwidth is available. If set to false, the MBMS traffic is not included in MB-TAC measurements, and MB-TAC will respond to any new MBMS connection set-up request by ‘accept’.

tacLimitGbrNormal.description: This parameter specifies the maximum permitted aggregate guaranteed transport bit rate for the normal GBR connections.

tacOverbookingLimit.description: This parameter sets a limit for the number of QCI#1 bearers which may be admitted by temporary overbooking in parallel.

The parameter defines the logging duration.
This configuration parameter defines a timer activated at the moment of configuration that continues independent of state changes, RAT or RPLMN change. When the timer expires the logging is stopped and the configuration is cleared (except for the parameters that are required for further reporting e.g. network absolute time stamp, trace reference, trace recording session reference and TCE Id).

The area scope specified in a MDT session shall support the same PLMN. If the parameter is not present the MDT data collection shall be done in the whole PLMN.

Trace ID identifies a cell trace session. In combination with PLMN ID, the identifier becomes unique.
Trace ID is part of Trace Reference contained in MDT logged Trace Reference
MDT logged Trace Reference is unique id identifying a trace session.
Trace Reference is globally unique and is 6 Octet length comprising of:
MCC+MNC+Trace ID.

MCC+MNC is of 3 Octet length
Trace ID is of 3 Octet length

E-UTRAN Trace ID is one of the trace parameters received for a trace session.

This applies when logging in using the BTS EM.

Note that existing local user sessions are not affected when this flag is enabled.

allowLocalUserDefaultPassword.description: Controls whether local user accounts are permitted to remain on their default/factory password; disabling this enforces a password change, improving security.

allowSysAdminDefaultPassword.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "allow Sys administrative Default Password" on the LUAC object. This parameter is updated to the local time on SBTS  when

b) its value is zero, SBTS is time synced, LUAC::localPasswdExpiryPeriod is not zero, and SBTS  authenticates a BTS Application Administrator localuser for the first time.

btsAccountLockoutDuration.description: This parameter defines the timer in minutes for locking the BTS local (operator) user account when the number of the failed login attempts exceeds the defined BTS maximum failed login attempts.

btsFailedLoginCountingPeriod.description: This parameter defines the timer in minutes for tracking the failed login attempts on a BTS local (operator) user account. The timer is automatically reset to zero in case the number of failed login attempts exceeds the defined BTS maximum failed login attempts before this timer expires.

btsMaxFailedLoginAttempts.description: This parameter defines the maximum number of failed login attempts allowed for a BTS local (operator) user account. If there are more failed login attempts during the defined BTS failed login counting period, the local BTS (operator) user account will be locked as defined in the BTS account lockout duration parameter. The value of '0' means that the feature is disabled.

btsSessionLoginDelay.description:
This parameter defines the delay after a failed login attempt on following applications before the next login is permitted.
For LTE eNB: BTS Site Manager
For SBTS: SBTS Element Manager

enableUserAccountCtrlAlarm.description: Enables an alarm raised on local user-account control events, such as lockouts or policy violations.

localPasswdExpiryPeriod.description:
This parameter defines the number of days after last local account password change, when the local user account will expire.
LUAC::localPasswdWarningPeriod  must be less than LUAC::localPasswdExpiryPeriod unless both are set to 0. 
Setting LUAC::localPasswordExpiryPeriod  to 0 will disable the password expiry functionality for local accounts. 
Recommended value is 90 days.

localPasswdLastChangedTime.description:
Time at which the password of the BTS System Administrator local user was last changed on eNB. 
This parameter is updated to the local time on eNB when
 a) the BTS System Administrator local user password is changed, or 
b) its value is zero, eNB is time synced, LUAC::localPasswdExpiryPeriod is not zero, and eNB authenticates a BTS System Administrator local user for the first time.

localPasswdWarningPeriod.description:

LUAC::localPasswdWarningPeriod must be less than LUAC::localPasswdExpiryPeriod unless both the parameters are set to 0.
Setting localPasswordWarningPeriod to 0 will disable the warning functionality.

Recommended value is 14 days.

Actual value = Value /2^32 s

eg: Value = 2,147,483,648 Fractional Seconds:

m1SyncId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC M1SYNC.
It uniquely identifies a M1SYNC instance.
It is recommended to modify the parameters of this MOC only if there are no active MBMS sessions.

m1TimeRef.description:
Represents the time reference used for M1 interface.
This parameter reflects the time reference used by the BM-SC to timestamp MBMS sync PDUs.

mbmsSyncPeriod.description:
Represents the duration of the sync period common for both Broadcast Multicast Service Center (BM-SC) and the eNBs. An increase in relative timestamped value within MBMS SYNC PDUs  will be interpreted by eNB as a start of new SYNC sequence.
 The actual SFN transmission time of data PDUs could be expressed as  fn [(current time - mbmsSyncRef) mod mbmsSyncPeriod].

Recommend to set the mbmsSyncPeriod to at least twice the value of the longest amongst all instances of MBSFNSYNCAREA-MBSFN-mchinfo-mchSchedulingPeriod.

mbmsSyncTimeOffset.description:
Represents the adjustment made to the timestamp of each packet received.
This parameter specifies the time offset between the BM-SC and the eNB. The time stamp in the sync header minus mbmsSyncTimeOffset will be used by the eNB. All the eNBs shall have the same offset for a given bearer service.  In case of modification, it should be made at BM-SC also. However, this parameter can be useful in case the eNBs are unsynchronized with one or several BM-SC.  The value specified here will apply to all M1 bearers.

mbsfnAreaInUseList.description: An element of the mbsfnAreaInUseList identifies an MBSFN Area Id that is currently enabled for use.  A minimum of one and up to eight MBSFN Area Ids may be configured per MBSFN Sync Area.

mbsfnHiddenList.description: An element of the mbsfnHiddenList identifies an MBSFN Area Id that is currently enabled for use, but shall not be included in SIB13.  If this list is defined, a minimum of one and up to eight MBSFN Area Ids may be configured per MBSFN Sync Area.

syncAreaInUse.description:
Represents the MBMS Sync Area that is associated with this Cell.
The MBSFN Sync Area associated with this MBSFNCEL will have the EARFCN and Channel Bandwidth matching the EARFCN and Channel Bandwidth of the associated LNCEL.

maxSyncSubfrPShare.description:
Defines the maximum MBSFN Sync Area subframe pattern share based on the proportion of the system capacity that shall be reserved for MBMS Service.  A Value of 25 indicates, 25% of subframes  are reserved for MBMS Services and 75% is left for Unicast Service.

It is recommended to modify the parameter only if there is no active MBMS session. Otherwise MBMS service will be temporarily suspended and resumed.
This parameter determines the values of radioframeAllocationPeriod, radioframeAllocationOffset, subframeAllocation(fourFrames) defined in TS36.331.

A lower percental share may be allocated by eNB if the required percental share is not possible with the actual configuration. In this case  the fault  'MBMS subframe pattern share exceeds avail. share' will be reported.

Note:  All Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode may be released, when this parameter is online modified together with Cat-M are activated.
maxSyncSubfrPShare.fullName: Maximum MBSFN sync area subframe pattern share

mbsfnDlChBw.description:
The downlink channel bandwidth used for MBSFN operation.
Only Maximum downlink channel bandwidth 10Mhz, 15Mhz, 20Mhz can be used. 
The downlink channel bandwidth mapping to number of Physical Resource Blocks is: 
10.0 MHz = 50 DL PRBS  
15.0 MHz = 75 DL PRBS 
20.0 MHz = 100 DL PRBS  
It is recommended to modify the parameter only if there is no active MBMS session. Otherwise MBMS service will be temporarily suspended and resumed.

mbsfnEarfcn.description:
E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number used for MBSFN operation. Services which are assigned to the MBSFN will be broadcasted in all cells of the eNB with earfcnDL equal to mbsfnEarfcn and dlChBw equal to mbsfnDlChBw.

It is recommended to modify the parameter only if there is no active MBMS session. Otherwise MBMS service will be temporarily suspended and resumed.
If MFBI is also enabled, then UEs that support the mapped band as indicated in the MFBIPR instance corresponding to earfcnDL will also be able to use MBMS services.

mbsfnOverlapAllowed.description:
Indicates if MBSFN Subframe overlapping configuration is allowed.
When this parameter is set to 'true', the MBSFNs belonging to this MBSFN Sync Area are allowed to have overlapping ranges of subframes.

Note:  All Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode may be released, when this parameter is online modified together with Cat-M are activated.

It uniquely identifies a MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD instance.

mcc.description:
Indicates the Mobile Country Code.
The Mobile Country Code parameter indicates the Mobile Country Code and is part of the PLMN identifier.

mnc.description:
Indicates the Mobile Network Code.
The Mobile Network Code parameter indicates the Mobile Network Code and is part of the PLMN identifier.

mncLength.description:
Indicates the length of the Mobile Network Code.
The Mobile Network Code length parameter indicates the length of the Mobile Network Code, either 2 or 3 digits.

syncAreaId.description:
Defines the MBSFN Synchronization Area ID.  Any specific Sync Area ID cannot be used across multiple carriers within an eNB.
This IE uniquely identifies an MBMS area supported for a specific frequency.  There could be up to eight MBSFNs supported within a single MBSFN Sync Area.

syncSubfrPShareAllowed.description:
Indicates the maximum allowed MBSFN Sync Area subframe pattern share which is currently in use.  A Value of 25 indicates, 25% of subframes  are reserved for MBMS Services and 75% is left for Unicast Service.
This parameter determines the values of commonSF-Alloc, radioframeAllocationPeriod, radioframeAllocationOffset, FourFrame defined in TS36.331.

The eNB selects a MBSFN Subframe configuration pattern which fits to the maximum percental share while considering other features (example: ETWS, OTDOA) which also reserve subframes.  The value may be less than or equal to maxSyncSubfrPShare.

If maxSyncSubfrPShare cannot be provided with the current eNB configuration, the value of syncSubfrPShareAllowed may be less than maxSyncSubfrPShare and the fault  'MBMS subframe pattern share exceeds avail. share' is reported.
syncSubfrPShareAllowed.fullName: Allowed MBSFN sync area subframe pattern share

maxSyncSubfrPShare.description:
Defines the maximum MBSFN Sync Area subframe pattern share based on the proportion of the system capacity that shall be reserved for MBMS Service.  A value of 25 indicates that maximum 25% of subframes  are reserved for MBMS Services and 75% are left for Unicast Service.

It is recommended to modify the parameter only if there is no active MBMS session. Otherwise MBMS service will be temporarily suspended and resumed. 

This parameter determines the values of radioframeAllocationPeriod, radioframeAllocationOffset, subframeAllocation(fourFrames) defined in TS36.331.

A lower percental share may be allocated by eNB if the required percental share is not possible with the actual configuration. In this case  the fault  'MBMS subframe pattern share exceeds avail. share' will be reported.

Note for TDD: Currently the use of MBMS is restricted to TDD subframe configuration#2.
maxSyncSubfrPShare.fullName: Maximum MBSFN sync area subframe pattern share

mbsfnDlChBw.description:
The downlink channel bandwidth used for MBSFN operation.
Only Maximum downlink channel bandwidth 10Mhz, 15Mhz, 20Mhz can be used. 
The downlink channel bandwidth mapping to number of Physical Resource Blocks is: 
10.0 MHz = 50 DL PRBS  
15.0 MHz = 75 DL PRBS 
20.0 MHz = 100 DL PRBS  
It is recommended to modify the parameter only if there is no active MBMS session. Otherwise MBMS service will be temporarily suspended and resumed.

mbsfnEarfcn.description:
E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number used for MBSFN operation. Services which are assigned to the MBSFN will be broadcasted in all cells of the eNB with earfcn equal to mbsfnEarfcn and chBw equal to mbsfnDlChBw.

It is recommended to modify the parameter only if there is no active MBMS session. Otherwise MBMS service will be temporarily suspended and resumed.
If MFBI is also enabled, then UEs that support the mapped band as indicated in the MFBIPR instance corresponding to earfcn will also be able to use MBMS services.

mbsfnOverlapAllowed.description:
Indicates if MBSFN Subframe overlapping configuration is allowed.
When this parameter is set to 'true', the MBSFNs belonging to this MBSFN Sync Area are allowed to have overlapping ranges of subframes.

mcc.description:
Indicates the Mobile Country Code.
The Mobile Country Code parameter indicates the Mobile Country Code and is part of the PLMN identifier.

mnc.description:
Indicates the Mobile Network Code.

syncAreaId.description:
Defines the MBSFN Synchronization Area ID.  Any specific Sync Area ID cannot be used across multiple carriers within an eNB.
This IE uniquely identifies an MBMS area supported for a specific frequency.  There could be up to eight MBSFNs supported within a single MBSFN Sync Area.

syncSubfrPShareAllowed.description:
Indicates the maximum allowed MBSFN Sync Area subframe pattern share which is currently in use.  A Value of 25 indicates, 25% of subframes  are reserved for MBMS Services and 75% is left for Unicast Service.
This parameter determines the values of commonSF-Alloc, radioframeAllocationPeriod, radioframeAllocationOffset, FourFrame defined in TS36.331.

The eNB selects a MBSFN Subframe configuration pattern which fits to the maximum percental share while considering other features (example: ETWS, OTDOA) which also reserve subframes.  The value may be less than or equal to maxSyncSubfrPShare.

If maxSyncSubfrPShare cannot be provided with the current eNB configuration, the value of syncSubfrPShareAllowed may be less than maxSyncSubfrPShare and the fault  'MBMS subframe pattern share exceeds avail. share' is reported.
syncSubfrPShareAllowed.fullName: Allowed MBSFN sync area subframe pattern share

dataMCS.description: Indicates the Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) applicable for the subframes of this (P)MCH.

maxSubfrPShare.description:
Defines the maximum MBSFN subframe pattern share based on the proportion of the system capacity that shall be reserved for MBMS Service. For eg., A Value of 25 indicates, 25% of subframes  are reserved for MBMS Services and 75% is left for Unicast Service.

It is recommended to modify the parameter only if there is no active MBMS session.
This parameter determines the values of radioframeAllocationPeriod, radioframeAllocationOffset, subframeAllocation(fourFrames) defined in TS36.331.

If MBSFN subframes are statically defined (actDynMBMSRes is set to FALSE), eNB selects a MBSFN subframe configuration pattern which fits to the maximum percental share.
Otherwise (actDynMBMSRes is set to TRUE), eNB selects a MBSFN subframe configuration pattern with an MBMS subframe percentage that is less than or equal to the maximum percental share.

Note:  All Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode may be released, when this parameter is online modified together with Cat-M are activated.

mcchRepetitionPeriod.description:
The parameter indicates the interval between transmissions of MCCH information. The MCCH is scheduled in the period where SFN mod mcch-RepetitionPeriod = mcch-Offset.
eNB will configure mchSchedulingPeriod of the first selected (P)MCH to be smaller than or equal to mcchRepetitionPeriod.

mchSchedulingPeriod.description:
Indicates the MCH scheduling period i.e. the periodicity used for providing MCH scheduling information at lower layers (MAC) applicable for an MCH. Value rf8 corresponds to 8 radio frames, rf16 corresponds to 16 radio frames and so on. 
The mchSchedulingPeriod starts in the radio frames for which: SFN mod mchSchedulingPeriod = 0.

If this (MSP) value is set excessively long when a high dataMCS is used, excessive packet discards might happen resulting in poor MBMS broadcast service. 
The MSP length must be set to one or multiple times of the Synchronization sequence length on the BM-SC for MBMS Services in the MCH.

qci.description:

It is recommended to modify the parameter only if there are no active MBMS sessions for the specific QCI.

addFreqBandInd.description:
Indicator of the mapped E-UTRA frequency band
A mapped E-UTRA frequency band must overlap with the native E-UTRA frequency band.
The native frequency band is either
- the operating band which is broadcasted in SIB1 with IE freqBandIndicator or
- the frequency band which is related to the target EARFCN in case of interfrequency mobility

The setting is commonly valid for all legacy category UE and Cat-M UE.
Note: This parameter used for NB-IoT standalone cell.

addSpectrEmissReq.description:
Additional spectrum emission requirement for the mapped frequency band.
The UE requirements related to IE AdditionalSpectrumEmission are defined in TS 36.101 [42, table 6.2.4.1].

The setting is commonly valid for all legacy category UE and Cat-M UE.
Note: This parameter used for NB-IoT standalone cell.

eutraCarrierFreq.description:
EARFCN value of the native carrier frequency for which the MFBI profile applies.
A MFBI profile defines a mapped frequency band in order to serve UEs which support the physical cell frequency but indicate the mapped frequency band.
The profile applies to eNB cells and inter-frequency neighbour cells with a frequency value matching eutraCarrierFreq.
Note: This parameter used for NB-IoT standalone cell.

freqBandIndPrio.description:
This parameter allows to prioritize mapped bands over native bands.
If the parameter is 'broadcasted', the eNB indicates to the UE to prioritize the corresponding frequency bands in the multiBandInfoList IE. Only if the UE does not support the frequency band in multiBandInfoList IE or does not support the frequency band adjustment, the UE shall use the value in freqBandIndicator IE. Otherwise, the UE applies the frequency band according to the rules defined in multiBandInfoList.

The setting is commonly valid for all legacy category UE and Cat-M UE.

ccaThreshold.description:
This parameter is used by the eNB to derive the maximum energy detection threshold "DataThresh_max" beyond which no PDCCH/PDSCH transmission is allowed from a cell in frequency band #46.

"DataThresh_max" is calculated taking the minimum between the configured ccaThreshold parameter value and the applied "Xthresh_max" (see lteUWiFiCoexistence parameter for details).

ccaThresholdDrs.description:
This parameter is used by the eNB to derive the maximum energy detection threshold "DrsThresh_max" beyond which no "DRS only" transmission is allowed from a cell in frequency band #46.

"DrsThresh_max" is calculated taking the minimum between the configured ccaThresholdDrs parameter value and the applied "Xthresh_max" (see lteUWiFiCoexistence parameter for details).

drsMtcPeriod.description: This parameter defnies the period by which the DRS window is transmitted.

enableLaaDsPadding.description:
This parameter enables or disables the padding of blank symbols of the discovery signal transmitted on an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode with random data. Enabling of the padding prevents other devices operating on the frequency of an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode from acquiring the channel during the silent symbols of the discovery signal transmission (e.g., symbol 2, 3, 9, 10). It also increases the total transmitted power per symbol and therefore reduces the possibility of transmission collision between LTE and other technologies (e.g., Wi-Fi). It is recommended to enable the discovery signal padding if an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode is expected to co-exist with other radio technologies (e.g., Wi-Fi).
Note 1: This parameter takes effect only if the unlicensed cell is operated in 'LAA' mode, i.e., actUnlicensedAcc is set to 'LAA'.
Note 2: For definition of an 'unlicensed cell', please, see its definition at parameter actUnlicensedAcc.
enableLaaDsPadding.fullName: Enable discovery signal padding for LAA

lteUWiFiCoexistence.description:
This parameter indicates whether or not the eNB has to share frequency band #46 with other systems (e.g., Wi-Fi). eNB will adapt accordingly the maximum continuous transmission period as per 3GPP TS 36.213 and derive which formula for the maximum energy detection threshold “Xthresh_max” to apply as follows:

If lteUWiFiCoexistence is set to 'no WiFi':
"XThresh_max" corresponds to the maximum energy detection threshold defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 when absence of any other technology sharing the carrier can be guaranteed on a long-term basis. If this formula applies, the parameter ccaThresholdXr corresponds to the "Xr" factor of the 3GPP specification.

If lteUWiFiCoexistence is set to 'WiFi':
"XThresh_max" corresponds to maximum energy detection threshold defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 when absence of any other technology sharing the carrier cannot be guaranteed on a long-term basis. If this formula applies, the parameter ccaThresholdXr does not play any role.

The so derived “XThresh_max” is then used in combination with the parameters ccaThreshold and ccaThreholdDrs to calculate the maximum energy detection thresholds (“DataThresh_max” and “DrsThresh_max”) that the eNB will apply to decide about transmission.

nonGbrThreshUnlicensed.description:
This parameter is used for calculating the minimum amount of data “MinBufferedData” which should be buffered in the unlicensed SCell for a given Channel Access Priority Class before considering its transmission.
“MinBufferedData” for data of a given Access Priority Class “P” is derived from nongbrThreshUnlicensed as follows:

For lteUItuRegion = 'USA'
    MinBufferedData = nonGbrThreshUnlicened * (Tmcot,p -1)/10,
For lteUItuRegion = 'Japan'
    MinBufferedData = nonGbrThreshUnlicened * (min(4, Tmcot,p -1))/10,
where: “Tmcot,p” corresponds to the maximum continuous transmission time allowed for the respective Access Priority Class “P”, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.213.

If this parameter is set to '0', no threshold before data transmission is applied.

Note: For definition of an 'unlicensed cell', please, see its definition at parameter actUnlicensedAcc.
nonGbrThreshUnlicensed.fullName: Min. non-GBR data for using unlicensed carrier

actNcYgMPlane.description: Likely activates a NETCONF/YANG-based Management-Plane interface on the module ('Nc'=NETCONF, 'Yg'=YANG), as an alternative to legacy M-plane protocols.

actPassivePartSync.description: Likely a true/false switch that enables or disables a behavior related to "activate/enable Passive Part synchronization" on the MNL object. This description was auto-generated from the parameter's name and usage context (not individually verified against Nokia's official parameter dictionary), because this parameter did not appear frequently enough in the sample files to be hand-researched.

cmSyncCheckPeriod.description:
Defines the period of forced CCN sending from BTS. 
If no other BTS parameter is modified within time defined by cmSyncCheckPeriod then BTS modifies cmSyncCheck parameter and reports itin CCN.

To switch off the periodical forced sending of CCN the cmSyncCheckPeriod parameter value shall be removed.

fixMacAddress.description:
This parameter is for fixing invalid MAC addresses on BTS.
Replaces first 3 bytes of MAC from D6-EF-CD to  54-FA-96
fixMacAddress.fullName: Fix invalid MAC address on BTS

microTmpActFeat1.description: Nokia-internal temporary/experimental feature-activation switch used during trials or staged rollouts; the generic name gives no public documentation of its exact function.

microTmpActFeat2.description: A second Nokia-internal temporary/experimental feature-activation switch, companion to microTmpActFeat1, with no publicly documented specific function.

mnlId.description: This parameter identifies the management layer class. There is only one instance of class MNL.

plannedSWReleaseVersion.description: The planned version of the BTS software release. This parameter can be assigned by the user to the plan to guarantee that the plan - once it is downloaded and validated in BTS Autoconfiguration preparation phase - is validated with the planned BTS SW version. The according SW version will be downloaded autonomously if not yet installed.

productVariantPlanned.description: This parameter is used to indicate the planned Network Element type.

timeZone.description:
Defines the BTS's time zone.

The BTS's time zone is presented as an enumeration. For example, for Helsinki the value is: "(GMT+2) Europe/Helsinki". The value of TIME-timeZone is used by the BTS to automatically derive the local time and daylight savings time offset that are broadcast in SIB16.

tmpActFeat1.description: A generic, Nokia-internal placeholder activation flag (its name suggests a temporary/staging feature switch used during feature rollout or lab testing) rather than a stable, documented feature toggle.
