validatePlanAgainstDetectedHW.description:
Perform configuration plan validation against the hardware detected by the BTS. 
This parameter indicates whether or not planned configuration changes are validated against the capabilities of the hardware physically installed and detected by the BTS. 

When set to "true", the BTS configuration is validated against the detected hardware as part of configuration plan validation. If the current BTS configuration violates a constraint of the detected hardware, configuration plan validation fails and the configuration plan is rejected. Additionally, if the configuration references hardware that is not yet physically installed in the BTS, configuration plan validation fails. 

If set to "false", the configuration plan is not validated against the detected hardware. In this case, planned configuration changes may be made prior to the installation of the appropriate hardware.

The validation functionality represented by this parameter is performed both for the configuration plan in which its value is modified as well as for subsequent configuration plans.

vnfIpAddress.description: VNF IP address. Parameter is mandatory for the connection establishment to BTSMED and RAPs.

cpriSyncBreakTime.description: Maximum allowed break time in CPRI link synchronization before the system declares a synchronization loss / raises an alarm.

delayCompType.description:
This parameter controls the way cells are grouped by the BTS to support compensation of fiber length differences in case of CPRI-OBSAI protocol mix.

The possible values of delayCompType are:
ProtocolBased- Delay compensation groups are constructed of cells using the same protocol only.  Setting of distRefPoint is not allowed.
CellBased - Delay compensation groups are constructed of cells with mixed of protocols allowed. Delay compensation is calculated for cells inside a group but not between different groups. BTS tries to create as many groups as possible. (In case of reconfiguration, the BTS will minimize number of cells that need to be taken temporarily out of service. However, it is unavoidable to stop time dependent functions during the period of re-configuration.) Setting of distRefPoint is allowed. Using distRefPoint will further restrict the group creation to be within an FSP such as an ABIA.

sharedRfTechnologies.description:
This parameter indicates the partner technologies external to the BTS which share the same RF equipment. The system will set this parameter automatically based on RF sharing configuration in the BTS.

NONE – All radio modules are standalone and not shared with other technologies
UTRAN-EUTRA – 1 or more radio modules are shared between WCDMA and LTE
UTRAN_GERAN – 1 or more radio modules are shared between WCDMA and GSM
EUTRA-GERAN – 1 or more radio modules are shared between LTE and GSM
EUTRA-EUTRA – 1 or more radio modules are shared between LTE and another LTE
EUTRA-EUTRA/EUTRA-GERAN – within 1 BTS, 2 sets of radios are being shared. 1 set is shared between LTE and another LTE and another set is shared between LTE and GSM.
EUTRA-CDMA - 1 or more radio modules are shared between LTE and CDMA

idleLBEutCelResWeight.description:
Weight factor of EUTRA carrier frequency used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing.
Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.
 All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured for SIBs  will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities.

The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
When not specified the weight is considered as 0.
idleLBEutCelResWeight.fullName: EUTRA carrier weight factor idle mode load balancing

allowLBHoToUtran.description: This parameter indicates if the SPID Group is allowed to be offloaded to UTRAN for Connected Mode Load Balancing.

autoAdapt.description:
This parameter offers the possibility to use existing LNCEL configuration as default mobility profile. This parameter defines auto adaptation rules for all mobility procedures except for Idle Mode Mobility Load Balancing procedures.

autoAdapt parameter is considered when MODPR applies. For details, see parameter description of LNBTS-actSelMobPrf.

If autoAdapt is 'true':
- the HO frequency lists defined in LNADJL, LNADJW and LNADJG objects are used instead of MODPR configuration. Frequency layers of newly created LNADJL, LNADJW and LNADJG objects are automatically included in the default profile. Exception for service based handover: eNB will treat the frequency list for service based handover as empty.
- VoLTE inter-frequency is not allowed.
- REDRT configuration of the corresponding cell is used instead of MODRED configuration. MODRED, if present, is not considered.

Note: Measurements are done only for adjacent objects (LNADJx) that are referred by a relationship object (LNRELx) with a frequency configured in the corresponding handover object (LNHOx).
autoAdapt.fullName: Auto adaptation to freq. layers of all neighbour cells

autoAdaptIMLB.description:
This parameter offers the possibility to use existing LNCEL configuration as default mobility profile. This parameter defines auto adaptation rules for Idle Mode Mobility Load Balancing procedures only.

autoAdapt parameter is considered when MODPR applies. For details, see parameter description of LNBTS-actSelMobPrf.

If autoAdaptIMLB is 'true':
- IMLB weights can be differentiated on the serving cell level. In this case IRFIM, UFFIM, CDFIM and GNFL configuration and serving carrier of the corresponding cell are used instead of MODIMP.
- MODIMP, if present, is not considered.

bandIndicator.description:

caBlockingAllowed.description: This parameter indicates, if a UE belonging to this mobility profile is subject to load-based carrier aggregation PCell and SCell blocking as defined by LTE4631.

freqLayListCsfbHighTdscdma.description:
List of TD-SCDMA target cell frequencies for high priority Circuit Switched Fallback (CSFB). The list applies even if LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘false’.
If LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘true’ it additionally applies to UEs when a MOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE.
No CSFB to TD-SCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListCsfbHighTdscdma.fullName: Frequency layer list high priority CSFB to TD-SCDMA

freqLayListCsfbHighWcdma.description:
List of WCDMA target cell frequencies for high priority Circuit Switched Fallback (CSFB). The list applies even if LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘false’.
If LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘true’ it additionally applies to UEs when a MOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE.

No CSFB to WCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.
freqLayListCsfbHighWcdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for high priority CSFB to WCDMA

freqLayListCsfbNormTdscdma.description:

If LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘true’ it additionally applies to UEs when a MOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE.
No CSFB to TD-SCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListCsfbNormTdscdma.fullName: Frequency layer list normal priority CSFB to TD-SCDMA

freqLayListCsfbNormWcdma.description:

If LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘true’ it additionally applies to UEs when a MOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE.

No CSFB to WCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.
freqLayListCsfbNormWcdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for normal priority CSFB to WCDMA

freqLayListDedLteLB.description:
Specifies the dedicated target frequency layers for inter-frequency load balancing handovers. The configured values are only applicable if feature LTE2571 "Dedicated target frequency list for load balancing" is activated for inter-frequency LB frequencies, i.e. parameter actDedFreqListsLB is configured to 'inter-frequency' or 'all'(FDD only).
When the list does not contain any target frequency even if the feature is activated, the eNB will not allow inter-frequency load balancing handover to all targets. 
If LTE1942 Dedicated VoLTE Inter-frequency Handover feature is activated, then the inter-frequency load balancing handover for VoLTE UEs will only be performed for frequency layers that are in both this list and in freqLayListDedVoLteHo of the MODPR instance.

In addition, when actSelMobPrf (Activate selective Mobility Profiles) is configured to 'true', the specified frequency layers in MODPR freqLayListDedLteLB apply only when no MOPR exists for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE. 

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListDedLteLB.fullName: Frequency layer list for ded. inter-frequency LB HO

freqLayListDedVoLteHo.description:
Specifies the dedicated target frequency layers for inter-frequency mobility during VoLTE calls. The configured values are only applicable if feature LTE1942 "Dedicated VoLTE IF frequency layers" is activated, i.e. parameter actDedVoLteInterFreqHo is configured to 'true'.
When the list does not contain any target frequency even if the feature is activated, the eNB will not allow VoLTE inter-frequency handover to all targets. 
For activated LTE1127 "Service Based Mobility Trigger" the list must include all frequency layers as defined in freqLayListServiceBasedHo of the MODPR instance.

When in addition actSelMobPrf (Activate selective Mobility Profiles) is configured to 'true', the specified frequency layers in MODPR freqLayListDedVoLteHo apply only when no MOPR exists for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE. 

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListDedVoLteHo.fullName: Frequency layer list for ded. VoLTE inter-frequency HO

freqLayListDedWcdmaLB.description:
Specifies the dedicated target frequency layers for WCDMA load balancing handovers. The configured values are only applicable if feature LTE2571 "Dedicated target frequency list for load balancing" is activated for WCDMA LB frequencies, i.e. parameter actDedFreqListsLB is configured to 'inter-system' or 'all'.
When the list does not contain any target frequency even if the feature is activated, the eNB will not allow WCDMA load balancing handover to all targets. 

In addition, when actSelMobPrf (Activate selective Mobility Profiles) is configured to 'true', the specified frequency layers in MODPR freqLayListDedWcdmaLB apply only when no MOPR exists for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE. 

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListDedWcdmaLB.fullName: Frequency layer list for ded. load based handover to WCDMA

freqLayListLte.description:
LTE inter-frequency mobility is restricted to the target frequency layers configured in freqLayListLte. 

If  LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to 'true' the restriction applies when a MOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE. 

If LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘false’ the restriction applies to all UEs.
No LTE Inter Frequency mobility will be provided if the parameter is omitted.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.
freqLayListLte.fullName: Frequency layer list for LTE inter frequency mobility

freqLayListPsHoTdscdma.description:
List of TD-SCDMA target cell frequencies for packet switched handover (PS HO) which applies to UEs when a MOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE.
No TD-SCDMA PS HO mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListPsHoTdscdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for PS handover TD-SCDMA

freqLayListPsHoWcdma.description:
WCDMA PS-HO mobility is restricted to the target frequency layers configured in freqLayListPsHoWcdma.

If  LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to 'true' the restriction applies when a MOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE. 

If LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘false’ the restriction applies to all UEs.

No WCDMA PS HO mobility will be provided to UEs if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListPsHoWcdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for packet switched handover WCDMA

freqLayListServiceBasedHo.description:
Specifies the frequency layers that are preferred for service based handover (LTE1127) or redirected VoLTE call setup (LTE2108). The eNB will based on the configured frequency layer list try to steer UEs with the established service to those preferred layers with service based handover, i.e. UEs with VoLTE calls will be guided to those frequency layers actively by the eNB.
The configured values are only applicable if either feature LTE1127 'Service Based Mobility Trigger' is activated (parameter actInterFreqServiceBasedHo is configured to 'true') or feature LTE2108 'Redirected VoLTE call setup' (parameter actRedirVoLte is configured to 'true') is activated.

When in addition LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is configured to 'true', the specified frequency layers in MODPR freqLayListServiceBasedHo apply only when no MOPR exists for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE.
If MODPR applies no service based mobility will be provided if the parameter is omitted or autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListServiceBasedHo.fullName: Frequency layer list for VoLTE service based HO

freqLayListSrvccWcdma.description:
List of WCDMA target cell frequencies for Single Radio Voice Call Continuity (SRVCC). The list applies even if LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘false’.
If LNBTS-actSelMobPrf is set to ‘true’ it additionally applies to UEs when a MOPR does not exist for the specific SPID and/or PLMN ID assigned to the UE.

No SRVCC to WCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter is meaningless if autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListSrvccWcdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for SRVCC to WCDMA

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.

redirGeranArfcnPrio.description:
The parameter specifies a priority order for GERAN ARFCN value according to which eNB shall built list of GERAN targets (CarrierFreqsGERAN IE of RedirectedCarrierInfo IE) in RRCConnectionRelease message with CSFB to GERAN via redirection.
GERAN ARFCN carriers will be placed in explicitListOfARFCNs IE as a choice of CarrierFreqsGERAN IE of RedirectedCarrierInfo IE in order of 'GERAN ARFCN priority order' value  starting from lowest value to highest configured by operator. GERAN ARFCN values without configured 'GERAN ARFCN priority order' will be placed at the end of list.

The parameter is meaningless if the MODPR parameter autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

redirGeranArfcnValue.description:

For ARFCN values not associated with one of those bands, the indicator has no meaning.
This parameter must always be configured if redirRAT=geran.
The parameter is meaningless if the MODPR parameter autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

The parameter is meaningless if the MODPR parameter autoAdapt is set to 'true'.

idleLBEutCelResWeight.description:
Weight factor of EUTRA carrier frequency used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing.
Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.
 All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured for SIBs  will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities.

The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
When not specified the weight is considered as 0.

idleLBGeranCelResWeight.description:
Weight factor of GERAN carrier frequency used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing.
Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.
 All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured for SIBs  will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities.

The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
When not specified the weight is considered as 0.
idleLBGeranCelResWeight.fullName: GERAN carrier weight factor idle mode load balancing

idleLBHrpdCelResPrio.description:
Absolute priority of the CDMA2000 HRPD band class used for idle mode load balancing.
For this parameter, 6 is the highest priority and 0 the lowest.
Note:
According to 3GPP 36.304, carriers in different RATs must have different Cell Reselection Priorities.
idleLBHrpdCelResPrio.fullName: CDMA HRPD band class prio for idle mode load balancing

moimpId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC MOIMP.
It uniquely identifies a MOIMP instance.
MOIMP contains the Idle Mobility configuration to be assigned to UE with corresponding SPID or PLMN ID.
If MOIMP is not defined, than MODIMP configuration is used.

utrFddCarFrq.description:
UTRA-FDD frequency as UARFCN value used for Idle Mode mobility
The UE performs only Load Balancing cell reselection for frequencies already configured for Idle Mobility (in UFFIM) and transmitted in system information. There is no need to provide other frequencies than configured already in SIBs. UE will ignore such frequencies.
utrFddCarFrq.fullName: UTRA FDD carrier freq for idle mode load balancing

utrTddCarFrq.description:
UTRA-TDD frequency as UARFCN value used for Idle Mode mobility
The UE shall only perform Load Balancing cell reselection for frequencies already configured for Idle Mobility (in UFFIM) and transmitted in system information. It does not make sense to provide other frequencies than configured already in SIBs. UE will ignore such frequencies.
utrTddCarFrq.fullName: UTRA TDD carrier freq for idle mode load balancing

moimpSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC MOIMPSPARE.
It uniquely identifies an MOIMPSPARE instance.

name.description:
This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.

value.description:
This is the value of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The allowed parameter values are defined in the feature specification.

The value of this spare parameter must be according to the provided information. It need to be case sensitive. In case the specified value doesn't match the supported values for this spare parameter, the BTS will reject the configuration.

allowLBHoToUtran.description: This parameter indicates if the SPID Group ia allowed to be offloaded to UTRAN for Connected Mode Load Balancing.

bandIndicator.description:
Indicator to distinguish the GERAN frequency band in case of ARFCN values associated with either DCS1800 or PCS1900 carriers.
For ARFCN values not associated with one of those bands, the indicator has no meaning.
bandIndicator.fullName: Band indicator applied to reference ARFCN

caBlockingAllowed.description: This parameter indicates, if a UE belonging to this mobility profile is subject to load-based carrier aggregation PCell and SCell blocking as defined by LTE4631.

freqLayListCsfbHighTdscdma.description:
List of TD-SCDMA target cell frequencies for high priority Circuit Switched Fallback (CSFB).
No CSFB to TD-SCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListCsfbHighTdscdma.fullName: Frequency layer list high priority CSFB to TD-SCDMA

freqLayListCsfbHighWcdma.description:
List of WCDMA target cell frequencies for high priority Circuit Switched Fallback (CSFB).

No CSFB to WCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListCsfbHighWcdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for high priority CSFB to WCDMA

freqLayListCsfbNormTdscdma.description:
List of TD-SCDMA target cell frequencies normal priority Circuit Switched Fallback (CSFB).
No CSFB to TD-SCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListCsfbNormTdscdma.fullName: Frequency layer list normal priority CSFB to TD-SCDMA

freqLayListCsfbNormWcdma.description:
List of WCDMA target cell frequencies normal priority Circuit Switched Fallback (CSFB).

No CSFB to WCDMA  mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the default profile if the parameter is omitted.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListCsfbNormWcdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for normal priority CSFB to WCDMA

freqLayListDedLteLB.description:
Specifies the dedicated target frequency layers for inter-frequency load balancing handovers. The configured values are only applicable if feature LTE2571 "Dedicated target frequency list for load balancing" is activated for inter-frequency LB frequencies, i.e. parameter actDedFreqListsLB is configured to 'inter-frequency' or 'all'(FDD only).
When the list does not contain any target frequency even if the feature is activated, the eNB will not allow inter-frequency load balancing handover to all targets. 
If LTE1942 Dedicated VoLTE Inter-frequency Handover feature is activated, then the inter-frequency load balancing handover for VoLTE UEs will only be performed for frequency layers that are in both this list and in freqLayListDedVoLteHo of the MOPR instance.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListDedLteLB.fullName: Frequency layer list for ded. inter-frequency LB HO

freqLayListDedVoLteHo.description:
Specifies the dedicated target frequency layers for inter-frequency mobility during VoLTE calls. The configured values are only applicable if feature LTE1942 "Dedicated VoLTE IF frequency layers" is activated, i.e. parameter actDedVoLteInterFreqHo is configured to 'true'.
When the list does not contain any target frequency even if the feature is activated, the eNB will not allow VoLTE inter-frequency handover to all targets. 
For activated LTE1127 "Service Based Mobility Trigger" the list must include all frequency layers as defined in freqLayListServiceBasedHo of the same MOPR instance.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListDedVoLteHo.fullName: Frequency layer list for ded. VoLTE inter-frequency HO

freqLayListDedWcdmaLB.description:
Specifies the dedicated target frequency layers for WCDMA load balancing handovers. The configured values are only applicable if feature LTE2571 "Dedicated target frequency list for load balancing" is activated for WCDMA LB frequencies, i.e. parameter actDedFreqListsLB is configured to 'inter-system' or 'all'.
When the list does not contain any target frequency even if the feature is activated, the eNB will not allow WCDMA load balancing handover to all targets. 

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListDedWcdmaLB.fullName: Frequency layer list for ded. load based handover to WCDMA

freqLayListLte.description:
List of downlink carrier frequencies for LTE inter frequency mobility.
No LTE Inter Frequency mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the profile if the parameter is omitted.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListLte.fullName: Frequency layer list for LTE inter frequency mobility

freqLayListPsHoTdscdma.description:
List of TD-SCDMA target cell frequencies for packet switched handover.
No TD-SCDMA PS HO mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListPsHoTdscdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for PS handover TD-SCDMA

freqLayListPsHoWcdma.description:
List of WCDMA target cell frequencies for packet switched handover.
No WCDMA PS HO mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListPsHoWcdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for packet switched handover WCDMA

freqLayListServiceBasedHo.description:
Specifies the frequency layers that are preferred for service based handover. The eNB will based on the configured frequency layer list try to steer UEs with the established service to those preferred layers with service based handover, i.e. UEs with VoLTE calls will be guided to those frequency layers actively by the eNB. The configured values are only applicable if feature LTE1127 'Service Based Mobility Trigger' is activated, i.e. parameter actInterFreqServiceBasedHo is configured to 'true'.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListServiceBasedHo.fullName: Frequency layer list for VoLTE service based HO

freqLayListSrvccWcdma.description:
List of WCDMA target cell frequencies for Single Radio Voice Call Continuity (SRVCC).

No SRVCC to WCDMA mobility will be provided to UEs which are assigned to the profile if the parameter is omitted.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
freqLayListSrvccWcdma.fullName: Frequency layer list for SRVCC to WCDMA

iFLBCandPrio.description: This parameter indicates UE candidate selection SPID priority for Connected Mode Load Balancing. With LTE3757 UE selection for offload is prioritized according to operator defined SPID groups.
iFLBCandPrio.fullName: Inter Frequency Load Balancing candidate selection priority

idleLBPercCaUe.description: Percentage of UE to be selected for Idle Mode Load Balancing for CA capable UEs.
idleLBPercCaUe.fullName: Percentage of UE for idle mode load balancing for CA capable UEs

idleLBPercUeTM9.description: The percentage of idle-mode UEs that support Transmission Mode 9 (TM9, used for advanced MIMO/CA) that are targeted for idle-mode load balancing redirection.

idleLBPercentageOfUes.description: Percentage of UE to be selected for Idle Mode Load Balancing.
idleLBPercentageOfUes.fullName: Percentage of UE for idle mode load balancing

moPrId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC MOPR.
It uniquely identifies a MOPR instance.

referenceARFCN.description: ARFCN value which is used as reference to a GERAN measurement object (LNHOG).

targetSelMethod.description: Selection method for the target frequency/layer for idle mode load balancing.
targetSelMethod.fullName: Cell reselection method for idle mode load balancing

moPrSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC MOPRSPARE.
It uniquely identifies an MOPRSPARE instance.

name.description:
This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.

value.description:
This is the value of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The allowed parameter values are defined in the feature specification.

The value of this spare parameter must be according to the provided information. It need to be case sensitive. In case the specified value doesn't match the supported values for this spare parameter, the BTS will reject the configuration.

addGsmSIToRedirMsg.description:
The parameter selects the kinds of UE redirections (CS fallback, UE redirection with context release, both) for which GSM system information is included in the RRC Connection Release message.
GSM system information (SI) will be added for up to 16 cells. SI for further GSM cells will be omitted even if configured via LNLRELG settings.
addGsmSIToRedirMsg.fullName: Add GSM system information to redirection message

addUtranSIToRedirMsg.description:
The parameter selects the kinds of UE redirections (CS fallback, UE redirection with context release, both) for which UTRAN system information shall be included in the RRC Connection Release message.
UTRAN system information (SI) will be added for up to 16 cells. SI for further UTRAN cells will be omitted even if configured via LNRELW settings.
addUtranSIToRedirMsg.fullName: Add UTRAN system information to redirection message

csFallBPrio.description:
This parameter defines priority for target RAT in selection of redirection target during CS Fallback with redirection procedure.
Value 1 means highest priority and value 6 lowest.
csFallBPrio.fullName: Redirection priority for CS fallback with redirection

emerCallPrio.description:
This parameter defines priority for target RAT in selection of redirection target during Emergency Call handling procedure.
Value 1 means highest priority and value 6 lowest.

moRedId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC MORED.
It uniquely identifies a MORED instance.

redirBandCdma.description: This parameter specifies the cdma2000 band class. It must be configured if redirRAT=cdma2000HRPD or redirRAT=cdma20001xRTT.

redirFreqCdma.description:
This parameter specifies the cdma2000 ARFCN.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.

It must be configured if redirRAT=cdma2000HRPD or redirRAT=cdma20001xRTT.

redirFreqEutra.description: This parameter specifies the eUTRA frequency. It must be configured if redirRAT=eutra.

redirFreqUtra.description:
This parameter specifies the UTRA frequency. It must be configured if redirRAT=utraFDD.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.

redirFreqUtraTDDL.description:
This parameter specifies a list of UTRA TDD frequency. It must be configured if redirRAT=utraTDD.
The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number “ARFCN”.
This parameter must be configured if redirRat=utraTDD.
It specifies the TD-SCDMA frequencies list.

redirGeranArfcnPrio.description:
The parameter specifies a priority order for GERAN ARFCN value according to which eNB shall built list of GERAN targets (CarrierFreqsGERAN IE of RedirectedCarrierInfo IE) in RRCConnectionRelease message with CSFB to GERAN via redirection.
GERAN ARFCN carriers will be placed in explicitListOfARFCNs IE as a choice of CarrierFreqsGERAN IE of RedirectedCarrierInfo IE in order of 'GERAN ARFCN priority order' value  starting from lowest value to highest configured by operator. GERAN ARFCN values without configured 'GERAN ARFCN priority order' will be placed at the end of list.

redirGeranArfcnValue.description: The parameter specifies a  GERAN ARFCN value.

redirGeranBandIndicator.description:
Indicator to distinguish the GERAN frequency band in case of ARFCN values associated with either GSM 1800 or GSM 1900 carriers.
For ARFCN values not associated with one of those bands, the indicator has no meaning.
This parameter must always be configured if redirRAT=geran.

redirRAT.description: This parameter selects the RAT to which the UE is redirected.
redirRAT.officialRange:
0: eutra 
1: geran 
2: utraFDD 
3: utraTDD 
4: cdma2000HRPD 
5: cdma20001xRTT

redirectPrio.description:
This parameter defines priority for target RAT in selection of redirection target during UE Context Release with redirection procedure.
Value 1 means highest priority and value 6 lowest.
redirectPrio.fullName: Redirection priority for UE context release

moRedSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC MOREDSPARE.
It uniquely identifies an MOREDSPARE instance.

name.description:
This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.

The value of this spare parameter must be according to the provided information. It need to be case sensitive. In case the specified value doesn't match the supported values for this spare parameter, the BTS will reject the configuration.

ipIfDN.description:
This parameter defines the IP interface to which the local management plane shall be assigned to. It need to be an IP interface which is associated with the Local Management Port (LMP). IPIF->ETHIF->ETHLK-connectorLabel=LMP.
The value is to be defined as distinguished name (DN).
Example:
MRBTS-1//TNLSVC-1/TNL-1/IPNO-1/IPIF-1

mPlaneLocalId.description: This parameter defines the instance identifier of the local management plane object. It uniquely identifies the object.

sseDscp.description:
This parameter defines the DSCP value that shall be used for any traffic originationg from the local management port (LMP).
The original value will be overwritten by the value defined for this parameter. If the parameter is not defined the original value will be kept.

actEnableTLSv13.description: Enables TLS protocol version 1.3 for securing management-plane (O&M) network connections.

autonomousResetType.description: Configures what autonomous corrective action the management-plane network element takes on certain fault conditions, for example doing nothing versus performing an automatic reset.

certTypeForEAPTlsAuth.description: Selects the certificate key type (e.g. RSA or ECDSA) used when authenticating via EAP-TLS for network access/M-plane security.

certTypeForTlsAuth.description: The certificate/key algorithm type (e.g. RSA) used for TLS mutual authentication on the management-plane connection.

ingressTrafficShapingBandwidth.description: This parameter defines the bandwidth in kbps to which the BTS shapes the BTS management plane ingress traffic.

ingressTrafficShapingEnabled.description:
This parameter defines whether ingress traffic shaping for the BTS management plane traffic shall be enabled.

Note: This parameter is only relevant in case TDM backhaul is used (not applicable to HW Airscale).

mPlaneDscp.description: This parameter specifies the differentiated services code point (DSCP) value to be used for management of the plane traffic.

mPlaneIpv4AddressDN.description:
This parameter defines the reference to the IPADDRESSV4 object instance which holds the IPv4 address to be used by management plane.
The related runtime object will provide the actually assigned IP address.
Example: MRBTS-1/TNLSVC-1/TNL-1/IPNO-1/IPIF-17/IPADDRESSV4-1
mPlaneIpv4AddressDN.fullName: Management plane IPv4 IP address reference

mPlaneIpv6AddressDN.description:
This parameter defines the reference to the IPADDRESSV6 object instance which holds the IPv6 address to be used by management plane.
The related runtime object will provide the actually assigned IP address.
Example: MRBTS-1/TNLSVC-1/TNL-1/IPNO-1/IPIF-17/IPADDRESSV6-1
mPlaneIpv6AddressDN.fullName: Management plane IPv6 IP address reference

mPlaneNwId.description: This parameter defines the instance identifier of the management plane network object.

oamPeerIpAddress.description:
This parameter defines the IP address of the  operation and maintenance system  to establish a management connection. The Management connection can be secured by using TLS. 

Value 0.0.0.0 means that BTSMED connection is disabled and BTS works in a standalone mode.

The IPv4 is in dotted decimal format  or IPv6 in format defined in RFC4291.
oamPeerIpAddress.fullName: IP address of the operation and maintenance system

oamTls.description:
This parameter defines whether the TLS shall be used to secure the management connection. The following values are supported:
"off" - The management connection is unsecure (TLS not in use).
"forced" - The management connection is secured with TLS (TLS in use).

The usage of the TLS requires that valid certificates are installed in the BTS.
oamTls.fullName: TLS usage towards the operation and maintenance system

tls11Enabled.description: This parameter specifies whether TLS1.1 is supported  between the BTS and other systems

tls12CbcCipherDisabled.description: Security-hardening flag that disables CBC-mode cipher suites in TLS 1.2, mitigating known CBC-related vulnerabilities.

tls12Enabled.description: Enables TLS protocol version 1.2 for securing management-plane (O&M) network connections.

tls12RsaKExDisabled.description: Security-hardening flag that disables RSA key-exchange cipher suites in TLS 1.2 in favor of forward-secret key-exchange methods.

tlsRenegotiationInterval.description:
This parameter defines the time interval in seconds to trigger secure renegotiation of a TLS session, used in management connections, according to RFC 5746. If the parameter is set to non-zero, BTS triggers secure renegotiation on a TLS session if the session allows secure renegotiation and the session has been alive for a period defined by this timer after initial setup or last renegotiation, whichever occurs most recently. If the parameter is set to zero, BTS does not trigger time-based secure renegotiation.

Note: this parameter can only be set to 0, or between 300 and 86400.

tlsSHA1DigitalSignDisable.description: Security-hardening flag that disables SHA-1-based digital signatures in TLS.

mPlaneNwRId.description: This parameter defines the instance identifier of the management plane network object in runtime.
mPlaneNwRId.fullName: Management plane network runtime object identifier

oamTlsStatus.description: This parameter shows the current TLS status of the BTS towards the operation and maintenance system.
oamTlsStatus.fullName: TLS state towards the operation and maintenance system

tls11EnabledStatus.description: This parameter shows the TLS1.1 enable status of the BTS towards the operation and maintenance system.
tls11EnabledStatus.fullName: TLS1.1 enable state towards the operation and maintenance system

autoResiliencyEnabled.description: Indicates whether the BTS will automatically failover to an available, non-serving mediator (MPLANENW instance) if connectivity to the serving mediator is lost. If automatic resiliency is disabled, a manual switchover (MPLANESWITCHREQ) is still permitted.

defaultMplaneDN.description:
The distinguished name of the M-plane managed object instance (MPLANENW) whose associated mediator will be assigned the serving role after first configuring M-plane resiliency.

Note: after the serving role is initially configured, the BTS will record its current serving M-plane such that, upon BTS restart, the BTS will assign the serving role to the M-plane that was assigned prior to the restart.

failoverWaitTime.description: If automatic resiliency is enabled, the amount of time the BTS will wait, after detecting a mediator failure condition and exhausting all retries, before failover to another mediator is initiated.

mplaneResilId.description: Identifier of the M-plane resiliency managed object

mplaneResilRId.description: Identifier of the M-plane resiliency read-only managed object

servingMediatorDN.description:
The distinguished name of the mediator (BTSMED) serving this BTS.

Note: this parameter is populated on behalf of the BTSMED serving this BTS and is visible only at the NMS.

servingMplaneDN.description: The distinguished name of the M-plane managed object instance (MPLANENW) whose associated mediator is serving this BTS.

mplaneSwitchReqId.description: Identifier of the M-plane Switchover Request command instance

failureReason.description: Reports details related to M-plane switchover failures

mplaneSwitchResId.description: Identifier of the M-plane Switchover result instance

MPUCCH_FDD.officialFullName: Manual PUCCH Allocation Configuration for FDD Cell

addAUeRrHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active UEs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActUE.
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..550 (recommended: 20)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..800 (recommended: 30)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 20)

Airscale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..400 (recommended: 20)
- for 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 30)

The range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.
addAUeRrHo.fullName: Add number active UEs radio reason handover

addAUeTcHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active UEs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "Time Critical HO". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActUE.
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..550 (recommended: 30)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..800 (recommended: 45)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 30)

AirScale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..400 (recommended: 30)
- for 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 45)

the range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.
addAUeTcHo.fullName: Add number active UEs time critical handover

addEmergencySessions.description:
Additional margin for Emergency Sessions;
this margin increases the thresholds for active UEs, active DRBs with a factor and active QCI1-DRBs in the cell
Emergency traffic shall have high preference against normal traffic in the cell.
The addEmergencySession value is used to increase several thresholds and it has to be considered, that the system limits are never exceeded for all resources.

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..550 (recommended: 20)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..800 (recommended: 30)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 20)

AirScale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:

minNumRrc.description:

minNumRrcNoDrb.description:
Minimum  number of UEs in the cell which may establish a RRC connection without a DRB establishment (e.g. doing tracking area updates); this parameter is relevant as additional margin for a minimum resource configuration. n1PucchAn.description:
Offset used to calculate ACK/NACK resource from PDCCH CCE.
This is the AckNack index offset relative to the lowest CCE index of the associated DL scheduling PDCCH.
Parameter is one parameter in a set which defines the maximum PUCCH allocation called as MaxPucchResourceSize.

nCqiRb.description:
Number of Physical Resource Blocks that are reserved for PUCCH formats 2/2a/2b/3.
This parameter is the number of Physical Resource Blocks that are reserved for PUCCH formats 2/2a/2b/3.

This parameter is part of the set which defines the maximum PUCCH allocation called  MaxPucchResourceSize. All other parameters are related to each other according to this formula:
Note: in the formula below the term dlChBw shall be considered in # of PRB and not in MHz!

MaxPucchResourceSize = nCqiRb + roundup{[ (max((M-i-1)* Np +i*Np1 + rounddown (((12 * (maxNrSymPdcch-Yi) - X) * chBw – mi*roundup(phichRes * (chBw / 8)) *  12 – 16 )/ 36)) + n1PucchAn - pucchNAnCs * c / deltaPucchShift) * deltaPucchShift] / (c*12)} + roundup (pucchNAnCs / 8),
All other parameters in this formula are O&M parameters, while MaxPucchResourceSize is a calculated value that has a maximum allowed value, which shall not be exceeded
Therefore the MaxPucchResourceSize is utilized to determine the correct offset allocation of the PRACH resources and to verify  that the maximal allowed amount of PUCCH resouces per BW is not overcome.

nPucchF3Prbs.description: This parameter defines how many PRBs are allocated for PUCCH Format3.
nPucchF3Prbs.fullName: Number of PUCCH PRBs for HARQ Format 3

phichDur.description:
Indicates the duration of PHICH.

phichDur also puts a lower limit on the size of the control region signalled by the PCFICH. Therefore, when phichDur is set to value (Extended), three OFDMA symbols need to be enabled to for PDCCH and maxNrSymPdcch needs to be set to value 3
When phichDur is set to value (Normal), PHICH is transmitted in the first OFDMA symbol, and when phichDur is set to value (Extended), PHICH is transmitted in first three OFDMA symbols. 

phichDur is transmitted in system information as information is cell specific, and all UEs need to know whether to receive PHICH from 1 or 3 symbols. 

phichDur also puts a lower limit on the size of the control region signalled by the PCFICH. Therefore, when phichDur is set to value (Extended), three OFDMA symbols need to be enabled for PDCCH and maxNrSymPdcch needs to be set to value 3. For futher info see Table 6.9.3-1 in TS 36.211.

phichRes.description:
Indicates the PHICH resource size.
The Physical Hybrid ARQ Indicatior Channel (PHICH) carries the hybrid-ARQ ACK/NAK. Multiple PHICHs mapped to the same set of resource elements constitute a PHICH group and the PHICH resource parameter defines the number of PHICH groups.

riEnable.description: Determines whether RI reporting is enabled (true) or not (false).

riPerM.description: Multiplier M for defining periodic RI feedback reporting period. It defines the multiplier for the cqiPerNp which results in the periodicity for RI periodic reports. RI periodicity = cqiPerNp * riPerM. When riPerM is equal to 0 (M=1) the parameter riPerOffset must be set to -1 (CQI and Ri are adjiacent) while when riPerM is set to 1 (M=2) the parameter riPerOffset must set to 0 (in this case CQI and RI alternate).
riPerM.fullName: Multiplier M for periodic RI reporting period

riPerOffset.description:
Time offset for periodic CQI/PMI reporting for defining the periodic RI reporting instance
The parameter defines the offset for periodic Rank Indicator reporting instance. The offset tells the time shift for the periodic CQI/PMI reporting instance. The range of the offset depends on the periodicity (cqiPerNp) of periodic CQI/PMI reporting.

- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..800 (recommended: 30)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 20)

The range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.
addAUeRrHo.fullName: Add Number Active Ues Radio Reason Handover

addAUeTcHo.description:

the range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.
addAUeTcHo.fullName: Add Number Active Ues Time Critical Handover

addEmergencySessions.description:
