actPCMDReporting.description: This parameter activates the PCMD reporting for a trace session.

actUeThroughputMR.description:
This parameter activates the UE throughput measurement reports for a trace session.
The feature flag LNBTS-actUeThroughputMeas must first be set to true to enable this parameter  for a trace session.

aoATracing.description:
This parameter describes whether tracing of AoA as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing is enabled or not.

This parameter is only applicable for TDD and 8 TX RRU.

cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced.description:
Defines the maximum number of active MDT UEs configured for MDT UE measurement reporting within a cell. This value is set by the operator at MDT trace session start.

Only UEs that enter the cell (Initial Context Setup, Handover or RRC re-establishment) can be selected for MDT, i.e. will be configured for periodic measurement of reportStrongestCell (RSRP/RSRQ of serving cell and neighbor cells).

Only UEs that were configured for periodic UE measurement reporting and did not reach the reportAmount are counted as active MDT UEs.  

UEs that were configured for periodic UE measurement reporting will continue to be traced after the last measurement report in an ImmediateMDTAndTrace session until the end of the call.

Also in case when the lcrId parameter is not set, i.e. the trace session is configured for all cells in the eNB, then this parameter cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced limits the number of active MDT UEs to be traced in each cell. This then limits the total number of MDT UEs traced per eNB as cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced multiplied by the number of cells in eNB. For the whole eNB operator shall not configure more than 900 UEs to be selected for LTE2202.
cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced.fullName: Cell maximum active MDT UEs traced

cellMaxActiveUEsTraced.description:
Defines the maximum number of active UE connections traced within a cell for a trace session. This value is set by operator at trace session start.

When maximum number of UEs that are traced for this trace session is reached in eNB, then eNB will continue to trace the currently traced UEs until the UEs leave the cell.
Also in case when the lcrId parameter is not set, i.e. the trace session is configured for all cells in the eNB, then this parameter cellMaxActiveUEsTraced limits the number of active UEs to be traced in each cell. This then limits the total number of UEs traced per eNB as cellMaxActiveUEsTraced multiplied by the number of cells in eNB. For the whole eNB operator shall not configure more than 900 UEs to be selected for LTE2202.

If jobType is "RLFReportsOnly" the parameter cellMaxActiveUEsTraced shall be ignored.

cellTaTracing.description: This parameter describes whether tracing of instantaneous TA value on cell level as part of vendor specific extension tracing is enabled or not.

cellTrcMode.description:
This indicates the status of the cell trace session i.e. whether the cell trace session is enabled or disabled. 

Note: This parameter currently should only be set to enabled (i.e. TRUE).

eutranTraceIdMcc.description:
MCC of PLMN ID contained in Trace Reference
This is the MCC of the PLMN ID contained in the Trace Reference of E-UTRAN Trace ID.

eutranTraceIdMnc.description:
MNC of PLMN ID contained in Trace Reference
This is the MNC of the PLMN ID contained in the Trace Reference of E-UTRAN Trace ID.

eutranTraceIdMncLen.description:
Length of MNC of PLMN ID contained in Trace Reference
This is the length of the MNC of the PLMN ID contained in the Trace Reference of E-UTRAN Trace ID.

forceUeIdsRepetition.description:
This optional parameter configures the eNB to send the three parameters MME UE S1AP ID, ENB UE S1AP ID and GUMMEI either in every trace record where they are available (true) of only once per call (false).

This field shall only be set to 'true' when required by used TCE.

iFFreqEARFCN.description: This parameter contains frequency used for inter-frequency MDT.

iFMDTPercentage.description: This parameter defines the percentage of MDT UEs configured for inter-frequency UE periodic measurement.

immedMDTAnonymization.description:
This parameter provides anonymization of MDT data to prevent subscriber identity from being sent to the Trace Collection Entity (TCE).  

It is only used when Job Type is "Immediate MDT Only" or "Immediate MDT and Trace". 
IMEI-TAC = The eNB shall send the CELL TRAFFIC TRACE message to the MME with the Privacy Indicator information element. 

No identity = The eNB shall not send the CELL TRAFFIC TRACE message to the MME.

immedMDTForceUEConsent.description:
This parameter controls whether the eNB will utilize or ignore the user consent for management based MDT when selecting UEs for Immediate MDT.


False - user consent not forced, i.e. the eNB considers "Management Based MDT Allowed" information element when selecting UE.

True - user consent forced, i.e. the eNB ignores "Management Based MDT Allowed" information element when selecting UE.

immedMDTObtainLocation.description:
This parameter controls whether the eNB requests the UE to attempt to provide detailed location information.

It is only used when the Job Type is "Immediate MDT Only" or "Immediate MDT and Trace".
The UE is requested to attempt to have valid detailed location information available whenever sending a measurement report for which it is configured to include available detailed location information. The UE may not succeed e.g. because the user manually disabled the GPS hardware, due to no/poor satellite coverage. Further details, e.g. regarding when to activate GNSS, are up to UE implementation.

False – The eNB does not send the obtainLocationConfig-r11 field in RRC signaling to UE.

True – The eNB sends the obtainLocationConfig-r11 field in RRC signaling to UEs which are GNSS capable and are 3GPP Release 11 (or higher).

immedMDTPosMethod.description:
This parameter defines whether GNSS positioning method is applied to the Immediate MDT job or no positioning method is used.

For 'GNSS' method, the eNB will send the RRC includeLocationInfo field to the UE as part of measurement configuration.  The UE will provide the GPS location information, if available, in the measurement report.

It is only used when the Job Type is set to "Immediate MDT" or "Immediate MDT and Trace".  

Only GNSS is supported as a positioning method with Immediate MDT (E-Cell ID is not supported, but defined in TS 32.422 for positioning method)

immedMDTSelectOnlyGNSSUes.description:
This parameter is used to limit the Immediate MDT to those UEs which are GNSS capable.  It is used when the Job Type is "Immediate MDT Only" or "Immediate MDT and Trace".
False – any UE (independent of GNSS capability) can be considered for Immediate MDT. 

True – only GNSS capable UEs wil be configured for Immediate MDT.
immedMDTSelectOnlyGNSSUes.fullName: Immediate MDT select only GNSS UEs

interfaceSelection.description:
This optional parameter allows the operator to choose the interface type for the trace session.

For NetAct TraceViewer only the old (NSNTI) interface is possible.
When PCMD reporting is enabled or forceUeIdsRepetition is 'true' only the new (NSETAP) interface is possible.

jobType.description:
This parameter describes the type of trace session: ImmediateMDTOnly, ImmediateMDTAndTrace, TraceOnly or RLFReportsOnly. It shall be set by the operator.
For each cell there can be only one MTRACE object with jobType set to ImmediateMDTOnly or ImmediateMDTAndTrace.

lcrId.description:
This parameter contains the Local Cell Resource Identifier (lcrId) of the Cell corresponding to the traced cell. It is the same as contained under LNCEL object.
MTRACE-lcrId shall be related to a real cell inside the eNB.
This contains the local cell resource identifier of the cell for which trace needs to be enabled.

If this optional parameter is empty, i.e. if no lcrId is provided the trace session is valid for all cells in the eNB.

mTraceId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of the MOC MTRACE.
Due to support of 96 cells per eNB the maximum number of cell trace sessions is extended, too.

maxBufferingTime.description: This parameter configures the maximum buffering time for trace records until they are sent to the TCE.

measBW.description: This parameter contains measurement bandwidth for frequency used in inter-frequency MDT.
measBW.officialRange:
0: mbw6 
1: mbw15 
2: mbw25 
3: mbw50 
4: mbw75 
5: mbw100

pDSCHPRBNumberTracing.description: Parameter pDSCHPRBNumberTracing configures whether tracing of PDSCH PRB Number Tracing, as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing, is enabled or not.

pHRTracing.description: This parameter describes whether tracing of PHR as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing is enabled or not.

pUSCHPRBNumberTracing.description: Parameter pUSCHPRBNumberTracing configures whether tracing of PUSCH PRB Number Tracing, as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing, is enabled or not.

reportAmount.description: Number of periodic ReportStrongestCells measurement reports configured at the UE

reportInterval.description: Time interval between two consecutive periodic ReportStrongestCells measurement reports configured at the UE

ripReportInterval.description: Parameter ripReportInterval defines the reporting interval for RIP measurements.

ripReportType.description: There are two types of RIP reporting: type1 for per RB&subframe&slot reporting (value RB_subframe_slot) and type2 for per subframe&slot based reporting (value subframe_slot).

ripTracing.description: Parameter ripTracing configures whether tracing of RIP as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing is enabled or not.

tATracingSynch.description: This parameter describes whether tracing of TA as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing is enabled or not.

tceCellTracePortNum.description: The Trace Port Number to be used for this Cell trace session while establishing trace connection(TCP) towards 3rd Party Tool. This will be used only if 3rd Party Tracing for Cell Trace is used.
tceCellTracePortNum.fullName: 3rd party tool cell trace port number

tceIpAddress.description:
IP address of the trace collection entity of 3rd Party Tool. This will be used only if  3rd Party Tracing for Cell Trace is enabled and the provided IP address is different from NetAct IP address.
This is the IP address of Trace Collection Entity i.e to which all trace records are sent for the user Trace Session.

If feature LTE955 is activated, the operator must provide an IPv6 address, otherwise the operator must provide an IPv4 address.

For IPv4, the parameter has to be entered in dotted decimal format.

For IPv6, the parameter has to be entered according to formats specified in RFC2460.

IPv4 address ranges:
It is not allowed to configure the address 0.0.0.0, the broadcast address 255.255.255.255 or an address within the range of multicast addresses
(224.0.0.0-239.255.255.255) or loop-back addresses (127.0.0.0-127.255.255.255).

IPv6 address ranges:
It is recommended to configure only an address within the range of Unique Local Unicast addresses (FC00::/7) or Global Unicast addresses (2000::/3).

traceId.description:
Trace ID identifies a cell trace session. In combination with PLMN ID, the identifier becomes unique.
Trace ID is part of Trace Reference contained in E-UTRAN Trace ID.
E-UTRAN Trace ID is unique id identifying a trace session.
E-UTRAN Trace ID is made up of Trace Reference and Trace Recording Session Reference.
Trace Reference is globally unique and is 6 Octect length comprising of:
MCC+MNC+Trace ID.

MCC+MNC is of 3 Octet length
Trace ID is of 3 Octet length

E-UTRAN Trace ID is one of the trace parameters received for a trace session.

traceRrcMsgCategory.description:
If traceRrcMsgCategory = UEspecific then the parameter traceRrcUeSpecMsgLst contains list of UE specific messages to be traced.
If traceRrcMsgCategory = nonUEspecific then the parameter traceRrcNonUeSpecMsgLst contains list of n
on-UE specific messages to be traced.
If traceRrcMsgCategory = all then the both lists are present.

traceRrcNonUeSpecMsgList.description:
If traceRrcMsgCategory = all or traceRrcMsgCategory = nonUEspecific then traceRrcNonUeSpecMsgList contains list of enum for the non-UE specific messages to be traced.
Note: These non-UE specific (eNB related) messages (e.g. Paging) were not included in RL20 cell trace, but only in interface trace.
traceRrcNonUeSpecMsgList.fullName: Trace RRC non UE spec msg list

traceRrcSetting.description: This parameter indicates if all RRC messages are traced (all), specific list(s) of RRC messages as defined in parameter traceRrcMsgCategory (specific), or RRC not traced at all (none).

traceRrcUeSpecMsgList.description: If traceRrcMsgCategory = all or traceRrcMsgCategory = UEspecific then traceRrcUeSpecMsgList contains list of enum for the UE specific messages to be traced.
traceRrcUeSpecMsgList.fullName: Trace RRC UE spec msg list

traceS1MsgCategory.description:
If traceS1MsgCategory = UEspecific then the parameter traceS1UeSpecMsgLst contains list of UE specific messages to be traced.
If traceS1MsgCategory = nonUEspecific then the parameter traceS1NonUeSpecMsgLst contains list of non-UE specific messages to be traced.
If traceS1MsgCategory = all then the both lists are present.

traceS1NonUeSpecMsgList.description:
If traceS1MsgCategory = all or traceS1MsgCategory = nonUEspecific then traceS1NonUeSpecMsgList contains list of enum for the non-UE specific messages to be traced.
Note: These non-UE specific (eNB related) messages (e.g. S1 setup or reset) were not included in RL20 cell trace, but only in interface trace.
traceS1NonUeSpecMsgList.fullName: Trace S1 non UE spec msg list

traceS1Setting.description: This parameter indicates if all S1 messages are traced (all), specific list(s) of S1 messages as defined in parameter traceS1MsgCategory (specific), or S1 not traced at all (none).

traceS1UeSpecMsgList.description: If traceS1MsgCategory = all or traceS1MsgCategory = UEspecific then traceS1UeSpecMsgList contains list of enum for the UE specific messages to be traced.
traceS1UeSpecMsgList.fullName: Trace S1 UE spec msg list

traceX2MsgCategory.description:
If traceX2MsgCategory = UEspecific then the parameter traceX2UeSpecMsgLst contains list of UE specific messages to be traced.
If traceX2MsgCategory = nonUEspecific then the parameter traceX2NonUeSpecMsgLst contains list of non-UE specific messages to be traced.
If traceX2MsgCategory = all then the both lists are present.

traceX2NonUeSpecMsgList.description:
If traceX2MsgCategory = all or traceX2MsgCategory = nonUEspecific then traceX2NonUeSpecMsgList contains list of enum for the non-UE specific messages to be traced.
Note: These non-UE specific (eNB related) messages (e.g. X2 setup or reset) were not included in RL20 cell trace, but only in interface trace.
traceX2NonUeSpecMsgList.fullName: Trace X2 non UE spec msg list

traceX2Setting.description: This parameter indicates if all X2 messages are traced (all), specific list(s) of X2 messages as defined in parameter traceX2MsgCategory (specific), or X2 not traced at all (none).

traceX2UeSpecMsgList.description: If traceX2MsgCategory = all or traceX2MsgCategory = UEspecific then traceX2UeSpecMsgList contains list of enum for the UE specific messages to be traced.
traceX2UeSpecMsgList.fullName: Trace X2 UE spec msg list

trcRecSessionRef.description:
Trace Recording Session Reference is set to invalid value for Cell trace session by O&M as it does not need this. It is set by system for identification of every call in a cell and is written into Trace Report for the cell.
Trace Recording Session Reference is part of E-UTRAN Trace ID.
It is 2 Octet length.

uEBSRTracing.description: Parameter uEBSRTracing configures whether tracing of UE Buffer Status Report Tracing, as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing, is enabled or not.

uERankTracing.description: Parameter uERankTracing configures whether tracing of UE RANK, as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing, is enabled or not.

uLSINRTracing.description: This parameter describes whether tracing of UL SINR as part of enhanced vendor specific extension tracing is enabled or not.

mTraceSpareId.description:
This parameter is the naming attribute of MOC MTRACESPARE.
It uniquely identifies an MTRACESPARE instance.

name.description:
This is the name of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The content is filled by the BTS and cannot be changed.

The mapping of the parameter to the particular feature is defined in the documentation.

value.description:
This is the value of the parameter and the class it belongs to. The allowed parameter values are defined in the feature specification.

The value of this spare parameter must be according to the provided information. It need to be case sensitive. In case the specified value doesn't match the supported values for this spare parameter, the BTS will reject the configuration.

ackNACKNumRep.description: The repetition number for UEs sending ACK/NACK for downlink data transfer. See TS 36.211  and TS 36.213 . If absent, the value of ack-NACK-NumRepetitions-Msg4 signalled in SIB2-NB is used.
ackNACKNumRep.fullName: Repetition Number of ACK/NACK for NB-IoT

ackNACKNumRepMsg4.description: The repetition number for UEs sending ACK/NACK for downlink message4.
ackNACKNumRepMsg4.fullName: Repetition Number of Msg4 ACK/NACK for NB-IoT

ackNACKNumRepNBCL0.description: The repetition number for UEs sending ACK/NACK for downlink data transfer in the NB-IoT Coverage Level 0. See TS 36.211  and TS 36.213.
ackNACKNumRepNBCL0.fullName: Repetition Number of ACK/NACK for NB-IoT Coverage Level 0

ackNACKNumRepNBCL1.description: The repetition number for UEs sending ACK/NACK for downlink data transfer in the NB-IoT Coverage Level 1. See TS 36.211  and TS 36.213.
ackNACKNumRepNBCL1.fullName: Repetition Number of ACK/NACK for NB-IoT Coverage Level 1

ackNACKNumRepNBCL2.description: The repetition number for UEs sending ACK/NACK for downlink data transfer in the NB-IoT Coverage Level 2. See TS 36.211  and TS 36.213.
ackNACKNumRepNBCL2.fullName: Repetition Number of ACK/NACK for NB-IoT Coverage Level 2

cpInactivityTimerNB.description: The parameter defines the time period for the indication of the UE- associated S1 logical connection inactivity in both DL and UL directions.

defPagCycNB.description: Default paging cycle of NB-IoT, referred to ‘T’ in TS 36.304
defPagCycNB.fullName: Default paging cycle for NB-IoT cell

defaultPagNumRep.description:
Default number of NPDCCH repetitions for paging if not presented in the paging message from MME.
This information is optional IE and is provided transparently by the serving eNB to the MME at transition to ECM_IDLE together with the respective cell identifier and is provided to the E-UTRAN during paging.
defaultPagNumRep.fullName: Default number of repetition for paging

iniMcsDl.description:
Initial downlink modulation and coding scheme for NB-IoT UEs.

Note: 
The highest MCS used in downlink NPDSCH transmission of Rel-13 NB-IoT UE is 12.
The highest MCS used in downlink NPDSCH transmission of Rel-14 NB-IoT UE is 13.

iniMcsUl.description: Initial uplink modulation and coding scheme for NB-IoT UEs.

iniNpdcchNumRepRa.description: Initial NPDCCH repetition number for NPDCCH common search space (CSS) (including RAR, Msg3 retransmission, and Msg4), and User Specific Search Space (USS) for data transmission.
iniNpdcchNumRepRa.fullName: Initial repetition number of NPDCCH for RA

iniNpdschNumRep.description: Initial unicast NPDSCH repetition number for NB-IoT UEs.

iniNpuschNumRep.description: Initial unicast NPUSCH repetition number for NB-IoT UE.

loadWeightAnchHighCL.description: Load weighting factor for NB-IoT UE in highest coverage level for carrier selection
loadWeightAnchHighCL.fullName: Load weighting factor for NB-IoT UE in Anchor carrier of highest coverage level

logicalChanSrProhibitTimerNB.description: Timer used to delay the transmission of an SR in NB-IoT, to wait the potential UL grant for the UL transmission.
logicalChanSrProhibitTimerNB.fullName: Logical channel SR prohibit timer for NB-IoT

maxRetxThreNB.description: The maximum number of  poll retransmission for the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in NB-IoT.

npdcchMaxNumRepPag.description:
Maximum number of repetitions for N-PDCCH common search space (CSS) for paging.
Note:  If there are multiple NB-IoT coverage levels configured, the parameter npdcchMaxNumRep should be set to the value which can satisfy the worst condition for all coverage levels.
npdcchMaxNumRepPag.fullName: Maximum number of repetitions for NPDCCH common search space for paging

npdcchMaxNumRepRa.description:
The maximum number of NPDCCH repetitions the UE needs to monitor for Common Search Space (CSS) (including RAR, Msg3 retransmission, and Msg4).

Note:
(1) If numCoverageLevels is equal to 3, all NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
(2) The operator must set npdcchStartSfRa to v2 or v4 or v8 if numSib1RepNB, siWindowLenNB, sib2PeriodicityNB, sib2RepPatternNB are set to other values than the default values with more invalid subframes in downlink.
npdcchMaxNumRepRa.fullName: Maximum number of repetitions for NPDCCH common search space for RA

npdcchOffsetRa.description:
Fractional period offset of starting subframe for NPDCCH CSS,see TS 36.211 and TS 36.213.

Note: If numCoverageLevels is equal to 3, all NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
npdcchOffsetRa.fullName: Offset for NPDCCH Common Search Space

npdcchStartSfRa.description:
The starting subframes configuration of the NPDCCH CSS for RAR/Msg3 re-transmission/Msg4,see TS 36.211 and TS 36.213.

Note:
(1) If numCoverageLevels is equal to 3, all NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
(2) The operator must set npdcchStartSfRa to v2 or v4 or v8 if numSib1RepNB, siWindowLenNB, sib2PeriodicityNB, sib2RepPatternNB are set to other values than the default values with more invalid subframes in downlink.
npdcchStartSfRa.fullName: Starting subframes of the NPDCCH Common Search Space for RA

nprachCpLen.description: Cyclic prefix length for NPRACH transmission.

nprachMaxNumPreambleCE.description: Number of maximum preamble transmission attempts per NPRACH resource.
nprachMaxNumPreambleCE.fullName: Max number of preamble attempts of NPRACH

nprachNumRepPreamble.description:
Number of NPRACH repetitions per attempt for each NPRACH resource.

Note: If numCoverageLevels is equal to 3, all NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
nprachNumRepPreamble.fullName: Number of repetitions per preamble attempt of NPRACH

nprachNumSubcarriers.description:
Number of subcarriers in a NPRACH resource.

Note: If numCoverageLevels is equal to 3, all NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

nprachPeriod.description:
Periodicity of a NPRACH resource.

Note: If numCoverageLevels is equal to 3, all NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

nprachStartTime.description:
Start time of the NPRACH resource in one period.

Note: If numCoverageLevels is equal to 3, all NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

nprachSubcarrierOffset.description:
Frequency location of the NPRACH resource.

Note: If numCoverageLevels is equal to 3, all NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

numSib1RepNB.description:
Number of repetition of SIB1-NB in periodicity 2560ms.

Note: All NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

pagAttMaxCovNB.description: This parameter indicates a threshold in case of Paging Attempt Count greater than or equal to this, eNB shall apply the highest (maximum) configured coverage level parameters for NPDCCH and NPDSCH
pagAttMaxCovNB.fullName: Maximum Coverage Level used for NB-IoT further paging attempts

pagingNbNB.description: NB-IoT nB is used as one of parameters to derive the Paging Frame and Paging Occasion according to TS 36.304. Value in multiples of 'T' as defined in TS 36.304. A value of fourT corresponds to 4 * T, a value of twoT corresponds to 2 * T and so on.
pagingNbNB.officialRange:
4: quarterT 
5: one8thT 
6: one16thT 
7: one32ndT 
8: one64thT 
9: one128thT 
10: one256thT 
11: one512thT 
12: one1024thT

raContResoTimNB.description: The maximum contention resolution timer parameter defines the maximum amount of time allowed for the contention resolution in NB-IoT.

raRespWinSizeNB.description: Random Access Response Window Size parameter defines the window size for the random access response in NB-IoT.
raRespWinSizeNB.fullName: RA response window size for NB-IoT

rrcGuardTimerNB.description: This timer for NB-IoT is started when an RRC message for setup, modification or release of a radio bearer is sent to the UE. When the timer expires, the corresponding procedure is aborted.
rrcGuardTimerNB.fullName: RRC guard timer radio bearer management for NB-IoT

siMessagePeriodicityNB.description:
Periodicity of this NB-IoT SI-Message.

Note: All NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

siMessageRepPatternNB.description:
Number of NB-IoT SI-Message Repetitions.

Note: All NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

siMessageSibTypeNB.description:
Indicates which SIB is contained in the NB-IoT SI-Message

Note: All NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
siMessageSibTypeNB.fullName: SI-Message of SIB Type for NB-IoT

siRadioFrameOffNB.description:
Offset in number of radio frames to calculate the start of the SI window.

Note: All NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
siRadioFrameOffNB.fullName: Offset of the start of SI-NB window

siWindowLenNB.description:
Common SI scheduling window for all SIs.

Note: All NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

sib2PeriodicityNB.description:
Periodicity of the SIB2-NB in radio frames

Note: All NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

sib2RepPatternNB.description:
Indicates the starting radio frames within the SI window used for SI message transmission. Value every2ndRF corresponds to every second radio frame, value every4thRF corresponds to every fourth radio frame and so on starting from the first radio frame of the SI window used for SI transmission.

Note: All NB-IoT UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.

srbInactivityTimerNB.description: The parameter defines the time period for the indication of the UE inactivity on signalling radio bearer in both DL and UL directions.

t300NB.description:
Timer T300-NB supervises the RRC connection establishment procedure for NB-IoT. 
Timer guard the period between RRCConnectionRequest-NB
and reception of RRCConnectionSetup-NB or RRCConnectionReject-NB message for NB-IoT.
Note:  If there are multiple NB-IoT coverage levels configured, the parameter t300NB should be set to the value which can satisfy the worst condition for all coverage levels.

t301NB.description:
Timer T301-NB supervises the RRC reestablishment procedure for NB-IoT.
Timer guard the period between RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest
and reception of RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject  message for NB-IoT.

t310NB.description:
Timer T310-NB supervises the recovery from physical layer problems for NB-IoT. Timer starts upon detecting physical layer problems  i.e. upon receiving n310 consecutive out-of sync indications from lower layers and stops upon receiving  n311 consecutive in-sync indications from lower layers, upon triggering the handover procedure and upon initiating the connection re-establishment procedure.

Note:  If there are multiple NB-IoT coverage levels configured, the parameter should be set to the value which can satisfy the worst condition for all coverage levels.

tExtendedWaitNB.description:
tExtendedWaitNB suppresses the reselection of a NB-IoT cell for a while.
eNB sends this parameter to the NB-IoT UE in the message 
-RRC CONNECTION REJECT-NB 
-RRC CONNECTION RELEASE-NB. 
The NB-IoT UE will consider access to the NB-IoT cell as barred for the time specified by tExtendedWaitNB.

tHalfRrcConNB.description:
The minimal time period for NB-IoT during which the internal state and the resources associated with an half-open RRC connection (i.e. one for which no RRC connection setup complete message has yet been received) must not be deleted in the eNB.

Note:  If there are multiple NB-IoT coverage levels configured, the parameter should be set to the value which can satisfy the worst condition for all coverage levels.
tHalfRrcConNB.fullName: Timer min lifetime of half-open RRC connection for NB-IoT

tL2AckRrcRelNB.description:
The maximum time period indicates the time after which the RRC L3 releases the RRC connection for NB-IoT context, if no positive ack is received from RLC to the RRC CONNECTION RELEASE-NB message.  This timer has to absorb the potential preceding NAS transmission, which can be approximated via rrcGuardTimerNB.  This timer is reset to 10 second upon reception of L1 HARQ ACK of RRC Connection Release, as per 3GPP R2-169034.
Note:The recommended value can be tPollRetrNB of highest coverage level * (maxRetxThreNB + 1)
tL2AckRrcRelNB.fullName: Timer missing L2 ack for NB-IoT RRC connection release

tPollRetrNB.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter t-PollRetransmit-r13 of [36.331].
This timer is used by the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll.

tReTxBsrTimeNB.description: Time when the regular BSRs are repeated in NB-IoT when the UE has data available for transmission and no corresponding UL grant is received so far.
tReTxBsrTimeNB.officialRange:
0: pp4 
1: pp16 
2: pp64 
3: pp128 
4: pp256 
5: pp512 
6: infinity

nbIoTPrSpareId.description:

NBIOT_FDD.officialFullName: NarrowBand Internet of Things in FDD

actHighTbsNB2.description: This parameter activates NB-IoT Rel-14 higher TBS

actMultiTones.description: This parameter activates NB-IoT multi-tone in uplink

assignedNonAnchGuardbandIndexDL.description: The Frequency offset for downlink of guardband NB-IoT Non-Anchor carrier, automatically assigned by Non-Anchor carrier algorithm.
assignedNonAnchGuardbandIndexDL.fullName: Assigned Guardband NB-IoT downlink Non-Anchor PRB index

assignedNonAnchGuardbandIndexUL.description: The frequency offset for a guardband NB-IoT uplink non-anchor carrier, automatically assigned by non-anchor carrier algorithm.
assignedNonAnchGuardbandIndexUL.fullName: Assigned PRB index of guardband NB-IoT uplink non-anchor carriers

assignedNonAnchInbandPRBIndexDL.description: The PRB index of downlink of inband NB-IoT Non-Anchor carrier, automatically assigned by Non-Anchor carrier algorithm.
assignedNonAnchInbandPRBIndexDL.fullName: Assigned PRB index of inband NB-IoT downlink Non-Anchor carriers

assignedNonAnchInbandPRBIndexUL.description: The PRB index of an inband NB-IoT uplink non-anchor carrier, automatically assigned by non-anchor carrier algorithm.
assignedNonAnchInbandPRBIndexUL.fullName: Assigned PRB index of inband NB-IoT uplink non-anchor carriers

baseSequenceMt3.description: Defines base sequence of DMRS for NB-IoT uplink 3 tones. If this parameter is not configured, it is given by NB-IoT phyCellId mod 12.
baseSequenceMt3.fullName: Base sequence of DMRS for NB-IoT uplink 3 tones

baseSequenceMt6.description: Defines base sequence of DMRS for NB-IoT uplink 6 tones. If this parameter is not configured, it is given by NB-IoT phyCellId mod 14.
baseSequenceMt6.fullName: Base sequence of DMRS for NB-IoT uplink 6 tones

cyclicShiftMt3.description: Defines cyclic shift of uplink reference signals for NB-IoT 3 tones.
cyclicShiftMt3.fullName: Cyclic Shift for NB-IoT uplink 3 tones

cyclicShiftMt6.description: Defines cyclic shift of uplink reference signals for NB-IoT 6 tones.
cyclicShiftMt6.fullName: Cyclic Shift for NB-IoT uplink 6 tones

dlChBw.description: Downlink channel bandwidth of NB-IoT cell, fixed to 200kHz

dlPwrBoost.description: Downlink channel power boost for inband and guardband NB-IoT
dlPwrBoost.fullName: Downlink channel power boost for inband or guardband NB-IoT

guardbandIndexDL.description:
eNB will dynamically decide if deployment change is needed and which cells are affected by the possible deployment change.
This parameter indicates the Frequency offset for guardband NB-IoT downlink anchor carrier.
guardbandIndexDL.fullName: NB-IoT guardband downlink Anchor PRB index

guardbandIndexUL.description:
This parameter indicates the Frequency offset in Anchor carrier for guardband NB-IoT uplink.
eNB will dynamically decide if deployment change is needed and which cells are affected by the possible deployment change
guardbandIndexUL.fullName: NBIoT guardband uplink Anchor PRB index

inbandPRBIndexDL.description:
This parameter indicates the PRB index of the host LTE cell used for NB-IoT inband downlink anchor carrier.
Only following anchor PRB indices are allowed to be used for inband NB-IoT based on the bandwidth of the host LTE cell:
5MHz: 2, 7, 17, 22
10MHz: 4, 9, 14, 19, 30, 35, 40, 45
15MHz: 2, 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, 32, 42, 47, 52, 57, 62, 67, 72
20MHz: 4, 9, 14, 19, 24, 29, 34, 39, 44, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95
inbandPRBIndexDL.fullName: NB-IoT inband downlink Anchor PRB index

inbandPRBIndexUL.description:
This parameter indicates the Anchor PRB index of the host LTE cell used for NB-IoT inband uplink.
The PRB index used for NB-IoT must not be configured to the resources used by PUCCH and PRACH in the host LTE cell.
inbandPRBIndexUL.fullName: NBIoT inband uplink Anchor PRB index

maxCoverageMCL.description:
Maximum Coupling Loss (MCL) for NB-IoT cell that NB-IoT UE can access.
144dB: Up to 144dB MCL limited by minimum receive level
154dB: Up to 154dB MCL limited by minimum receive level
164dB: Up to 164dB MCL limited by minimum receive level
Note: The maximum coupling loss which can be reached may also be limited by the maximum transmission power of the radio (e.g. small cells).
maxCoverageMCL.fullName: Maximum Coupling Loss (MCL) for NB-IoT cell

maxCrPgDlNB.description:
The parameter defines the maximum code rate for paging for NB-IoT. This maximum code rate is taken into account during NPDSCH scheduling.

Note:
The amount of paging records being transmitted per paging occasion is limited such that the configured code rate is not exceeded; a single paging record is transmitted in any case.

maxNumRrcNB.description:
Threshold for the maximum number of NB-IoT UEs in the cell which may establish a RRC connection.

Additionally for the inband NB-IoT cell:
The wideband LTE UEs in host LTE cell and NB-IoT UEs share the common threshold of maximum number for RRC connected UEs (maxNumRrc) defined in the host LTE cell.
If actAutoPucchAlloc is disabled:
The maxNumRrcNB should be set smaller than maxNumRrc in host cell.
If actAutoPucchAlloc is enabled:
The maxNumRrcNB should be set smaller than maxNumActUE + aPucchMinNumRrcNoDrb in host cell.

nprachConfigIndex.description:
This parameter indicates NPRACH configuration pattern will be pre-defined or manually configured. 
If 'Manual Configuration' is selected, the NPRACH configuration will be set based on the parameters in NBIOTPR profile.
If any pre-defined pattern is selected, the NPRACH configuration will be decided from pre-defined pattern.
nprachConfigIndex.officialRange:
0: Manual Configuration 
11: Pre-defined pattern 1-1 
12: Pre-defined pattern 1-2 
21: Pre-defined pattern 2-1 
22: Pre-defined pattern 2-2 
31: Pre-defined pattern 3-1 
32: Pre-defined pattern 3-2

nprachRsrpThreshold1.description: The RSRP threshold to separate NB-IoT Coverage Level 0 (RSRP measurement >= this threshold) and  Coverage Level 1 (RSRP measurement < this threshold).

nprachRsrpThreshold2.description: The RSRP threshold to separate NB-IoT Coverage Level 1 (RSRP measurement >= this threshold) and Coverage Level 2 (RSRP measurement < this threshold).

startingCovLevelPagingOptNB.description:
Starting Coverage Level supports Paging Optimization configured for NB-IoT cell. Paging optimization will send the paging over specific cell for first paging message from MME, and paging over TAC region for re-paging messages from MME.
i.e.
Coverage Level 0 - Paging Optimization support start from  coverage level 0 (all levels)
Coverage Level 1 - Paging Optimization support start from  coverage level 1
Coverage Level 2 - Paging Optimization support in coverage level 2
if this parameter is not configured, then this function is considered to be disabled.
startingCovLevelPagingOptNB.fullName: Starting Coverage Level supports Paging Optimization for NB-IoT
startingCovLevelPagingOptNB.officialRange:
0: Coverage Level 0 
10: Coverage Level 1 
20: Coverage Level 2

syncSigTxMode.description: The parameter determines whether NB-IoT Primary and Secondary Synchronization Signals (NPSS, NSSS) are transmitted into a cell via one antenna port (SingleTx) or via all antenna ports using TX diversity with Precoding Vector Switching (PVS).

tCellDelNB.description:
The guard time period indicates the time after which the eNB forces the release of UE context(s) for NB-IoT cell deletion, even if not all RRC Connections were released yet.
Note: ‘force release’ means that UE Contexts are released by the eNB without waiting for their ordinary termination.

sCellActivationMethod.description:
This parameter defines the method to be used for SCell activation.
The meaning of the values is as follows:
'blind' means that SCell is blindly activated and it is never re-activated after the expiration of the timer sCellDeactivationTimerEnb.
'nonGBRBufferBased' means that SCell activation is triggered depending on the non-GBR data in the buffer. For a UE with two configured SCells, SCell activation is triggered depending on the non-GBR data in the buffer in a joint way, i.e., one MAC CE command activates all SCells.
'nonGBRBufferBasedStepWise' means that for a UE with two configured SCells, SCell activation by one or more separate MAC CE command(s) is triggered depending on the non-GBR data in buffer in a step-wise way. In the first step one SCell is activated depending on the non-GBR data in buffer and after that depending on the non-GBR data in buffer the second SCell is activated if needed.

Note: The period of the SCell activation cycle is configured in sCellActivationCyclePeriod.

With actULCAggr=UL_CA_with_smartSched, a DL&UL sCell's activation will be triggered by eNB to reach fast load balance purpose, this kind of sCell activation trigger scheme works without regard to sCellActivationMethod setting.

cellBarred.description:
The cell barred flag indicates if the cell status is barred or not. A barred cell is a cell that a UE is not allowed to camp on, not even for emergency calls. If a cell on which a UE is currently camped becomes barred, a cell reselection is triggered.

The setting is commonly valid for all legacy category UE and Cat-M UE.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.

cellDepType.description: Defines the NR cell's deployment/dependency type: whether it operates only as an EN-DC secondary (NSA) cell, as a Standalone (SA) cell, or supports both NSA and SA operation simultaneously.

cellIndividualSsbRsrpOffset.description: A Cell Individual Offset applied to this cell's SSB RSRP measurement results when UEs evaluate it for mobility (reselection/handover), biasing how attractive the cell appears relative to its true measured signal strength.

cellIndividualSsbRsrqOffset.description: A Cell Individual Offset applied to this cell's SSB RSRQ measurement results for mobility evaluation purposes, analogous to the RSRP offset but based on signal quality rather than strength.

cellName.description:
This parameter allows the operator to give a cell a unique name.

The range represents the number of bytes to store all the characters of the string. If the string is UTF-8 encoded, each character occupies between 1 to 4 bytes, depending upon the language. If ASCII encoded, each character occupies a single byte. The numbers of characters supported in case of UTF-8 encoding is at least 20.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.

cellTechnology.description: This parameter identifies of the LNCEL instance shall be used as FDD or TDD cell. Dependent on the configuration of the technology, subordinated classes to the LNCEL have to be configured.

chBw.description:
Channel Bandwidth defines the Downlink and Uplink bandwidth for the eNode-B transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks which is transmitted in the MIB. The Channel Bandwidth mapping to Number of Physical Resource Blocks is: 1.4 MHz = 6 PRB; 3.0 MHz = 15 PRB; 5.0 MHz = 25 PRB; 10.0 MHz = 50 PRB; 15.0 MHz = 75 PRB; 20.0 MHz = 100 PRB.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

pMax.description:
This parameter defines the maximum output power of the cell per antenna carrier in dBm. The maximum output power is the maximum value for the linear sum of the power of all downlink physical channels that is allowed to be used in a cell. The reference point is the antenna connector.
The most common configurable dBm values correspond to following Watt:
10.0 dBm =  10 mW
37.0 dBm =   5 W
39.0 dBm =   8 W
40.0 dBm =  10 W
41.8 dBm =  15 W
43.0 dBm =  20 W
44.3 dBm =  27 W
44.8 dBm =  30 W
46.0 dBm =  40 W
46.5 dBm =  45 W
47.8 dBm =  60 W
49.0 dBm =  80 W

For low power RRH the carrier power value is used for repeater(s) connected to low power RRH, where the carrier power value in RRH is fixed. For example FHCB output power is fixed to 10 mW (10 dBm) and FHEC output power is fixed to 1 mW (0 dBm).

Note for LTE-GSM sharing configurations:
45W and 80W power level is only supported in LTE dedicated configuration.

Note: The allowed cell power value which are allowed to be configured depend on the used hardware variant. During online commissioning the BTS Site Manager will based on the hardware variant support only the allowed values. Please refer to the documentation where per variant the supported power values are specified.

Note: for RF sharing configurations:
When same antenna line is shared with other technology it needs to be ensured that maximum supported power per antenna line is not exceeded.
Note: This parameter used for NB-IoT standalone cell.

t300.description:
Timer T300 supervises the RRC connection establishment procedure. 
Start: Transmission of RRCConnectionRequest
Stop: Reception of RRCConnectionSetup or RRCConnectionReject message, cell re-selection and upon abortion of connection establishment by upper layers

At expiry: Perform the actions as specified in 36.331, 5.3.3.6

In case LNBTS-actContextPreemption is activated, the minimum recommended value is 600ms. If both LNBTS-actContextPreemption and LNBTS-actSatBackhaul are activated the minimum recommended value is further increased to 1500ms.

t301.description:
Timer T301 supervises the RRC connection re-establishment procedure. 
Start: Transmission of RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest
Stop: Reception of RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject message as well as when the selected cell becomes unsuitable

At expiry: Go to RRC_IDLE

b1ThresholdNrRsrp.description:
RSRP threshold of neighbor NR cell for triggering of B1 event.
Set in nr-RSRP-r15 of B1 event of ReportConfigInterRAT for NR frequency measurement.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
b1ThresholdNrRsrp.fullName: B1 RSRP treshold for NR DC

b1ThresholdNrRsrq.description:
RSRQ threshold of neighbor NR cell for triggering of B1 event.
Set in nr-RSRQ-r15 of B1 event of ReportConfigInterRAT for NR frequency measurement.

The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB
b1ThresholdNrRsrq.fullName: B1 RSRQ treshold for NR DC

enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.description:
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset defines the power reduction applied by the eNB to the UE maximum transmit power (maxUEtxPower) to derive the maximum power value (p-MaxEUTRA) that the UE can transmit to the EUTRA when  in EN-DC as follows:
p-maxEUTRA [dBm] = maxUEtxPower[dBm] - enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset [dB].

Where:
- maxUEtxPower is the UE maximum UE transmit power per corresponding EN-DC power class (see TS 38.101-3). 
- p-maxEUTRA is the value configured by the eNB to the UE (see TS 36.331).

Note: p-MaxEUTRA value provided to the UE may be further limited by the UL maximum power allowed in the UE LTE PCell (i.e. via the parameter lteULpMaxOwnCell)
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.fullName: p-MaxEUTRA power offset applied in EN-DC

enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset.description:
enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset defines the power reduction applied by the eNB to the UE maximum transmit power (maxUEtxPower) to derive the maximum power value (p-MaxNR) that the UE can transmit to the NR when  in EN-DC as follows:
p-maxNR [dBm] = maxUEtxPower[dBm] - enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset [dB].

Where:
- maxUEtxPower is the UE maximum UE transmit power per corresponding EN-DC power class (see TS 38.101-3). 
- p-maxNR is the value configured by the en-gNB to the UE, based on indication received from the eNB (see TS 38.331).

Note: p-MaxNR value provided to the UE may be further limited by the UL maximum power allowed in the UE NR PSCell.

If set to value '-1', dynamic trigger based LTE-NR Dual Connectivity fo all cells of the BTS are enabled. In this case no dedicated cells are allowed to be configured, i.e. the list is allowed to include only one item.

b1ThresholdNrRsrp.description:
RSRP threshold of neighbor NR cell for triggering of B1 event.
Set in nr-RSRP-r15 of B1 event of ReportConfigInterRAT for NR frequency measurement.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm
b1ThresholdNrRsrp.fullName: B1 RSRP treshold for NR DC

b1ThresholdNrRsrq.description:
RSRQ threshold of neighbor NR cell for triggering of B1 event.
Set in nr-RSRQ-r15 of B1 event of ReportConfigInterRAT for NR frequency measurement.

The dB values are mapped to 3GPP IE values according to TS 36.133:
- -20 dB means a threshold lower than -19.5 dB
- values between -19.5 dB and -3.5 dB mean a threshold higher than or equal to the configured value but lower than (value + 0.5 dB)
- -3 dB means a threshold higher than or equal to -3 dB
b1ThresholdNrRsrq.fullName: B1 RSRQ treshold for NR DC

enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.description:
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset defines the power reduction applied by the eNB to the UE maximum transmit power (maxUEtxPower) to derive the maximum power value (p-MaxEUTRA) that the UE can transmit to the EUTRA when  in EN-DC as follows:
p-maxEUTRA [dBm] = maxUEtxPower[dBm] - enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset [dB].


Where:
- maxUEtxPower is the UE maximum UE transmit power per corresponding EN-DC power class (see TS 38.101-3). 
- p-maxEUTRA is the value configured by the eNB to the UE (see TS 36.331).

Note: p-MaxEUTRA value provided to the UE may be further limited by the parameter LTE_ULpMaxOwnCell
If not configured, the value from the default profile NRDCDPR is used.
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.fullName: p-MaxEUTRA power offset applied in EN-DC

enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset.description:
enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset defines the power reduction applied by the eNB to the UE maximum transmit power (maxUEtxPower) to derive the maximum power value (p-MaxNR) that the UE can transmit to the NR when  in EN-DC as follows:
p-maxNR [dBm] = maxUEtxPower[dBm] - enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset [dB].

Where:
- maxUEtxPower is the UE maximum UE transmit power per corresponding EN-DC power class (see TS 38.101-3). 
- p-maxNR is the value configured by the en-gNB to the UE, based on indication received from the eNB (see TS 38.331).

Note: p-MaxNR value provided to the UE may be further limited by the UL maximum power allowed in the UE NR PSCell
If not configured, the value from the default profile NRDCDPR is used.
enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset.fullName: p-MaxNR power offset applied in EN-DC

actLostPduFastRetx.description: Activates fast retransmission of PDUs detected as lost (e.g. via sequence-number gap detection) on this NR Data Radio Bearer, reducing recovery latency.

actOptDataFlowRateEst.description: Activates an optimized algorithm for estimating the data flow rate on this bearer, used to improve flow-control and buffer-management decisions.

allowedPdcchPowerBoostALDueCce.description: Configures the allowed PDCCH transmit-power boost (by aggregation level) applied when CCE (Control Channel Element) usage conditions warrant extra robustness.

The Resource Type indicates whether bearer is a GBR or NON-GBR bearer
The Resource Type determines if dedicated network resources related to a service or bearer level Guaranteed Bit Rate (GBR) value are permanently allocated.

rlcMode.description: This parameter configures the RLC Mode of the data radio bearer

schedulBSD.description:
This parameter is used to configure the Bucket Size Duration (BSD) of the UL scheduler
The BSD is sent to UE for the UL scheduling algorithm according [36.321].
The UE calculates the bucket size of a logical channel by PBR * BSD.

schedulPrio.description:

This priority is sent to UE for the UL scheduling algorithm according for DRB [36.321].
Increasing priority values indicate lower priority.

pdcpBufDiscardEnabled.description: Enables PDCP buffer-based SDU discard, whereby data is dropped once the PDCP transmit buffer exceeds a configured occupancy threshold.

pdcpBufDiscardThreshold.description: PDCP transmit-buffer occupancy threshold above which buffered SDUs start being discarded when buffer-based discard is enabled.

pdcpDelayThreshRetxMode.description: Controls whether/how PDCP delay-threshold-based retransmission handling is enabled (e.g. one or two configured delay thresholds active, or disabled).

tReorderingDl.description: The standard 3GPP PDCP t-Reordering timer for the downlink: how long the receiving PDCP entity waits for out-of-sequence PDUs before delivering to upper layers or declaring them lost.

tReorderingUl.description: The standard 3GPP PDCP t-Reordering timer for the uplink.

xxFlowControlProfForCuIdx.description: An index selecting a flow-control profile (a parameter set governing PDCP-level flow control between the CU and DU/CU-UP) applied to this bearer's PDCP entity.

dlMaxRetxThreshold.description: NR RLC AM maximum retransmission threshold: the maximum number of times an RLC PDU can be retransmitted before the link declares failure, the 5G/NR counterpart of maxRetxThresh.

dlPollByte.description: AM RLC Poll Byte value in DL direction for UE category 1.

dlPollPDU.description: Sets the number of downlink RLC AM PDUs after which the sender requests a status report from the receiver (the "poll" mechanism), for the NR Data Radio Bearer's RLC Acknowledged Mode entity. A value of "infinity" disables PDU-count-based polling so only other poll triggers (e.g. last PDU) are used.

dlTPollRetr.description: The RLC AM t-PollRetransmit timer for the downlink NR Data Radio Bearer: if the sender does not receive an expected status report before this timer expires, it re-triggers polling to recover from a lost poll or status PDU.

dlTProhib.description: The RLC AM t-StatusProhibit timer for the downlink: the minimum time the receiver must wait between sending two consecutive status reports, used to limit status-report signaling overhead.

dlTReassembly.description: The RLC t-Reassembly timer for the downlink: started when a gap in received sequence numbers is detected, used to wait briefly for out-of-order PDUs to arrive before declaring them lost and requesting retransmission.

dlTReassemblyIBCA.description: An RLC AM downlink t-Reassembly timer (milliseconds), used to detect missing RLC PDUs and trigger a status report/retransmission request; the IBCA suffix indicates a specific bearer-context variant.

duFlowControlProfId.description: An identifier selecting a preconfigured DU flow-control profile (a parameter set governing DU-CU data flow control) applied to this radio bearer's RLC AM entity.

ulMaxRetxThreshold.description: The maximum number of RLC retransmissions allowed for an uplink RLC AM PDU before the RLC layer declares a failure and reports it to upper layers (potentially triggering an RRC re-establishment / radio link failure).

ulPollByte.description: AM RLC Poll Byte value in UL direction for UE category 1.

ulPollPDU.description: Same as dlPollPDU but for the uplink direction: the number of RLC AM PDUs sent before the UE's RLC entity requests a status report from the network.

ulTPollRetr.description: The RLC AM t-PollRetransmit timer applied to the uplink RLC entity, governing when a poll is re-sent if no status report is received in time.

ulTProhib.description: The RLC AM t-StatusProhibit timer applied to the uplink RLC entity: minimum spacing enforced between consecutive status report transmissions.

ulTReassembly.description: The RLC t-Reassembly timer applied to the uplink RLC entity, used to detect and wait out reordering gaps before requesting retransmission of missing PDUs.

Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
